036fa8f7.title: Presales Solution Architect (Data & AI Solutions)
036fa8f7.description:
We’re a leader in data and AI. Through our software and services, we inspire customers around the world to transform data into intelligence \- and questions into answers.
   

  

 If you're looking for a dynamic, fulfilling career with flexibility and a world\-class employee experience, you'll find it here. We're recognized around the world for our inclusive, meaningful culture and innovative technologies by organizations like Fast Company, Forbes, Newsweek and more.
   

  

**Help Organizations Turn Ideas Into Impact**
 We are looking for a Presales Solution Architect who enjoys technology, likes building things, and wants to help organizations use data, AI, analytics, and decisioning to solve real business challenges.
   

  

 This is a customer\-facing, demo\-driven role for someone who enjoys exploring new technologies, building fast, and showing customers what is possible.
   

  

 Prior SAS experience is not required. We are looking for someone with curiosity, hands\-on ability, strong solution instincts, and the confidence to learn new platforms quickly.
   

  

**Why This Role Matters**
 Organizations across industries are working to improve services, make better decisions, reduce risk, improve compliance, and use data more effectively.
   

  

 In this role, you will help organizations explore practical ways to use data, AI, analytics, automation, and SAS solutions across areas such as citizen services, fraud detection, compliance, case management, public safety, healthcare, transport, finance, and policy analytics.
   

  

 You will not just talk about technology. You will help bring ideas to life through demos, prototypes, workshops, and solution stories that customers can see and understand.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
**Discover**
* Meet customers to understand their mission, priorities, challenges, and operating environment.
* Identify where data, AI, analytics, automation, and decisioning can create practical business value.


**Design**
* Turn customer needs into simple solution concepts, demo stories, architecture diagrams, proposal content, and RFP responses.
* Work with sales, product, delivery, partner, and SAS specialists to shape credible and useful solutions.


**Build**
* Build and customise demos, prototypes, proof\-of\-concepts, and solution walkthroughs.
* Explore new tools, APIs, datasets, cloud services, AI capabilities, and integration patterns.
* Move quickly from idea to prototype, making things work fast enough to support customer conversations and workshops.


**Showcase**
* Present solutions clearly to business, technical, leadership, and procurement audiences.
* Show how the solution works, what problem it solves, and why it matters.
* Help customers understand the value of better decisions, improved services, risk reduction, compliance, transparency, and operational efficiency.


**You’ll Enjoy This Role If**
* You like turning ideas into working demos.
* You enjoy testing new tools, APIs, AI capabilities, datasets, and platforms.
* You like being in front of customers and showing them what is possible.
* You are the kind of person who sees a problem and starts thinking, “I can probably build something to show this.”
* You enjoy the mix of technology, storytelling, business impact, and problem\-solving.


**What We’re Looking For**
* We are looking for someone who is curious, hands\-on, practical, and customer\-focused.
* You should enjoy learning new technologies, building quick working examples, making things work, and explaining technical ideas in simple language.
* You do not need to be a SAS expert. We will support you with SAS product knowledge. What matters more is your ability to learn fast, think clearly, build creatively, and showcase solutions in a way that customers understand.


**Helpful Experience**
 Experience in any of these areas would be helpful:
   

  

* Presales, solution consulting, solution architecture, technical consulting, systems integration, or industry technology consulting
* Data, analytics, AI, BI, cloud, automation, case management, workflow, or enterprise software
* Building demos, prototypes, dashboards, workflows, proof\-of\-concepts, or solution showcases
* Tools such as Python, SQL, APIs, notebooks, BI tools, cloud platforms, low\-code tools, workflow tools, or AI tools
* Customer meetings, workshops, proposals, RFPs, tenders, or solution presentations
* SAS experience is useful but not required.


**What Success Looks Like**
* You help customers see what is possible.
* You can turn a customer challenge into a clear, practical solution idea.
* You can quickly build or customise a demo that makes the idea real.
* You can explain technology clearly to both business and technical audiences.
* You make sales conversations more credible, practical, and exciting.
* You help move opportunities from interest to action.


**You are welcome here.**
 At SAS, it’s not about fitting into our culture – it’s about adding to it. We believe our people make the difference. Our inclusive workforce brings together unique talents and inspires teams to create amazing software that reflects the diversity of our users and customers.
   

  

**Additional Information**
*SAS only sends emails from verified “sas.com” email addresses and never asks for sensitive, personal information or money. If you have any doubts about the authenticity of any type of communication from, or on behalf of SAS, please contact* 
*Recruitingsupport@sas.com.*
 Let's stay in touch! Join our Talent Community to stay up to date on company news, job updates and more.
   

  

 \#SAS

0bf9275f.title: Solution Engineering - Copilot
0bf9275f.description:
**Overview**
 our purpose is to empower organizations to transform the way they work by harnessing the full potential of artificial intelligence. We guide customers through the evolving digital landscape, enabling them to unlock new opportunities, enhance productivity, and deliver exceptional employee and customer experiences. By integrating advanced AI capabilities across devices, cloud platforms, and everyday business applications, we help organizations realize seamless, innovative, and secure solutions that drive sustained growth and success in the AI era.
   

  

 As a Solution Engineer in the AI Business Solutions – Copilot team, you will lead technical engagements that drive AI transformation for enterprise customers. Your mission is to win technical decisions and accelerate adoption of Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Chat, Copilot Studio \& Agents, and related solutions by delivering compelling demos, envisioning sessions, and scalable architectures. You will act as a trusted advisor, guiding customers through secure, compliant, and value\-driven implementations that align with their enterprise strategies.
   

  

 This role is pivotal in shaping the future of work by enabling customers to realize the full potential of AI\-powered productivity. You will collaborate closely with sales, customer success, engineering, and partner teams to remove technical blockers, generate pipeline, and ensure seamless handoffs for deployment and adoption. Your success will be measured by technical wins, customer adoption, partner engagement, and your contributions to a high\-performance, learning\-oriented team culture
   

  

* Drive AI transformation by orchestrating complex technical engagements across multiple stakeholders.
* Lead architecture design for secure, scalable solutions aligned with enterprise strategy.
* Mentor IC3–IC4 engineers and lead peer learning sessions to elevate team capability.
* Influence product and go\-to\-market strategy by providing structured feedback to engineering and sales leadership.
* Proactively identify and escalate unresolved technical blockers through formal channels.
* Champion compliance, diversity, and inclusion by modeling ethical behavior and inclusive practices


**Responsibilities**
* Lead AI transformation engagements (e.g. demos, pilots) to win technical decisions and drive customer commitment to Copilot/Agents, including documented adoption plans and a smooth hand\-off to Customer Success/partners for usage onboarding.
* Support AI Workforce SSP hunting effort by engaging w/customer contacts, lead qual., and partner co\-sell opportunities
* Assist in ME3 , ME5 , ME7 , Agent 365 upsell opportunities focused on Teams Phone that require technical support, and bring in a partner for co\-sell.
* Generate new pipeline and competitive wins for M365 Copilot, Copilot Chat, Copilot Studio \& Agents, ME3 and Frontline Worker by delivering impactful AI\-powered demos/Art\-of\-Possible sessions, removing technical blockers, and highlighting Microsoft’s differentiation to secure deals and protect the install base.
* Craft scalable, secure, and modular architectures that align to customer’s enterprise strategy and technical roadmap while embedding security at every level.
* Maintain operational excellence with 100% deal hygiene – capture technical close plans and consumption plans in MSX for every opportunity, attach a partner to every qualified deal, and promptly escalate unresolved technical blockers.
* Continuously upskill to meet role expectations (achieve L200 consultative and L400 technical depth certifications) and contribute to team excellence by sharing at least one deal win/loss insight per quarter and engaging in regular coaching.


**Qualifications**
 Core Qualifications
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8\-10 years of Experience in pre\-sales, solution engineering, technical consulting, or customer\-facing technical roles.
* Strong understanding of Microsoft Copilot technologies, Generative AI, and AI\-powered productivity solutions.


 Technical Skills
   

  

* Knowledge of Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Power Platform, and Azure AI services.
* Understanding of Microsoft 365 workloads such as:
+ Microsoft Teams
+ SharePoint
+ Outlook
+ Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

* Basic to advanced knowledge of cloud architecture, identity, security, and compliance concepts.
* Ability to build demos, proof\-of\-concepts, and customer solution architectures.


 Customer \& Business Skills
   

  

* Experience conducting customer discovery sessions and identifying business challenges.
* Ability to translate business requirements into AI\-powered solutions.
* Strong presentation, storytelling, and executive communication skills.
* Experience leading technical demonstrations and workshops.


**Preferred Experience**
* Experience with AI, machine learning, prompt engineering, or conversational agents.
* Knowledge of enterprise productivity, business process automation, and digital transformation.
* Relevant Microsoft certifications (for example, Azure AI, Power Platform, or Microsoft 365 certifications


 This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
   

  

 Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about

a8a7d0c5.title: Solutions Engineer.
a8a7d0c5.description:
Key Responsibilities:
 



  





 1\. Solution Design \& Architecture
 



 • Engage with enterprise technology partners, software vendors, and end customers to understand their existing systems and translate requirements into a clear solution architecture.
 



 • Lead integration planning discussions, mapping data flows, defining API specifications, and aligning on technical interfaces between systems.
 



 • Produce solution design documents, architecture diagrams, and data flow maps that both technical and non\-technical stakeholders can act on.
 



 • Work with clients to design deployment configurations, on\-premise, cloud, or hybrid, based on their infrastructure constraints and performance needs.
 



 • Define compute specifications (CPU/GPU, memory, storage), network topology, and infrastructure sizing for each engagement.
 



 • Produce cloud cost estimates and total cost of ownership (TCO) models across AWS, GCP, and Azure.
 



 • Own and respond to RFPs and RFIs, including technical, security, and compliance questionnaires.
 



  





 2\. Hands\-on POC \& MVP Execution
 



 • Build working proofs of concept to validate architecture decisions before full engineering investment, including integration adapters, API bridges, and automation scripts.
 



 • Take POCs through to reference\-quality implementations where appropriate, contributing clean, maintainable code.
 



 • Document findings, limitations, and recommended next steps for every POC.
 



  





 3\. Handover \& Documentation
 



 • Create structured handover packages for product and deployment teams: runbooks, decision logs, open item trackers, and escalation paths.
 



 • Maintain a growing library of reference architectures and integration patterns as reusable assets across engagements.
 



 • Ensure nothing falls through the gap between a sales commitment and a working deployment.
 



  





 4\. Cross\-functional Technical Leadership
 



 • Act as the primary technical liaison between sales, product, engineering, and the client — translating requirements in both directions.
 



 • Identify risks early and propose pragmatic mitigations without stalling progress.
 



 • Feed deployment learnings and client signals back into CARPL's product roadmap discussions.
 



  





 Core Requirements:
 



  





 System Design \& Architecture
 



 • Solid grounding in system design, you can design a distributed system on a whiteboard and then go build it.
 



 • Familiarity with common architecture patterns: microservices, event\-driven architecture, API gateway, CQRS, pub/sub.
 



 • Understanding of how to make tradeoffs between consistency, availability, latency, and cost in real systems.
 



 • Understanding of secure design principles and data protection techniques, including encryption (at\-rest and in\-transit).
 



 • Experience designing and implementing robust access control mechanisms, such as Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC), Single Sign\-On (SSO), and the principle of least privilege.
 



 • Knowledge of vulnerability management, secure coding standards (e.g., OWASP Top 10\), and integrating vulnerability testing into CI/CD pipelines.
 



  





 Hands\-on Engineering
 



 • Proficiency in at least one backend language, Python (preferred), Go, or Java, and the confidence to write production\-quality code without supervision.
 



 • Experience building REST or gRPC APIs, integration adapters, and automation scripts from scratch.
 



 • Comfortable with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and standard DevOps tooling.
 



  





 Databases
 



 • Hands\-on experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) — schema design, query optimisation, indexing.
 



 • Working knowledge of at least one NoSQL store (MongoDB, Redis, Elasticsearch, DynamoDB) and when to use it.
 



 • Understanding of data modelling tradeoffs for operational vs. analytical workloads.
 



  





 Cloud \& Infrastructure
 



 • Practical experience on at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) including compute, storage, networking, managed services \& cloud firewall and security rules.
 



 • Familiarity with containerisation (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes) in production or near\-production environments.
 



 • Ability to size infrastructure, estimate costs, and build a credible deployment plan for a client.
 



  





 Client\-facing \& Communication
 



 • Strong written and verbal communication: comfortable presenting architecture to a CTO or CPO and explaining tradeoffs to a developer.
 



 • Experience writing technical documentation, RFP/RFI responses, solution proposals, or architecture design documents.
 



 • Skilled at producing clear diagrams (Lucidchart, draw.io, Miro, or similar).
 



  





 Experience
 



 • 2\+ years in solutions architecture, technical pre\-sales engineering, software engineering, or a combination.
 



 • Track record of owning end\-to\-end technical integrations with enterprise or mid\-market clients..
 



 • Experience navigating procurement cycles: security reviews, compliance questionnaires, vendor assessments.
 



  





 Preferred but not mandatory
 



 • DICOM: Working knowledge of DICOM — DIMSE services, DICOMweb (WADO/STOW/QIDO), structured reports, and DICOM node configuration.
 



 • HL7 / FHIR: Familiarity with HL7 v2 messaging and FHIR R4 resources, and how they flow between hospital systems.
 



 • PACS / VNA: Experience working with PACS, VNA, RIS, or HIS systems — ideally in an integration or deployment capacity.

***JOB DESCRIPTION \& CANDIDATE PROFILE \-\-\- PROJECT ARCHITECT/ JUNIOR ARCHITECT Positions \-\-\- 1 to 3 Years Experience***

***Location:*** Pondicherry / Puducherry \| ***Engagement:*** Full\-time

***Hiring intent:*** Experienced candidates only. Fresh graduates / zero\-experience candidates are not the target profile for this requirement. About company:

***About RADICAL ARHITECTURE:***

**Radical Architecture** is a small, ***couple\-led (Architect. Manivel Rajan CA/2209/45519 \& Architect. Janani Manivel \- CA/2010/50503\)*** ***architecture and interior design studio*** based in Pondicherry , operating from a **home\-based studio**. We work across residential, villa, commercial and institutional projects, with direct involvement from **design through execution.**

We are currently looking for **Junior Architects with 1 to 3 years of professional experience** to join our couple studio and work closely with our projects. If you are looking for **hands\-on exposure, direct project involvement and a small studio environment with 20\+ years experienced Principal\-Architects' mentorship**, Radical Architecture could be a good fit.

***JOB LOCATION: AT PONDICHERRY (NOT BANGALORE/ NOT CHENNAI/ NOT HYDERABAD). JOB IS AT RADICAL ARCHITECTURE, PONDICHERRY STUDIO***

***JOB DESCRIPTION \& CANDIDATE PROFILE \- Architecture Positions 1 to 3 Years Experience***

***1\. POSITIONS \& EXPERIENCE BAND:***

***Education Degree Requirement \- B. Arch \[Bachelors of Architecture]***

***Junior Architect*** \- 1 to 2 years \- Strong production ability; accurate drawings with limited supervision. SALARY \- 20000 to 24000/ Month

***Project Architect*** \- 2 to 3 years \- Ownership of project packages, coordination and delivery. Interior working drawings, detailing, materials, joinery and site coordination. SALARY \- 24000 to 28000/ Month

***2\. PREVIOUS FIRM EXPERIENCE:***

* Preferred: 1 to 3 years of professional experience in an architecture, architecture\-interiors or design\-build studio.
* Experience should demonstrate actual project production, not only academic work, rendering or presentation work.
* Residential architecture, villas, bungalows, interiors, institutional projects and small\-to\-medium scale work are particularly relevant.
* Candidate should be able to identify drawings or project packages personally produced or substantially developed.
* Small/medium practice experience is an advantage because the role requires versatility and direct responsibility.

***3\. CORE TECHNICAL \& SOFTWARE REQUIREMENTS:***

* AutoCAD mandatory: plans, sections, elevations, working drawings, annotation, dimensions, layers and sheet organisation.
* SketchUp mandatory: competent architectural modelling and model development.
* Enscape / D5 / Lumion mandatory: usable architectural visualisation and presentation views.
* Photoshop mandatory: presentation boards, image editing and post\-production.
* Illustrator / InDesign advantageous.
* Revit / Rhino / 3ds Max advantageous only where genuinely demonstrable.
* Software claims must be validated through a practical test; CV keywords alone are insufficient.

***4\. ARCHITECTURAL HAND SKILLS:***

* Read and understand plans, sections, elevations and details.
* Identify missing information, dimensional conflicts, inconsistencies and drawing errors before submission.
* Develop a drawing from a brief rather than mechanically reproduce a reference.
* Basic freehand sketching / diagramming for design and site communication.
* Convert verbal instructions into a clear drawing workflow.
* Understand materials, construction logic, basic building components and practical detailing.
* Maintain drawing standards, file naming, revisions and issue discipline.

***5\. PROJECT ARCHITECT / HIGHER\-END RESPONSIBILITIES***

* Independent ownership of assigned projects or packages from brief through drawing development.
* Plan work against deadlines and communicate risks before deadlines are missed.
* Coordinate structural, MEP and specialist consultant inputs.
* Attend and understand site coordination and basic buildability.
* Review own work before submitting it to the Principal Architect.
* Handle multiple projects/workstreams without losing priorities.
* Make reasonable decisions independently and escalate matters genuinely requiring Principal\-level direction.

***6\. SOFT SKILLS \& PROFESSIONAL ATTITUDE:***

* Ownership: responsibility for the result, not merely the task.
* Deadline discipline: prioritise and communicate early when a deadline is at risk.
* Comprehension: understand the purpose behind instructions.
* Problem\-solving: attempt a reasoned solution before asking for the answer.
* Feedback maturity: accept corrections and convert feedback into improved future output.
* Learning attitude: actively develop technical and architectural competence.
* Communication: clear and professional with principals, consultants, vendors and site teams.
* Reliability: consistent attendance, punctuality and predictable delivery.

***7\. SITE READINESS \& PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:***

* Attend sites when project requirements demand it.
* Work safely in unfinished buildings and normal site conditions using appropriate precautions.
* Travel locally or interstate for meetings, measurements and site coordination when required.
* Maintain professional conduct and safety awareness at construction sites.

***8\. PONDICHERRY\-BASED CANDIDATES:***

* Reliable daily commuting and punctual attendance.
* Ability to remain available for site visits and project coordination within Pondicherry and nearby locations.
* Understand that the role is a professional studio position, not simply a convenient hometown employment option.
* Willingness to work in a small, direct\-reporting practice where responsibility is visible and individual output matters.
* Ready to work across drawing production, coordination, site\-related tasks and project support.

***9\. CANDIDATES FROM OTHER CITIES / STATES:***

* Must demonstrate genuine and practical willingness to relocate to Pondicherry / Puducherry for an office\-based role.
* Relocation, accommodation and commuting arrangements should be independently planned before joining.
* Should not treat Pondicherry merely as a temporary stop while waiting for a preferred\-city opportunity.
* Must maintain reliable attendance and participate in site work and project coordination.
* Candidates from Chennai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Coimbatore, Madurai, Trichy and other cities will be considered where their skill profile is materially stronger.

***10\. IDEAL RADICAL ARCHITECTURE CANDIDATE:***

**We are looking for an architect who can think, draw, coordinate and take ownership.** The ideal candidate is not expected to know everything at 1 to 3 years of experience, but should demonstrate a strong learning curve, technical discipline, architectural curiosity, accountability and the ability to convert instructions into accurate deliverables. For a small studio, individual contribution is highly visible; reliability and ownership are as important as software proficiency.

bc2abe56.title: Platform Customer Engineer, Google Cloud
bc2abe56.description:
**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer\-facing or support role.
* Experience with cloud engineering, on\-premise engineering, virtualization, or containerization platforms.
* Experience engaging with, or presenting to, technical stakeholders or executive leaders.
* Experience in programming languages, debugging, systems design, prototyping, demos, or customer workshops.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Experience selling technical solutions in one or more of the following: Infrastructure Modernization, Application Modernization, Data Management, Data Analytics, Cloud AI, Networking, Migrations, Security.
* Experience driving the entire business cycle (e.g., defining the delivery and consumption plan and transitioning it for execution).
* Experience building the technical strategies to uncover new workloads with customers.
* Experience with security concepts (e.g., encryption, identity management, access control, attack vectors).


**About The Job**
 When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You listen and deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem\-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.
   

  

 As a Platform Customer Engineer (CE), you will partner with technical Sales teams to differentiate Google Cloud to our customers. You will serve as the customer’s primary technical partner and trusted advisor, engaging in technical\-led conversations to understand their business challenges. You will troubleshoot technical questions and roadblocks, engage in proofs\-of\-concepts and demos, and use your expertise to architect cross\-pillar cloud solutions that solve these business challenges. You will drive the technical win and define the delivery and consumption plans. You will use your business acumen and presentation skills to engage with technical and business leaders, and present solutions on Google Cloud. You will have excellent technical, communication and organizational skills.
   

  

 You will focus on identifying, pursuing, and winning new business workloads and driving engagement within existing ones. You will have a breadth of technical expertise, spanning infrastructure modernization, application modernization, data analytics and more. You will blend business expertise, market knowledge and direct technical engagement to prove the value of the Google Cloud portfolio.
   

  

 Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop and own the technical account plan and strategy, participating in planning and supporting targeted business motions.
* Combine sales, programming, and solutions architecture expertise to prove the value of Google Cloud Platform across the portfolio through demos, pilots and workshops.
* Architect cross\-pillar solutions, drive technical wins, and define initial delivery plans for customers; continue to lead the technical engagement in the solution phase.
* Facilitate the post\-sales transition by supporting pricing activities and transitioning the final delivery plan to implementation teams.
* Maintain awareness of progress against the delivery plan, providing support to cross\-functional teams during ramp, delivery, migration or implementation phases.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

ca6ef3ac.description:
The Senior Solution Architect – Workforce designs business\-driven, standards\-based, and future\-ready solutions for Roche's complex, multi\-product Workforce ecosystem. Operating at the intersection of People \& Culture (P\&C) business needs, enterprise architecture standards, and technical execution, this role provides overall architectural governance across the core HR, payroll, time, rewards, and employee experience stack.
 



 This role serves as the architectural lead for key platforms—including Workday, ServiceNow HRSD, and global/regional payroll \& time engines (ADP, Ramco, Euhreka etc.). Additionally, the role is accountable for ensuring technical solutions comply with global data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR) by taking ownership of technical security artifacts, most notably mandatory System Risk Assessments (SRAs).
 



  





 Responsibilities:
 



 Architecture Design \& Domain Strategy: Design resilient, scalable solution architectures across the Workforce product portfolio (Workday core, ServiceNow HRSD module, Total Rewards, Time \& Absence, and External Workforce). Ensure alignment with enterprise standards, FAIR data principles, and the overarching "Capability Factory" mission.
 



 HR Ecosystem Integration \& Standards: Architect seamless, secure integration pathways across heterogeneous platforms, connecting global core platforms (Workday, ServiceNow HRSD) with regional/local payroll and time systems (e.g., ADP, Ramco, Euhreka).
 



 Data Privacy, Compliance \& SRA Governance: Lead the technical evaluation and authoring of mandatory compliance documentation for all Workforce systems. Serve as the technical primary driver for System Risk Assessments (SRAs), data privacy assessments (GDPR, local labor laws), and security controls to maintain Roche's "License to Pay" and "License to Operate."
 



 Technical Leadership \& Consultation: Provide technical oversight, decision guidance, and architectural direction to product delivery leads, System Managers, and external vendor partners (e.g., Accenture, PwC).
 



 Architectural Artifacts \& Standards: Create and maintain conceptual and logical data models, integration taxonomies, system interaction diagrams, and enterprise ontologies for P\&C data.
 



 Governance \& Documentation: Establish reference architectures and enforce discipline through Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) across all sub\-domains (Payroll, Time, Benefits, People Data, People Relations, Mobility).
 



 Innovation \& Technical Debt Management: Evaluate emerging HR tech capabilities (e.g., ServiceNow NowAssist, AI automation) while systematically evaluating, prioritizing, and decommissioning technical debt across the landscape.
 



 Accountabilities:
 



 Solution Integrity \& NFRs: Accountable for defining and maintaining Non\-Functional Requirements (NFRs), security baselines, system reliability, and fitness functions across the lifecycle of all Workforce products.
 



 Compliance \& Risk Readiness: Accountable for architectural alignment with global regulatory standards, successfully passing SRAs, and ensuring system readiness for data privacy and security audits.
 



 Technology Roadmapping: Accountable for developing and maintaining the multi\-year technology landscape roadmap for the Workforce product circle.
 



 Stakeholder \& Vendor Alignment: Accountable for translating complex technical and risk concepts for P\&C leadership, internal IT circles, and external service delivery partners.
 



 Key Qualifications \& Expertise
 



 HR Technology Architecture: Extensive experience as a Solution Architect designing enterprise\-scale HR and Workforce solutions.
 



 Core Platform Proficiency:
 



 Hands\-on architecture and integration experience with Workday (HCM, Core Data, Security).
 



 Experience with ServiceNow HRSD (Human Resources Service Delivery) module and workflow automation.
 



 Experience integrating global and regional Payroll \& Time engines (e.g., ADP, Ramco, Euhreka,).
 



 Data Privacy \& Governance: Strong understanding of data protection frameworks (GDPR, international labor laws) and hands\-on experience authoring technical security assessments such as System Risk Assessments (SRAs).
 



 Data \& Integration Patterns: Proven ability with API management, event\-driven architecture, identity management, and FAIR data principles.
 



 Communication \& Influencing: Outstanding ability to bridge business requirements with deep technical execution across cross\-functional global teams.

89c352fa.title: Service Delivery Manager
89c352fa.description:
Bloomreach is building the world’s premier
 **agentic platform for personalization** 
 .We’re revolutionizing how businesses connect with their customers, building and deploying AI agents to personalize the
 ***entire***
 customer journey.
   

  

* We're taking autonomous search mainstream, making product discovery more intuitive and conversational for customers, and more profitable for businesses.
* We’re making conversational shopping a reality, connecting every shopper with tailored guidance and product expertise — available on demand, at every touchpoint in their journey.
* We're designing the future of autonomous marketing, taking the work out of workflows, and reclaiming the creative, strategic, and customer\-first work marketers were always meant to do.


 And we're building all of that on the intelligence of a single AI engine —
 **Loomi** 
 — so that personalization isn't only autonomous…it's also consistent.From retail to financial services, hospitality to gaming, businesses use Bloomreach to drive higher growth and lasting loyalty. We power personalization for more than 1,400 global brands, including American Eagle, Sonepar, and Pandora.
   

  

**About The SDM Team**
 The Service Delivery Management team at Bloomreach is the engine behind every successful customer implementation. We don't just manage projects — we orchestrate complex, multi\-workstream implementations that bring Bloomreach's AI\-powered platform to life for the world's leading brands.
   

  

**What makes our SDM team different in 2026:**
* AI\-native operations — We use Von (our AI copilot), automated processes, and intelligent workflows to eliminate manual overhead and focus on high\-value delivery
* Agentic tooling — ClickUp automations, Slack\-integrated utilization tracking, and automated retrospective analysis are standard operating procedure
* Commercial ownership — SDMs own the services metrics for their projects, identify upsell opportunities, author/ review SOWs, and drive revenue through delivery excellence
* Cross\-pillar delivery — We implement across Marketing (Engagement), Search (Discovery), DataHub, and Loomi AI for Shopify (LAIS), often on the same project alongside Content platform


**The Role**
 As a Service Delivery Manager based in India, you will own the end\-to\-end delivery of Bloomreach implementation projects for customers across EMEA and APAC. You'll manage multiple concurrent projects, coordinate cross\-functional teams, and serve as the primary delivery contact for customers — ensuring every project lands on time, on budget, and with measurable business outcomes.
   

  

 This is not a traditional PM role. You'll be expected to leverage AI tools and automation to operate at a higher level — spending less time on status updates and more time on strategic delivery, risk mitigation, and commercial growth.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Project Delivery \& Execution**
* Own the project plan, schedule, milestones, dependencies, and critical path for 8–12 concurrent implementation projects
* Manage customer launches on the Bloomreach platform, including data migration, SDK integration, Event Streams / Item Collections setup, and go\-live readiness
* Facilitate customer meetings, articulate business requirements, and translate them into actionable implementation plans
* Provide proactive reporting — leveraging automated reporting tools (Von, ClickUp) rather than manual slide decks
* Own escalation management — identify risks early, communicate clearly, and drive resolution with the right stakeholders


**Commercial \& Strategic**
* Identify opportunities to sell additional services during project delivery — create Salesforce opportunities, helping in scoping and estimation
* Own the services metrics for your project portfolio — track utilization, manage scope, and ensure profitability
* Partner with Account Managers and CSMs to align delivery with the customer's broader success plan and renewal timeline


**AI\-First Operations**
* Use Von and other AI tools for meeting prep, status reporting, customer research, and project analysis
* Build and maintain automated workflows (ClickUp, Slack, Zapier) to streamline repetitive delivery tasks
* Contribute to the team's automation roadmap — propose and implement new ways to use AI in service delivery
* Use data and dashboards to drive project decisions, track delivery health, and identify patterns across your portfolio


**Collaboration**
* Work closely with Business Consultants (BCs), Solutions Consultants (SCs), AMs, and CSMs to ensure seamless handoffs and aligned delivery
* Coordinate with Product and Engineering teams on technical blockers, feature requests, and platform capabilities
* Participate in cross\-functional initiatives like LAIS rollouts, DataHub migrations, and One Platform upgrades


**What You Bring**
**Must\-Have**
* 5–7 years of experience in project/program management within SaaS, martech, or digital services
* Proven track record of managing multiple concurrent implementation projects (10\+ simultaneously)
* Strong understanding of web technologies — APIs, SDKs, webhooks, data pipelines, frontend/backend architecture
* Experience with project management tools (ClickUp, Jira, Asana, or similar) and comfort building automations within them
* Commercial awareness — experience with SOW review, services scoping, and revenue tracking
* Excellent communication skills — ability to run customer\-facing meetings, write clear status reports, and manage stakeholder expectations across timezones (EMEA/APAC overlap required)
* Comfort with AI tools — active user of AI assistants, automation platforms, or similar technology in a professional context


**Nice\-to\-Have**
* Experience with CDP/martech platforms (Bloomreach, Braze, Klaviyo, SFMC, Emarsys, or similar)
* Familiarity with Jinja templating, SQL, or scripting languages
* Experience working in a globally distributed team with EMEA/AMER stakeholders
* PMP, PRINCE2, or Agile certification
* Experience with Salesforce CPQ or services quoting processes


**What Success Looks Like**
**Timeframe**
**Milestone**
**30 days**
 Onboarded on Bloomreach platform, tools (Von, ClickUp, Slack workflows), and processes. Shadowed 2–3 active projects.
   

  

**60 days**
 Independently managing 4–6 projects. First automated status report generated. The first customer meeting led solo.
   

  

**90 days**
 Full portfolio of 8–12 projects. First services upsell opportunities identified. Contributing to the team automation roadmap.
   

  

**6 months**
 Recognized as a reliable delivery partner by AMs and CSMs. Delivering projects on time with \>90% customer satisfaction. At least one new automation or process improvement shipped.
   

  

**Why Bloomreach**
* AI\-first company — You'll work with cutting\-edge AI (Loomi) and be expected to use AI in your own work, not just deliver it to customers
* Global impact — Your projects will power personalized experiences for millions of consumers across the world's leading brands
* Growth trajectory — The India SDM function is new, and you'll have the opportunity to shape how it operates from the ground up
* Collaborative culture — You'll work with smart, passionate people across engineering, product, sales, and customer success


 More things you'll like about Bloomreach:
   

  

**Culture:**
* A great deal of freedom and trust. At Bloomreach we don’t clock in and out, and we have neither corporate rules nor long approval processes. This freedom goes hand in hand with responsibility. We are interested in results from day one.
* We have defined our 5 values and the 10 underlying key behaviors that we strongly believe in. We can only succeed if everyone lives these behaviors day to day. We've embedded them in our processes like recruitment, onboarding, feedback, personal development, performance review and internal communication.
* We believe in flexible working hours to accommodate your working style.
* We work virtual\-first with several Bloomreach Hubs available across three continents.
* We organize company events to experience the global spirit of the company and get excited about what's ahead.
* We encourage and support our employees to engage in volunteering activities \- every Bloomreacher can take 5 paid days off to volunteer\*.
* The Bloomreach Glassdoor page elaborates on our stellar 4\.7/5 rating. The Bloomreach Comparably page Culture score is even higher at 4\.9/5


**Personal Development:**
* We have a People Development Program \- participating in personal development workshops on various topics run by experts from inside the company. We are continuously developing \& updating competency maps for select functions.
* Our resident communication coach Ivo Večeřa is available to help navigate work\-related communications \& decision\-making challenges.\*
* Our managers are strongly encouraged to participate in the Leader Development Program to develop in the areas we consider essential for any leader. The program includes regular comprehensive feedback, consultations with a coach and follow\-up check\-ins.
* Bloomreachers utilize the $1,500 professional education budget on an annual basis to purchase education products (books, courses, certifications, etc.)\*


**Well\-being:**
* The Employee Assistance Program \-\- with counselors \-\- is available for non\-work\-related challenges.\*
* Subscription to Calm \- sleep and meditation app.\*
* We organize ‘DisConnect’ days where Bloomreachers globally enjoy one additional day off each quarter, allowing us to unwind together and focus on activities away from the screen with our loved ones.
* We facilitate sports, yoga, and meditation opportunities for each other.
* Extended parental leave up to 26 calendar weeks for Primary Caregivers.\*


**Compensation:**
* Restricted Stock Units or Stock Options are granted depending on a team member’s role, seniority, and location.\*
* Everyone gets to participate in the company's success through the company performance bonus.\*
* We offer an employee referral bonus of up to $3,000!
* We reward \& celebrate work anniversaries \-\- Bloomversaries!\*


*(\*Subject to employment type. Interns are exempt from marked benefits, usually for the first 6 months.)*
**Excited? Join us and transform the future of commerce experiences!**
*If this position doesn't suit you, but you know someone who might be a great fit, share it \- we will be very grateful!*
*Any unsolicited resumes/candidate profiles submitted through our website or to personal email accounts of employees of Bloomreach are considered property of Bloomreach and are not subject to payment of agency fees.*

**Responsibilities**
--------------------


Bengaluru, Karnataka, India **Job category:** Software Engineering **Job ID:** 135449\-en\_US
**Own Every Moment at NetApp**

Ready to innovate and contribute to our path to $10B? Here, you'll collaborate with passionate teams, tackle real\-world challenges, and see your impact in how customers transform and grow. Join teams that innovate to elevate, drive results, and excel together across every function.

---------------

We’re looking for a collaborative and curious Lead Software Engineer to join our development team at NetApp Instaclustr (www.instaclustr.com).


Our mission at NetApp Instaclustr (www.instaclustr.com) is to make it easy for customers around the globe to run powerful open\-source applications at scale \- like Cassandra, Kafka, PostgreSQL, OpenSearch, Cadence, and ClickHouse, across both on\-premises data\-centres and in the cloud.

--------------------

Demonstrated experience with leading people.
  

Proficiency in Java, SQL and at least one other modern programming language \- and openness to learning more.
  

Strong communication skills and a humble and collaborative nature \- essential for working harmoniously with multiple teams.
  

A curious mindset with a keen interest in how your work will positively impact customers.
  

Eagerness to tackle new challenges and continuously grow you and your team’s software engineering skills.

Work with other Lead Software Engineers to support each other in developing complex solutions or agreeing on the best approach to solve problems which affect everyone. DevOps best practices as part of a global team that operates 24x7\. This may include participating in on\-call support roles to assist in keeping our management platform running smoothly.

-------------


IC \- Typically requires a minimum of 12 years of related experience.Mgr \& Exec \- Typically requires a minimum of 8 years of related experience.

**Why You'll Thrive at NetApp**

**Our culture**


We celebrate mold breakers, bold thinkers, and problem solvers. We reward initiative, impact, and ownership. We provide flexibility so you can balance professional ambition with your personal life. Here, differences are not just welcomed—they drive everything we do.

**Our values**

170a349c.title: Penetration Testing Pre-Sales Consultant
170a349c.description:
**JOB SUMMARY** 




 Serve as the technical subject matter expert for penetration testing opportunities. Work closely with Account Executives, Sales Teams, Solution Architects, Project Managers, and customers to understand requirements, define scope, prepare Statements of Work (SOWs), estimate effort, support proposal creation, and present penetration testing solutions. Act as the bridge between sales and delivery teams.
 



  





**TESTING AREAS \& SPECIALIZATIONS** 




**Application Security Testing** 



* Web Application Penetration Testing
* API Penetration Testing
* Mobile Application Security Testing



**Network Security Testing** 



* External Network Penetration Testing
* Internal Network Penetration Testing
* Wireless Security Assessments



**Identity \& Access Security Testing** 



* Active Directory Security Assessments
* Microsoft Entra ID Security Assessments
* Hybrid Identity Security Assessments
* Okta Security Assessments
* CyberArk Security Assessments



**Cloud Security Testing** 



* Microsoft Azure Security Assessments
* AWS Security Assessments
* Cloud Configuration Reviews
* Cloud Exposure Assessments



**Social Engineering Assessments** 



* Phishing Campaign Assessments
* Spear Phishing Assessments
* Vishing (Voice Phishing) Assessments
* Smishing (SMS Phishing) Assessments
* User Awareness \& Susceptibility Testing



**Advanced Security Testing** 



* Assumed Breach Assessments
* Privilege Escalation Testing
* Lateral Movement Testing
* Attack Path Analysis
* Security Control Validation



  





**OPERATIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES** 



* Participate in customer discovery calls to understand security assessment requirements, business objectives, and technical environments.
* Conduct scope definition activities for web applications, APIs, internal networks, external networks, cloud environments, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, wireless, and social engineering assessments.
* Review customer requirements and translate them into penetration testing engagement scopes and deliverables.
* Define assumptions, constraints, exclusions, dependencies, and Rules of Engagement.
* Develop Statements of Work (SOWs), scope documents, level\-of\-effort estimates, and service descriptions.
* Calculate testing effort based on applications, IP ranges, APIs, cloud resources, identities, and testing complexity.
* Support proposal creation, RFP/RFI responses, and technical solution documentation.
* Work with delivery teams to validate effort estimates, schedules, staffing requirements, and testing approaches.
* Present proposed solutions during customer meetings and technical discussions.
* Provide guidance on testing methodologies, deliverables, risk considerations, and industry best practices.
* Support customer workshops, security assessments, and advisory engagements during the sales cycle.
* Assist with service catalog development, testing packages, and standard pricing models.
* Maintain knowledge of emerging threats, penetration testing services, and market trends.
* Participate in transition meetings to hand off opportunities to delivery teams after project award.



**EDUCATIONAL REQUIREMENTS, TOOLS \& CERTIFICATIONS** 




 Education: Diploma/bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology or equivalent experience.
 



 Experience:
 


* 6–10 years in Penetration Testing, Security Consulting, or Cybersecurity Pre\-Sales.
* Experience scoping and estimating penetration testing engagements.
* Experience supporting US\-based customers and working USA hours.
* Strong customer\-facing experience.



 Tools \& Technologies:
 


* **Primary VM Tools:** 
 Tenable, Rapid7 / InsightVM
* **Patch / Remediation Tools:** 
 Tanium, Automox
* **Risk \& GRC:** 
 TruOps, Cyberfusion
* **IAM / PAM:** 
 Okta, CyberArk
* **Endpoint Security:** 
 CrowdStrike, SentinelOne
* **Penetration Tools:** 
 Burp Suite Professional, OWASP ZAP, Nmap, Metasploit, BloodHound, sqlmap, Nessus
* **Scripting and Automation:** 
 Python, Powershell, Bash
* **Reporting:** 
 Power BI, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio



  





**Certifications:** 



* OSWE, CRTP / CRTE , CISSP, CEH, Security \+, OSCP, Azure Security Certifications (Preferred)

b3002128.title: Senior Solution Architect, Mumbai
b3002128.description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud\-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
   

  

**What is The Role:**
 Are you looking to make a real impact and play a meaningful role in the growth of our company?
   

  

 As a Solutions Architect at Elastic you will serve as a technical authority and trusted advisor to our sales team, customers, partners and community. You will understand and tackle our customer’s business issues with the Elastic Stack, engage the regional Elastic community through events and programs, and enable sales through our Partners. A successful SA at Elastic will be passionate about perfection; taking the initiative to improve both themselves and the team through continuous learning and questioning the status quo.
   

  

 “We question the status quo, debate the best ways to accomplish our goals and hold ourselves and our teams to the highest standards of performance. We take pride in our ability to understand our customers needs and make recommendations that are based on extensive global experience across multiple use cases. We learn from our mistakes and losses and celebrate our successes with an eye towards constant improvement. Join this team if you are up for a compassionate, understanding and fair environment where you can really grow into the next phase of your career.” VP WW Solution Architecture, Elastic

49202a12.title: Solutions Architect
49202a12.description:
**Description**
 About Upwind Security
   

  

 Upwind Security is a rapidly growing, innovative cybersecurity firm specializing in Cloud\-Native Application Protection Platforms (CNAPP). We provide comprehensive security solutions that span the entire cloud application lifecycle, from build to runtime. Our mission is to secure the next generation of cloud infrastructure, helping businesses innovate without fear. We foster a dynamic, fast\-paced, and collaborative environment, focused on excellence and customer success.
   

  

 The Opportunity
   

  

 We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Solution Architect (SA) to join our expanding team in India. This role is pivotal in providing deep technical expertise throughout the sales cycle, ensuring successful proof\-of\-concepts (POCs), and architecting tailored CNAPP solutions for our enterprise clients. The ideal candidate possesses a strong background in cloud security, DevSecOps, and modern cloud architecture, coupled with exceptional communication skills in English.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Technical Sales and Solution Design
   

  

* Serve as the primary technical resource for the India sales team, engaging directly with prospects and customers to understand their cloud security posture, challenges, and technical requirements.
* Design and present compelling, tailored Upwind Security CNAPP solutions, mapping product capabilities to specific customer security frameworks and business outcomes.
* Lead and execute all technical validation activities, including Proof\-of\-Concepts (POCs), pilots, and hands\-on demonstrations, ensuring successful completion and clear articulation of value.
* Develop comprehensive solution architectures and technical proposals that integrate Upwind Security into the customer's existing cloud and CI/CD environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).


 Expertise and Market Intelligence
   

  

* Maintain expert\-level knowledge of the Upwind CNAPP platform, competitive landscape, and emerging trends in cloud\-native security (e.g., KSPM, CIEM, CSPM, CWPP, shift\-left security).
* Act as a trusted technical advisor, educating customers and partners on cloud security best practices, DevSecOps principles, and risk mitigation strategies.
* Provide valuable feedback to the global product management and engineering teams regarding regional technical requirements, feature requests, and competitive intelligence specific to the Indian market.


 Collaboration and Enablement
   

  

* Work closely with Account Executives (AEs) to develop account strategies, qualify opportunities, and accelerate technical closure.
* Assist in the technical enablement and training of channel partners (SIs, VARs) to ensure they can effectively position and deploy the Upwind Security solution.
* Create and refine technical sales collateral, including presentations, diagrams, deployment guides, and best practice documents tailored for the Indian audience.


 Why Join Upwind Security?
   

  

* Be a key technical leader in establishing our market presence in India.
* Work with a cutting\-edge CNAPP technology that is revolutionizing cloud security.
* Competitive salary, bonus structure, and stock options.


 Upwind Security is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
   

  

**Requirements**
 Required Qualifications
   

  

**Experience:** 
 10\+ years in a customer\-facing technical role (e.g., Sales Engineer, Solution Architect, Consultant) selling or supporting complex cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, or DevSecOps solutions.
   

  

**Domain Knowledge:** 
 Deep, hands\-on experience with major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and a strong understanding of their security services and architectural best practices. Expertise in containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), serverless technologies, and modern CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab, GitHub Actions).
   

  

**Cloud Security Expertise:** 
 Proven knowledge of application security principles, cloud security frameworks, and CNAPP components (e.g., infrastructure\-as\-code scanning, vulnerability management, runtime protection).
   

  

**Language Proficiency:** 
 Native or equivalent professional fluency in English (written and verbal) is essential for client engagement and technical documentation. Additional proficiency in Indian languages is a plus.
   

  

**Cultural Acumen:** 
 Experience working effectively within the Indian enterprise IT and security culture.
   

  

**Education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Certifications (e.g., AWS/Azure/GCP Solution Architect or Security, CISSP, Kubernetes) are a plus.
   

  

 Desired Attributes
   

  

* Exceptional problem\-solving skills and the ability to articulate complex technical topics simply and effectively.
* Proactive, self\-motivated, and comfortable operating autonomously in a dynamic start\-up environment.
* Strong presentation skills, capable of leading technical discussions with developers, security engineers, and C\-level executives.
* Willingness to travel within India (up to 25%) as required for customer engagements.

57d2bf4e.title: Solution Architect
57d2bf4e.description:
**Project Role :** 
 Solution Architect
   

  

**Project Role Description :** 
 Translate client requirements into differentiated, deliverable solutions using in\-depth knowledge of a technology, function, or platform. Collaborate with the Sales Pursuit and Delivery Teams to develop a winnable and deliverable solution that underpins the client value proposition and business case.
   

  

**Must have skills :** 
 Network Architecture and Design
   

  

**Good to have skills :** 
 SD\-WAN Implementation
   

  

**Minimum 12 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :** 
 15 years full time education
   

  

 Summary:
   

  

 As a Solution Architect, a typical day involves interpreting and transforming client needs into unique and actionable solutions that align with business objectives. This role requires close collaboration with sales and delivery teams to craft strategies that not only meet client expectations but also provide a strong foundation for successful project execution. The position demands continuous engagement with various stakeholders to ensure that the proposed solutions are practical, innovative, and add significant value to the client s business case, fostering long\-term partnerships and successful outcomes.
   

  

 We are seeking a seasoned and highly experienced Senior Solution Architect to join our Technology Practice. This is a strategic, client\-facing solutioning role where the primary focus is converting sales\-qualified opportunities into well\-defined, technically sound, and commercially viable solutions. Opportunities are brought in by the Sales Team — your remit begins with validating the requirement and ends with a complete solution ready for delivery.
   

  

 The successful candidate will work in close partnership with the Sales Team to understand client needs, validate scope, and develop compelling solution proposals. This role demands exceptional communication skills, deep technical expertise across networking, cloud, and Microsoft technologies, and the ability to define resource requirements and delivery timelines with precision.
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities:
   

  

* Requirement Validation \& Sales Collaboration


 Receive sales\-qualified opportunities from the Sales Team and conduct thorough validation of client requirements, scope, and technical feasibility.
   

  

 Work closely with the Sales Team to clarify ambiguities, fill gaps in the brief, and ensure a clear understanding of the client's business and technical needs before solutioning begins.
   

  

 Act as the key liaison between the Sales Team and the technical practice — ensuring alignment on scope, timelines, and commercial expectations throughout the engagement.
   

  

* Client Engagement \& Advisory


 Lead client\-facing conversations to probe, validate, and refine requirements in collaboration with the Sales Team.
   

  

 Build credibility with client stakeholders as a trusted technical advisor, articulating solution value clearly at both technical and business levels.
   

  

 Present solution proposals, architecture blueprints, and delivery roadmaps with confidence to client and internal stakeholders.
   

  

* Solutioning \& Architecture


 Design end\-to\-end technical solutions across SD\-WAN, networking, Microsoft Product Suite, and Cloud Implementation Services based on validated requirements.
   

  

 Define resource requirements and effort estimates — specifying the number of resources and number of days required for delivery.
   

  

 Develop high\-level and detailed architecture documentation, including Bills of Materials (BOMs), Statements of Work (SOWs), and technical proposals.
   

  

 Ensure proposed solutions are scalable, secure, and aligned with client business objectives and industry best practices.
   

  

* Internal Coordination \& Stakeholder Management


 Coordinate internally with delivery leads, engineers, project managers, vendors, and practice leads to validate and refine solutions prior to submission.
   

  

 Serve as the bridge between the Sales Team and delivery, ensuring a seamless handover with complete solution documentation and knowledge transfer post\-award.
   

  

 Engage with vendor and partner ecosystems (e.g., Microsoft, Cisco, AWS/Azure) to leverage technical and commercial support during the solutioning process.
   

  

 Professional \& Technical Skills:
   

  

 Required Technical Expertise \-
   

  

* SD\-WAN \& Networking


 Hands\-on experience designing and architecting SD\-WAN solutions (e.g., Cisco Meraki, Fortinet, VMware VeloCloud, or equivalent).
   

  

 Strong grounding in enterprise networking — routing, switching, firewalls, MPLS, BGP, and network segmentation.
   

  

 Experience with network transformation projects, including migration from legacy WAN to SD\-WAN environments.
   

  

* Microsoft Product Suite


 Deep expertise across Microsoft 365, Azure Active Directory, Intune, Teams, SharePoint, and related productivity and security toolsets.
   

  

 Familiarity with Microsoft licensing models and their commercial implications in solution design.
   

  

 Experience with Microsoft security frameworks including Defender, Sentinel, and Zero Trust architecture principles.
   

  

* Cloud Implementation Services


 Proven experience architecting cloud solutions on Microsoft Azure and/or AWS — including IaaS, PaaS, hybrid cloud, and cloud migration projects.
   

  

 Understanding of cloud governance, cost optimisation, and security best practices in enterprise environments.
   

  

 Ability to size and scope cloud engagements, including resource and effort estimation for delivery.
   

  

 Additional Information:
   

  

* Demonstrated track record of designing and delivering complex, multi\-technology solutions in client\-facing solutioning roles.
* Experience working alongside Sales Teams — translating sales\-qualified opportunities into complete, delivery\-ready solution proposals.
* Strong commercial acumen — experience building resource plans, effort estimates, and solution costings.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills ability to present confidently to both technical and non\-technical audiences.

 You Excel At
   

  

 Leading complex client conversations with confidence

 Navigating ambiguity and driving clarity

 You Are Known For

 Ownership mentality — end to end
   

  

 A collaborative, low\-ego approach
   

  

 The candidate should have minimum 12 years of experience in Network Architecture and Design.

Principal AI Agent Architect
  
**Date Posted:** Sep 1, 2026
  
**Requisition ID:** 2149
  
  

**Location:**  

Bangalore, IN, 560048
  
  

**\#job\-location.job\-location\-inline { display:** inline; }
  
**Brand:** Penguin Solutions
  
  

**At Penguin Solutions (Nasdaq:** PENG) – The AI Factory Platform Company – we’re building a team of innovators who thrive on collaboration, creativity, and the opportunity to help shape the future of AI. As part of the AI technology revolution, our teams design, build, deploy, and manage AI factories for enterprises, sovereign AI initiatives, and neocloud providers worldwide.
  
  

Headquartered in Silicon Valley, California, Penguin Solutions operates globally through a network of R\&D, manufacturing, and sales locations. For nearly three decades, we have operated at the intersection of memory and AI/HPC infrastructure. That engineering expertise positions us to power the next generation of AI workloads, from training to inference and agentic AI at scale.
  
  

Penguin Solutions brings together differentiated infrastructure software, advanced memory, compute systems, end\-to\-end services, and industry\-leading partner solutions in a full\-stack AI factory platform designed to help customers deploy and scale AI workloads with speed and precision.
  
  

At Penguin Solutions, we value ideas over hierarchy and believe in servant leadership, where leaders enable teams to do their best work. We empower employees to take ownership, drive innovation, and grow through challenging work, continuous learning, and exposure to advanced AI tools and technologies. With flexibility where it matters and a strong focus on outcomes, Penguin Solutions is a place to do your best work, grow your career, and make a meaningful impact.
  
  

Job Overview
  
  

We are looking for a Principal AI Agent Architect to design and deliver key architectural components of ClusterWareAI's next\-generation AI Operational Agent. You will help build a secure, reliable, and measurable agentic AI platform capable of reasoning over enterprise infrastructure, orchestrating tools and workflows, and executing actions with appropriate levels of autonomy.
  
  

This is a hands\-on technical leadership role for a senior technical expert who will design complex production AI systems, partner closely with engineering and technical leadership, mentor engineers, and contribute to the evolution of ClusterWareAI's AI platform architecture.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
  

Design and implement key architectural components of the ClusterWareAI AI Operational Agent, including planning, reasoning, memory, state management, tool orchestration, and autonomous or human\-approved execution.
  
Design scalable agentic workflows and enterprise AI architectures, including multi\-agent approaches where appropriate.
  
Design knowledge management, RAG, context engineering, agent memory, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) capabilities for enterprise infrastructure automation.
  
Design reliable execution patterns for long\-running and asynchronous agent workflows, including state management, retries, recovery, fallbacks, and idempotency.
  
Contribute to AI evaluation and observability frameworks covering task success, quality, reliability, latency, cost, tool execution, and failure modes.
  
Design and implement guardrails and secure execution patterns for autonomous operations, including appropriate controls for tool access, privileges, data protection, tenant isolation, and human approval.
  
Partner with Product Management, AI, platform, and infrastructure engineering teams to translate customer and operational requirements into scalable AI capabilities.
  
Evaluate model and architecture choices, including model selection, routing, inference performance, reliability, and cost tradeoffs.
  
Mentor engineers, contribute to technical standards and engineering best practices, and provide technical guidance on complex AI system design.
  
Evaluate emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and platform capabilities and provide recommendations for adoption.
  
  

Required Qualifications
  
  

10\+ years of software engineering experience, including demonstrated experience designing and delivering complex production systems.
  
Deep hands\-on experience designing, building, and operating production\-grade LLM or agentic AI systems involving planning, reasoning, tool use, orchestration, and autonomous or human\-approved execution.
  
Strong expertise in Python and production software engineering.
  
Strong expertise in distributed systems and fault\-tolerant architectures, including asynchronous workflows, state management, retries, recovery, failure handling, and idempotency.
  
Experience with agent orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, or similar, and familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or equivalent tool\-integration patterns.
  
Experience with RAG architectures, vector databases, knowledge retrieval, context engineering, and agent memory.
  
Strong understanding of enterprise software architecture, APIs, microservices, and cloud\-native application development.
  
Hands\-on experience with Kubernetes and cloud\-native infrastructure, including deployment, APIs, automation, observability, and production operations.
  
Experience designing or implementing AI evaluation and observability approaches with measurable quality, reliability, latency, and cost metrics.
  
Strong understanding of AI/agent security, including prompt injection, tool security, excessive agency, privilege management, data protection, tenant isolation, and secure execution.
  
Experience evaluating model selection, routing, inference performance, and cost tradeoffs in production AI systems.
  
Demonstrated technical leadership, architecture experience, and ability to mentor engineers and influence complex technical decisions.
  
  

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

15\+ years of software engineering experience, with significant experience in architecture or senior technical leadership roles.
  
Experience building AI agents for infrastructure, cloud operations, SRE, Kubernetes, or enterprise IT operations.
  
Experience with infrastructure management, observability, virtualization, storage, networking, or cloud platforms.
  
Experience designing human\-in\-the\-loop or human\-on\-the\-loop systems and risk\-based levels of agent autonomy.
  
Experience with long\-running agent workflows, persistent memory, multi\-agent systems, and advanced context engineering.
  
Experience operating AI systems in multi\-tenant enterprise environments with strong security, auditability, and reliability requirements.
  
Experience with GPU\-based AI infrastructure, inference platforms, or AI workload orchestration.
  
Contributions to open\-source AI agent, Kubernetes, AI infrastructure, or distributed\-systems projects.
  
Published technical content, conference presentations, patents, or other demonstrated thought leadership in AI or distributed systems are a plus.
  
  

Location
  
  

Hybrid – Bangalore, India

**Solution Engineer – Onam Cloud** 




**Location:** 
 Kochi / Bengaluru / Chennai (Work from office)
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**About Onam Cloud** 




 Onam Cloud is a sovereign cloud platform operated by Saints and Masters India Private Limited. We offer public cloud, dedicated private cloud, bare\-metal infrastructure, storage, Kubernetes, and hybrid and multi\-cloud connectivity for customers requiring greater control, performance, compliance, and digital sovereignty.
 



**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a hands\-on Solution Engineer who can design secure, scalable, and cost\-effective cloud and infrastructure solutions for Onam Cloud customers.
 



 You will own the technical aspects of the customer journey—from understanding requirements and designing solution architectures to conducting demonstrations and proof\-of\-concept deployments. You will also ensure that approved solutions are clearly documented and handed over effectively to the implementation and operations teams.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Engage customers to understand their business, application, infrastructure, security, compliance, and operational requirements.
* Assess customers’ digital sovereignty and data residency requirements and design appropriate solutions for government, BFSI, and other regulated sectors.
* Design solutions across public cloud, private cloud, hybrid cloud, multi\-cloud, bare\-metal, and on\-premises environments.
* Prepare solution architectures, bills of materials, technical proposals, presentations, implementation plans, and effort estimates.
* Conduct product demonstrations, technical workshops, solution walkthroughs, and proof\-of\-concept deployments.
* Recommend compute, storage, networking, virtualization, container, backup, and disaster recovery architectures based on each customer’s workload and risk profile.
* Perform workload assessments and support migrations from VMware, on\-premises platforms, AWS, Azure, and other cloud environments.
* Recommend modern monitoring, observability, automation, and AIOps practices that help customers move from reactive troubleshooting towards proactive operations.
* Work closely with Sales, Platform Engineering, Customer Success, implementation, and partner teams.
* Support customer onboarding and ensure a smooth handover to implementation and operations teams.
* Maintain reusable solution templates, architecture diagrams, technical documentation, and customer\-facing materials.



**Required Technical Skills** 



* Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting skills.
* Experience designing solutions on AWS, Microsoft Azure, hybrid\-cloud, and multi\-cloud environments.
* Experience with cloud\-native architectures and the deployment and administration of Kubernetes workloads.
* Deep understanding of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, switching, VPNs, firewalls, DNS, load balancing, and public and private IP addressing.
* Strong understanding of virtualization technologies such as KVM, Proxmox VE, and VMware.
* Hands\-on knowledge of Terraform, Ansible, and infrastructure automation.
* Understanding of bare\-metal infrastructure, server hardware, storage, RAID, and data\-centre environments.
* Experience with on\-premises infrastructure, workload assessment, and migration.
* Knowledge of backup, disaster recovery, monitoring, high availability, security, and capacity planning.
* Familiarity with AIOps concepts, including AI/ML\-assisted monitoring, anomaly detection, event correlation, and observability.
* Ability to troubleshoot infrastructure, networking, platform, and application connectivity issues across multiple technology layers.



**Preferred Platform Experience** 




 Experience with one or more of the following would be an advantage:
 


* Linux administration
* KVM, Proxmox VE, or VMware
* Ceph storage
* Kubernetes and KubeVirt
* Apache CloudStack or OpenStack
* OPNsense or similar firewall platforms
* Arista or Cisco networking
* Infrastructure monitoring and observability platforms
* AIOps, DevOps, or SRE practices involving monitoring, automation, or incident response
* Keycloak, LDAP, SSO, and multi\-tenant identity and access management
* GitOps and CI/CD practices
* Cloud security, governance, risk, and compliance controls



**Professional Skills** 



* Strong customer\-facing communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to translate business requirements into practical technical solutions.
* Ability to explain complex technologies clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong technical documentation and solution\-writing skills.
* Commercial awareness and an understanding of cloud pricing and cost optimization.
* Ability and willingness to own opportunities from technical discovery through customer onboarding.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to work effectively across multiple internal and external teams.



**Experience and Qualifications** 



* At least three years of relevant experience in cloud infrastructure, solution architecture, systems engineering, pre\-sales, DevOps, SRE, or a similar role.
* Practical, hands\-on infrastructure experience is essential.
* Relevant certifications would be an advantage, including AWS or Azure Solutions Architect, CKA, CKAD, RHCSA, LFCS, or equivalent cloud, cloud\-native, Linux, networking, or infrastructure certifications.
