ac1daa73.title: DevOps Architect
ac1daa73.description:
Req ID:524266

  



At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high\-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling, and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

  

Could you be the full\-time Software Architect in \[LOCATION] we’re looking for?

  

**Your future role**



Take on a new challenge and apply your technical leadership and software design expertise in a cutting\-edge field. You’ll work alongside innovative and collaborative teammates.



You'll play a pivotal role in shaping the software architecture and delivering software solutions aligned with our development processes. Day\-to\-day, you’ll work closely with cross\-functional teams, including Product Architects, System Engineering, and Quality teams, to meet Quality, Cost, and Delivery (QCD) commitments. Additionally, you’ll mentor and guide a team of Software Designers, ensuring alignment with best practices and applicable standards.



You’ll specifically take care of designing and specifying software architecture, but also leading the development of high\-quality software solutions.



We’ll look to you for:


* Specifying and designing software architecture in alignment with project requirements
* Technically leading a team of Software Designers
* Interfacing with System, Project, Product, and Quality teams to ensure QCD commitments
* Driving the adoption of DevOps practices and cloud technologies
* Ensuring software development adheres to applicable standards and best practices
* Collaborating with geographically distributed teams to deliver high\-quality solutions
  


  

**All about you**



We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:


* Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field
* At least 10 years of experience in software design and development using object\-oriented methodologies
* Experience in DevOps and cloud technologies, including Kubernetes and Docker
* Proficiency in cloud platforms like AWS, GCP, or Azure
* Experience in developing distributed web applications and microservices
* Proficiency in CI/CD tools such as Jenkins or CircleCI
* Experience with configuration management tools (e.g., Ansible, Puppet, Chef)
* Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation)
* Experience with Web APIs, PostgreSQL, Kafka, and MinIO
* Familiarity with Linux/Unix command line interface and networking concepts
* Hands\-on experience with COTS tools like GitLab/GitHub, SVN, ClearQuest, Eclipse, and Synergy
* Good understanding of SDLC and software development methodologies
* Strong collaboration and communication skills in a global, multicultural environment
  


  

**Things you’ll enjoy** Join us on a life\-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:


* Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long\-term career free from boring daily routines
* Work with new security standards for rail signalling
* Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues
* Contribute to innovative projects
* Utilise our flexible and inclusive working environment
* Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries
* Benefit from our investment in your development through award\-winning learning
* Progress towards senior leadership or technical expert roles
* Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension)

You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

  

**Important to note**



As a global business, we’re an equal\-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

  

  

**Job Segment:** Cloud, Computer Science, Linux, Unix, Technology

56caba86.title: Senior Solutions Architect, Life Insurance (Cloud-Native Platforms) - VOIS
56caba86.description:
**Who We Are**
 VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology \& Transformation.
   

  

 As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next\-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry\-first model which brings together the best of in\-house and 3rd party capability.
   

  

 We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
   

  

 \#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture
   

  

**About This Role**
 We are seeking an experienced Solutions Architect with deep expertise in Life and Funeral Insurance, cloud\-native architecture, and regulated financial services environments. This role is responsible for defining and governing end\-to\-end technology solutions that support insurance products and operations across customer onboarding, policy administration, premium collection, servicing, and claims.
   

  

 The successful candidate will provide architectural leadership across multiple agile delivery teams, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, compliant, and aligned with enterprise standards. This role combines strategic thinking, hands\-on technical architecture, stakeholder engagement, and insurance domain expertise to deliver future\-ready digital insurance platforms.
   

  

 Key focus areas include cloud\-native architecture, API\-first design, microservices, event\-driven systems, integration architecture, security\-by\-design, observability, and regulatory compliance within the insurance domain.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Design end\-to\-end solution architectures for Life and Funeral Insurance initiatives, balancing business objectives, technology strategy, cost efficiency, and long\-term sustainability
* Produce High\-Level Designs (HLDs), detailed solution designs, architecture decision records, integration designs, and supporting architectural documentation
* Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to understand requirements, define solution options, and translate strategy into implementable technology solutions
* Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance across multiple agile squads and delivery teams
* Drive adoption of cloud\-native, API\-first, microservices, and event\-driven architectural approaches
* Ensure solutions meet key non\-functional requirements including scalability, resilience, performance, observability, availability, and security
* Lead architecture reviews, governance processes, technology assessments, and design assurance activities
* Design and govern integrations across policy administration platforms, CRM systems, payment solutions, identity services, and customer engagement channels
* Partner with engineering, operations, security, risk, compliance, and business teams as a trusted technology advisor
* Apply FinOps principles to optimise cloud investments and support platform modernisation initiatives
* Ensure architecture aligns with compliance obligations such as AML, KYC, CDD, EDD, sanctions screening, PEP screening, FICA, POPIA, fraud prevention, audit requirements, and privacy\-by\-design principles
* Support agile and SAFe delivery practices by providing architectural direction and delivery readiness across releases and programmes
* Leverage AI\-assisted architecture tools responsibly to accelerate analysis, design exploration, and documentation activities


**Who You Are**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline
* 5–10\+ years of experience across software engineering and solution architecture
* 5\+ years of experience designing enterprise\-scale cloud\-native solutions
* Demonstrated experience within insurance, financial services, or another highly regulated industry
* Strong expertise in Life and Funeral Insurance products, policy administration, customer journeys, premium collection, servicing, claims, and domain integrations
* Proven ability to engage with both executive stakeholders and technical delivery teams
* Experience designing cloud architectures, preferably on AWS
* Strong knowledge of:
+ Microservices architecture
+ Event\-driven architecture
+ REST APIs and API management
+ Kafka, SNS/SQS, RabbitMQ, or equivalent messaging technologies
+ Oracle, PostgreSQL, and NoSQL databases
+ OAuth2, OpenID Connect, IAM, and security architecture
+ Observability platforms including CloudWatch, Grafana, ELK, and Dynatrace
+ CI/CD practices and architecture governance
+ Agile and ideally SAFe frameworks

* Excellent communication, collaboration, stakeholder management, strategic thinking, problem\-solving, mentoring, and decision\-making skills
* Preferred certifications:
+ AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional
+ TOGAF
+ SAFe for Architects or equivalent certification


**Not a perfect fit?**
 Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
   

  

**What's In It For You**
* Opportunity to shape the future of digital Life and Funeral Insurance platforms serving large customer populations
* Exposure to business\-critical architecture decisions within a highly regulated financial services environment
* Collaborative and supportive culture focused on innovation, continuous improvement, and meaningful customer impact
* Opportunity to work alongside engineering, security, risk, compliance, and business leaders
* Involvement in cloud transformation and platform modernisation programmes
* Hybrid working model with regular collaboration across multidisciplinary teams
* Opportunity to influence architecture strategy, governance, and technology adoption at scale


**What Skills You Will Learn**
* Advanced cloud\-native architecture and modernisation strategies
* Enterprise\-scale insurance platform architecture and integration design
* Financial services regulatory architecture and compliance\-by\-design practices
* FinOps methodologies and cloud cost optimisation techniques
* Advanced event\-driven and API\-first architecture patterns
* Enterprise observability and resilience engineering approaches
* Architecture governance and decision\-making frameworks
* AI\-assisted architecture and design acceleration techniques
* Stakeholder influencing and strategic technology leadership skills


**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
 Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio\-economic background.
   

  

**Join Us**
 At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
   

  

 We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
   

  

 With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.
   

  

**Alert**
 Apply for Vodafone jobs only through the official Vodafone Careers website to avoid job scams and fraud.
   

  

 \#JDEnhancedByTARA
   

  

**Follow us on social media**
 Follow us on social media and \#StayConnected
   

  

* LinkedIn: VOIS LinkedIn
* Facebook: VOIS Facebook
* Instagram: VOIS Instagram
* You can also chat with our employees to learn more about our projects: Employee Connect

16b205f7.title: Lead System Architect
16b205f7.description:
**Meet Our Team**
 Our team lives and breathes the Pega delivery vision: quickly building high\-quality, outcome\-driven applications that evolve with the changing needs of business. As a key member of the Pega Consulting team (GTM), you will work with a passionate and driven project team, delivering new and innovative business and technical solutions using Pega technology.
   

  

**Picture Yourself At Pega**
 Pega is changing the way the world builds software. In this role, you’ll help us design, develop, implement and test the next generation customer centric solutions. This is your chance to get your hands\-on leading technology that figures out what people really care about.
   

  

 At Pega, we actively explore and embrace emerging AI capabilities with curiosity, responsibility, and a drive for meaningful innovation. You will work in an environment where AI‑enabled tools are used to enhance learning, improve engineering efficiency, and support better decision‑making across the cloud platform.
   

  

 We expect engineers to apply critical thinking to all AI‑generated outputs—validating accuracy, quality, and relevance before applying them in production environments. We view AI maturity as a spectrum, progressing from foundational adoption toward more strategic, advocacy‑driven integration, and you will play an active role in that journey.
   

  

**What You'll Do At Pega**
* Lead and drive scope definition, requirements analysis, functional and technical design, application build, product configuration, unit testing, UAT and production deployment
* Partner with our world leading clients to deliver high quality technical solutions across all phases of the software development lifecycle
* Utilize your outstanding technical consulting skills to demonstrate new and innovative ways to implement software solutions
* Collaborating with a high performing Pega delivery team you will ensure the solution meets or exceeds your client’s expectations.
* Provide support and technical governance focused on one or more projects at a single client
* Act as a Subject Matter Expert to the organization and pro\-actively respond to adhoc questions


**Who You Are**
* Pega CLSA Certified resource must.
* You are a highly technical hands on individual who is passionate about exploring and applying Pega technology to help solve business problems.
* Experience in building and implementing model\-driven, enterprise\-level business solutions.
* Excellent time management and organization skills, with the capability to manage multiple competing priorities
* Exceptional interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate, partner and collaborate

**Experience:**

 Immediate to 30 Days

 **Cloud Architect**

* Understanding of microservices, API gateways, messaging systems, caching, and distributed applications.

* Strong understanding of cloud security, zero\-trust architecture, identity management, encryption, key management, and security operations.
* Working knowledge of FinOps, cloud budgeting, resource tagging, utilization monitoring, reserved capacity, and cost optimization.
* Familiarity with AI/ML cloud services, GPU workloads, object storage, data lakes, and retrieval\-based AI applications will be advantageous.

 The candidate should have experience designing environments aligned with applicable standards and project requirements, including:
 


* ISO 27001 and information\-security controls
* CERT\-In guidelines and audit requirements
* MeitY/GIGW requirements for Government applications
* Data localization and data\-residency requirements
* DPDP Act\-aligned privacy and security controls
* OWASP security practices
* Backup, retention, audit\-log, RTO, and RPO requirements
* Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing coordination

 Experience Requirements

 **10 years of overall IT infrastructure or cloud experience** 
 .
* At least
 **5 years of experience in cloud architecture, migration, or modernization roles** 
 .
* Proven experience designing and deploying production\-grade enterprise cloud environments.
* Experience handling large Government, PSU, BFSI, or enterprise projects is highly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience with high\-availability, disaster\-recovery, security\-compliant, and business\-critical systems.

 B.Tech/B.E./M.Tech/MCA or an equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related discipline.

 One or more of the following certifications will be preferred:
 


* AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional

Employment Type: Full Time  

Education Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field or higher with minimum 08 years of relevant experience.  

  

Position Overview  

We are seeking a highly experienced and proactive Senior Linux Administrator \& AWS Cloud Engineer with 8 to 10 years of hands on technical experience to join our IT Infrastructure team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, deploying, configuring, maintaining, and optimizing enterprise grade Linux servers and AWS cloud infrastructure.  

The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in Linux operating systems (Red Hat Enterprise Linux, CentOS, Ubuntu), robust cloud management skills in Amazon Web Services (AWS), and strong capabilities in automation, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), performance tuning, security hardening, and high availability operations.  

  

Key Responsibilities  

1\. Linux System Administration \& Engineering  

  

. Provision, configure, and maintain Linux enterprise environments (RHEL, CentOS, Rocky Linux, Ubuntu Server).  

. Perform advanced system administration tasks including OS upgrades, patch management, kernel tuning, user access management, and package management (yum, dnf, apt).  

. Manage storage subsystems, including Logical Volume Management (LVM), SAN/NAS mounts, NFS, and file system maintenance.  

. Troubleshooting complex operating system, hardware, networking, and application performance issues.  

  

2\. AWS Cloud Infrastructure Management  

  

. Architect, build, and manage scalable, reliable, and secure infrastructure on AWS.  

. Operate core AWS services including EC2, VPC, S3, IAM, EBS, EFS, Route 53, CloudWatch, CloudTrail, ALB/NLB, Auto Scaling Groups, RDS, and ElastiCache.  

. Manage containerized workloads using Docker and AWS container services (ECS / EKS).  

. Implement cost optimization and resource usage strategies (Savings Plans, Reserved Instances, right sizing).  

  

3\. Automation \& Infrastructure as Code (IaC)  

  

. Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration, and deployments using Terraform, CloudFormation, and Ansible.  

. Write and maintain robust shell scripts (Bash) and Python scripts for system monitoring, task automation, and maintenance routines.  

. Build and integrate deployment pipelines using CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions).  

  

4\. Security, Compliance \& System Hardening  

  

. Enforce enterprise security standards, CIS benchmarks, vulnerability scanning, and OS hardening procedures.  

. Manage AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) role policies, security groups, network ACLs, and SSL/TLS certificate lifecycle.  

. Participate in internal and external audit compliance processes (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, or PCI DSS).  

  

5\. Operations, High Availability \& Disaster Recovery  

  

. Ensure system reliability, uptime, and high availability across multi AZ AWS environments.  

. Design, test, and execute Backup and Disaster Recovery (DR) strategies.  

. Monitor system metrics, setup automated alerts, and respond to critical system incidents.  

. Serve as a senior technical escalation point and participate in an on call rotation schedule.  

  

  

Required Qualifications \& Technical Skills  

  

. Experience: 8–10 years of dedicated experience in Linux System Administration, with at least 4\+ years of hands on experience managing production AWS environments.  

. Linux OS Expertise: Strong proficiency with RHEL / CentOS / Ubuntu, command line utilities, systemd, boot sequences, and kernel diagnostics.  

. AWS Expertise: Proven track record in managing enterprise AWS architectures, networking (VPC peering, Transit Gateway, VPNs), and IAM governance.  

. Configuration Management \& IaC: Hands on experience with Terraform and Ansible for environment provisioning and configuration.  

. Scripting: Proficiency in Bash and Python for automation.  

. Networking \& Security: Solid understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, SSH, Firewalld/IPTables, VPN, SSL/TLS, load balancing, and routing.  

. Database Administration Support: Experience supporting Linux based database servers (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, or Oracle).  

. Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, System Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.  

  

  

Preferred Certifications \& Plus Points  

  

. AWS Certifications: AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or Professional AWS Certified SysOps Administrator – Associate AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional  

. Linux Certifications: Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) or Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE)  

. Experience with: Kubernetes / EKS administration Monitoring platforms like Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or New Relic Infrastructure compliance frameworks

**Your future duties and responsibilities**

**Required qualifications to be successful in this role**

bd95acde.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in technical program management.
* Experience working on consumer\-facing mobile applications and high\-frequency transactional/utility products in the FinTech, Payments, or Commerce industry.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience in applying modern AI/ML tools, Large Language Models (LLMs), and agent\-based automation to advance technical program management practices (e.g., autonomous dependency tracking, predictive risk analysis, and process optimization).
* Experience collaborating effectively with distributed Engineering, Product Management, Partnerships, UX, Legal, Compliance, and Finance teams.
* Understanding of the India digital payments and utility ecosystem, including UPI, Bharat Connect, regulatory landscape (RBI, NPCI), and key market players.

**About the job**
-----------------


A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.


Google Pay India is at the forefront of India's digital payments revolution. We build and scale a leading platform used by hundreds of millions of consumers and millions of merchants for a wide range of transactions, from peer\-to\-peer transfers and bill payments to in\-store and online purchases. Beyond payments, we are expanding access to financial services, striving to make money management and financial products more accessible to all Indians. Joining our team means shaping the future of finance in one of the world's most dynamic digital economies.


Whether it is paying online with Autofill, using tap and pay in stores, or using the Google Pay app, the Payments team at Google is focused on making payments simple, seamless, and secure. In addition to consumer payment technologies, the Payments team also powers the money movement between Google and its consumers and businesses.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Lead and own the end\-to\-end delivery of multiple complex, cross\-functional technical programs critical to Google Pay India's strategic goals, such as everyday utility payments (Billpay, Recharge, Transit), new feature launches, platform modernization, and partner ecosystem integrations.
* Define program scope, objectives, and key results (OKRs), translating ambiguous problems into clear plans, milestones, and deliverables.
* Drive program execution, proactively identify and mitigate risks, manage dependencies, and ensure timely delivery of high\-quality outcomes in a fast\-paced environment.
* Advocate the integration of agent\-based AI tools and autonomous workflows into technical program management practices, proactively automating routine operations and enhancing predictive risk mitigation.
* Exercise strong technical judgment to understand engineering challenges, contribute to design discussions, evaluate trade\-offs, and guide technical decisions.

Convert undefined customer interest into scoped, investment\-justified engagement proposals with clear success metrics and ROI projections.
* Develop and articulate executive\-level narratives that connect developer transformation to business outcomes — productivity ROI, innovation velocity, and competitive differentiation. Tailor value propositions by industry vertical and customer maturity, and present independently to VP/CxO\-level engineering and business leaders.
* Lead cross\-functional delivery with Solutions Architects, Developer Specialist SAs, and field teams to design and execute AI\-native engineering transformation programs — including AI\-DLC workshops, and Kiro and developer tool adoption accelerators. Own engagement architecture and sequencing decisions. Resolve technical ambiguity by making informed trade\-offs.
* Own end\-to\-end engagement lifecycle — from qualification and scoping through delivery, measurement, and post\-engagement follow\-up — for complex enterprise developer transformation programs. Manage a portfolio of 8\-12 concurrent engagements across industries (FSI, manufacturing, technology, telecom), ensuring progress toward documented, measurable outcomes. Track and report pipeline metrics (ARR, opportunity conversion, engagement\-to\-launch ratio) with full accountability for India DevTx program targets.
* Design engagement governance structures — defining scope, success criteria, escalation paths, and exit criteria — in partnership with customer technical and business stakeholders. Evaluate feasibility, long\-term value realization potential, and AWS investment ROI before committing resources. Establish systems that ensure consistent engagement quality and eliminate non\-differentiated work through automation and reusable frameworks.
* Drive alignment across AWS internal teams (account managers, solutions architects, specialist teams) and customer organizations (engineering leadership, platform teams, developer communities). Navigate competing priorities and organizational politics to maintain momentum on transformation initiatives. Serve as the single thread connecting customer business outcomes to AWS technical delivery.
* Build and maintain trusted advisor relationships with senior engineering leaders (VP/Director level) within customer organizations. Be recognized as the go\-to person for developer platform strategy and AI\-driven engineering transformation. Engage occasionally with C\-suite executives on strategic transformation vision and engagement decisions.
* Guide customers in designing their AI\-native software development operating models — from tool adoption (Kiro) through methodology transformation (AI\-DLC framework) to organizational change management. Ensure transformation initiatives deliver verified, quantified business outcomes within agreed timelines.
* Capture and systematize learnings from engagements into reusable assets (playbooks, case studies, enablement content) that multiply team effectiveness. Provide actionable customer feedback to AWS teams that informs DevTx charter and strategy. Contribute to thought leadership through internal blogs, external case studies, and conference presentations.
* Coordinate with APJ and Global DevTx peers on cross\-geography engagement opportunities, shared customer programs, and methodology standardization. Represent India DevTx in regional forums and contribute to scaling successful India engagement patterns across APJ.

  

What Makes This Role Unique  

  

This is not a traditional Engagement Manager or Professional Services role. In this role, you will:  

* Own programs, not projects — drive multi\-quarter customer transformation journeys, not time\-boxed billable engagements
* Combine strategy with execution — present transformation roadmaps to VPs of Engineering one day, then triage intake queues and unblock engagements the next
* Own business outcomes — be accountable for pipeline metrics, opportunity conversion, and ARR — not just engagement satisfaction scores

  

A day in the life  

Your days will be varied and high\-impact. One morning you might be reviewing a customer's AI\-DLC workshop feedback, refining the follow\-up plan that converts a successful prototype into a production adoption roadmap with clear revenue implications.  

  

Later that day, you could be presenting a transformation case to a customer's leadership team — articulating why their 5,000\-developer engineering org needs a structured AI\-native development program and what the expected business outcome looks like in 6 months.  

  

Between meetings, you'll triage new engagement requests in the intake queue — qualifying a GSI's ask for Kiro enablement, deprioritizing a low\-signal opportunity, and connecting an account team with the right specialist SA for a complex developer transformation scoping and review.  

  

You'll spend time building — creating reusable engagement frameworks, updating pipeline trackers, and authoring the narrative that justifies expanding DevTx's footprint into new customer segments. You'll collaborate with your global peers to exchange learnings, align on methodology standards, and identify customers with cross\-geography presence that need coordinated engagement strategies.  

  

This role requires balancing strategic executive engagement with operational program management — you'll shift between leadership conversations and intake triage daily.  

  

About the team  

The AWS Developer Transformation (DevTx) India team leads the next generation of software development practices across India's largest enterprises. We help engineering teams adopt AI\-native development methodologies and AI\-Driven Development Lifecycle (AI\-DLC) transformations — compressing development timelines from months to days and weeks. Our team works directly with CTOs and VPs of Engineering to accelerate developer productivity at scale.  

  

We operate with high ownership, transparency, and autonomy — every team member owns their engagements from intake to outcome. This is a small, high\-impact team where your work directly shapes how major Indian enterprises build software.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 6\+ years of leading large\-scale, technical or engineering programs with a proven record of thought leadership, business case development, realizing customer benefits, and successful program completion experience
* 6\+ years of customer\-facing work, engaging with customer executives, technologists or partners to solve business problems with advanced technologies experience
* Bachelor's degree in science, technology, engineering, math, business or equivalent
* Experience leading technical and non\-technical transformation project teams with a proven ability to work across broad functional teams

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

c527eb00.description:
**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program management.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* 5 years of experience managing cross\-functional or cross\-team projects.
* Experience working in SaaS or subscription\-based business models, with a deep understanding of recurring revenue streams or enterprise customer lifecycles.
* Experience in software development workflows (code review, testing) and define quality metrics for automated systems.
* Experience managing end\-to\-end product lifecycles and large\-scale rollouts.


**About The Job**
 A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.
   

  

 Google Workspace is home to billions of users and millions of businesses. The Workspace Monetization (Commerce and Admin Experience) team is at the heart of our commercial strategy and enterprise customer lifecycle.
   

  

 As a Technical Program Manager on this team, you will lead complex, cross\-functional programs that define how we monetize the next generation of AI\-powered productivity.
   

  

 Our team is responsible for the end\-to\-end customer lifecycle journey in Workspace. We focus on developing value\-capture strategies, managing usage limits, mitigating abuse, optimizing purchase flows, and minimizing customer churn for millions of global businesses. Building core infrastructure for metering, billing, and invoicing based on SKUs and resource consumption. Modernizing our enterprise administration platforms, advancing mobile administration tools, and deploying AI agents and assistants to streamline IT operations. Building robust auditing and reporting platforms, deploying AI\-driven diagnostics, and designing seamless migration and onboarding pathways for enterprise and small business customers.
   

  

 Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with team members and stakeholders to understand or identify defined work problems and program goals, obtain prioritized deliverables, and discuss program impact.
* Prioritize program goals, understand and translate other stakeholders’ needs into program goals and prioritized deliverables with minimal assistance, and contribute to decisions on prioritizing goals and deliverables.
* Define the scope of projects and develop, execute, or manage project plans for supported programs.
* Review key metrics pertaining to a program, monitor potential metric deviations, and define corrective actions for critical deviations.
* Identify, communicate, and collaborate with relevant stakeholders within one or more teams to drive impact and work toward mutual goals. Build, maintain and enhance business, operational, and management dashboards. Build relationships and manage complex dependencies across core product teams, Payments, Risk, Legal, and Privacy departments.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. d65a1c60.description:
**About Nebius** 




  





 Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full\-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in\-house AI/ML infrastructure.
 



 Built by engineers, for engineers. From large\-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.
 



 Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R\&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500\+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R\&D.
 



  





**The role** 




  





 As a Technical Program Manager, you will own the delivery of a defined workstream within large\-scale GPU and data center infrastructure deployment programs. In this role you’ll be responsible for tracking progress, managing dependencies, and ensuring your workstream is delivered on time and at quality.
 



 This is a hands\-on role at the intersection of infrastructure, execution, and coordination, with strong exposure to real\-world data center delivery.
 



 Travel: On\-site presence at data centers will be required during key deployment phases.
 



  





**Your Responsibilities Will Include** 




  




* Own delivery of a defined workstream within a larger data center or infrastructure program.
* Track scope, schedule, and dependencies, escalating risks when needed.
* Coordinate with engineering, networking, construction, and operations teams.
* Maintain clear and structured reporting on progress, risks, and blockers.
* Support vendor and contractor coordination within your scope.
* Work closely with the Senior TPM to align on priorities and execution approach.



  





**Technical Scope \& Expectations** 




  





 This role requires exposure to physical infrastructure environments, not only software\-based projects.
 



  





**You Should Be Comfortable Working With Or Learning About** 




  




* Data center environments: basic understanding of infrastructure readiness (power, cooling, space, networking dependencies).
* Compute infrastructure: knowledge about server and storage equipment.
* Networking: cabling, connectivity, and integration dependencies.
* Deployment \& bring\-up: understanding how systems move from installation to operational readiness.



 You are not expected to be an expert, but you should:
 


* Be willing to learn technical concepts quickly.
* Understand how different parts of infrastructure depend on each other.
* Identify when something is not ready or at risk and escalate appropriately.
* Communicate effectively with technical teams.



  





**We Expect You To Have** 




  




* 2–5 years of experience in program management, operations, or technical coordination roles.
* Ability to organize work, track progress, and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
* communication skills and ability to work with cross\-functional teams.
* Structured thinking and attention to details.
* Willingness to learn and grow in a fast\-paced, technical environment.



  





**It will be an added bonus if you have** 




  




* Exposure to data center, networking, or hardware\-related projects,
* Familiarity with program management tools (Jira, Asana, etc.),
* Understanding of cloud environments infrastructure,
* Certifications or coursework in program management.



  





**Benefits \& Perks** 




  




* Competitive compensation
* Career growth and learning opportunities
* Flexibility and ownership
* Collaborative and innovative culture
* Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
* International environment and talented teams



  





**What's It Like To Work At Nebius** 




  





 Fast moving \- Bold thinking \- Constant growth \- Meaningful impact \- Trust and real ownership \- Opportunity to shape the future of AI
 



  





**Equal Opportunity Statement** 




  





 Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
 



 Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.
 



 If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

Requisition ID: 1738802

* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving abilities
* Effective stakeholder and client management skills
* Strong architecture and technical documentation expertise
* Presentation and solution demonstration skills
* Team\-player mindset with collaborative working style
* Self\-motivated and proactive attitude

abe4c669.title: Mainframe Infrastructure Solution Architect
abe4c669.description:
**Job Title: Mainframe Infrastructure Solution Architect \- Presales**
**Location:** 
 Bengaluru / Chennai / Gurgaon / Pune
   

  

**Job Type:** 
 Full\-time
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled Mainframe Infrastructure Architect to join our dynamic team. This pivotal role will be responsible for providing technical leadership and strategic guidance throughout the presales cycle, focusing on mainframe solutions and modernization initiatives. The ideal candidate will possess deep technical knowledge of mainframe environments, coupled with exceptional communication and presentation skills to articulate complex solutions to both technical and non\-technical audiences, including C\-level executives.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Solution Design \& Architecture:
+ Lead the design and definition of overall mainframe infrastructure solutionframeworks for mainframe components within client proposals and bids.
+ Analyze client requirements, existing IT landscapes, and business objectives to architect tailor\-made mainframe solutions, including on\-premise, cloud, and hybrid models.
+ Develop detailed architectural designs, high\-level designs, and associated documentation (e.g., application views, multiple sections \& views, artefacts).
+ Evaluate and recommend solutions to integrate mainframe systems with the broader technology ecosystem.
+ Identify improvements, options, and tradeoffs to define target state solutions.

* Presales \& Client Engagement:
+ Act as the primary technical subject matter expert during the presales phase, supporting the sales team in all technical aspects.
+ Engage directly with clients, including C\-level executives, technical decision\-makers, and business stakeholders, to understand their challenges and demonstrate how our mainframe solutions can address their needs.
+ Develop and deliver compelling technical presentations, demonstrations, and proofs\-of\-concept (POCs).
+ Collaborate with sales, program/project, and consulting teams to ensure proposed solutions align with client expectations and internal capabilities.
+ Participate in the development of RFP/RFS responses, providing technical analysis, cost estimations, and architectural validation.
+ Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective clients.

* Mainframe Modernization \& Innovation:
+ Provide technical and strategic input for mainframe modernization strategies, including re\-hosting, refactoring, re\-platforming, and rewriting initiatives.
+ Guide customers in planning, evaluating, architecting, and re\-engineering legacy applications to leverage modern cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, GCP, etc.).
+ Stay abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies (e.g., AI/ML for modernization), and best practices in mainframe and cloud landscapes.
+ Contribute to the development of white papers, case studies, and thought leadership content related to mainframe solutions and modernization.

* Technical Leadership \& Mentorship:
+ Provide technical leadership to design, development, and implementation teams for custom solutions.
+ Mentor developers, designers, and junior architects, fostering their growth and enhancing their capabilities.
+ Contribute to internal architecture practices by conducting interviews and sharing knowledge.

* Costing \& Risk Management:
+ Develop fully costed solution architectures and provide accurate cost estimates for mainframe solution implementation (such as MFaaS) and ongoing support.
+ Identify implementation risks and potential impacts, proposing mitigation strategies.
+ Validate solutions from a technology, cost structure, and customer differentiation perspective.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Typically 12\+ years of experience in a technology environment, with a strong focus on mainframe infrastructure solutions
* Minimum of 5\+ years of hands\-on technical experience with mainframe systems and technologies such as:
+ Languages: COBOL, JCL, PL/I, Assembler, REXX, Natural, RPG.
+ Databases: DB2 for z/OS, IMS DB, VSAM, Adabas.
+ Transaction Managers: CICS, IMS TM.
+ Operating Systems: z/OS, z/VM, zLinux.
+ Middleware: MQ, WebSphere.
+ Tools: IBM Debug Tool for z/OS, Syncsort, SPUFI, ChangeMan, Endevor, CA\-7/ESP/Control\-M (Job Schedulers).

* Proven experience in designing and delivering complex mainframe solutions, including large\-scale migrations and modernizations.
* Strong understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and experience in architecting solutions for mainframe to cloud migration/integration and tools like Zowe, OpenShift, Wazi
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts clearly and concisely to diverse audiences.
* Proven presentation skills, comfortable presenting to large groups and executive levels.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.
* Demonstrated ability to build and maintain strong client relationships.
* Willingness to travel as required.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer Engineering / relevant
* Experience with specific mainframe modernization tools and patterns (re\-architecture, rewrite, refactor, rehost).
* Familiarity with distributed client\-server architecture systems.
* Exposure to GenAI technologies (LLMs, NLP) for application modernization assessments or code transformation.
* Experience with ITILv3 or ITSM principles.
* IBM Mainframe administration certification

**Delivery Manager \| Enterprise Technology \& Performance\-Technology Strategy \& Transformation \| ITSM**

**The team**



Enterprise technology has to do much more than keep the wheels turning; it is the engine that drives functional excellence and the enabler of innovation and long\-term growth. Learn more about ET\&P

  


**Your work profile**

  



We are seeking a highly driven and governance\-focused SIAM professional to establish and mature enterprise\-scale IT Service Integration and Management (SIAM) operations across complex multi\-vendor environments. The role will be responsible for driving Service Delivery Excellence, improving operational governance, enhancing customer experience, reducing Major Incidents, and enabling proactive IT operations through process optimization, governance frameworks, and AIOps\-led operational transformation.



The ideal candidate should possess strong experience in ITSM governance, Incident/Major Incident Management, Problem Management, vendor governance, operational reporting, RCA governance, and service quality assurance across large\-scale ERP/MIS/Infrastructure landscapes.



This role requires hands\-on engagement with cross\-functional teams, MSPs, infrastructure partners, application support teams, and business stakeholders to establish a mature governance operating model aligned to industry best practices.

  



SIAM Governance \& Service Integration


* Establish and operationalize SIAM governance frameworks across multi\-vendor IT ecosystems.
* Drive Service Delivery Excellence initiatives across Incident, Problem, Change, Major Incident, and Service Improvement processes.
* Define and implement governance operating models for large\-scale managed services engagements.
* Create governance structures for Daily, Weekly, Monthly, and Quarterly operational reviews.
* Ensure accountability across multiple support vendors and assignment groups.
* Develop governance dashboards, operational KPIs, and service quality scorecards.
* Conduct Delivery \& Objectives (DNO) reviews and operational governance assessments.

  



Major Incident \& Operational Excellence


* Lead governance around Incident Management (IM), Problem Management (PM), Change Management (CHG), and Major Incident Management (MIM).
* Review effectiveness of current MIM processes and identify operational gaps.
* Drive reduction of recurring P1/P2 incidents through structured Problem Management and RCA governance.
* Ensure high\-quality Post Incident Reviews (PIRs) and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) documentation.
* Improve incident triaging, escalation effectiveness, communication quality, and stakeholder management.
* Implement quality checks for incident lifecycle management and operational adherence.
* Reduce operational backlog through governance\-driven action plans and vendor accountability.

  



Vendor Governance \& Service Accountability


* Establish vendor accountability models and governance mechanisms across MSP and support partners.
* Define measurable operational KPIs, SLAs, OLAs, and service quality benchmarks.
* Conduct operational governance reviews with vendors and internal stakeholders.
* Drive continuous service improvement programs (SIP) aligned to business outcomes.
* Identify operational inefficiencies and governance gaps across support delivery teams.

  



ITSM Process Excellence

69ba0a71.title: Delivery Leader - Engineering
69ba0a71.description:
**About Us:**
 Barry\-Wehmiller is a diversified global supplier of engineering consulting and manufacturing technology for the packaging, corrugating, sheeting and paper\-converting industries. By blending people\-centric leadership with disciplined operational strategies and purpose\-driven growth, Barry\-Wehmiller has become a $3 billion organization with nearly 12,000 team members united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world.
   

  

**Job Description:**
**Build a Better World Through Business**
 At Barry\-Wehmiller, we believe business can be a powerful force for good. We are a global provider of manufacturing technologies and services serving customers across packaging, paper converting, sheeting, corrugating, engineering, and industrial automation markets.
   

  

 What sets us apart is our commitment to Truly Human Leadership, a philosophy centered on creating meaningful work, caring for people, and delivering business results through strong relationships and responsible leadership.
   

  

 Our Chennai Global Competency Center (GCC) serves as a strategic engineering and operational hub supporting Barry\-Wehmiller businesses worldwide. Teams across Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Content Management, IT, Sourcing, and Shared Services collaborate with global platforms to deliver innovative solutions and exceptional customer outcomes.
   

  

**The Role**
 We are seeking an experienced engineering people leader to lead a multidisciplinary GCC Engineering team supporting the Barry\-Wehmiller Papersystems platform.
   

  

 The Delivery Leader is responsible for day\-to\-day delivery, people leadership, capacity alignment, stakeholder communication, and team performance. This role converts platform demand into executable work, develops engineering capability, and creates an environment where teams can consistently deliver high\-quality outcomes.
   

  

 This is an ideal opportunity for a leader who enjoys building high\-performing teams, strengthening delivery discipline, developing future leaders, and partnering with global stakeholders in a people\-first culture.
   

  

**Team Scope**
 You will lead a large multidisciplinary engineering team consisting of Mechanical, Electrical, and Controls Engineering professionals working in partnership with Technical Leads and global Papersystems stakeholders.
   

  

**Role Scope**
 The Delivery Leader is accountable for:
   

  

* People leadership and team development
* Capacity planning and resource alignment
* Delivery governance and execution discipline
* Stakeholder communication and expectation management
* Performance management and talent development
* Hiring, onboarding, and retention
* First\-level issue escalation and risk management


 Technical Leads in the team remain accountable for detailed technical direction, engineering methodologies, and design decisions.
   

  

 The Delivery Leader's role is to bring together people, priorities, capacity, and stakeholder expectations to ensure predictable and sustainable execution.
   

  

**What You Will Own**
*Delivery Excellence*
* Translate business priorities and stakeholder demand into executable plans aligned with team capacity and capability.
* Ensure projects are delivered with quality, efficiency, and predictability.
* Monitor delivery health, identify risks early, and drive timely resolution.
* Establish clear operating rhythms, dashboards, metrics, and governance mechanisms.
* Maintain transparency through proactive communication with stakeholders and leadership.
* Create accountability across the team while fostering a culture of ownership and continuous improvement.


*Build Capability and Develop People*
* Coach and develop team members to strengthen technical, professional, and leadership capabilities.
* Partner with Technical Leads to identify capability gaps and strengthen skill depth across engineering disciplines.
* Support the development of Subject Matter Experts in priority technical domains.
* Lead goal setting, performance management, career development planning, and feedback processes.
* Create an engaging environment that enables learning, growth, and professional fulfillment.
* Build a healthy pipeline of future technical and people leaders.


*Lead Team Effectiveness*
* Align talent to business priorities and resource needs.
* Monitor workload distribution and team capacity to ensure sustainable performance.
* Remove organizational barriers that impact productivity and delivery.
* Drive collaboration between Mechanical, Electrical, and Controls Engineering teams.
* Foster teamwork, accountability, and cross\-functional partnership.


*Stakeholder Partnership*
* Build trusted relationships with global platform leaders and project stakeholders.
* Align expectations, priorities, timelines, and delivery commitments.
* Anticipate future demand and support workforce planning discussions.
* Communicate effectively across functions, cultures, and geographies.


*Drive Operational Discipline*
* Reinforce engineering standards, delivery discipline, and quality expectations.
* Promote continuous improvement initiatives that improve efficiency and predictability.
* Use data and metrics to guide decision making and monitor performance.
* Balance stakeholder needs with sustainable team operations and long\-term capability building.


**What Success Looks Like**
 Success in this role will be measured through:
   

  

* Consistently high\-quality project delivery
* Strong stakeholder trust and communication
* Healthy team engagement and retention
* Improved technical capability and succession strength
* Effective capacity planning and workload management
* Development of future leaders and subject matter experts
* Sustainable performance through People and Performance in Harmony


**What You Bring**
*Leadership Experience*
* Proven experience leading medium to large engineering teams in a people leadership capacity.
* Demonstrated success managing performance, coaching individuals, and developing future leaders.
* Strong experience leading hiring, talent assessment, onboarding, and workforce planning activities.
* Ability to influence both individual contributors and technical leaders without relying solely on positional authority.


*Delivery \& Business Leadership*
* Experience driving engineering delivery in a global or matrixed environment.
* Strong project, program, or delivery management experience.
* Proven ability to create visibility through metrics, dashboards, and delivery governance frameworks.
* Experience balancing multiple stakeholder priorities while maintaining team well\-being and delivery quality.


*Technical Foundation*
* Background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Industrial Automation, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field.
* Broad engineering understanding to guide execution and effectively partner with Technical Leads.
* Ability to understand cross\-functional engineering workflows and identify risks, dependencies, and improvement opportunities.


*Global Collaboration*
* Experience working with geographically distributed teams and international stakeholders.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to navigate ambiguity, competing priorities, and organizational complexity while maintaining alignment and momentum.


**Preferred Experience**
* Experience leading teams of approximately 25\-40\+ engineers.
* Experience working within GCCs, captive centers, engineering services organizations, OEMs, or manufacturing technology companies.
* Exposure to Mechanical, Electrical, and Controls Engineering environments.
* Experience building capability development programs, technical talent pipelines, or SME frameworks.
* Experience supporting performance, compensation, and career development processes.


**Knowledge Areas**
* Engineering Operations and Delivery Management
* Mechanical, Electrical and Controls Engineering Fundamentals
* Manufacturing and Installation Processes
* Engineering Resource Planning
* Talent and Performance Management
* Stakeholder Management
* Continuous Improvement
* OEM Engineering Environments


**Core Leadership Capabilities**
* Builds Trust and Credibility
* Develops Talent
* Drives Accountability
* Communicates with Clarity and Courage
* Balances People and Performance
* Leads Through Influence
* Navigates Complexity
* Promotes Inclusion and Collaboration
* Demonstrates Business Acumen
* Champions Continuous Improvement


**Education And Experience**
* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related discipline.
* Master's degree preferred.
* Minimum 15 years of relevant engineering experience, including significant people leadership responsibility.


**Travel**
 Up to 10% based on business requirements.
   

  

 We believe our culture differentiates us from other firms. To know more about us and our people\-centric culture, you may like to watch a 20 Minute video from Late Mr. Robert Chapman Chairman of Barry\-Wehmiller. Please click on the following link to watch the Truly Human Leadership video.
   

  

 Barry\-Wehmiller is a place where you can bring your best self to life through the work that you do — no matter the path you choose.
   

  

 Watch the video below to hear Barry\-Wehmiller President Kyle Chapman discuss how our vast career opportunities empower our team members to choose their own journeys, no matter who they want to be click here to watch
   

  

*At Barry\-Wehmiller we recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent beyond just the technical requirements of a job. If your experience is close to what you see listed here, please still consider applying. We know that our differences often can bring about innovation, excellence and meaningful work—therefore, people from all backgrounds are encouraged to apply to our positions. Please let us know if you require reasonable accommodations during the interview process.*

616f7e03.title: Senior Engagement Manager, Developer Transformation
616f7e03.description:
**Description**
 Are you ready to lead the AI\-driven transformation of how enterprise software teams build, ship, and scale? Do you combine deep technical credibility with strategic business acumen to drive measurable developer productivity outcomes at Fortune 500 companies? Can you operate independently in ambiguous environments — setting direction when strategy is unclear and turning undefined opportunities into quantifiable business impact?
   

  

 As a Senior Engagement Manager for Developer Transformation (DevTx), AWS India, you will own end\-to\-end strategy and execution of AI\-native developer transformation programs across India's largest enterprise customers. You will lead complex, multi\-stakeholder engagements where scope, ownership, and success criteria are often undefined — bringing clarity, setting direction, and driving documented business outcomes. You will serve as a trusted advisor to senior engineering and business stakeholders, connecting developer AI adoption to measurable business value (productivity gains, time\-to\-market acceleration). You will build mechanisms that scale impact beyond individual engagements, shaping how AWS's developer transformation methodology is delivered across the APJ region.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Own the India AI\-DLC engagement pipeline — proactively identify, qualify, and prioritize developer transformation opportunities across ISVs, GSIs, FSI, and Enterprise segments by diving deep into customers' engineering organization structures, technology stacks, and business priorities. Define intake criteria and triage mechanisms that enable scale across the team. Convert undefined customer interest into scoped, investment\-justified engagement proposals with clear success metrics and ROI projections.
* Develop and articulate executive\-level narratives that connect developer transformation to business outcomes — productivity ROI, innovation velocity, and competitive differentiation. Tailor value propositions by industry vertical and customer maturity, and present independently to VP/CxO\-level engineering and business leaders.
* Lead cross\-functional delivery with Solutions Architects, Developer Specialist SAs, and field teams to design and execute AI\-native engineering transformation programs — including AI\-DLC workshops, and Kiro and developer tool adoption accelerators. Own engagement architecture and sequencing decisions. Resolve technical ambiguity by making informed trade\-offs.
* Own end\-to\-end engagement lifecycle — from qualification and scoping through delivery, measurement, and post\-engagement follow\-up — for complex enterprise developer transformation programs. Manage a portfolio of 8\-12 concurrent engagements across industries (FSI, manufacturing, technology, telecom), ensuring progress toward documented, measurable outcomes. Track and report pipeline metrics (ARR, opportunity conversion, engagement\-to\-launch ratio) with full accountability for India DevTx program targets.
* Design engagement governance structures — defining scope, success criteria, escalation paths, and exit criteria — in partnership with customer technical and business stakeholders. Evaluate feasibility, long\-term value realization potential, and AWS investment ROI before committing resources. Establish systems that ensure consistent engagement quality and eliminate non\-differentiated work through automation and reusable frameworks.
* Drive alignment across AWS internal teams (account managers, solutions architects, specialist teams) and customer organizations (engineering leadership, platform teams, developer communities). Navigate competing priorities and organizational politics to maintain momentum on transformation initiatives. Serve as the single thread connecting customer business outcomes to AWS technical delivery.
* Build and maintain trusted advisor relationships with senior engineering leaders (VP/Director level) within customer organizations. Be recognized as the go\-to person for developer platform strategy and AI\-driven engineering transformation. Engage occasionally with C\-suite executives on strategic transformation vision and engagement decisions.
* Guide customers in designing their AI\-native software development operating models — from tool adoption (Kiro) through methodology transformation (AI\-DLC framework) to organizational change management. Ensure transformation initiatives deliver verified, quantified business outcomes within agreed timelines.
* Capture and systematize learnings from engagements into reusable assets (playbooks, case studies, enablement content) that multiply team effectiveness. Provide actionable customer feedback to AWS teams that informs DevTx charter and strategy. Contribute to thought leadership through internal blogs, external case studies, and conference presentations.
* Coordinate with APJ and Global DevTx peers on cross\-geography engagement opportunities, shared customer programs, and methodology standardization. Represent India DevTx in regional forums and contribute to scaling successful India engagement patterns across APJ.


 What Makes This Role Unique
   

  

 This is not a traditional Engagement Manager or Professional Services role. In this role, you will:
   

  

* Own programs, not projects — drive multi\-quarter customer transformation journeys, not time\-boxed billable engagements
* Combine strategy with execution — present transformation roadmaps to VPs of Engineering one day, then triage intake queues and unblock engagements the next
* Own business outcomes — be accountable for pipeline metrics, opportunity conversion, and ARR — not just engagement satisfaction scores


 A day in the life
   

  

 Your days will be varied and high\-impact. One morning you might be reviewing a customer's AI\-DLC workshop feedback, refining the follow\-up plan that converts a successful prototype into a production adoption roadmap with clear revenue implications.
   

  

 Later that day, you could be presenting a transformation case to a customer's leadership team — articulating why their 5,000\-developer engineering org needs a structured AI\-native development program and what the expected business outcome looks like in 6 months.
   

  

 Between meetings, you'll triage new engagement requests in the intake queue — qualifying a GSI's ask for Kiro enablement, deprioritizing a low\-signal opportunity, and connecting an account team with the right specialist SA for a complex developer transformation scoping and review.
   

  

 You'll spend time building — creating reusable engagement frameworks, updating pipeline trackers, and authoring the narrative that justifies expanding DevTx's footprint into new customer segments. You'll collaborate with your global peers to exchange learnings, align on methodology standards, and identify customers with cross\-geography presence that need coordinated engagement strategies.
   

  

 This role requires balancing strategic executive engagement with operational program management — you'll shift between leadership conversations and intake triage daily.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The AWS Developer Transformation (DevTx) India team leads the next generation of software development practices across India's largest enterprises. We help engineering teams adopt AI\-native development methodologies and AI\-Driven Development Lifecycle (AI\-DLC) transformations — compressing development timelines from months to days and weeks. Our team works directly with CTOs and VPs of Engineering to accelerate developer productivity at scale.
   

  

 We operate with high ownership, transparency, and autonomy — every team member owns their engagements from intake to outcome. This is a small, high\-impact team where your work directly shapes how major Indian enterprises build software.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 6\+ years of leading large\-scale, technical or engineering programs with a proven record of thought leadership, business case development, realizing customer benefits, and successful program completion experience
* 6\+ years of customer\-facing work, engaging with customer executives, technologists or partners to solve business problems with advanced technologies experience
* Bachelor's degree in science, technology, engineering, math, business or equivalent
* Experience leading technical and non\-technical transformation project teams with a proven ability to work across broad functional teams


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience implementing cloud services including migrations and modernization projects or similar
* Knowledge of software development lifecycle, including design, development, test, build, deployment processes and timelines
* PMP certification, or SCRUM/Agile, SAFe certification
* Experience building scalable programs and repeatable scalable processes, levering various tools and methods to create scale and efficiency
* Experience using data and metrics to measure impact and determine improvements
* Experience with AI/ML\-assisted development tools, developer productivity platforms, or DevOps/platform engineering transformation


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
   

  

  

**Company** 
 \- AWS India \- Haryana

5e6ba0fc.title: Technical Program Manager, Enterprise Architecture
5e6ba0fc.description:
**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2 years of experience in program management.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* 5 years of professional experience in software engineering, systems design, corporate IT, technical program management, or business process engineering.
* Experience organizing review pipelines, managing technical project queues, and facilitating cross\-team technical alignment.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to read complex integration diagrams, map system dependencies, and systematically spot application redundancies.
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills to collaborate seamlessly with globally spread partners and influence distributed developer teams.


**About The Job**
 A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.
   

  

 At Corp Eng, we build world\-leading business solutions that scale a more helpful Google for everyone. As Google’s IT organization, we provide end\-to\-end solutions for organizations across Google. We deliver the right tools, platforms, and experiences for all Googlers as they create more helpful products and services for everyone. In the simplest terms, we are Google for Googlers.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Drive the continuous improvement and meticulous hygiene of our centralized architecture repository (powered by LeanIX). Ensure application metadata, system capabilities, and cross\-pillar integration flows are mapped and documented with the highest standards of accuracy to serve as a reliable global source of truth.
* Partner with globally spread product, engineering, and architecture teams across corporate engineering domains to drive alignment, foster collaboration, and help teams adopt enterprise standards, enabling faster delivery and standard practices globally.
* Assist in defining, establishing, and maintaining core architectural foundations. This includes helping build and curate the EA Toolkit of approved reference architectures, reusable design patterns, standard guidelines, and approved technologies to drive consistency.

e0d31073.title: Solutions Engineer
e0d31073.description:
**The role sits between sales and engineering, and is accountable to both** 



  


 A high\-growth, VC\-backed SaaS company is hiring its founding India team through Flexiple. Deals are increasingly won or lost on whether a prospect's technical evaluator believes the product will work in their environment, and right now the founders are personally doing that call. It does not scale past about here. Flexiple is a managed marketplace that helps global companies build high\-performing teams and GCCs in India.
 


  


**What the week contains** 



  


 Technical discovery with prospects, which mostly means finding out what they actually have rather than what the RFP says. Building demonstrations against a customer's real constraints. Running proofs of concept and being straight about what did not work. Writing up integration requirements clearly enough that engineering can act on them without a second meeting.
 


  


**The uncomfortable part** 



  


 Telling a sales lead the deal will not work as scoped. That happens, and the people who last in this role are the ones who do it early rather than letting a proof of concept quietly fail three weeks later.
 


  


**Looking for** 



  

* 4 to 8 years in solutions engineering, pre\-sales engineering or a customer\-facing technical role
* Enough hands\-on ability to build a working integration, not only describe one
* APIs, authentication models and the usual enterprise objections around data residency
* Composure in front of a sceptical technical audience


  


 Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune, Delhi NCR, Mumbai or Chennai, or remote within India, with some travel to customer sites. A screening call, a technical conversation, a live scenario, then time with the founding team.
 


  


*Applying once also puts you forward for later customer\-facing engineering roles here.*
