06bf9637.description:
**Company Overview:** 




 IRISS is the global leader in industrial safety and condition\-based monitoring technologies, trusted by power generation, data center, and critical infrastructure teams worldwide. We design and manufacture in our facility in Bradenton Florida (made in the USA) innovative solutions that make maintenance safer, smarter, and more connected — helping organizations prevent failure, reduce risk, and protect their people.
 



 IRISS has its headquarters in the U.S. with operations across LATAM, EMEA, APAC, and India. At our core is a simple idea with profound impact: We Humanize Safety. That means creating products and technologies that are not only advanced, but intuitive, empowering, and designed with people in mind.
 



 We’re shaping the future of how industries work — and how workers stay safe
 



  





***Please review our website and YouTube to learn more about our products and who we are:***




  





**Electrical Maintenance Safety Solutions \| IRISS Inc** 




 https://iriss.com/
 



**IRISS \- YouTube** 




 https://www.youtube.com/@Irissemsd
 



  





**Company:** 
 IRISS ASIA PACIFIC PVT. LTD.
 



**Experience:** 
 3\-5 Years
 



**Education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical, Instrumentation, Industrial Engineering or related discipline)
 



  





**Position Summary** 




 The Sales Engineer will be responsible for promoting and selling IRISS safety and reliability solutions to industrial customers, EPC contractors, consultants, utilities, and channel partners. The role requires a blend of technical expertise, commercial acumen, and strong relationship\-building skills to identify opportunities, develop customer solutions, and achieve sales targets.
 



 \-\-\-
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Business Development \& Sales** 




 · Identify and develop new business opportunities across assigned territories.
 



 · Generate leads through prospecting, networking, referrals, and customer visits.
 



 · Promote IRISS products and solutions to industrial customers and key decision\-makers.
 



 · Develop and execute territory sales plans to achieve revenue and growth targets.
 



 · Manage the complete sales cycle from lead generation to order closure.
 



 Technical Consultation
 



 · Understand customer reliability and safety challenges and recommend appropriate solutions.
 



 · Work closely with customers to develop value\-based proposals and ROI justifications.
 



 · Coordinate with technical teams for solution design and implementation support.
 



  





**Customer Relationship Management** 




 · Establish and maintain strong relationships with plant managers, maintenance managers, reliability engineers, electrical engineers, and procurement teams.
 



 · Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction and post\-sales support.
 



 · Maintain regular engagement with key accounts to identify repeat business opportunities.
 



 Market Intelligence
 



 · Monitor industry trends, competitor activities, and emerging market opportunities.
 



 · Gather market feedback and provide insights to management.
 



 · Participate in trade shows, technical seminars, and industry events.
 



 Reporting \& CRM
 



 · Maintain accurate sales forecasts, opportunity pipelines, and customer records in CRM.
 



 · Submit weekly sales activity and performance reports.
 



 · Track project status and ensure timely follow\-up on quotations and proposals.
 



 \-\-\-
 



 Required Qualifications
 



 Education
 



 · Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical, Instrumentation, Industrial Engineering or related discipline).
 



 Experience
 



 · 3\-5 years of sales experience in industrial products, electrical equipment, condition monitoring solutions, maintenance services, automation, reliability solutions, or related industrial sectors.
 



 \-\-\-
 



 Preferred Industry Background
 



 Candidates with experience in selling any of the following will be highly preferred:
 



 · Electrical Safety Products
 



 · Infrared Inspection Solutions
 



 · Predictive Maintenance Solutions
 



 · Reliability Engineering Solutions
 



 · Industrial Automation
 



 · Asset Management Systems
 



 · Condition Monitoring Equipment
 



 · Power Quality Solutions
 



 · Industrial Instrumentation
 



 · Industrial Electrical Products
 



 \-\-\-
 



 Key Skills \& Competencies
 



 · Strong technical and commercial sales skills.
 



 · Excellent communication and presentation abilities.
 



 · Expertise in consultative and solution selling.
 



 · Ability to engage with plant\-level and corporate\-level stakeholders.
 



 · Strong negotiation and closing skills.
 



 · Self\-driven and target\-oriented mindset.
 



 · CRM and sales pipeline management experience.
 



 · Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
 



 \-\-\-
 



 Travel Requirement
 



 · Extensive travel within the assigned territory.
 



 · Willingness to conduct regular customer visits and attend industry events.
 



 \-\-\-
 



 What We Offer
 



 · Competitive salary and performance\-based incentives.
 



 · Opportunity to work with a globally recognized leader in industrial safety and reliability.
 



 · Career growth and professional development opportunities.
 



 · Exposure to leading industrial customers across India.
 



 · Collaborative and innovation\-driven work environment.
 



 \-\-\-
 



 Ideal Candidate Profile
 



 A proactive Sales Engineer with 3\-5 years of industrial sales experience who can confidently engage with maintenance, reliability, and electrical engineering teams, identify customer challenges, and position IRISS solutions as strategic investments for improving asset reliability, safety, and operational performance.
 



 Apply with your updated resume mentioning current CTC, expected CTC, notice period, and preferred location.

bed842a1.title: Lead System Architect & Technical Program Manager
bed842a1.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


We are seeking a visionary and execution\-oriented **Lead System Architect \& Technical Program Manager (TPM)** to lead the execution of our high\-priority, large\-scale technical initiatives for the CitiDirect Platform Core and Platform Digital Servicing Agile Release Trains (ARTs). This is a unique, hybrid role designed for a senior technical leader who can both design complex, enterprise\-grade system architectures and actively drive their execution across both ARTs.


In this role, your primary focus will be **System Architecture**—defining the technical vision, designing scalable system architectures, and building the architectural runway. Concurrently, you will leverage **Technical Program Management** competencies to operationalize your designs, manage cross\-team technical dependencies, mitigate risks, and ensure the successful delivery of high\-priority technical initiatives.


You will serve as the ultimate technical authority for the CitiDirect Platform ARTs, bridging the gap between high\-level enterprise strategy and hands\-on engineering execution.


**Key Responsibilities**
========================


**1\. System Architecture \& Technical Strategy (Primary Focus \- 70%)**
------------------------------------------------------------------------


* **Architectural Vision \& Design:** Define and communicate the future\-state architecture, technical vision, and system design patterns for the platforms within the Platform ARTs.
* **Architectural Runway:** Design and champion **Enabler Epics and Features** (covering cloud infrastructure, microservices, security, and data architecture) to ensure the platform supports near\-term business features without technical debt.
* **Non\-Functional Requirements (NFRs):** Define, monitor, and enforce NFRs—including security, scalability, high availability, performance, and maintainability—across the ART scrum teams.
* **Technical Debt \& Modernization:** Identify systemic technical debt, prioritize remediation efforts, and lead architectural spikes or prototyping for new technology evaluations.
* **Engineering Standards:** Establish and promote modern engineering practices, including DevSecOps, Test\-Driven Development (TDD), automated testing, and API\-first design patterns.

**2\. Technical Program Management \& Execution (30%)**
-------------------------------------------------------


* **Program Delivery Coordination:** Partner with the Release Train Engineer (RTE) to facilitate PI (Program Increment) execution, ensuring that engineering teams deliver on technical milestones and architectural enablers.
* **Dependency \& Risk Management:** Proactively identify, map, and resolve complex technical dependencies across multiple partner ARTs.
* **Risk Mitigation:** Lead the identification of program\-level technical risks and systematically address them through stakeholder engagement – product, architecture and engineering.
* **Backlog Prioritization:** Partner with Product Managers and Product Owners (POs) to refine the Program Backlog to ensure epics/tasks are always available for upcoming PIs.
* **Technical Translation:** Translate complex architectural designs, non\-functional requirements (NFRs), and security mandates into clear, actionable features and user stories for engineering teams.
* **Stakeholder Communication:** Provide transparent, data\-driven status updates, technical risk assessments, and delivery metrics to senior leadership and stakeholders.

**Key SAFe Ceremony Involvements**
==================================


* **PI Planning:** Present the Architectural Vision and technical context to the ART; facilitate technical breakout sessions to validate team\-level designs, map dependencies on the Program Board, and draft technical PI objectives.

**Job Title BY ESP Solution Architect/Developer**
**Location** 
 Hyderabad, India
   

  

**Job Summary** 
 We are seeking an experienced Blue Yonder (formerly JDA) ESP Solution Architect/Developer to lead the design, configuration, development and deployment of Enterprise Supply Planning solutions. This role will play a pivotal part in enabling global supply chain transformation by leveraging Blue Yonder’s advanced planning capabilities to optimize supply planning, inventory positioning, and production strategies. The candidate must be willing to work on site 4 days a week in Hyderabad, during US EST time zone.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Solution Architecture \& Design**
* Lead and own the end\-to\-end architecture and design of Blue Yonder ESP (Enterprise Supply Planning) solutions.
* Translate business requirements into scalable solution designs that align with industry best practices and Blue Yonder's functional framework.
* Define planning models, network design, constraints, and heuristics aligned to business supply strategies.
* Expertise in interpreting solver results ensuring optimized planning quality based on constraints.


**Configuration \& Development**
* Configure and develop components within Blue Yonder ESP, including supply planning, inventory balancing, pegging, and constraint\-based planning logic.
* Customize ESP engines to align with business supply network models, demand signals, and production capacities.
* Create and manage planning parameters, supply chain hierarchies, and master data elements.


**Implementation \& Configuration**
* Configure ESP modules including supply planning, constrained planning, and inventory optimization.
* Guide integration of ESP with up/downstream systems (Demand Planning, ERP, MRP, MES, Google Datalake).
* Oversee data modeling, master data configuration, and rule\-based planning logic.


**Technical Leadership \& Governance**
* Provide leadership and guidance to implementation teams and technical consultants.
* Review and approve functional and technical design documents.
* Ensure adherence to Blue Yonder standards and change management protocols.


**Business Collaboration \& Change Enablement**
* Collaborate with business stakeholders across supply chain, manufacturing, and IT to gather requirements and align solution outcomes.
* Conduct design workshops, walkthroughs, and training sessions to ensure knowledge transfer and user adoption.
* Act as the primary point of contact for solution design decisions and issue resolution.


**Continuous Improvement \& Support**
* Identify and propose enhancements for planning performance, configuration, or data integration.
* Support hypercare and transition to steady\-state planning operations.
* Evaluate emerging Blue Yonder capabilities and industry trends to evolve the planning landscape.
* Contribute to production support and documenting processes and facilitating enablement sessions to empower stakeholders with the necessary skills and knowledge to utilize BY ESP solutions effectively.


**Qualifications**
* Education Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field.
* Experience 10\+ years of experience in supply chain planning, with at least 5\+ years in Blue Yonder ESP architecture or implementation.
* Technical Skills Hands\-on expertise in configuring, designing and deploying Blue Yonder ESP modules (Supply Planning, Inventory Optimization, S\&OP, Manufacturing Planning) solutions and managing Control\-M with extensive experience of MAP solver and ability to understand and interpret solver output ensuring optimal planning results. Strong understanding of planning algorithms (constrained/unconstrained), pegging, and network optimization. Scripting (e.g., PL/SQL, Python, or batch scripting) skill is a must. Experience with integration to ERP systems like SAP, Oracle, or Infor. Familiarity with data integration tools (e.g., SAP PI, MuleSoft, Informatica) and batch/scheduled data feeds.
* Leadership Skills Excellent communication, leadership, and client\-facing skills.
* Problem\-Solving Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities, with a proactive approach to addressing challenges.
* Cultural Awareness Ability to work effectively in a multicultural and highly dynamic environment and manage teams across different time zones. Must be multi\-tasker and able to prioritize and deliver assignments with the highest quality under pressure with short deadlines.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Blue Yonder certification in ESP or SCPO suite is highly desirable.
* Experience in scripting (e.g., PL/SQL, Python, or batch scripting) is a significant advantage especially OIL scripts.
* Experience in deploying complex BOM, Load building planning, dynamic deployment functionality is highly preferred.
* Experience in SPARQ solver is a plus.
* Experience in large\-scale global supply chain transformation programs.
* Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience working in Agile or hybrid implementation methodologies.
* Knowledge of other Blue Yonder modules (Demand Planning, Sequencing, Control Tower) is a plus.
* Knowledge of Anaplan (planning) models is a plus.

 We are a leading organization committed to leveraging technology to drive business success. Our team is dedicated to innovation, collaboration, and delivering exceptional results. Join us and be a part of a dynamic and forward\-thinking company.

 Interested candidates are invited to submit their resume and cover letter detailing their relevant experience and qualifications.

**Who We Are…**





 When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the
 *storytellers* 
 bringing our characters to life, the
 *creators* 
 bringing them to your living rooms and the

 From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.
 




  


**Your New Role**
**:**
  
 



 As the
 **Staff, Solutions Architect (AI/ML)** 
 , you will play a pivotal role in driving the adoption of AI and Machine Learning solutions within one of the world’s largest Media \& Entertainment companies. Based in India, you will lead the design and implementation of innovative AI/ML architectures that transform how we create, distribute, and monetize content across global markets.
 







 Your expertise will help bridge the gap between complex business challenges and advanced technical solutions, ensuring AI initiatives deliver real business value. This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of creativity and technology, where you’ll lead the development of intelligent solutions for personalized viewer experiences, optimized content workflows, and data\-driven decision\-making.
 







 If you’re passionate about leveraging AI/ML to revolutionize the Media \& Entertainment industry and thrive in a dynamic, collaborative environment, this role is for you.
 







  


**1\. AI/ML Solution Design and Development** 



* Design and develop scalable AI/ML solutions tailored to address business challenges such as audience analytics, content personalization, and ad optimization.
* Lead the end\-to\-end architecture of AI/ML platforms, ensuring seamless integration with existing systems and data pipelines.
* Collaborate with data scientists, engineers, and business stakeholders to convert models into production\-ready solutions.
* Evaluate and select appropriate AI/ML frameworks, technologies, and tools to meet project requirements.
* Ensure AI solutions are optimized for performance, scalability, and reliability across diverse use cases.



  


**2\. Technical Leadership and Innovation** 



* Provide technical leadership for AI/ML projects, guiding teams through solution architecture, development, and deployment.
* Stay abreast of emerging AI/ML trends and technologies to introduce innovative solutions and best practices.
* Lead proof\-of\-concept (POC) initiatives to validate new AI capabilities and demonstrate their potential impact.
* Promote a culture of innovation within the team, encouraging experimentation with cutting\-edge AI/ML techniques.
* Mentor junior architects and engineers to build a strong pipeline of AI/ML talent.



  


**3\. Collaboration and Stakeholder Engagement** 



* Act as a key interface between business units, technical teams, and senior leadership to align AI/ML solutions with organizational goals.
* Translate business requirements into technical specifications, ensuring clarity and feasibility.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to prioritize and execute AI/ML projects that deliver the highest business impact.
* Communicate the value and progress of AI/ML initiatives to non\-technical stakeholders through clear, compelling narratives.
* Foster strong relationships with external partners, including technology vendors and academic institutions, to drive innovation.



  


**4\. AI Governance and Risk Management** 



* Implement best practices for AI/ML governance, including model explainability, accountability, and ethical use.
* Ensure AI solutions comply with data privacy regulations and internal security protocols.
* Proactively identify and mitigate risks associated with AI/ML implementations, such as bias, overfitting, or data quality issues.
* Develop monitoring frameworks to track model performance and retrain models as necessary to maintain effectiveness.
* Establish guidelines and documentation for AI/ML processes, ensuring consistency and transparency.



  


**5\. Scalability and Continuous Improvement** 



* Architect solutions that are modular and scalable, capable of supporting future business growth and technological evolution.
* Regularly review and optimize existing AI/ML systems for improved performance and cost\-efficiency.
* Establish feedback loops to capture learnings from deployed solutions and inform future enhancements.
* Identify opportunities for automation and operational efficiency using AI/ML.
* Lead initiatives to streamline workflows and reduce time\-to\-market for AI/ML projects.







  


**Qualifications \& Experiences:**




  


**Academic Qualifications:** 



* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical discipline.
* Specialized certifications in AI/ML (e.g., Google Cloud AI Engineer, AWS Machine Learning Specialty) are a plus.



  


**Professional Experience:** 



* **8\+ years** 
  of experience in AI/ML solution architecture, with at least 
 **3\+ years**

9ee0cfa8.description:
⚡We are your
 **Energy Technology Partner** 
 . We electrify, automate, and digitalize every industry, business, and home, driving efficiency and sustainability for all.
   

  

 At Schneider Electric, our values – IMPACT (Inclusion, Mastery, Purpose, Action, Curiosity, Teamwork) – are the foundation of everything we do. Becoming an Impact Maker means turning sustainability ambitions into actions at the intersection of automation, electrification, and digitization.
   

  

 Are you ready to lead the digital transformation to create a more sustainable world?🌳
   

  

 If you are up to challenge your creativity and make an impact, we are excited to welcome you!
   

  

**Schneider Digital** 
 is the digital department of Schneider Electric, leading the digital transformation in the company by giving support globally to our internal teams and our clients. Schneider Digital consists of 6 Digital Hubs worldwide which are strategically located to ensure a 24/7 support across the company (France, China, India, USA, Mexico and Spain). Our Digital Hub in Barcelona is formed by \+450 employees working in strategic projects and different roles such as Data, Cybersecurity, ERP, Cloud, Infrastructures, IT Project Management or Digital Marketing.
   

  

 DCR is the digital backbone of Schneider Electric, representing \~1,200 FTEs and FTCs across eight capability domains. As AI is projected to reshape every DCR role, The DCR AI Operations team has been established to stand up a governed programme that turns the AI vision into measurable delivery across all DCR capabilities.
   

  

 Phase 2 of the programme (H2 2026\) focuses on building the foundation: establishing governance structures, validating priority use cases through live pilots, and preparing the organisation for full\-scale deployment in Phase 3\. The Transformation \& Change stream is the backbone of this phase — responsible for programme governance, use case portfolio management, process reinvention, and capability upskilling across all domains.
   

  

 In this context, the
 **Program Manager** 
 is the operational lead of the Transformation stream and the central orchestrator of the overall programme, translating strategic intent into a governed and deliverable roadmap.
   

  

**What will you do?**
**Key Responsibilities**
 The Program Manager leads the Transformation stream and orchestrates the end\-to\-end programme.
   

  

 Scope: Transformation \& Change \| Value Realization \| Solution Design \| AI Delivery
   

  

* Set up the programme operating model \& governance – Programme leadership role
* Define the end\-to\-end programme operating model: roles, decision rights, RACI matrix, and organisational design.
* Establish and chair the governance cadence, from operational syncs to executive steering committees, ensuring appropriate escalation paths and decision clarity.
* Define programme\-level KPIs aligned to the value framework; drive delivery against H2 2026 milestones (operating model set\-up, pilot selection, reinvention vision, upskilling strategy).

9f38a6b7.title: ServiceNow Architect -SOMT-Manger
9f38a6b7.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY\-ServiceNow Technical Architect \- Telecom Sales \& Order Management (SOMT) \& Integrations**
 As part of EY GDS\-ServiceNow team, you will be solving client problems using the ServiceNow platform. You will get the opportunity to work with a high\-performing team and drive innovative solutions that address complex client needs.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We are seeking a hands\-on ServiceNow Technical Architect with deep expertise in Telecom Sales \& Order Management (SOMT), enterprise integrations, and ServiceNow platform development. The ideal candidate will lead architecture and delivery while actively contributing to coding, configuration, troubleshooting, and mentoring teams. Experience with telecom OSS/BSS ecosystems, Performance Analytics, and AI capabilities is essential.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Architect and deliver ServiceNow Sales \& Order Management (SOM/SOMT) solutions for telecommunications clients.
* Lead discovery sessions, requirements workshops, solution design discussions, and stakeholder reviews.
* Design and implement integrations using REST, SOAP, IntegrationHub, Scripted APIs, and MID Servers with external OSS/BSS, CRM, ERP, billing, and inventory systems.
* Remain hands\-on by configuring and developing ServiceNow solutions, including Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, Flow Designer, Catalog Items, UI Actions, and custom applications.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex platform, integration, and production issues through root cause analysis and technical leadership.
* Lead development teams, conduct code reviews, enforce best practices, and drive technical governance.
* Mentor and train junior developers, providing technical guidance and capability development across the team.
* Leverage ServiceNow AI capabilities, automation, and Performance Analytics to improve operational efficiency and business outcomes.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* ServiceNow SOM/SOMT, TSM, TNI, ITSM, CSM, FSM, CMDB/CSDM, integrations
* Telecom OSS/BSS integration experience.
* Performance Analytics, Now Assist, AI Agents, and Agentic AI solutions.
* Strong communication, workshop facilitation, stakeholder management, and team leadership skills.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* College degree in a related technology field (Computer Science, Engineering, etc.) or equivalent experience
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA).
* Minimum two (2\) ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) certifications.
* 8\+ years of ServiceNow experience, including architecture, development, and integration delivery.
* Strong hands\-on scripting experience in JavaScript, Glide APIs, Business Rules, Script Includes, Flow Designer, and IntegrationHub.
* Proven experience in telecom order management, order orchestration, fulfillment, and Lead\-to\-Cash processes.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Experience with tools like JIRA, ServiceNow Agile, or equivalent for backlog management
* Exposure to ServiceNow upgrades, platform governance, and release management
* Experience in stakeholder management and client\-facing roles
* Knowledge of ServiceNow’s latest features and roadmap


**What We Look For**
* A team player and Leader with strong technical acumen and leadership capabilities
* Proactive problem\-solving mindset with a focus on operational excellence
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities in a fast\-paced environment
* Passion to learn and adapt to new technologies


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start\-ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work on inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. You’ll quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging assignments and be part of a collaborative environment focused on quality and innovation.
   

  

 Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching, and feedback from experienced professionals
* Opportunities to develop new skills and grow your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

620fedf2.title: Senior Staff Solution Architect
620fedf2.description:
**Strength in Trust**
 OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016\. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.
   

  

 Sr Staff Solutions Architect (Design Partner Program)
   

  

 The Challenge
   

  

 We're looking for a Solutions Architect to join our R\&D Customer Engineering organisation and partner with strategic Design Partner customers. This is a highly customer\-facing role that sits at the intersection of solution architecture, product strategy, and enterprise governance.
   

  

 You will work directly with customers to understand their business challenges, technical requirements, regulatory considerations, and strategic objectives. Acting as the bridge between customers, Product Management, Engineering, and Executive Leadership, you will help shape product direction, influence roadmap investments, and design scalable solutions that deliver measurable customer outcomes.
   

  

 Success in this role means helping customers operationalise trust, governance, privacy, risk management, consent, and responsible data use while accelerating adoption, improving implementation outcomes, and driving long\-term platform value.
   

  

**Your Mission**
* Partner directly with enterprise customers to understand business objectives, technical requirements, operational challenges, and strategic priorities.
* Lead discovery workshops, architecture reviews, solution assessments, and technical design sessions.
* Translate customer needs into scalable solution architectures, implementation strategies, and reusable design patterns.
* Bridge customer requirements with Product Management and Engineering teams by identifying product gaps, influencing roadmap priorities, and driving platform improvements.
* Design secure, scalable, and resilient enterprise solutions across workflows, integrations, APIs, data models, governance processes, and operational architectures.
* Drive measurable customer outcomes through successful adoption, implementation quality, operational efficiency, governance maturity, and long\-term platform value.
* Create reference architectures, best practices, implementation standards, and reusable solution patterns that improve customer success and scalability.


**You Are**
* A customer\-facing technical leader who operates at the intersection of solution architecture, business strategy, and enterprise technology.
* Comfortable engaging with executives, architects, engineers, product leaders, privacy, risk, compliance, security, governance, identity, marketing, and business stakeholders.
* Able to translate complex technical concepts, architecture decisions, and regulatory requirements into clear business outcomes.
* A systems thinker who designs for scalability, security, resilience, maintainability, and long\-term platform success.
* Influential without direct authority and effective at driving alignment across cross\-functional teams.


**Your Experience Includes**
* 10\+ years of experience in Solution Architecture, Enterprise Architecture, Solutions Consulting, Technical Product Leadership, Customer Engineering, or similar customer\-facing technical roles within enterprise SaaS organisations.
* Proven experience working directly with enterprise customers to gather requirements, lead discovery, shape technical strategy, design solutions, and drive adoption.
* Strong solution architecture experience, including APIs, integrations, workflow design, data models, enterprise platforms, governance controls, security, and scalable implementation patterns.
* Experience partnering with Product Management and Engineering teams to influence product direction and solve complex customer challenges.
* Strong executive communication, facilitation, stakeholder management, and presentation skills.
* Experience designing reusable frameworks, reference architectures, implementation patterns, best practices, and solution standards.


 Domain Experience
   

  

 Experience in one or more of the following areas is preferred:
 **Privacy, Risk \& Governance, Compliance, Security Governance, Data Governance, Consent \& Preference Management, Identity, MarTech, Customer Data Platforms (CDP), or related enterprise SaaS domains.**
 Where we Work
   

  

 We are embracing an office\-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person.
   

  

 Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview.
   

  

**Benefits**
 As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you’ll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14\+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company\-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers.
   

  

 Resources
   

  

 Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people:
   

  

* OneTrust Careers on YouTube
* @LifeatOneTrust on Instagram


 Your Data
   

  

 You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview
 **.** 
 You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form.
   

  

 Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an "@onetrust.com" email address. You may also receive legitimate emails from "@us.greenhouse\-mail.io". Recruiters will only reach out to candidates who have applied for a role through our ATS (Greenhouse) or prospects via LinkedIn InMail. Job offers will come from a recruiter and may have a "@docusign.net" email address. For more information or if you have been targeted please reach out to askrecruiting@onetrust.com.
   

  

**Our Commitment to You**
 When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad — the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career.
   

  

 OneTrust provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by local laws.

ac7e9936.title: Sr Technical Consultant - Azure Cloud, DevOps, Sql & Site Reliability Engineering(SRE)
ac7e9936.description:
**Overview**
* The BYX Platform provides shared cloud provisioning, compute, storage, observability and runtime capabilities for enterprise applications and implementation teams.
* We are seeking an astute Cloud Platform with a strong technical foundation and hands\-on experience in Microsoft Azure, Kubernetes, containers, observability, networking and production automation.


**Our Current Technical Environment**
* Cloud and Compute: Microsoft Azure, Kubernetes, node pools, container workloads, Azure Container Registry, KEDA, Dask, autoscaling, CPU, memory and GPU capacity.
* Observability: Logs, metrics and traces; collectors and exporters; Elastic/Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana, dashboards, alerts and correlation identifiers.
* Data and Storage: MongoDB/Atlas, SQL, Redis, NFS, managed storage, replicas, regional capacity and service quotas.
* Networking and Security: DNS, CIDR, private endpoints, firewall rules, allowlists, TLS/certificates, SPNs, API keys, tokens, image\-pull credentials and Git\-hosted secrets.
* Operations and Automation: Linux, Git, CI/CD deployment workflows, infrastructure automation and scripting using Bash, Python or PowerShell.


**What You’ll Do**
* Review and act on incidents, service requests, infrastructure requests and provisioning failures logged by implementation teams and platform users.
* Own L2/L3 cloud\-platform issues from initial triage through recovery, validation, communication, root\-cause analysis and closure.
* Troubleshoot Kubernetes pods, deployments, replicas, services, events, health checks, node pools, scheduling and resource constraints.
* Diagnose container image\-pull, startup, shutdown, registry\-authentication, rollout and workload\-reconciliation failures.
* Investigate CPU, memory, GPU, quota, region, placement and capacity issues affecting platform workloads.
* Troubleshoot workload and event\-driven autoscaling using Kubernetes metrics and technologies such as KEDA.
* Support Azure resource provisioning, provider operations, resource lifecycle workflows and reconciliation between desired and actual state.
* Diagnose ACR, private endpoint, firewall, allowlist, CIDR, DNS, TLS and runtime\-connectivity problems.
* Trace logs, metrics and distributed telemetry from the workload through collectors, exporters and observability ingestion pipelines.
* Support Elastic/Logstash/Kibana ingestion, index mappings, access, dashboards, alerts and environment filters.
* Investigate operational issues involving MongoDB/Atlas, SQL, Redis, NFS and related managed data or storage services.
* Support certificates, service principals, API keys, image\-pull credentials and infrastructure credential rotation.
* Support regional releases, environment configuration, disaster\-recovery workflows and post\-deployment validation.
* Develop automation to improve platform reliability, reduce manual provisioning and shorten incident recovery time.
* Maintain runbooks, dashboards, alerts, known\-error records and diagnostic procedures for use by platform support teams.
* Participate in capacity planning, incident reviews, change reviews, release readiness and an agreed production on\-call rotation.


**What We Are Looking For**
* Minimum 5\-10 years of relevant work experience in Azure cloud infrastructure, DevOps, site reliability engineering or platform operations.
* This role includes Rotational Shifts(Night shifts of 2 months in Year)
* Hands\-on production experience with Microsoft Azure services and operational troubleshooting
* Strong Kubernetes troubleshooting skills covering workloads, events, services, networking, scheduling, scaling and resource management.
* Experience with a container registry; Azure Container Registry experience is highly relevant.
* Practical observability experience across logs, metrics, traces, dashboards and alerts.
* Experience with Elastic Stack components—Elasticsearch, Logstash and Kibana—or a closely comparable platform.
* Working knowledge of DNS, TLS/certificates, CIDR, firewalls, proxies, load balancing and private networking.
* Strong Linux administration, application log analysis and production incident\-troubleshooting skills.
* Scripting experience with Bash, Python or PowerShell for diagnostics and operational automation.
* Experience troubleshooting CI/CD deployments, configuration changes and failed rollouts.
* Working knowledge of Git, service identities and secrets\-management fundamentals.
* Working knowledge of MongoDB/Atlas, Redis, SQL or NFS operations is preferred.
* Experience with infrastructure as code such as Terraform, Bicep or ARM templates and Kubernetes packaging such as Helm is preferred.
* Experience with incident response, Root Cause Analysis, post\-incident reviews and controlled production changes.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills with the ability to work across application, security, networking and vendor teams.
* Willingness to participate in a scheduled production on\-call rotation and planned out\-of\-hours changes when required.


**Our Values**
 If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success – and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours? Find out here: Core Values
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

84229614.title: Technical Program Manager
84229614.description:
Portcast is a venture\-backed, Singapore\-based logistics technology startup helping freight forwarders turn data into better decisions and measurable business impact. Portcast uses AI to surface shipment exceptions, cost risks, and the right actions, helping teams focus on the shipments that need their attention, keep freight costs under control, and make procurement decisions with confidence. Our vision is to be the AI data and intelligence layer that powers exception management and margin improvement on every shipment.
   

  

 Founded in 2018 and backed by leading technology investors, we are a lean, globally distributed team building technology for an industry going through a major digital transformation.
   

  

**About The Role**
 You'll be the person accountable for the delivery state of our product initiatives once they move into execution. You'll report directly to our Senior Product Manager and make sure ownership is clear across Engineering, Data, and Solutions, work is progressing as expected, dependencies are being managed, and risks are surfaced early rather than when they become launch problems.
   

  

 We're looking for someone who understands our product, technology, and data well enough to follow the work, understand why we're building something, spot when execution is drifting from the intended outcome, and know when to bring an issue back to Product for clarification.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on IC role and you'll be the first person in this role at Portcast, giving you the opportunity to shape how we manage and deliver product initiatives as we scale. This role requires daily working\-hour overlap with our Asia\-based Tech Team.
   

  

**What Success Looks Like In This Role**
* No launch delays, cleaner releases, and shorter cycle times, driven by earlier identification of risks, dependencies, and blockers, better coordination across Product, Engineering, Data, and Solutions, and clearer visibility into what is moving, what is blocked, and what needs attention.


**What You’ll Own**
* Own delivery from kickoff to release: Take ownership of the operational delivery state once a product initiative moves into execution. Make sure ownership is clear, work starts when expected, progress is visible, and initiatives continue moving through development, testing, and release.
* Track dependencies and surface risks early: Monitor cross\-functional dependencies, blockers, competing priorities, scope changes, and potential delays.
* Coordinate across Product, Engineering, Data, and Solutions: Make sure teams know who owns what, dependencies are understood, and the right people have the context they need. Act as the central point of coordination so Product has a clear view of delivery.
* Coordinate handover and launch readiness: Help coordinate the handover between Engineering, Data, Solutions, and Product so that the relevant teams have what they need for testing and acceptance.
* Keep execution aligned with product intent: Understand the goals and key requirements behind an initiative well enough to spot when implementation appears to diverge from what was intended. Surface questions, gaps, or inconsistencies early and bring them back to Product for clarification before they become testing or release issues.
* Maintain a clear source of truth: Keep tickets, timelines, project status, dependencies, key decisions, and risks up to date so that the team can quickly understand what is moving, what is blocked, and where attention is needed.
* Keep delivery moving without creating bureaucracy: Bring structure, follow\-through, and accountability to the delivery process without adding unnecessary processes. Join relevant standups and working sessions so you can identify issues and resolve them quickly.


**What We’re Looking For**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* At least 3\+ years in project management, program management, delivery, product operations, or a similar role.
* A proven ability to close things and keep initiatives moving: Experience managing projects or initiatives involving multiple technical and cross\-functional teams in a startup or B2B SaaS environment, ideally in data\-heavy domains, and even better in logistics tech or supply chain tech.
* Understands data and strong technical foundation. You can read code, understand how systems and data pipelines fit together, and dig into the work alongside engineers and data scientists. You know the difference between a real blocker and noise.
* Strong execution instincts: You naturally keep track of the details that others might miss. You chase loose ends, surface blockers, follow up on dependencies, and make sure decisions actually turn into action.
* First\-principles problem solving: When something is stuck or going off track, you understand why rather than simply following the existing process. You work out what needs to change and involve the right people to resolve it.
* Comfort with ambiguity: You can create clarity when the requirements, ownership, or process aren't fully defined. You are comfortable making progress without having every answer upfront.
* Strong cross\-functional communication: You can translate between Product, Engineering, Data, and customer\-facing teams. You know what different teams need to know, communicate clearly, and escalate issues early without creating unnecessary noise.
* High ownership: You don't see your job as simply tracking whether someone completed a task. You take responsibility for the overall delivery state and stay on an issue until it is actually resolved.
* Startup mindset: You enjoy working in a lean environment where there isn't a dedicated person for every function. You're willing to get into the details, solve problems yourself, and build lightweight processes when they are genuinely useful.


**What’s In It For You**
* Own a high\-leverage problem: You'll be the person responsible for keeping delivery moving across teams, directly influencing how quickly and reliably we turn product ideas into something customers can use.
* Work at the intersection of Product, AI, Data, and Logistics: Our products combine software, data, machine learning, and deep logistics expertise. You'll get exposure to complex product problems where the challenge isn't simply building software, but making sure data, models, workflows, and customer needs come together.
* Real impact from day one: we’re lean by design so you'll have a high degree of ownership. There is no large PMO or layer of project managers around you. You'll need to be comfortable getting into the details, figuring things out independently, and knowing when something needs to be pushed, clarified, escalated, or simply solved.
* Globally distributed, remote\-first flexibility: work with a fully distributed team across Asia and Europe, built on trust, accountability, and collaboration.


**OUR CORE VALUES GUIDE EVERYTHING WE DO**
* Curiosity: We dig into why something's slipping, not just how to patch it. We stay close to the work and the data.
* Ownership: We act like founders. We hold a project together end to end and stay on it until it ships cleanly.
* Raising the bar: We don't settle for "it launched." We aim for delivery that's predictable, aligned, and free of last\-minute surprises.
* Effective: We focus on shipping what was actually intended, on time, with real impact, not process for its own sake.


 Join us at Portcast in our vision to become the AI data and intelligence layer that powers exception management and margin improvement on every shipment.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

f2273172.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, Amazon
f2273172.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Grocery Catalog and Supplier org is looking for a passionate and innovative Sr Technical Program Manager to join our Catalog team. This team will be deployed against some of our most complex and challenging projects and will deliver innovative technical solutions. We have an opportunity to revolutionize on\-line shopping and set new standards for accessing the highest quality organic and natural groceries on\-online.  

  

As the Sr TPM, you will be a key member of tech leadership and will need to drive forward the technology across catalog system to create a best in class online grocery shopping experience.  

We are looking for a Sr Technical Program Manager (TPM) with business and technical skills, great communication abilities, and a passion to use cutting edge science and technologies to help WFM.  

  

Our team is seeking Sr Technical Program Managers to manage large, cross functional programs and projects that support catalog business. In this role you will be responsible for delivering large projects end\-to\-end that span multiple technology and operational teams. These projects will include initiatives such as rolling out new technology to new geographies as we expand, creating new technology to support new businesses and use cases, and otherwise building great technology platforms that can scale. In this role, you will lead large\-scale re\-architecture of our technology stack across multiple systems and teams. You will lead and coordinate design/implementation efforts, coordinating across multiple teams to develop optimal solutions. You will be expected to make appropriate tradeoffs to optimize time\-to\-market, clearly communicate goals, roles, responsibilities, and desired outcomes to internal cross\-functional and remote project teams.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

This role is inherently cross\-functional—this leader will work closely with engineering, project management, design, operations, finance, legal, business development, customer service, and executive teams to bring products to market, develop and grow business opportunities, and enhance our existing products and features. A successful candidate will be highly analytical, resourceful, customer\-focused, team oriented, and will have an ability to work independently under time constraints to meet deadlines. The leader will have a proven track record in taking on end\-to\-end ownership and successfully delivering results in a fast\-paced and dynamic business environment. As a Sr TPM, you will anticipate bottlenecks, provide escalation management, anticipate and make tradeoffs, and balance the business needs versus technical constraints. An ability to take large, complex projects and break them down into manageable pieces, develop functional specifications, then deliver them in a successful and timely manner is expected. Maturity, high judgment, negotiation skills, ability to influence, analytical talent and leadership are essential to success in this role.


**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 8\+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* 8\+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing technical programs across cross\-functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------


\- \- Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules  

\- \- Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi\-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership  

\- \- Experience driving multiple products through a complete lifecycle  

\- \- High Scale services experience  

\- \- Experience combining hardware \& software development  

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. c8b93253.title: Technical Program Manager
c8b93253.description:
Portcast is a venture\-backed, Singapore\-based logistics technology startup helping freight forwarders turn data into better decisions and measurable business impact. Portcast uses AI to surface shipment exceptions, cost risks, and the right actions, helping teams focus on the shipments that need their attention, keep freight costs under control, and make procurement decisions with confidence. Our vision is to be the AI data and intelligence layer that powers exception management and margin improvement on every shipment.
   

  

 Founded in 2018 and backed by leading technology investors, we are a lean, globally distributed team building technology for an industry going through a major digital transformation.
   

  

**About The Role**
 You'll be the person accountable for the delivery state of our product initiatives once they move into execution. You'll report directly to our Senior Product Manager and make sure ownership is clear across Engineering, Data, and Solutions, work is progressing as expected, dependencies are being managed, and risks are surfaced early rather than when they become launch problems.
   

  

 We're looking for someone who understands our product, technology, and data well enough to follow the work, understand why we're building something, spot when execution is drifting from the intended outcome, and know when to bring an issue back to Product for clarification.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on IC role and you'll be the first person in this role at Portcast, giving you the opportunity to shape how we manage and deliver product initiatives as we scale. This role requires daily working\-hour overlap with our Asia\-based Tech Team.
   

  

**What Success Looks Like In This Role**
* No launch delays, cleaner releases, and shorter cycle times, driven by earlier identification of risks, dependencies, and blockers, better coordination across Product, Engineering, Data, and Solutions, and clearer visibility into what is moving, what is blocked, and what needs attention.


**What You’ll Own**
* Own delivery from kickoff to release: Take ownership of the operational delivery state once a product initiative moves into execution. Make sure ownership is clear, work starts when expected, progress is visible, and initiatives continue moving through development, testing, and release.
* Track dependencies and surface risks early: Monitor cross\-functional dependencies, blockers, competing priorities, scope changes, and potential delays.
* Coordinate across Product, Engineering, Data, and Solutions: Make sure teams know who owns what, dependencies are understood, and the right people have the context they need. Act as the central point of coordination so Product has a clear view of delivery.
* Coordinate handover and launch readiness: Help coordinate the handover between Engineering, Data, Solutions, and Product so that the relevant teams have what they need for testing and acceptance.
* Keep execution aligned with product intent: Understand the goals and key requirements behind an initiative well enough to spot when implementation appears to diverge from what was intended. Surface questions, gaps, or inconsistencies early and bring them back to Product for clarification before they become testing or release issues.
* Maintain a clear source of truth: Keep tickets, timelines, project status, dependencies, key decisions, and risks up to date so that the team can quickly understand what is moving, what is blocked, and where attention is needed.
* Keep delivery moving without creating bureaucracy: Bring structure, follow\-through, and accountability to the delivery process without adding unnecessary processes. Join relevant standups and working sessions so you can identify issues and resolve them quickly.


**What We’re Looking For**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* At least 3\+ years in project management, program management, delivery, product operations, or a similar role.
* A proven ability to close things and keep initiatives moving: Experience managing projects or initiatives involving multiple technical and cross\-functional teams in a startup or B2B SaaS environment, ideally in data\-heavy domains, and even better in logistics tech or supply chain tech.
* Understands data and strong technical foundation. You can read code, understand how systems and data pipelines fit together, and dig into the work alongside engineers and data scientists. You know the difference between a real blocker and noise.
* Strong execution instincts: You naturally keep track of the details that others might miss. You chase loose ends, surface blockers, follow up on dependencies, and make sure decisions actually turn into action.
* First\-principles problem solving: When something is stuck or going off track, you understand why rather than simply following the existing process. You work out what needs to change and involve the right people to resolve it.
* Comfort with ambiguity: You can create clarity when the requirements, ownership, or process aren't fully defined. You are comfortable making progress without having every answer upfront.
* Strong cross\-functional communication: You can translate between Product, Engineering, Data, and customer\-facing teams. You know what different teams need to know, communicate clearly, and escalate issues early without creating unnecessary noise.
* High ownership: You don't see your job as simply tracking whether someone completed a task. You take responsibility for the overall delivery state and stay on an issue until it is actually resolved.
* Startup mindset: You enjoy working in a lean environment where there isn't a dedicated person for every function. You're willing to get into the details, solve problems yourself, and build lightweight processes when they are genuinely useful.


**What’s In It For You**
* Own a high\-leverage problem: You'll be the person responsible for keeping delivery moving across teams, directly influencing how quickly and reliably we turn product ideas into something customers can use.
* Work at the intersection of Product, AI, Data, and Logistics: Our products combine software, data, machine learning, and deep logistics expertise. You'll get exposure to complex product problems where the challenge isn't simply building software, but making sure data, models, workflows, and customer needs come together.
* Real impact from day one: we’re lean by design so you'll have a high degree of ownership. There is no large PMO or layer of project managers around you. You'll need to be comfortable getting into the details, figuring things out independently, and knowing when something needs to be pushed, clarified, escalated, or simply solved.
* Globally distributed, remote\-first flexibility: work with a fully distributed team across Asia and Europe, built on trust, accountability, and collaboration.


**OUR CORE VALUES GUIDE EVERYTHING WE DO**
* Curiosity: We dig into why something's slipping, not just how to patch it. We stay close to the work and the data.
* Ownership: We act like founders. We hold a project together end to end and stay on it until it ships cleanly.
* Raising the bar: We don't settle for "it launched." We aim for delivery that's predictable, aligned, and free of last\-minute surprises.
* Effective: We focus on shipping what was actually intended, on time, with real impact, not process for its own sake.


 Join us at Portcast in our vision to become the AI data and intelligence layer that powers exception management and margin improvement on every shipment.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

f6ae838a.description:
**Description**
 Amazon's Buyer Abuse Prevention (BAP) team sits within the broader Buyer Risk Prevention (BRP) organization — a centralized technology and program team whose mission is to make Amazon the safest and most trusted place worldwide to transact online. Buyer abuse is defined as the risk associated with customers repeatedly violating Amazon's policies and affecting the profitability, brand, and reputation of Amazon or its Selling Partners.
   

  

 BAP sits at the intersection of technology, policy, and operations to detect, investigate, and prevent abusive behaviors across Amazon. Our work directly impacts Amazon's bottom line, protecting hundreds of millions of dollars in concession losses annually while preserving the customer and seller experience.
   

  

 BAP is seeking an innovative, results\-oriented, and customer\-centric Program Manager to own and drive the Automation program across the Buyer Abuse Prevention organization. In this role, you will be responsible for scaling Amazon's ability to investigate and act on risky orders and concessions at billions\-of\-transactions scale — without relying on manual effort. You will define the automation strategy, manage a portfolio of automation initiatives, and balance the dual mandate of maximizing automation rate while carefully managing enforcement quality through leakage (under\-enforcement) and customer experience (over\-enforcement) metrics.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be highly analytical, resourceful, customer focused, team oriented, and have an ability to work independently under time constraints to meet deadlines. He or she will have a proven track record in taking on end\-to\-end ownership and successfully delivering results in a fast\-paced and dynamic business environment.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Own the end\-to\-end Automation program strategy, roadmap, and execution across BAP, including setting goals, success metrics, and mechanisms to track progress against automation rate targets.
* Balance the core automation tradeoff: maximizing automation rate while managing leakage (under\-enforcement risk) and customer experience metrics (over\-enforcement risk), ensuring precision thresholds are maintained across all deployed models and workflows.
* Define and manage key success metrics for the Automation program, including automation rate, task coverage, precision, leakage rate, false positive rate, and customer\-facing impact metrics.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Machine Learning, and Data Science teams to design, test, and launch new automation capabilities — including LLM\-powered enforcement, model\-based auto\-decisions, and workflow automation.
* Interact with key stakeholders to define the metrics, measurements, and tools to quantify automation program goals and communicate results to Senior Leaders across Amazon.
* Conduct in\-depth reviews of automation performance data to identify patterns, gaps, and opportunities; develop reports and narratives for leadership and partner teams.
* Communicate (both verbally and in writing) program successes, failures, lessons learned, and mitigation plans to stakeholders.
* Champion on behalf of Amazon and our Customers and help uncover issues currently impacting our Customer Experience as a result of automation decisions.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 3\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience

4a54ca63.title: Senior Technical Architect
4a54ca63.description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3\.7 billion in revenue, its first billion\-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27\. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology \- hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.
   

  

 This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.
   

  

**THE ROLE**
 As a Senior Technical Architect on our Advanced Services team, you will bridge pre\-sales strategy and post\-sales delivery to architect enterprise data migration, disaster recovery, and hybrid\-cloud storage solutions. In this dual consultative and hands\-on role, you will collaborate closely with Sales, Engineering, and enterprise customers to translate complex business needs into resilient, automated IT infrastructure. You will drive revenue growth and project success by serving as the trusted technical authority across high\-impact data center transformations.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Architect \& Scope High\-Impact Solutions: Partner with Sales, Product Marketing, and customer leadership to evaluate complex enterprise environments, design high\-availability storage architectures (replication, clustering, cloud integration), and scope Professional Services engagements that drive sales conversion and solution adoption.
* Lead Enterprise Data Migrations \& Implementations: Own end\-to\-end technical execution of complex data center consolidations and block/file migrations using specialized appliances (e.g., Cirrus Data) and native toolsets, ensuring seamless cutovers with zero data loss and minimal operational disruption.
* Automate \& Modernize Storage Operations: Develop custom scripts (Python, PowerShell, Shell) and integration workflows to automate replication, disaster recovery, and cloud\-bursting processes within client environments, drastically reducing delivery timelines and human error.
* Direct Consultative Project Delivery \& Risk Management: Deliver post\-sales technical engagements as a lead subject matter expert, managing technical scope changes, mitigating delivery risks, and ensuring projects complete on time and within budget to maximize customer ROI and satisfaction.


**What You Bring**
* Storage Architecture \& Disaster Recovery Expertise: Mastery of enterprise storage infrastructure (SAN, NAS, block, file), high\-availability clustering, replication technologies, and disaster recovery/business continuity framework design.
* Data Migration \& Toolsets Mastery: Deep hands\-on experience executing large\-scale data center migrations using appliance\-based tools (e.g., Cirrus Data) and host\-level migration utilities across multi\-vendor OS environments (Linux, UNIX, Windows).
* Automation \& Cloud Infrastructure Proficiency: Demonstrated skill in authoring automation scripts (Python, PowerShell, Shell) to integrate storage environments, automate migrations, and orchestrate hybrid\-cloud infrastructures (AWS, Azure, VMware).
* Consultative \& Technical Leadership: Strong pre\-sales and post\-sales advisory capabilities, with proven ability to manage project scope, mitigate delivery risks, and effectively articulate complex technical solutions to enterprise stakeholders.
* We are primarily an in\-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Bangalore office in compliance with Pure’s policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.


**What You Can Expect From Us**
* Innovation: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.
* Growth: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!
* Team: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.


 And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company\-sponsored team events. Check out purebenefits.com for more information.
   

  

**Accommodations And Accessibility**
 Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at TA\-Ops@purestorage.com if you’re invited to an interview.
   

  

**Our Commitment To a Strong And Inclusive Team**
 We’re forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn’t just accepted but embraced. That’s why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership.
   

  

 Everpure is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other characteristic legally protected by the laws of the jurisdiction in which you are being considered for hire.
   

  

**Join us and bring your best.**
**Bring your bold.**

**Be the one building AI\-powered experiences where they matter most.**

Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.

**Job Summary**
 The position is integral to the on\-going technical solution deployment and technical application support of professional services (PS) capabilities. This includes five key areas:
   

  

* Demonstrates product expertise in most Genesys Cloud products
* Provides top quality service engagements for large or strategic customers or other accounts serving as the lead technical advisor and/or engineer
* Follows PS implementation standards
* Assesses complex Genesys Cloud implementations to make appropriate recommendations to both Genesys and the customer
* Initiates and suggests process improvements to Project Managers / Service Delivery Managers and other Management to increase efficiencies for delivery of Genesys Cloud solutions or support


**Major Responsibilities/Activities**
 The Genesys Cloud consultant is responsible for delivering and supporting Genesys Cloud solutions for customers or Partners. This position is responsible for developing a high level of expertise across the majority of Genesys products. The consultant should be flexible to work on post\-production support projects as well.
   

  

**Technical Consultation**

**Minimum Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree in a Computer Engineering/Computer Science/Computer Technology/Telecommunication or related discipline or equivalent professional technical experience
* 3\+ years of related experience
* Prior experience with Genesys Cloud Implementation and/or Administration is mandatory
* Prior experience working on Genesys Digital Channel customer projects deploying Email, SMS, ChatBot, Social media channels will be a plus.
* Good technical problem\-solving skills and ability to collaborate in troubleshooting challenging configurations.
* Flexibility to work across different time zones specifically North America
* Flexibility to take up a operational service management role (managing a customer environment), if there is business need


**Technical Skills**
* Knowledge of HTTP requests, REST web services, and JSON
* IP Telephony \& Hardware: Genesys Cloud Edge, Audiocodes, Cisco Gateways, IP Telephones (Polycom, Cisco, etc.)
* Cisco/Juniper/other network routing and switching devices is an added advantage.
* Software: Wireshark, MS Server, DHCP/DNS, MS Hyper\-V, VMWare ESXi, MS Visio, MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access), Email (MS Outlook)

* Operating Systems: Windows 200/2008/2012R2, XP, Vista, Windows 7

**Business Skills**
* Capable of working on or leading a team through a fast paced and complex project.
* Excellent verbal and written business communication skills (English is a must), including escalation management and information presentation.
* Prior experience in working in a customer facing role
* Knowledge of customer service processes.
* Knowledge of Cloud change control processes.
* Exercises good judgment
* Strong follow\-through, ownership \& responsibility on tasks assigned.
* Effective time management and maintains flexibility
* Demonstrate flexibility to adjust working hours to match customer and team interactions


**Working at Genesys**
* AI at enterprise scale – Build, support and operate AI\-powered technology used by more than 8,000 organizations worldwide. 150\+ new AI features were released in the last fiscal year
* A flexible\-first culture – Join a global team of nearly 7,000 employees with flexible ways of working designed to help people do their best work
* Growth in the AI era – Build future\-ready skills through mentorship, learning programs, leadership development and education support
* Time to recharge and give back – Benefits include paid volunteer time, August Free Fridays, well\-being resources and regionally tailored programs for employees and their families
* Recognized globally – Genesys is Great Place to Work® certified in 17 countries and 94% of employees are proud to tell others they work at Genesys


 Learn more about our culture, AI innovation and sustainability commitments through our Careers site and Sustainability Report.
   

  

**What Happens After You Apply**
 After you apply, here's what you can typically expect:
