ea110ffd.title: ServiceNow Platform Architect
ea110ffd.description:
**We’re Hiring \| ServiceNow Platform Architect \| Remote**

Are you an experienced **ServiceNow Platform Architect** ?

The candidate should have 12\+ years of overall IT experience, including at least 8 years of hands\-on ServiceNow experience and experience delivering a minimum of two end\-to\-end ServiceNow platform implementations.

**Role:**ServiceNow Platform Architect  
**Location:** Remote  
**Experience:** 12\+ Years  
Salary**:** Up to ₹1\.2 lakh per Month

Role Summary

The ServiceNow Platform Architect will be responsible for architecting, designing, and implementing ServiceNow solutions at an enterprise scale. The role will provide technical leadership across multiple agile delivery teams and ensure that the platform is designed in alignment with CSDM v5, ITIL best practices, and ServiceNow Zurich release capabilities, with a strong focus on scalability, automation, upgradeability, and maximum adoption of out\-of\-the\-box capabilities. The role will involve close collaboration with business stakeholders, SMEs, Product Owners, Business Analysts, and development teams to build a cohesive ServiceNow ecosystem across ITSM, ITOM, CMDB, automation, governance, and enterprise planning.

Key Responsibilities

● The candidate will define and own the end\-to\-end ServiceNow platform architecture, ensuring scalability, performance, security, and upgradeability, and will act as the technical authority across multiple ServiceNow implementations and agile teams. The role will involve making architectural decisions aligned with ServiceNow best practices and CSDM v5 while promoting minimal customization and maximum use of out\-of\-the\-box features, workflows, and AI\-driven capabilities.

● The candidate will architect and implement ServiceNow modules including CMDB and CSDM v5, Service Catalogue, ITSM Pro\+, Now Assist, Virtual Agents, ITOM, Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, Workflow Data Fabric, Integration Hub, and IRM/GRC. The role will also involve driving automation\-first solutions using Flow Designer, Integration Hub, RPA Hub, Now Assist agents, and AI/ML capabilities.

● The candidate will lead CMDB and Discovery architecture, including CI classes, relationships, data quality, reconciliation, governance, service models, business services, and application services. They will also define CMDB health metrics, audit mechanisms, and continuous improvement processes while applying ITIL best practices across Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Asset, and Service Portfolio Management.

● The role will also require experience designing and overseeing integrations between ServiceNow and on\-premise applications, cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, and GCP, and enterprise tools across monitoring, security, finance, HR, and ERP. Strong knowledge of Integration Hub, REST/SOAP APIs, MID Servers, event\-driven integration patterns, Python, Now Assist, Virtual Agents, and RPA Hub is expected.

● The candidate will technically lead multiple agile teams, collaborate with senior technical and business stakeholders, translate business requirements into scalable technical designs and delivery roadmaps, and communicate complex technical concepts effectively to both technical and non\-technical audiences.

Requirements

Required Skills and Experience

● The candidate must have proven experience designing and implementing at least two complete ServiceNow instances covering multiple product families, along with deep hands\-on expertise in the ServiceNow Zurich release.

● Strong expertise in CMDB architecture, CSDM v5, ITSM Pro\+, ITOM, Discovery, Service Mapping, Integration Hub, Workflow Data Fabric, Flow Designer, and IRM/GRC is required.

● The candidate should also have a strong understanding of ITIL processes, service lifecycle management, enterprise\-scale automation, ServiceNow scripting using JavaScript and Glide APIs, REST/SOAP integrations, MID Server architecture, data modelling, CI reconciliation, normalization, performance, security, upgrade\-safe design, and cloud/hybrid integration patterns.

Leadership and Certifications

● The candidate should demonstrate excellent verbal and written communication skills, the ability to influence architecture decisions and lead without authority, experience working with senior business and technology stakeholders, and strong mentoring and coaching capabilities.

● Knowledge of Agile methodologies, including Scrum and SAFe, is expected. ServiceNow CTA or Certified Master Architect and ITIL v4 certifications are desirable, along with relevant ServiceNow CIS certifications.

**The Position**

  

Under the direction of Organon Cross Functional Expert Lead: ERP Finance Solution Architect, this position will be accountable to gather requirement and map business process with the suitable design in SAP systems. Supporting and guiding initiatives across the global financial systems landscape by designing robust and scalable SAP FI/CO solutions that build on existing platforms. Your expertise in accounting and SAP FI/CO processes enables you to translate complex business requirements into practical, high\-quality concepts that strengthen global financial processes.  

  

Support the Cross\-Functional Process Expert Lead by designing, governing, and improving end\-to\-end (E2E) processes across domains. Ensure process harmonization, standardization, and smooth cross\-system handoffs across ERP and enterprise data platforms.  

  

**Responsibilities**

* As a Cross Functional Expert: SAP FI\-CO Solution Architect, the candidate would be responsible for the timely completion of tasks and actions defined by the project plan.
* The candidate would be responsible to Build and expand in\-house expertise across SAP S4 HANA FI\-CO modules including GL, AP, AR, Tax, AA, CCA, PCA, Internal Orders, COPA, CO\-PC, Banking, treasury, and consolidation systems to enable delivery of high\-value use cases.
* Lead from FICO perspective, including local legal compliance requirement implementation, rollout, upgrade, migration and continuous improvement projects across multiple business units and geographies. Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather and document business requirements and align them with SAP FICO capabilities.
* Serve as the Technology Lead and trusted advisor to our Treasury and Finance Business Partners as we support the Treasury Management solution. Find opportunities to bring efficiencies and improvements in business processes in the area of Corporate Treasury. Support the Treasury management system which includes Bank account and Communication management, In House Cash, Netting, Intercompany payments, Lockbox processing, Bank Communication Management, Bank Statements, Interest calculations, FX and Investments. Deep subject matter and technical knowledge are both required in many of these areas.
* Identify process variants, duplication, and optimization opportunities across regions, plants, and business units. Define cross\-domain handoffs, operational controls, and integration points between systems.
* Align process standards with XLAs, business KPIs, and compliance requirements. Assess process impacts across ERP and data platforms. Maintain a cross\-system dependency matrix for E2E processes. Provide impact analysis for upcoming changes, releases, and cross\-functional initiatives. Enforce modelling standards, naming conventions, and process policies.
* Ensure proper approvals, documentation quality, and compliance with enterprise controls. Maintain the enterprise process repository and ensure consistent version management. Collaborate with Product Owners, Architecture, Data Governance, and Operations teams.


Expected Outcomes:

* Reduced process fragmentation and fewer variants across the enterprise.
* Smoother and more reliable handoffs across systems, functions, and domains.
* Better visibility into cross\-system dependencies and reduced release\-related risks.
* Standardized, high\-quality process documentation used consistently across teams.


Success Measures:

* Reduction in E2E process variants.
* Decrease in handoff\-related defects or errors.
* Process documentation quality and compliance score.
* Fewer cross\-system defects due to improved impact visibility.
* Stakeholder alignment and adoption of standard process models.


Decision Rights:

* Recommend and enforce process modelling standards.
* Approve or reject process exceptions or variants.
* Validate cross\-system impacts for major changes.
* Influence Product Owner backlogs where E2E process alignment is affected.

**Required Education, Experience and Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, IT, or related discipline (or equivalent experience); Master’s degree preferred.
* 10\+ years of experience in SAP FICO consulting, including full\-cycle implementations and post\-go\-live support.
* Expertise in SAP FICO core modules (GL, AP, AR, AA, Bank Accounting, CCA, PCA, IO, COPA, CO\-PC). Strong knowledge of cross\-module integration points with MM, SD, PS, RAR and HCM.
* Experience in SAP Treasury and Risk Management, and Tax(Vertex integration) is highly desirable.
* Experience in development of solution for E\-Invoice(SAP DRC), SAFT, DMEE etc. requirements.
* Skilled in writing detailed Functional Design Specifications (FDS) and collaborating on RICEFW objects with ABAP developers.
* Experienced in using agile methodology to bring new solutions though experimental/Proof of Concept (POC) stages to a realized fully sustained solution.
* Excellent facilitation and cross\-functional alignment capabilities.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate, communicate and coordinate with business and IT stakeholders.
* Analytical, structured problem\-solving and process thinking. Ability to influence without authority and communicate clearly. Governance\-minded, detail\-oriented, and organized.

Organon delivers ingenious health solutions that enable people to live their best lives. We are a $6\.5 billion global healthcare company focused on making a world of difference for women, their families and the communities they care for. 0eb83fb8.description:
We are looking for an accomplished
 **Technical Architect with 8\+ years of experience** 
 in designing, implementing, and leading enterprise\-grade cloud, DevOps, and infrastructure solutions. The ideal candidate will have a strong combination of
 **technical architecture, hands\-on engineering, automation, cloud transformation, application deployment, and technical leadership** 
 experience.
   

  

 The candidate will be responsible for architecting
 **highly available, scalable, secure, resilient, and cost\-optimized platforms** 
 while driving automation, standardization, CI/CD adoption, containerization, observability, and continuous improvement across the organization.
   

  

 The role requires a strong understanding of modern cloud\-native architectures, coupled with the ability to work hands\-on with engineering teams and provide technical direction across the complete application and infrastructure lifecycle.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Cloud Architecture \& AWS:**
* Design and implement enterprise\-scale AWS architectures that are secure, highly available, scalable, resilient, and cost\-effective.
* Define cloud architecture standards, reference architectures, design patterns, and infrastructure best practices.
* Provide hands\-on expertise across AWS services including: VPC, EC2, EFS, Auto Scaling, Elastic Load Balancer, IAM, CloudWatch, S3, Lifecycle Manager, SNS, Lambda, Secrets Manager, MSK, ElastiCache, ACM, DynamoDB, Security Hub, SES, S3 Glacier, Fault Injection Service, and RDS.
* Design solutions for high availability, disaster recovery, business continuity, scalability, performance, and fault tolerance.
* Perform architecture and infrastructure reviews to identify opportunities for performance improvement, security enhancement, automation, and cost as Code \& Platform Automation:
* Architect and implement infrastructure provisioning using Terraform, following modular, reusable, version\-controlled, and scalable IaC practices.
* Establish Terraform standards covering modules, remote state, environment isolation, governance, and lifecycle management.
* Automate infrastructure configuration, provisioning, patching, backup, and operational processes.
* Develop Ansible playbooks for OS configuration, patch management, application configuration, and recurring operational activities.
* Develop robust Shell scripts for infrastructure, application, database, and log\-management automation.
* Reduce manual operational activities through automation and self\-service infrastructure capabilities.


**CI/CD \& DevSecOps Architecture**
* Design and implement enterprise\-grade CI/CD and DevSecOps pipelines using Jenkins.
* Configure and manage Jenkins environments from the ground up, including distributed build and deployment architectures.
* Integrate SonarQube/SAST, security scanning, automated testing, artifact management, and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines.
* Manage artifact lifecycle and repositories using JFrog Artifactory.
* Establish standardized build, deployment, release, rollback, and promotion strategies across multiple environments.
* Troubleshoot complex pipeline, build, deployment, and integration issues and provide architectural solutions.
* Drive continuous improvement in deployment frequency, release reliability, security, and operational efficiency.


**Kubernetes, Docker \& Cloud\-Native Platforms**
* Architect and manage containerized and cloud\-native application platforms using Docker and Kubernetes.
* Design Kubernetes environments with focus on scalability, availability, security, networking, resource optimization, and operational resilience.
* Develop and manage Helm charts for standardized application deployment and configuration.
* Define best practices for Kubernetes workloads, configuration management, secrets, ingress, scaling, health checks, and deployment strategies.
* Lead application modernization initiatives involving microservices, containerization, and Kubernetes adoption.


**Application \& Database Architecture**
* Provide technical architecture and deployment expertise for microservices, Apache Tomcat, and Angular\-based applications.
* Design application deployment strategies supporting scalability, reliability, security, and seamless releases.
* Architect and manage database platforms including MySQL, MongoDB, and YugabyteDB.
* Define database provisioning, backup, recovery, high availability, monitoring, and performance\-management strategies.
* Automate database backup and maintenance activities.
* Work closely with development teams to resolve application, database, performance, and integration challenges.


**Networking, Reverse Proxy \& Traffic Management**
* Design and manage application traffic and reverse\-proxy solutions using NGINX and HAProxy.
* Configure load balancing, SSL/TLS termination, routing, health checks, and traffic\-management policies.
* Troubleshoot complex networking, connectivity, routing, and application\-access issues.
* Ensure secure and optimized communication between application, infrastructure, and cloud components.


**Observability, Monitoring \& Logging**
* Design and implement enterprise monitoring and observability strategies using AWS CloudWatch, Dynatrace, and Nagios.
* Establish infrastructure, application, service, and availability monitoring with effective alerting and escalation mechanisms.
* Implement centralized logging and log analytics using Graylog and ELK Stack.
* Develop dashboards and operational metrics to provide visibility into system health, performance, capacity, and availability.
* Define proactive monitoring and alerting strategies to minimize service disruption and improve MTTR.


**Environment, Release \& Infrastructure Management**
* Architect and manage Development, QA, UAT, Pre\-Production, and Production environments.
* Define environment\-specific infrastructure standards, sizing, capacity, security, and deployment strategies.
* Design infrastructure and instance strategies to support different application releases and workloads.
* Ensure consistency across environments through automation and Infrastructure as Code.
* Establish and maintain standards for backup, disaster recovery, patch management, security, monitoring, and operational readiness.


**Technical Leadership**
* Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance to DevOps, Cloud, Development, QA, and IT teams.
* Translate business and application requirements into scalable and maintainable technical architectures.
* Lead architecture discussions, solution design, technology evaluations, proof\-of\-concepts, and technical reviews.
* Act as the senior technical escalation point for critical infrastructure, deployment, and production issues.
* Mentor engineers and establish engineering standards, best practices, and operational processes.
* Collaborate with application and business stakeholders to ensure solutions align with business objectives.
* Drive initiatives focused on automation, reliability, scalability, security, performance, and cost optimization.


**Core Technical Expertise**
* Cloud: AWS VPC, EC2, EFS, ELB, Auto Scaling, IAM, S3, RDS, DynamoDB, Lambda, CloudWatch, SNS, Secrets Manager, MSK, ElastiCache, ACM, Security Hub, Glacier, Fault Injection Service
* Infrastructure as Code: Terraform
* Configuration \& Automation: Ansible, Shell Scripting
* CI/CD \& DevSecOps: Jenkins, SonarQube, JFrog Artifactory
* Containers \& Orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes, Helm
* Databases: MySQL, MongoDB, YugabyteDB
* Source Control: GitHub, GitLab
* Application Platforms: Apache Tomcat, Microservices, Angular
* Web \& Proxy: NGINX, HAProxy
* Monitoring \& Observability: AWS CloudWatch, Dynatrace, Nagios
* Logging: ELK Stack, Graylog


**Required Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, Platform Engineering, or Technical Architecture.
* Proven experience designing and implementing enterprise\-grade AWS architectures.
* Strong hands\-on expertise in Terraform, Jenkins, Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, Ansible, and Shell scripting.
* Strong understanding of CI/CD, DevSecOps, cloud\-native architecture, microservices, and automation.
* Experience with enterprise monitoring, logging, observability, and production support.
* Strong understanding of networking, security, high availability, disaster recovery, scalability, and performance engineering.
* Experience working across multiple environments and supporting mission\-critical production workloads.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex infrastructure and application issues.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills.

e8578120.title: Oracle Cloud GL (General Ledger) — Application Support Consultant
e8578120.description:
**Job Description: Oracle Cloud GL (General Ledger) — Application Support Consultant** 




**Experience Required:** 
 6–8 Years
 



**Location:** 
 Hyderabad (1st preference). Other locations are also fine, Chennai, Bangalore, Gurugram, Pune, Mumbai, Kolkata
 



**About the Role** 




 We are looking for an experienced Oracle Cloud General Ledger (GL) Support Consultant with strong hands\-on functional expertise in Oracle Cloud GL, with proven experience resolving production issues, handling period\-close activities, and providing day\-to\-day operational support in a live Oracle Cloud Financials environment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Provide L2/L3 production support for Oracle Cloud General Ledger module, ensuring timely resolution of incidents and service requests within defined SLAs
* Manage and troubleshoot day\-to\-day GL issues: journal posting errors, allocation failures, reconciliation mismatches, ledger balancing issues
* Support month\-end, quarter\-end, and year\-end close activities including journal review, accruals, revaluation, translation, and consolidation
* Monitor and resolve issues in scheduled processes (ESS jobs) related to GL — posting, import, allocations, period close
* Handle intercompany transactions, elimination entries, and cross\-ledger balancing issues
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring issues and recommend permanent fixes/configuration changes
* Coordinate with Oracle Support (SRs/Service Requests) for bug fixes, patches, and quarterly update issues
* Support functional testing of Oracle Cloud quarterly patches/updates and regression testing for GL processes
* Work closely with subledger (AP, AR, FA \& CM) support teams to resolve cross\-module integration issues impacting GL
* Assist in FBDI\-based data loads, journal uploads, and correction of failed interface/import processes
* Maintain and update support documentation, SOPs, and knowledge base articles
* Handle minor enhancements, CRs (Change Requests), and configuration updates as per business need
* Provide end\-user support, training, and query resolution related to GL processes
* Track tickets via ITSM tools (ServiceNow, JIRA, Remedy, etc.) and report on SLA compliance and ticket trends
* Participate in on\-call/rotational support and be available during period\-close windows (including weekends, if required)



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 



* 6–8 years of experience in Oracle applications, with at least 4–5 years dedicated to Oracle Cloud GL support/operations
* Strong hands\-on experience in a
 **production support environment**
* Solid understanding of GL configurations: Chart of Accounts, Ledgers, Calendars, Journal Sources/Categories, Data Access Sets
* Practical experience with allocations, revaluation, translation, and consolidation processes
* Experience handling period\-close cycle issues and providing close\-window support
* Working knowledge of GL integration points with AP, AR, FA, CM, and Expenses
* Hands\-on experience with OTBI, FRS (Financial Reporting Studio), and Smart View for troubleshooting/reporting issues
* Familiarity with FBDI templates and resolving failed import/interface issues
* Experience raising and managing Oracle Service Requests (SRs) via My Oracle Support (MOS)
* Understanding of Oracle Cloud release cycles (quarterly updates) and their impact on GL configurations
* Good knowledge of ITSM/ticketing tools (ServiceNow, JIRA, Remedy)
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to prioritize under pressure



  





**Preferred/Good to Have** 



* Oracle Cloud Financials (GL) certification
* Prior experience in AMS/support engagements (as opposed to only implementation projects)
* Exposure to SLA\-driven support models and ticket\-severity frameworks (P1/P2/P3\)
* Basic understanding of SQL for data validation/debugging (not mandatory)



  





**Soft Skills** 



* Strong ownership mindset with a sense of urgency during close periods
* Good client communication and ticket documentation skills
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple tickets/priorities simultaneously
* Team player with willingness to support on\-call/rotational schedules

1a04093e.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, AI Solutions (Night Shift)
1a04093e.description:
### **Redefine the future of customer experiences. One conversation at a time.**



At Nextiva, we’re reimagining how businesses connect, bringing together customer experience and team collaboration on a single, conversation centric platform. Powered by AI, driven by human innovation.



Our culture is forward thinking, customer obsessed and built on the belief that meaningful connections drive better business outcomes. Whether it’s through our signature Amazing Service®, the technology we create, or the experiences we cultivate, connection is at the core of who we are.



If you’re ready to collaborate with incredible people, make an impact, and help businesses everywhere deliver truly amazing experiences, this is where you belong.

 **Work Hours:** Night Shift (7:00 PM \- 3:00 AM IST)


**Location:** Bengaluru


**In\-Office Expectation:** This role is primarily shift\-based. As the office does not currently operate between 8:00 PM and 8:00 AM, work during these hours will be performed remotely until further notice. The Company reserves the right, at its sole discretion, to modify office operating hours and require in\-office work in the future.



Employees may be required to work onsite on an occasional basis for team collaboration, meetings, or other business needs. Accordingly, candidates must be based in Bengaluru and maintain the ability to work from Nextiva’s office located at Wilshire III by MFAR, 492, Hobli, RHB Colony, Mahadevapura, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560048, as required.



Specific work schedules and any flexibility will be determined by the employee’s reporting manager in alignment with business requirements and team collaboration needs.



This role serves as a growth path into AI Solutions Engineering, Product Specialist opportunities, or Customer Success Leadership. At Nextiva, all team members working a standard shift are expected to work onsite, supporting a highly collaborative, in\-person team environment.



**About the Role:**



Nextiva is looking for a passionate and detail\-oriented **AI Implementation / Customer Success Engineer** to help deploy AI solutions for customers, design high\-quality conversational experiences, and manage end\-to\-end agent implementations. This role blends technical skills, prompt engineering, workflow design, and customer\-facing responsibilities to ensure successful delivery of AI\-driven customer experience products.



You will work closely with product, engineering, and customer success teams to translate business needs into scalable AI workflows and optimized conversational agents.


**Key Responsibilities:**



AI Agent Implementation \& Prompt Engineering


* Design, build, and optimize AI agents using advanced prompt engineering techniques.
* Create structured workflows and decision trees that guide AI agent behavior.
* Use LLMs such as **GPT\-4o, Gemini, Claude, Llama** etc., to build, test, and refine agents.
* Implement **function\-calling / tool\-calling** capability within prompts using simple UI builders.
* Configure constraints and guardrails to reduce hallucinations and ensure reliable outputs.


Customer\-Facing Implementation


* Work directly with customers to understand business needs, use cases, workflows, and integration requirements.
* Translate customer requirements into technical implementation plans.
* Assist in onboarding, deployment, and testing of AI solutions for customer environments.
* Provide ongoing optimization and support to ensure solution adoption and success.


Workflow \& Integration Management


* Build, maintain, and optimize automation workflows using platform workflow builders.
* Integrate agents with customer tools, APIs, CRMs, or communication platforms where needed.
* Troubleshoot workflow, configuration, or data issues during implementation.


Conversation \& Experience Design


* Create high\-quality conversation flows for AI agents, ensuring clarity, tone, and brand alignment.
* Apply AI conversation design principles to improve user satisfaction and agent performance.


Technical Skills \& Development


* Use basic **Python** for data handling, API interactions, testing, or workflow extensions.
* Work with GenAI technologies, SaaS tools, and no\-code/low\-code integration platforms.
* Perform evaluation and tuning of AI prompts, workflows, and agent performance.


Cross\-functional Collaboration \& Documentation


* Work with product teams to relay customer feedback and improve platform features.
* Maintain clear documentation for workflows, prompts, integrations, and customer implementations.
* Train customers and internal teams on product capabilities and best practices


**Required Skills \& Qualifications:**


* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related field.
* 1\+ years of experience in **AI product implementation, customer success engineering, or technical support** roles.
* Prior experience supporting US based customers **strongly preferred**
* Excellent **spoken and written English**, with the ability to clearly explain **technical and AI\-driven processes to non\-technical audiences**.
* Comfortable leading customer discussions, gathering requirements, and explaining issues, solutions, and next steps with clarity and confidence.
* Strong hands\-on experience with **LLMs (GPT\-4o, Gemini, Claude, etc.)** for building agents and prompts.
* Solid understanding of **Generative AI concepts, prompt engineering, and workflow design**.
* Basic knowledge of **Python**, APIs, and SaaS tools.
* Experience in **customer support / onboarding / technical implementation**.
* Ability to manage hallucinations, constraints, and safe AI output design.
* Experience with workflow builders and no\-code automation platforms.
* Good analytical, problem\-solving, and debugging skills.
* Willingness to work **night shifts** to collaborate with global teams or customers.


**Preferred (Nice\-to\-Have) Skills:**


* Knowledge of **vector databases, embeddings, or RAG workflows**.
* Experience with **API\-based integrations**.
* Familiarity with **enterprise customer environments (CRM, CX platforms, VoIP, ticketing tools)**.
* Understanding of **AI evaluation frameworks** (test cases, scoring, prompt iteration).
* Exposure to **Nextiva** products or any communication/CX platforms is a plus.


**What We Offer:**


* Opportunity to work on cutting\-edge GenAI implementations for global customers.
* Growth path into **AI Solutions Engineering, Product Specialist, or Customer Success Leadership** roles.
* Collaborative global team environment with high ownership and autonomy.


**Nextiva DNA** (Core Competencies)



Nextiva’s most successful team members share common traits and behaviors:


* **Drives Results**: Action\-oriented problem solvers who quickly bring clarity and **simplicity** to ambiguity, challenge the status quo, and lead meaningful change; celebrating wins to fuel momentum. They act swiftly and pragmatically, learning and improving as they go.
* **Critical Thinker:** Data\-driven, **forward\-thinking** individuals who identify key drivers, anticipate risks, and deliver clear recommendations. They confidently leverage AI and automation to reduce friction, improve decision\-making, and focus on higher\-value work.
* **Right Attitude:** Collaborative, competitive, and resilient team players who jump in to solve tough problems, learn from setbacks, and foster a culture of service, respect, and **care** for customers and teammates.


**Total Rewards**



Our Total Rewards offerings are designed to allow our employees to take care of themselves and their families so they can be their best, in and out of the office.



Our compensation packages are tailored to each role and candidate's qualifications. We consider a wide range of factors, including skills, experience, training, and certifications, when determining compensation. We aim to offer competitive salaries or wages that reflect the value you bring to our team. Depending on the position, compensation may include base salary and/or hourly wages, incentives, or bonuses.


* **Medical** \- Medical insurance coverage is available for employees, their spouse, and up to two dependent children with a limit of 500,000 INR, as well as their parents or in\-laws for up to 300,000 INR. This comprehensive coverage ensures that essential healthcare needs are met for the entire family unit, providing peace of mind and security in times of medical necessity.
* **Group Term \& Group Personal Accident Insurance** \- Provides insurance coverage against the risk of death / injury during the policy period sustained due to an accident caused by violent, visible \& external means.
	+ **Coverage Type** \- Employee Only
	+ **Sum Insured** \- 3 times of annual CTC with minimum cap of INR 10,00,000
	+ **Free Cover Limit** \- 1\.5 Crore
* **Work\-Life Balance** **️** \- 15 days of Privilege leaves per calendar year, 6 days of Paid Sick leave per calendar year, 6 days of Casual leave per calendar year. Paid 26 weeks of Maternity leaves, 1 week of Paternity leave, a day off on your Birthday, and paid holidays
* **Financial Security**\- Provident Fund \& Gratuity
* **Wellness** **‍** \- Employee Assistance Program and comprehensive wellness initiatives
* **Growth** \- Access to ongoing learning and development opportunities and career advancement


At Nextiva, we're committed to supporting our employees' health, well\-being, and professional growth. Join us and build a rewarding career!



Beware of Recruitment Fraud: At Nextiva, we follow a merit\-based hiring process and do not charge any fees or require a deposit at any stage. We also do not authorize any third parties to collect payments or sensitive information on our behalf.


**All genuine communications from Nextiva originate from official email addresses ending in “@nextiva.com”.** Communications received from free email services (such as Gmail, Yahoo, or Hotmail) purporting to be from Nextiva should be treated as fraudulent. If you are contacted by a third\-party claiming to represent us, please verify their credentials by writing to talent@nextiva.com.


We encourage candidates to stay vigilant and verify the authenticity of any communication claiming to be from Nextiva, including unsolicited calls, WhatsApp messages and Telegram communications. While we strive to maintain a secure hiring process, Nextiva is not responsible for any losses arising from fraudulent activities. If you believe that you have been a victim of recruitment fraud, please contact your law enforcement agencies immediately.



For genuine opportunities, please apply only through our official career sites: Nextiva Careers \& Nextiva Jobs on LinkedIn.



\#LI\-MM1 \#LI\-HYBRID

  


Founded in 2008, Nextiva has grown into a global leader trusted by over 100,000 businesses and 1M\+ users worldwide. Headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona, and with teams across the globe, we're the future of customer experience and team collaboration through our AI\-powered, conversation\-centric platform.



Want to see what life at Nextiva is all about?

70033c9f.title: Technical Program Manager
70033c9f.description:
Portcast is a venture\-backed, Singapore\-based logistics technology startup helping freight forwarders turn data into better decisions and measurable business impact. Portcast uses AI to surface shipment exceptions, cost risks, and the right actions, helping teams focus on the shipments that need their attention, keep freight costs under control, and make procurement decisions with confidence. Our vision is to be the AI data and intelligence layer that powers exception management and margin improvement on every shipment.
   

  

 Founded in 2018 and backed by leading technology investors, we are a lean, globally distributed team building technology for an industry going through a major digital transformation.
   

  

**About The Role**
 You'll be the person accountable for the delivery state of our product initiatives once they move into execution. You'll report directly to our Senior Product Manager and make sure ownership is clear across Engineering, Data, and Solutions, work is progressing as expected, dependencies are being managed, and risks are surfaced early rather than when they become launch problems.
   

  

 We're looking for someone who understands our product, technology, and data well enough to follow the work, understand why we're building something, spot when execution is drifting from the intended outcome, and know when to bring an issue back to Product for clarification.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on IC role and you'll be the first person in this role at Portcast, giving you the opportunity to shape how we manage and deliver product initiatives as we scale. This role requires daily working\-hour overlap with our Asia\-based Tech Team.
   

  

**What Success Looks Like In This Role**
* No launch delays, cleaner releases, and shorter cycle times, driven by earlier identification of risks, dependencies, and blockers, better coordination across Product, Engineering, Data, and Solutions, and clearer visibility into what is moving, what is blocked, and what needs attention.


**What You’ll Own**
* Own delivery from kickoff to release: Take ownership of the operational delivery state once a product initiative moves into execution. Make sure ownership is clear, work starts when expected, progress is visible, and initiatives continue moving through development, testing, and release.
* Track dependencies and surface risks early: Monitor cross\-functional dependencies, blockers, competing priorities, scope changes, and potential delays.
* Coordinate across Product, Engineering, Data, and Solutions: Make sure teams know who owns what, dependencies are understood, and the right people have the context they need. Act as the central point of coordination so Product has a clear view of delivery.
* Coordinate handover and launch readiness: Help coordinate the handover between Engineering, Data, Solutions, and Product so that the relevant teams have what they need for testing and acceptance.
* Keep execution aligned with product intent: Understand the goals and key requirements behind an initiative well enough to spot when implementation appears to diverge from what was intended. Surface questions, gaps, or inconsistencies early and bring them back to Product for clarification before they become testing or release issues.
* Maintain a clear source of truth: Keep tickets, timelines, project status, dependencies, key decisions, and risks up to date so that the team can quickly understand what is moving, what is blocked, and where attention is needed.
* Keep delivery moving without creating bureaucracy: Bring structure, follow\-through, and accountability to the delivery process without adding unnecessary processes. Join relevant standups and working sessions so you can identify issues and resolve them quickly.


**What We’re Looking For**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* At least 3\+ years in project management, program management, delivery, product operations, or a similar role.
* A proven ability to close things and keep initiatives moving: Experience managing projects or initiatives involving multiple technical and cross\-functional teams in a startup or B2B SaaS environment, ideally in data\-heavy domains, and even better in logistics tech or supply chain tech.
* Understands data and strong technical foundation. You can read code, understand how systems and data pipelines fit together, and dig into the work alongside engineers and data scientists. You know the difference between a real blocker and noise.
* Strong execution instincts: You naturally keep track of the details that others might miss. You chase loose ends, surface blockers, follow up on dependencies, and make sure decisions actually turn into action.
* First\-principles problem solving: When something is stuck or going off track, you understand why rather than simply following the existing process. You work out what needs to change and involve the right people to resolve it.
* Comfort with ambiguity: You can create clarity when the requirements, ownership, or process aren't fully defined. You are comfortable making progress without having every answer upfront.
* Strong cross\-functional communication: You can translate between Product, Engineering, Data, and customer\-facing teams. You know what different teams need to know, communicate clearly, and escalate issues early without creating unnecessary noise.
* High ownership: You don't see your job as simply tracking whether someone completed a task. You take responsibility for the overall delivery state and stay on an issue until it is actually resolved.

 Master's Degree

7e87f8bd.description:
**Company Profile**
**Lennox (NYSE: LII)** 
 Driven by 130 years of legacy, HVAC and refrigeration success, Lennox provides our residential and commercial customers with industry\-leading climate\-control solutions. At Lennox, we win as a team, aiming for excellence and delivering innovative, sustainable products and services. Our culture guides us and creates a workplace where all employees feel heard and welcomed. Lennox is a global community that values each team member’s contributions and offers a supportive environment for career development. Come, stay, and grow with us.
   

  

**Job Description**
 The Lead Architect owns the end\-to\-end technical design of enterprise applications built on Java and the Spring ecosystem. The role combines hands\-on architecture of cloud\-ready, event\-driven microservices with technical leadership across the software development lifecycle \- setting standards, mentoring engineers, driving engineering excellence and ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, resilient, and aligned with business goals. You will collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams, including developers, product managers, and business stakeholders, to deliver innovative and future\-proof solutions.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own the end\-to\-end architecture for assigned systems, from solution design through detailed component, integration, and deployment architecture.
* Translate business and product requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable technical solutions while collaborating closely with business, product, and delivery teams.
* Define and maintain architectural standards, best practices, governance frameworks, and technical roadmaps.
* Ensure non\-functional requirements including performance, scalability, security, availability, resilience, and fault tolerance are incorporated into all solutions.
* Design and oversee the development of Java\-based, cloud\-ready microservices using Spring Boot, REST APIs, and event\-driven architectures.
* Provide architectural guidance to development teams and ensure implementation aligns with the approved architecture.
* Partners with product and delivery leads to estimate effort, sequence work, and manage architectural dependencies and technical risks.
* Lead the development of new features, enhancements, and modernization initiatives across the application landscape.
* Participate in and provide technical leadership throughout the Software Development Lifecycle (requirements, design, development, testing, deployment, and support).
* Conduct architecture and code reviews to ensure compliance with coding standards, security guidelines, and quality best practices.
* Drive engineering excellence through Agile architecture, DevSecOps practices, CI/CD automation, and cloud adoption.
* Optimize application performance, troubleshooting complex technical issues, and continuously improving system reliability.
* Mentor architects and senior developers while fostering collaboration, innovation, and technical excellence.
* Promote knowledge sharing through technical documentation, architecture artifacts, workshops, and training sessions.
* Stay current with emerging technologies and evaluate their applicability to improve business outcomes and engineering capabilities


**Qualifications**
* 10–12 years of experience in enterprise application development, with at least 3\+ years in a Solution Architect or Technical Lead role.
* Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise\-scale, distributed applications and microservices.
* Strong expertise in Java SE/EE and Spring ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security).
* Proficiency in Java as the primary language, with working knowledge of Python or JavaScript as an advantage.
* Experience designing RESTful APIs, microservices, event\-driven architectures, and integration using SOAP where required.
* Experience with messaging platforms such as Kafka or RabbitMQ and API Gateway technologies.
* Strong knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server) and database design principles.
* Familiarity with front\-end technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and frameworks like React.
* Experience with Git and modern software development workflows.
* Experience implementing DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and cloud\-native deployment patterns.
* Hands\-on experience with a major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Familiarity with observability and monitoring tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) and SLO/SLA definition.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues.
* Ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions aligned with enterprise architecture.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with experience collaborating across engineering teams, business stakeholders, and senior leadership.
* Ability to influence technical decisions and drive architectural governance across multiple teams.

 Job Category
   

  

 Customer Success
   

  

 Job Details
   

  

**About Salesforce**
 Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
   

  

 Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
   

  

 Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include—but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
   

  

 You are both a big picture thinker and in\-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution, including knowing how to leverage AI development tools like Claude and GitHub Copilot to optimize code quality and accelerate design cycles. The solutions you design are built for the long\-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API's as well as a strong development background.
   

  

 What You'll Actually Be Doing
   

  

* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Translate business requirements into well\-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform, including identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI capabilities using Agentforce
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects, championing an AI\-First Delivery \& Engineering methodology by utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed, utilizing AI coding assistants to help enforce standards and optimize code performance
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation, championing the team's use of tools like GitHub Copilot to accelerate the generation of Apex classes, mock data, and REST integrations
* Focus on Performance Evaluation \& ROI by collaborating with customers to develop evaluation frameworks to measure AI performance and business value for their specific use cases
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues, leveraging AI diagnostics to interpret system logs and isolate performance bottlenecks quickly
* From time\-to\-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre\-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep\-dive sessions, Proof\-Of\-Concept (POC) development with prospects using AI tools to build prototypes rapidly
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50\-75%


 You're Our Person If...
   

  

* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9\-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Community, Marketing, and Community Clouds, as well as an understanding of Agentforce architecture
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance\-driven solutions, including using AI platforms to evaluate architectural scaling and load limits
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices, with experience using AI tools to model data distribution and analyze potential data skew risks
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth) and how to configure them securely
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.), utilizing AI platforms to parse third\-party REST API documentation and map complex data schemas
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Practical fluency using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to accelerate delivery, document technical architecture, and maintain a high standard of code quality
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end\-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web\-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire.


 Unleash Your Potential
   

  

 When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
 *be your best* 
 , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
 *do your best* 
 . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
   

  

 Accommodations
   

  

 If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
   

  

 Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.
   

  

 Posting Statement
   

  

 Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non\-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit.  You are both a big picture thinker and in\-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep.  You're Our Person If...

9e0d71bb.title: AI Solutions Architect
9e0d71bb.description:
Clinisys is a leading global provider of intelligent informatics solutions, offering advanced technologies and expert services that transform modern laboratory operations across diverse sectors such as healthcare, life sciences, public health, environmental testing, water quality, toxicology, and contract services. Through its platform and cloud\-based solutions, Clinisys empowers over 3,000 laboratories in 34 countries to generate millions of analytical and diagnostic results, and data insights every day, supporting more efficient and effective workflows for laboratories and testing environments worldwide.
   

  

 Headquartered in Tucson, Arizona, and Woking, England, Clinisys’ mission is to enhance the effectiveness of diagnostic workflows in any laboratory or testing environment and keep citizens and communities healthier and safer.
   

  

**Clinisys' AI Philosophy**
 Building an AI‑first organisation is central to Clinisys’ purpose and the impact we deliver. As a global provider of intelligent diagnostic informatics solutions, we build AI‑enabled, cloud‑based platforms to enhance diagnostic workflows across healthcare, life sciences, and public health. By applying intelligent technology thoughtfully and responsibly, we help laboratories and testing environments operate more effectively, generate meaningful insights at scale, and ultimately support healthier and safer communities. Operating across more than 30 countries, Clinisys expects all colleagues—regardless of role or function—to work confidently with AI‑enabled tools, apply digital and analytical thinking, and continuously adapt as technologies evolve, must drive an AI first sense of purpose and urgency.
   

  

**Purpose (of The Role)**
 As an AI Solutions Architect and a member of a dynamic and multi\-functional Agile development team, you will play a pivotal role in championing AI\-enabled capabilities into software development operations and commercialized product offerings. Clinisys is building a dedicated AI engineering team to transform how laboratories configure and interact with LIMS and LIS products. The AI Solutions Architect will lead the technical design and integration of agentic AI systems that simplify workflows, reduce configuration time, and align with our Microsoft\-first technology strategy. This role will set the technical standard for AI development at Clinisys, guiding both the dedicated AI team and enabling full\-stack engineers to contribute effectively.
   

  

 Practical experience in deploying AI solutions in a Production environment is essential. Your hands\-on experience and past leadership experience using GenAI tools—such as ChatGPT, Copilot, etc. and your familiarity with the latest versions of popular LLMs such as Claude or GPT\-X—as well as a strong foundational understanding of other AI domains (NLP, Predictive Analytics, Computer Vision) will be instrumental in creating operational efficiencies and commercialized product features.
   

  

 You will collaborate with product managers, UX designers, and data scientists to deliver and champion AI\-enabled, GenAI, and agentic solutions for our customers to help drive their productivity. You will lead the process improvement initiatives within the SDLC to ensure applicable areas are AI\-enabled, creating agentic workflows were needed, which can include user\-story generation, code\-generation, test\-automation, PR automation etc.
   

  

 You will design, host, and deploy AI\-enabled solutions—including GenAI, Predictive Analytics, LLM, and RAG—ensuring effective integration with Clinisys applications. You are also responsible for cost\-efficient cloud architecture for both internal and external solutions.
   

  

**Essential Functions**
* AI Architecture Design: Lead the design of AI\-enabled, GenAI, LLM and RAG, solutions that integrate with LIMS/LIS platforms to support sample tracking, test result interpretation, anomaly detection, and workflow optimization.
* Architect scalable, secure, and compliant AI systems using Microsoft Azure services:
* Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, Azure Functions, Azure Service Bus
* Design agentic workflows that allow an LLM\-powered assistant to autonomously build and modify configurations within LIMS/LIS products
* Create reference implementations and reusable components for full\-stack engineers to extend AI functionality
* Lead architecture reviews and technical workshops to align engineering practices across teams
* Define API contracts and integration patterns between AI services and product backends:
* .NET (C\#), RDBMS, SQL Server , Oracle, NoSQL, Azure Cosmos, MongoDB, RESTful APIs
* Data Integration \& Governance: Architect secure and scalable pipelines for ingesting structured and unstructured lab data (e.g., HL7, FHIR, ASTM, DICOM) while ensuring compliance with CLIA, CAP, HIPAA, and GDPR.
* Collaboration: Partner with lab directors, pathologists, and clinical informatics teams to translate diagnostic and operational needs into AI capabilities.
* Collaborate with product engineering teams to embed AI capabilities into existing UIs and workflows
* Model Development \& Deployment: Oversee the lifecycle of AI models, including training, validation, deployment, and monitoring in regulated environments.
* Automation \& Efficiency: Drive intelligent automation initiatives such as auto\-verification of results, smart routing of samples, and predictive maintenance of lab instruments.
* Compliance \& Explainability: Ensure AI solutions meet regulatory standards and provide explainable outputs suitable for clinical environments.
* Innovation Leadership: Evaluate emerging technologies (e.g., LLMs and RAG for lab report summarization, computer vision for slide analysis) and lead proof\-of\-concept initiatives.


**Skills Needed To Be Successful**
* Strong architectural thinking with the ability to design scalable, modular, and secure AI systems
* Deep understanding of large language models (LLMs) and RAG, agentic systems, and workflow orchestration
* Proficiency in both Python and .NET (C\#) for building production\-grade AI services and APIs
* Expertise in Microsoft Azure services, including Azure OpenAI, Azure ML, and Azure DevOps
* Ability to translate business and domain\-specific requirements into technical solutions
* Strong communication and mentoring skills to guide engineers and influence cross\-functional teams
* Familiarity with regulatory and compliance frameworks relevant to healthcare and life sciences
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, cross\-functional environment with evolving priorities
* Strong problem\-solving and debugging skills.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.


**Required Experience \& Education**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
* 8\+ years of experience in software architecture or engineering
* 3\+ years of experience designing and implementing AI/ML systems in production environments
* Demonstrated experience with Microsoft Azure cloud services and infrastructure
* Proven track record of integrating AI systems into enterprise software products


**Preferred Experience \& Education**
* Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field
* Experience in regulated industries such as healthcare, life sciences, or environmental sciences
* Familiarity with laboratory information systems (LIMS/LIS) or scientific data workflows
* Experience with embedding AI assistants or chatbots into enterprise applications
* Knowledge of prompt engineering, vector databases, and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG)


**Supervisory Responsibilities**
* This role does not have direct reports initially but will:
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to AI engineers and full\-stack contributors
* Influence architectural decisions across multiple engineering teams
* Help define future team structure and hiring needs as the AI initiative scales
* AI Architecture Design: Lead the design of AI/ML solutions that integrate with LIMS/LIS platforms to support sample tracking, test result interpretation, anomaly detection, and workflow optimization.
* Data Integration \& Governance: Architect secure and scalable pipelines for ingesting structured and unstructured lab data (e.g., HL7, FHIR, ASTM, DICOM) while ensuring compliance with CLIA, CAP, HIPAA, and GDPR.
* Clinical Collaboration: Partner with lab directors, pathologists, and clinical informatics teams to translate diagnostic and operational needs into AI capabilities.
* Model Development \& Deployment: Oversee the lifecycle of AI models, including training, validation, deployment, and monitoring in regulated environments.
* Automation \& Efficiency: Drive intelligent automation initiatives such as auto\-verification of results, smart routing of samples, and predictive maintenance of lab instruments.
* Compliance \& Explainability: Ensure AI solutions meet regulatory standards and provide explainable outputs suitable for clinical environments.
* Innovation Leadership: Evaluate emerging technologies (e.g., LLMs for lab report summarization, computer vision for slide analysis) and lead proof\-of\-concept initiatives.


 Merged accordingly.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.*

c3026f9a.title: AWS Cloud Engineer
c3026f9a.description:
**Your Career, Accelerated** 




 Vivanti, Australia's leading technology data and analytics consulting firm, is growing their team in their Bengaluru Global Delivery Center.
 



 Vivanti was founded as a platform for talented technologists who want to make a real impact for their clients. Some of the world’s biggest businesses turn to us to help bring their data strategy, AI, cloud engineering and digital solutions to life. We’re the home base for talented technologists who want more and are looking to take their career to the next level by having more learning, more variety, more support and more chances to do meaningful work.
 



 Our consultants use emerging technologies and best practices to help clients become more data driven across a range of industries. Recent projects include building a customer data platform for a leading Airline, an IoT based real\-time driver safety dashboard for a global logistics firm, architecture advisory for Australia’s largest radio network, a full fledged enterprise cloud and data platform for the world’s leading medical aid manufacturing company, to name a few.
 



 We work with all the major technologies used in the market today and are partners with some of the largest names in the industry i.e. Databricks, Snowflake, Google, AWS, Azure and many more.
 



 If that sounds like the kind of place you’d thrive in, keep reading.
 



  





**What You’ll Get** 




 We know you're bringing the skills, the passion and the drive. What we bring is the platform to help you go further.
 



 At Vivanti, you're not just taking a job, you're investing in your growth.
 



 Here’s a taste:
 


* A platform for growth: Work across industries, clients and technologies that stretch your thinking and build your personal and professional skills.
* Access global businesses: Work with some of the world's biggest brands
* IP, frameworks and accelerators: We share what we know. Our playbooks and toolkits fast\-track your success on projects.
* Access to a broad ecosystem of technologies
* Senior consultants who have your back: You’ll always have a guide on your journey, not just be thrown into the deep end.
* Serious learning support: Paid certs, weekly training, guilds, hackathons, mentoring and more.
* Progress that’s transparent: Annual Progress Reviews based on 360° feedback, not vague vibes. Clear goals, solid feedback and real growth.
* Toastmasters and Pitch sessions to embrace your public speaking and leadership skills
* Hackathons to gear up for technologies on the horizon
* Comprehensive Health Insurance
* Kudos and rewards: We celebrate wins, reward impact and offer long\-term incentives.
* Real connection: From Friday socials to annual team building days \- we work hard and play harder.



  





**What You’ll Do** 




 Scaling and Operating a robust AWS platform:\-
 


* Act as a technical lighthouse. You’ll join client reviews to explain why they should migrate to EKS, adopt Serverless, or rethink their Disaster Recovery strategy.
* Design, deploy, and maintain multi\-tenant AWS environments using Terraform. You’ll ensure that "manual change" isn't in our vocabulary.
* Build and optimize deployment pipelines (GitLab CI) that allow our clients to ship code safely and frequently without waking you up at 3 AM.
* Identify repetitive operational tasks, from certificate renewals to environment provisioning, and write the Python or Go code to automate them away
* Implement "Observe\-everything" stacks using Amazon CloudWatch,
 
 and Open Telemetry



 Designing and Scaling the next generation of LLM workloads on AWS Bedrock
 


* Operationalize AWS Bedrock by managing model access, provisioning "Provisioned Throughput" for consistent performance.
* Deploy and maintain the "plumbing" for Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), including Bedrock Knowledge Bases and vector databases.
* Implement Bedrock Guardrails to enforce content filtering and PII masking, ensuring client AI applications stay within safety and compliance boundaries.



  





**What We’re Looking For** 




 4\+ years deep familiarity with AWS products and services, including:
 


* Serverless architecture with Lambda, ECS and Fargate
* Expertise in cloud networking (security groups, WAF, ALBs, API Gateway, etc)
* Cloud governance with IAM roles and permissions
* Knowledge of AWS AI offerings including AWS Bedrock Agentcore, AWS Strands, and Bedrock KnowledgeBases
* Operational reporting and monitoring with CloudWatch and Open Telemetry
* Experience with IaC frameworks like Terraform and Cloud Formation
* Strong fundamentals in Linux, scripting, automation



**If you don’t have 4\+ years of deep AWS experience, this might not be the right fit just yet.** 
 We encourage you to keep building those cloud muscles and look out for our mid\-level openings in the future!
 



  





**Why Explore a Career at Vivanti** 




 We are a consultant led organisation. We invest heavily in our consultants to ensure they have the technical skills and commercial acumen to be successful in their work. Our consultants have a passion for data and solving complex problems. They are curious, ambitious and experts in their fields. We have developed a first rate team so you will be supported and learn from the best.
 



 We invest heavily in professional development both technically, through training and guided certification pathways, and in consulting, through workshops in client engagement and communication. Growth in our organisation happens from growth in our people.
 



 Working on your own macbooks in our custom designed offices in the heart of Bengaluru, away from the big tech parks, we provide a peaceful and productive work environment close to shops, parks and metro stations.
 



 Vivanti consultants engage with the business to give expert advice, solve problems and deliver data, analytics, digital, AI, customer and cloud solutions, by drawing on years of experience across diverse projects, industries and technologies!
 



  





**The Vivanti Interview Process**

* Good technical problem\-solving skills and ability to collaborate in troubleshooting challenging configurations.
* Flexibility to work across different time zones specifically North America
* Flexibility to take up a operational service management role (managing a customer environment), if there is business need


**Technical Skills**
* Knowledge of HTTP requests, REST web services, and JSON
* IP Telephony \& Hardware: Genesys Cloud Edge, Audiocodes, Cisco Gateways, IP Telephones (Polycom, Cisco, etc.)
* Cisco/Juniper/other network routing and switching devices is an added advantage.
* Software: Wireshark, MS Server, DHCP/DNS, MS Hyper\-V, VMWare ESXi, MS Visio, MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access), Email (MS Outlook)
* Software Development experience in Java and C\#.NET, Python, PHP, web application development scripting, tools and methods is a BIG Plus
* Operating Systems: Windows 200/2008/2012R2, XP, Vista, Windows 7
* Knowledge on Amazon Web Services (AWS) is a bonus


**Business Skills**
* Capable of working on or leading a team through a fast paced and complex project.
* Excellent verbal and written business communication skills (English is a must), including escalation management and information presentation.
* Prior experience in working in a customer facing role
* Knowledge of customer service processes.
* Knowledge of Cloud change control processes.
* Exercises good judgment
* Strong follow\-through, ownership \& responsibility on tasks assigned.
* Effective time management and maintains flexibility
* Demonstrate flexibility to adjust working hours to match customer and team interactions


**Working at Genesys**
* AI at enterprise scale – Build, support and operate AI\-powered technology used by more than 8,000 organizations worldwide. 150\+ new AI features were released in the last fiscal year
* A flexible\-first culture – Join a global team of nearly 7,000 employees with flexible ways of working designed to help people do their best work

95050d9a.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field (e.g., Civil, Electrical, or Mechanical Engineering) or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in technical program management, specifically designing, constructing, or managing projects.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience in software focused program/project management and in the business technology market.
* Knowledge of distributed software applications and the ability to quickly grasp new technical concepts.
* Ability to establish credibility and rapport with technical and non\-technical team members alike.
* Proven successful technical program management outcomes from idea to launching programs, throughout your career.
* Customer\-focused, intent on helping the team build an execution process that delivers incremental value on a frequent basis.
* Comfortable building relationships across functions, product areas, and organizational boundaries.

**About the job**
-----------------


Google's projects, like our users, span the globe and require managers to keep the big picture in focus while being able to dive into the unique engineering challenges we face daily. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you lead complex, multi\-disciplinary engineering projects using your engineering expertise. You plan requirements with internal customers and usher projects through the entire project lifecycle. This includes managing project schedules, identifying risks and clearly communicating them to project stakeholders. You're equally at home explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical trade\-offs in product development with engineers.  

  

Using your extensive technical and leadership expertise, you manage projects of various size and scope, identifying future opportunities, improving processes and driving the technical directions of your programs.



Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Set the vision and direction for a program by outlining goals and objectives, evaluating and running multiple projects, organizing cross\-project work within the program, and defining program controls/governance/standards.
* Drive consistency between Cloud processes and central processes. Bring visibility and strengthen communication across the teams.
* Enable execution across multiple teams and drive delivery across the complete portfolio of Cloud products and solutions.
* Engage with engineering directors, product leaders and other Technical Program Manager (TPM) groups, to streamline processes, simplify execution, manage OKRs, release on time, bring tooling for efficiencies and help the teams you are engaged with in execution.
* Contribute to various initiatives in Cloud Storage, Data Cloud, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) technical program manager community.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.
