27a065d5.title: Sr. Program Manager-Customer Delight Engine
27a065d5.description:
**The Title Is Familiar. The Job Is Not.**
Most Sr. Program Manager roles are coordination layers. Status meetings. Slide decks. Nudging people
to reply to emails. This is none of that.
We are building GoComet's Customer Delight Engine — an AI\-native function that transforms how
enterprise accounts experience value. Getting there requires someone who can hold the entire
operating system together while we rebuild it from the inside.
Your success is not measured by what you organised. It's measured by whether the transformation
actually happened.  

You are not the person who reports on the org. You are the person who runs it.
If you think in outcomes, not tasks — keep reading. **Why This Role Exists**
GoComet serves enterprise accounts at $250K–$1M\+ ARR. At this scale, a failure to deliver outcomes
is not just a bad quarter — it is a reference story that closes future doors.
We are transforming the Customer Delight Engine into an AI\-native function — moving from traditional
SaaS implementation toward outcome\-driven delivery, where intelligence replaces rigid workflows and
results replace activity.
That transformation doesn't happen because we planned it well. It happens because someone holds the
entire operating system together while we rebuild it from the inside.
When the Head of the Customer Delight Engine is away for a quarter — nothing should break.
Everything should run. That is the bar for this role. **What You Will Own** **Delivery Governance**
Full visibility of every client engagement. Stage, health, risk, and escalation — in real time. You know
before anyone else when something is slipping. Every project tracker reflects outcome commitments,
not just task lists. **Process Enforcement**Four cycles. SOPs. Anchor PM. PRD discipline. You audit. You flag. You close gaps. If it's documented
but not followed — that's your queue to fix the problem. **Statement of Work Alignment**
What was sold must match what is being built. You track fidelity between commercial commitments and
delivery reality. Drift gets flagged before it becomes a loss — for GoComet or for the customer. **Customer Outcome Mapping**
PMs, CSMs, and Solution Specialists must track outcomes — not milestones. You ensure the entire
Customer Delight Engine is measuring what changes in the real world for the customer, not just what
tasks got closed. **Hiring Operations**
Every open position in the Customer Delight Engine is your responsibility. Not to recruit — to own
velocity and quality. Positions moving, candidates coming in. You drive this.
Staffing \& Resourcing  

You own the staffing plan aligned to our AI\-native transformation roadmap. Is there enough capacity?
Are gaps visible before they become delivery failures? Is the plan keeping pace with where we are
heading? **POD Structure**
GoComet runs customer\-aligned PODs. You assess their health, spot structural problems, and drive
improvements. Handoffs clean. Roles clear. Escalation paths working.**Transformation Metrics**
Two metrics. Both must rise together: Revenue per Employee and Tokens per Employee. You own
the measurement, the reporting, and the accountability for whether the Customer Delight Engine is
genuinely moving toward AI\-native delivery — or just saying it is.**AI\-Native Product Initiatives**
You drive initiatives that make the Customer Delight Engine progressively more AI\-native — AI\-powered
integrations, outcome dashboards CSMs can build themselves, configuration\-driven workflows that
remove engineering dependency. You do not just manage these. You ensure these are delivered.  

How You'll Work**As the Operator**
Weekly delivery reviews. Cross\-team process enforcement. Trackers and systems that make
accountability structural. You do not chase people — you build systems, so they do not need to be
chased.**As the Transformation Driver**
You use AI tools to drive the internal transformation of the Customer Delight Engine — not to build
products, but to change how the org itself works. You prototype AI\-native alternatives to how the team
currently operates, demonstrate what a transformed delivery function looks like in practice, and drive
adoption from the inside. The people who need to change how they work need to see what is possible
first. You are the one who shows them.**As the Anchor**
You are the connective tissue between Sales, Discovery, Build, and Deploy. When something falls
through the gap between teams — that is your gap. You own it. You close it. **Who You Are**
You don't ask: "What should we track?" You ask: "What must change in the real world for this to matter?" **Must\-Have*** 5–7 years across delivery, product, transformation, or operations roles — ideally a combination, not


a single track* Led or managed large\-scale digital transformation programs across multiple organisations or teams


simultaneously* Heavy stakeholder management — business leaders, enterprise customers, cross\-functional


teams, all at once* Strong process design and enforcement background — has built SOPs in complex environments


and made them actually stick* Enterprise B2B exposure — understands how implementation quality drives renewal, expansion,


and reference value* Technical sensibility: not a developer, but not intimidated by tech. Can read architecture


diagrams, understand integration patterns, and hold substantive conversations with engineers* Can use AI tools to build working proof\-of\-concepts — Claude, GPT, Cursor, or equivalent. Not


just as a user — as a builder* Understands LLM concepts at a working level — enough to evaluate, drive, and communicate


AI\-native delivery initiatives* Outcome\-obsessed — knows the difference between a team that is busy and a team that is


delivering **Nice to Have*** Background in logistics, freight, or supply chain operations
* Experience building internal AI tools, agents, or workflow automations
* Has previously acted as a deputy or operator for a senior leader
* Zero\-to\-one product or platform experience

 **What This Role Is NOT*** Not a Sr. Program Manager who manages calendars and owns meeting notes
* Not a programme manager who tracks task completion
* Not an analyst who builds decks and hands them upward
* Not a consultant who recommends changes and moves on

LinkedIn is the world's largest professional network, built to create economic opportunity for every member of the global workforce. Our products help people make powerful connections, discover exciting opportunities, build necessary skills, and gain valuable insights every day. We're also committed to providing transformational opportunities for our own employees by investing in their growth.  Join us to transform the way the world works.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**


**Location: Banglaore / Mumbai / Gurgaon**





 At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.
   

  





 The Senior Program Manager will be a member of the LinkedIn Sales Solutions – Program Management Office reporting to the Chief of Staff to the Global Vice President for Sales, LinkedIn Sales Solutions who is also the Managing Director for LinkedIn's APAC business.

The Senior Program Manager will establish clear governance, surface cross\-program risks and dependencies, drive decisions through the appropriate forums, and keep leaders and working teams aligned on outcomes, ownership, milestones, and success measures.
   

  





 The role is based in India and will require regular collaboration across India, Singapore, and North American time zones. Some travel may be required (1\-2 trips per year).
   

  





**Responsibilities:**




 Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

9dea26c2.title: Lead System Architect & Technical Program Manager
9dea26c2.description:
We are seeking a visionary and execution\-oriented
 **Lead System Architect \& Technical Program Manager (TPM)** 
 to lead the execution of our high\-priority, large\-scale technical initiatives for the CitiDirect Platform Core and Platform Digital Servicing Agile Release Trains (ARTs). This is a unique, hybrid role designed for a senior technical leader who can both design complex, enterprise\-grade system architectures and actively drive their execution across both ARTs.
   

  

 In this role, your primary focus will be
 **System Architecture** 
 —defining the technical vision, designing scalable system architectures, and building the architectural runway. Concurrently, you will leverage
 **Technical Program Management** 
 competencies to operationalize your designs, manage cross\-team technical dependencies, mitigate risks, and ensure the successful delivery of high\-priority technical initiatives.
   

  

 You will serve as the ultimate technical authority for the CitiDirect Platform ARTs, bridging the gap between high\-level enterprise strategy and hands\-on engineering execution.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* System Architecture \& Technical Strategy (Primary Focus \- 70%)
* Architectural Vision \& Design: Define and communicate the future\-state architecture, technical vision, and system design patterns for the platforms within the Platform ARTs.
* Architectural Runway: Design and champion Enabler Epics and Features (covering cloud infrastructure, microservices, security, and data architecture) to ensure the platform supports near\-term business features without technical debt.
* Non\-Functional Requirements (NFRs): Define, monitor, and enforce NFRs—including security, scalability, high availability, performance, and maintainability—across the ART scrum teams.
* Technical Debt \& Modernization: Identify systemic technical debt, prioritize remediation efforts, and lead architectural spikes or prototyping for new technology evaluations.
* Engineering Standards: Establish and promote modern engineering practices, including DevSecOps, Test\-Driven Development (TDD), automated testing, and API\-first design patterns.
* Technical Program Management \& Execution (30%)
* Program Delivery Coordination: Partner with the Release Train Engineer (RTE) to facilitate PI (Program Increment) execution, ensuring that engineering teams deliver on technical milestones and architectural enablers.
* Dependency \& Risk Management: Proactively identify, map, and resolve complex technical dependencies across multiple partner ARTs.
* Risk Mitigation: Lead the identification of program\-level technical risks and systematically address them through stakeholder engagement – product, architecture and engineering.
* Backlog Prioritization: Partner with Product Managers and Product Owners (POs) to refine the Program Backlog to ensure epics/tasks are always available for upcoming PIs.
* Technical Translation: Translate complex architectural designs, non\-functional requirements (NFRs), and security mandates into clear, actionable features and user stories for engineering teams.
* Stakeholder Communication: Provide transparent, data\-driven status updates, technical risk assessments, and delivery metrics to senior leadership and stakeholders.


 Key SAFe Ceremony Involvements
   

  

* PI Planning: Present the Architectural Vision and technical context to the ART; facilitate technical breakout sessions to validate team\-level designs, map dependencies on the Program Board, and draft technical PI objectives.
* ART Sync / Scrum of Scrums: Act as the primary technical escalation point to resolve architectural blockers, infrastructure issues, and cross\-team dependencies.
* System Demo: Lead the evaluation of the integrated system demo to ensure architectural integrity, interoperability, and NFR compliance.
* Inspect \& Adapt (I\&A): Lead problem\-solving workshops to address systemic technical, architectural, or infrastructure bottlenecks identified during the PI.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
 Required:
   

  

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Experience:
+ 7\+ years of experience in software engineering, system design, and enterprise\-scale architecture.
+ Deep, hands\-on experience working within a Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) environment.

* Technical Depth:
+ Proven expertise in designing and deploying cloud\-native architectures (ECS, AWS), microservices, and event\-driven systems.
+ Strong understanding of DevSecOps, CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Kubernetes/Docker), and modern data architectures.


 Preferred Certifications:
   

  
+ Architecture: SAFe® System Architect (ARCH), AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional, or Azure Solutions Architect Expert.
+ Agile/Program Management: SAFe® Product Owner/Product Manager (POPM), SAFe® Release Train Engineer (RTE), or Project Management Professional (PMP).


 Core Competencies
   

  
+ Architectural/Technical Authority: Strong technical credibility to guide, mentor, and gain the respect of senior engineers, tech leads, and system architects.
+ Strategic Execution: Exceptional ability to translate abstract architectural concepts into concrete, phased execution plans.
+ Influence \& Collaboration: Proven ability to influence cross\-functional teams and senior stakeholders without direct authority.

**Systemic Problem Solving:** 
 A track record of diagnosing and resolving complex, systemic technical blockers across highly matrixed organizations.

**There’s another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works.**
  

  

  

 Freshworks Inc. builds uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional employee and customer experiences. Our people\-first approach to AI eliminates friction, helping businesses reduce complexity, lower cost\-to\-serve, and deliver faster, more human support through enterprise\-grade yet easy\-to\-use CX and IT solutions. Nearly 75,000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S\&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks to power their Employee Experience (EX) and Customer Experience (CX) operations.
   

  

  

  

**Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**



**Job Description**

 Solution Architect (SA) role is a critical internally and externally\-facing role within Freshworks Professional Services (FPS) which acts the senior technical SME heavily involved in Sales, Delivery and Expansion phases of the customer lifecycle.
   

  





 FPS SA is a trusted advisor internally and externally working with the highest level functional and technical resources within Freshworks and the customer organizations to translate business outcome requirements into scalable solutions.
   

  





**Your role and responsibilities:**



* During the Sales cycle, FPS SA will work closely with the Freshworks Presales team to understand a prospects pain points and solutions discussed to address them, and then directly interacts with the prospects leadership and functional owners to devise the best implementation approach for the identified solutions in line with industry and FPS best practices.
* During the Delivery phase, FPS SA will be the key resource who translates the high\-level solution provided during the sales cycle into detailed design information to meet the customer’s objectives and also for the FPS technical resources to implement the final solution.
* In the Expansion phase, FPS SA will work with the customer to adjust or expand their deployed capabilities by adjusting their implemented solutions to the customer’s updated needs and organizational changes.



**Some of the specific SA deliverables and activities are:**



* Product Champion: Act as a product leader in the region, instilling confidence in prospects during the sales cycle, devising innovative solutions during implementation, assessing existing enterprise customer health for improvement suggestions, and providing valuable customer feedback to the product team.

**About the Role** 




  





  





 The Sales Engineer is the technical authority and narrative driver in customer engagements. This role is responsible for translating complex AI, Identity, and Data Protection challenges into defensible, real\-world solutions—while helping customers understand not just how something works, but why it matters. This role blends deep hands\-on technical expertise with storytelling, big\-picture (“paint the picture”) thinking, and collaborative problem solving. You will work with prospects to obtain the technical win by designing a viable technical solution with an amazing product that can be applied to various scenarios. You will operate across AI security, LLMs, AI agents, MCP, DLP, and Identity, partnering closely with Sales, Product, and Engineering to close deals and influence product direction.
 



  





  





**Responsibilities** 




  





  





**Technical Discovery \& Storytelling** 



* Lead technical discovery for AI security, DLP, and Identity\-driven use cases.
* Translate complex security architectures into clear narratives that resonate with:
* CISOs and VP’s
* Security leaders
* Architects
* Engineers
* Business stakeholders
* “Paint the big picture” by connecting AI usage, identity trust, and data protection into a cohesive story.
* Clearly articulate what problems are solvable today, what are partially solvable, and what are structural limitations.



  





**Architecture \& Solution Design** 



* Design and present end\-to\-end architectures covering:
* LLM and AI agent workflows (human \+ non\-human identities)
* Data protection, inspection, and policy enforcement
* Identity, authentication, authorization, and trust boundaries

* Integrate enterprise environments including:
* Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Okta
* Microsoft Intune, Jamf Pro
* Explain and demonstrate AI pipelines using:
* LangChain, LangGraph
* MCP\-style agent orchestration patterns
* Lead deep dives into DLP architectures, including:
* What DLP can realistically detect and enforce
* Where traditional DLP breaks down (AI, agents, encrypted channels, context loss)
* Common false assumptions customers have about DLP coverage
* Help customers understand enforcement gaps, bypass scenarios, and risk trade\-offs without overselling.



  





**Workshops \& Collaborative Problem Solving** 



* Facilitate technical workshops and brainstorming sessions with customer teams.
* Co\-design architectures and controls with customers rather than prescribing static solutions.
* Whiteboard flows covering:
* AI access paths
* Identity trust boundaries
* Data movement and enforcement points

**Execution \& Field Innovation** 



* Troubleshoot complex issues across AI pipelines, identity flows, and data paths.
* Create interim or custom solutions using Python, YAML, and cloud services when product features are missing.
* Collaborate with Product and Engineering to validate feasibility and relay field feedback.

* Deep, practical understanding of Data Loss Prevention (DLP):
* Inspection, classification, enforcement points
* Real\-world limitations and bypass scenarios
* Strong hands\-on knowledge of:
* AI systems, LLMs, AI agents
* Emerging AI security risks and abuse patterns
* Solid foundation in Identity \& Access Management (IAM):
* SSO, OAuth/OIDC, tokens, policy enforcement
* Practical experience with:
* Docker
* Linux
* Python
* YAML\-based configuration
* Familiarity with endpoint and device trust tooling:
* Microsoft Intune
* Jamf Pro
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Comfortable using GitHub for code, configs, and version control.
* Exceptional communication, storytelling, and executive\-level presentation skills.
* Ability to lead workshops, whiteboard complex systems, and drive collaborative design sessions.
* Experience in an early startup environment preferred.



  





  





**What Success Looks Like** 




  





  




* Customers trust you not just as a technologist, but as a strategic advisor.

* POCs reflect real customer constraints, not idealized lab conditions.
* Workshops result in alignment, not confusion.
* Deals move forward because solutions are credible, transparent, and defensible—even as the product evolves.

415b50f3.title: Solutions Engineer - I
415b50f3.description:
Asia's leading robotics solutions provider, automating enterprise supply chains since 2017\. We build syncOS — the industry\-first no\-code platform that lets manufacturers and warehouse operators integrate, reprogram, and scale automation systems without halting production or calling in specialists. Our autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) run 24/7 for global brands — transforming production lines in hours, not weeks.
   

  

 As Botsync scales AMR demos across India and Southeast Asia, this Solution Engineer role owns everything between the demo fleet in Bengaluru and a live, working robot on a customer's floor — commissioning, running, and troubleshooting demos that convert prospects into customers.
   

  

**The roles and responsibilities:**
**Running demos on customer sites**
* Travel to customer plants and warehouses across India and Southeast Asia to set up and run live AMR demonstrations, typically 1 to 3 demos a month
* Unpack, commission and map a MAG\-series AMR on an unfamiliar floor within a single shift: network setup, mapping, waypoint and route configuration in syncOS, charging and docking checks
* Run the demo itself in front of plant managers, operations heads and safety teams, narrating what the robot is doing and answering questions on payload, navigation, safety and charging
* Diagnose and recover live on site when a floor behaves differently from the plan: reflective surfaces, poor WiFi coverage, uneven docking, changing traffic around the route
* Work to site rules at all times: PPE, permit\-to\-work, and safe operation around forklifts, pedestrians and live production


**Demo fleet readiness and logistics**
* Own the readiness of the demo fleet: batteries, chargers, magnetic tape, tote and trolley attachments, spares kit, and syncOS software versions matched to the demo scope
* Test every configuration end to end at the Bengaluru facility before it ships, so no robot leaves with a known open issue
* Coordinate packing, freight, customs paperwork and site access with operations for each demo, including cross\-border shipments into Southeast Asia
* Maintain the demo asset log and calibration records, and flag units that need refurbishment before they fail in front of a customer


**Feeding the sales and product loop**
* Work with the sales team before each visit to understand the customer's material flow and agree what the demo must prove: cycle time, payload, route, or integration with existing lines
* Write a short demo report within two working days covering what was shown, what the customer asked for, and what blocked or nearly blocked the run
* Log every product issue seen on site into the engineering tracker with logs, photos and reproduction steps, so recurring failures reach the product team with evidence
* Support the pre\-sales team with layout inputs, video and photo capture from demos, and the occasional trade show or partner event


**Requirements**
**Essential**
* 1\-3 years of relevant experience in robotics, industrial automation, system integration, field applications, commissioning, or a related technical field
* Hands\-on experience commissioning or deploying mobile robots, AMRs, or similar automation hardware — network setup, mapping, and route/waypoint configuration
* Comfortable troubleshooting live, in unpredictable field conditions (connectivity issues, sensor interference, site\-specific quirks) without escalating every issue
* Strong presentation and communication skills — able to explain technical systems clearly to non\-technical audiences (plant managers, operations heads, safety teams)
* Willingness to travel extensively and work across multiple sites and countries on a recurring basis
* Comfortable working cross\-functionally with sales, product, and operations teams, and writing clear, structured technical reports


**Highly desirable**
* Experience with fleet management, asset logistics, or spares/calibration tracking
* Familiarity with syncOS or comparable robot fleet orchestration software
* Prior experience in a pre\-sales, solutions engineering, or field applications engineering role


**Benefits**
* Competitive salary
* Comprehensive health benefits package
* Hustle of a young startup, always something to do and something to improve
* Opportunities for professional development and growth into management roles
* Collaborative and inclusive work environment

22dd623c.title: Forward Deployed Engineering Leader- Microsoft AI Business Solutions
22dd623c.description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**


At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**Crowe's Microsoft focused delivery practice brings together advisory, outcome delivery and managed services across Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Azure, data, automation and AI. The practice is expected to double over the next two years, and this role will help shape how our approximately 20 person India engineering team operates as it grows.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**We are looking for an experienced engineering leader who has built strong teams, raised technical standards and improved how complex software is delivered. Deep experience with every Microsoft product is not required. What matters most is engineering judgment, people leadership, learning agility and the ability to work with platform specialists to make sound architecture and delivery decisions.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**This is a player coach role. You will remain technically engaged through architecture reviews, critical design decisions, prototypes, complex delivery situations and customer conversations. You will not be expected to be the deepest specialist in every Microsoft technology, but you must be able to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions and help teams reach practical, defensible decisions.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**What you will do**
--------------------

* **Build a high performing engineering organization with clear expectations for quality, ownership, collaboration, technical judgment and continuous improvement.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Set and evolve engineering and architecture standards across applications, data, cloud, automation, AI, security and integration, partnering with Dynamics 365, Power Platform and Azure specialists where deep platform expertise is needed.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Stay close to the work by reviewing critical designs, contributing to prototypes and accelerators, helping resolve complex delivery issues and participating in important client conversations.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Translate ambiguous business problems into practical solution approaches, including deciding when AI or an agentic workflow is appropriate and when better data, a clearer process or a deterministic solution will serve the client better.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Coach engineers, technical leads and architects; identify high potential talent; strengthen succession; influence performance decisions; and make difficult talent calls when needed.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Improve the team's ability to work directly with business users, IT teams, architects and senior leaders, particularly when requirements are incomplete or business processes need to change.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Help expand the practice across Power Platform, Azure, data, automation, Copilot and agentic AI by creating an environment in which specialists can learn from one another and apply strong engineering fundamentals consistently.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**What you will do, continued**
-------------------------------

* **Identify opportunities to automate delivery, reuse components and create Crowe intellectual property that reduces effort, improves quality and increases margin across multiple engagements.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Establish meaningful measures for throughput, cycle time, predictability, rework, defects, escalations, reuse and team health, then drive visible improvement against them.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Support solution shaping, estimation, technical workshops, pre sales and executive discussions, connecting technical choices to client outcomes, delivery risk and commercial value.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Partner with practice leadership to turn repeatable delivery patterns into fixed fee or managed services offerings with clear scope, architecture, delivery playbooks and operating measures.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

**Within your first year, you will have:**
------------------------------------------

* **Raised the engineering bar. Teams are operating with clearer standards, stronger architecture discipline and greater ownership of difficult decisions.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Strengthened the leadership bench. Technical leads and high potential engineers are visibly more capable, and expectations and performance decisions are clearer.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Improved delivery health. Predictability, cycle time, quality, escalations and rework are measured, understood and moving in the right direction.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Put reuse to work. Components, delivery patterns, automation and AI enabled workflows are being applied across multiple engagements rather than remaining isolated within one project.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Built credibility across the Microsoft practice. Platform specialists see you as a leader who improves their decisions and effectiveness, even when they have deeper product expertise.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Earned client trust. Clients and colleagues involve you in ambiguous, high consequence technical and delivery decisions.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Opened a stronger commercial path. The practice has a growing pipeline of repeatable fixed fee or managed services offerings supported by real delivery playbooks.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Developed practical fluency across Crowe's Microsoft portfolio and a clear understanding of where specialist depth is required.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Required experience**
-----------------------

* **Ten or more years of software engineering experience, including at least five years leading engineering teams in a global or distributed environment.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **A demonstrated record of building high performing teams, developing leaders, mentoring engineers and improving engineering culture and delivery outcomes.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Strong technical foundations across modern application architecture, cloud platforms, APIs, integrations, data, security, automation and software delivery practices.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Required experience, continued**
----------------------------------

* **Experience setting technical standards and leading architecture or design decisions across complex products, platforms or client engagements.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Sufficient hands on depth to review designs, challenge technical assumptions, guide prototypes and lead teams through difficult engineering problems.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Experience with AI enabled software, automation or data driven solutions, including the judgment to evaluate whether AI is appropriate for a business problem.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Strong client and executive communication skills, with the ability to translate between business outcomes, engineering tradeoffs and delivery risk.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Experience leading through a meaningful business or engineering transformation that changed how work was performed, not simply which system was used.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Comfort operating with ambiguity, taking ownership and making progress before every detail is known.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Preferred experience**
------------------------

* **Experience with one or more parts of the Microsoft business applications and cloud ecosystem, such as Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Dataverse, Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Copilot Studio, Azure OpenAI or Azure AI Search.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Experience in consulting or professional services, including scoped client engagements, solution shaping, estimation and technical workshops.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Experience leading production AI enabled or agentic solutions with appropriate evaluation, security, governance and human oversight.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Exposure to fixed fee delivery, managed services, reusable intellectual property or other approaches that improve delivery leverage and margin.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Business process experience in areas such as customer service, sales, field service, finance, operations, risk or compliance.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**How we will support your success**
------------------------------------

**You will work closely with experienced Dynamics 365, Power Platform and Azure practitioners who provide deep product expertise. In turn, you will help those specialists apply stronger engineering methods, architecture discipline, people leadership and delivery practices. We expect you to build practical Microsoft fluency quickly, while being candid about where specialist input is needed.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Mindset we value**
--------------------

* **You make other engineers and leaders better, remain technically engaged and do not need to be the expert in every room.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **You automate unnecessary work, communicate clearly, seek evidence, invite challenge and own outcomes across people, technology, delivery and clients.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**

**Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high\-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Beyond that, we're looking for someone who:**
-----------------------------------------------

* **Has an automation mindset — the instinct is to eliminate the work, not just scale the number of people doing it.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Crowe's Microsoft focused delivery practice brings together advisory, outcome delivery and managed services across Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Azure, data, automation and AI. Deep experience with every Microsoft product is not required. What matters most is engineering judgment, people leadership, learning agility and the ability to work with platform specialists to make sound architecture and delivery decisions.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

--------------------

* **Build a high performing engineering organization with clear expectations for quality, ownership, collaboration, technical judgment and continuous improvement.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Translate ambiguous business problems into practical solution approaches, including deciding when AI or an agentic workflow is appropriate and when better data, a clearer process or a deterministic solution will serve the client better.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Coach engineers, technical leads and architects; identify high potential talent; strengthen succession; influence performance decisions; and make difficult talent calls when needed.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Improve the team's ability to work directly with business users, IT teams, architects and senior leaders, particularly when requirements are incomplete or business processes need to change.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Help expand the practice across Power Platform, Azure, data, automation, Copilot and agentic AI by creating an environment in which specialists can learn from one another and apply strong engineering fundamentals consistently.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**What you will do, continued**
-------------------------------

* **Identify opportunities to automate delivery, reuse components and create Crowe intellectual property that reduces effort, improves quality and increases margin across multiple engagements.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Establish meaningful measures for throughput, cycle time, predictability, rework, defects, escalations, reuse and team health, then drive visible improvement against them.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Support solution shaping, estimation, technical workshops, pre sales and executive discussions, connecting technical choices to client outcomes, delivery risk and commercial value.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Partner with practice leadership to turn repeatable delivery patterns into fixed fee or managed services offerings with clear scope, architecture, delivery playbooks and operating measures.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

**Within your first year, you will have:**
------------------------------------------

* **Raised the engineering bar. Teams are operating with clearer standards, stronger architecture discipline and greater ownership of difficult decisions.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Strengthened the leadership bench. Technical leads and high potential engineers are visibly more capable, and expectations and performance decisions are clearer.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Improved delivery health. Predictability, cycle time, quality, escalations and rework are measured, understood and moving in the right direction.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Put reuse to work. Components, delivery patterns, automation and AI enabled workflows are being applied across multiple engagements rather than remaining isolated within one project.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Built credibility across the Microsoft practice. Platform specialists see you as a leader who improves their decisions and effectiveness, even when they have deeper product expertise.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Earned client trust. Clients and colleagues involve you in ambiguous, high consequence technical and delivery decisions.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Opened a stronger commercial path. The practice has a growing pipeline of repeatable fixed fee or managed services offerings supported by real delivery playbooks.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Developed practical fluency across Crowe's Microsoft portfolio and a clear understanding of where specialist depth is required.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Required experience**
-----------------------

* **Ten or more years of software engineering experience, including at least five years leading engineering teams in a global or distributed environment.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **A demonstrated record of building high performing teams, developing leaders, mentoring engineers and improving engineering culture and delivery outcomes.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Strong technical foundations across modern application architecture, cloud platforms, APIs, integrations, data, security, automation and software delivery practices.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Required experience, continued**
----------------------------------

* **Experience setting technical standards and leading architecture or design decisions across complex products, platforms or client engagements.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Sufficient hands on depth to review designs, challenge technical assumptions, guide prototypes and lead teams through difficult engineering problems.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Experience with AI enabled software, automation or data driven solutions, including the judgment to evaluate whether AI is appropriate for a business problem.**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Strong client and executive communication skills, with the ability to translate between business outcomes, engineering tradeoffs and delivery risk.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Experience leading through a meaningful business or engineering transformation that changed how work was performed, not simply which system was used.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Comfort operating with ambiguity, taking ownership and making progress before every detail is known.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Preferred experience**
------------------------

* **Experience with one or more parts of the Microsoft business applications and cloud ecosystem, such as Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Dataverse, Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Copilot Studio, Azure OpenAI or Azure AI Search.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Experience in consulting or professional services, including scoped client engagements, solution shaping, estimation and technical workshops.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Experience leading production AI enabled or agentic solutions with appropriate evaluation, security, governance and human oversight.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Exposure to fixed fee delivery, managed services, reusable intellectual property or other approaches that improve delivery leverage and margin.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Business process experience in areas such as customer service, sales, field service, finance, operations, risk or compliance.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**How we will support your success**
------------------------------------

**You will work closely with experienced Dynamics 365, Power Platform and Azure practitioners who provide deep product expertise. In turn, you will help those specialists apply stronger engineering methods, architecture discipline, people leadership and delivery practices. We expect you to build practical Microsoft fluency quickly, while being candid about where specialist input is needed.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Mindset we value**
--------------------

* **You make other engineers and leaders better, remain technically engaged and do not need to be the expert in every room.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

7c31df5d.description:
**About the Role**
We are looking for a Delivery Lead \- AI who can help build and scale our AI organization.
This is not a traditional project or delivery management role. We are looking for a builder, owner, and AI leader who has experience taking something from an early stage and turning it into a successful product, service, team, or business function.
The ideal candidate could come from an AI/product company, a technology services organization where they built a new AI practice or service line, or an AI startup/venture they helped build from the ground up. **What You'll Own*** Scale the AI team,, processes, capabilities, and delivery.
* Lead high\-performing AI teams, with the ability to build toward 200\+ professionals.
* Own AI initiatives from idea and strategy through execution and scale.
* Work across Generative AI, LLMs, AI Agents, Machine Learning, automation, and AI\-enabled products/services.
* Partner with leadership to define AI priorities, roadmap, operating model, and new business opportunities.
* Identify opportunities to turn AI capabilities into scalable products, services, and solutions.
* Build processes and structures that enable the organization to scale without compromising quality or speed.
* Develop people, create accountability, and build future AI leaders.
* Act as the bridge between AI, product, business, people, and delivery.

 **What We're Looking For*** 4–6 years of strong experience in AI, product, technology, consulting, or technology services.
* Proven experience building something from scratch, such as an AI product, practice, service line, startup, or new business function.
* Experience leading teams and taking ownership beyond formal responsibilities.
* Strong understanding of modern AI technologies and their practical business applications.
* Strong product and business mindset, with the ability to connect technology to real business outcomes.
* Entrepreneurial, hands\-on, highly accountable, and comfortable operating in ambiguity.
* Strong communication, decision\-making, and stakeholder management skills.

 **Who Will Stand Out?**
Someone who has built, not just managed.
This could be someone who:* Built and scaled an AI practice within a services company.
* Launched an AI product or new AI service line.
* Built an AI team and operating model from the ground up.
* Founded or co\-founded an AI\-focused startup or venture.
* Took an early\-stage AI initiative and turned it into a functioning team, product, or business.

 **What This Role Is Not:*** This role is not intended for a traditional delivery/project manager whose experience is primarily limited to managing timelines, resources, and existing processes.
* We are looking for someone who can create the playbook, build the team, solve problems along the way, and scale what they build.

 **What Success Looks Like:*** Success in this role means building an AI organization that is technically strong, commercially relevant, reliable in delivery, scalable in structure, and capable of continuously developing new AI products and services.
* If you've built something from zero and are ready to build something significantly bigger, we'd like to hear from you.

2d300ff7.description:
We are looking for experienced SAP Project/Program Manager.
 



  





 Job Description:
 



  





 1\. Project management: Planning, organizing, and managing all aspects of SAP projects, including scope, timelines, resources, and budget.  4\. Client relationship management: Building and maintaining strong relationships with clients, understanding their requirements and expectations, and ensuring that projects meet their needs.  5\. Quality assurance: Ensuring that SAP projects meet high\-quality standards. This includes conducting regular quality checks, reviewing deliverables, and ensuring that best practices and standards are followed throughout the project lifecycle.
 



 6\. Risk management: Identifying and managing project risks and issues. This includes proactively identifying potential risks, developing risk mitigation strategies, and taking necessary actions to resolve issues and maintain project progress.
 



 7\. Continuous improvement: Identifying opportunities for process improvements and implementing best practices to enhance efficiency, quality, and client satisfaction. This involves staying up to date with the latest SAP trends and technologies and recommending innovative solutions to clients.

b42580b2.title: Solutions Engineer II
b42580b2.description:
**About Hologram**
 Hologram is building the future of IoT connectivity, delivering internet access to millions of connected devices worldwide. We process over 5 billion transactions per month across our global infrastructure, this isn't just another app, it's the invisible backbone powering everything from fleet tracking to smart city infrastructure. We tackle challenges of scale, reliability, and performance that few companies face.
   

  

**What Makes a Hologrammer?**
 We look for people with insatiable curiosity and an uncompromising commitment to excellence. Hologrammers are the type who dig deeper when things break, ask 'why' before 'how,' and aren't satisfied until the solution is bulletproof.
   

  

**You'll Love Working Here If You**
**Value tenacious ownership of outcomes:** 
 You don't just resolve tickets, you immerse yourself in the customer's use case, identify root causes, and follow through until their IoT devices are online and stable in production.
   

  

**Crave genuine technical challenges:** 
 You want the problems that keep production IoT deployments online: diagnosing connectivity issues across networks, devices, and protocols, then building the tooling so nobody has to diagnose that one by hand again.
   

  

**Relentlessly pursue growth:** 
 IoT technology evolves rapidly, and so do we. You take on new challenges, quickly master emerging protocols and configurations, and share what you learn to elevate customers and teammates.
   

  

**Solutions Engineer II**
**About This Role**
 The Solutions Engineering team owns the customer relationship after the sale, from first deployment through every connectivity issue that follows. This role covers onboarding, troubleshooting across SIM, device, and network issues, hands\-on L2 escalation work, and building the automation and internal tooling the team runs on. It's the first technical relationship a new customer has with Hologram, and the one that keeps their deployment live.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own customer onboarding end to end, from SIM provisioning and device configuration through to a deployment that is live and stable in production
* Diagnose and resolve SIM, device, and network\-level connectivity issues across the full deployment lifecycle, including L2 escalations, partnering with engineering on anything systemic
* Lead the team's automation work: find the manual work worth removing, then build it away
* Improve and automate the technical onboarding process, from SIM order intake through provisioning and connectivity setup, as new customers come through it
* Automate account\-health monitoring and alerting for Account Management team
* Maintain and expand internal tooling, including AI\-driven support tooling, along with the internal and external documentation behind it
* Advocate for customers internally, surfacing product gaps and technical pain points to product and engineering
* Write the runbooks and hand the work off, so any Solutions Engineer can pick up a build ticket and finish it
* Extend automation across the rest of the post\-sale path: SIM order intake, billing configuration and reconciliation, and renewal admin, partnering with Revenue Operations and the account team


**Requirements**
* 5\+ years in a customer\-facing technical role (e.g., Solutions Engineer, Technical Support Engineer, or Technical Consultant), including ownership of customer onboarding through to production
* Solid understanding of cellular networks, IoT devices, various Radio Access Technologies (RATs), and communication protocols (e.g., TCP/IP, UDP, MQTT)
* Experience working with scripting languages (e.g., Python or Ruby), SQL, and REST APIs
* A track record of building automations or integrations against real operational workflows, not just using them
* Experience applying AI tooling to real support, onboarding, or operational workflows
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics to non\-technical audiences
* Proven ability to quickly learn and adapt to new technologies and technical concepts
* Comfortable working independently across a wide range of technical problems, and defining your own approach on work that has no established process yet
* Familiarity with Salesforce or a comparable CRM, and how record hygiene affects downstream reporting (nice\-to\-have)


**You Might Be a Great Fit If You…**
* Enjoy solving complex, technical problems that directly impact customer success
* Have a curious, self\-driven mindset and aren't afraid to dig into logs, APIs, or device configurations
* Thrive in customer conversations and can translate technical detail into clear, actionable guidance
* Are comfortable working across teams, from support and sales to product and engineering
* Enjoy taking a manual process and turning it into something clean, automated, and built to last


*Target Salary Range* 
*:* 
 $135,000 \- $150,000 \+ New Hire Equity grant (RSUs)
   

  

**How We Work At Hologram**
 Hologram is a fun, upbeat, and remote\-first team united by our mission to build a more connected future. We trust you to do what’s best for our product, customers, and team members and empower you to make the right calls without heavy bureaucracy.
   

  

**Benefits And Perks**
**Competitive compensation:** 
 All employees receive equity with transparent salary and equity formulas across the team
   

  

**Health \& time off:** 
 Flexible health coverage (up to 100% employee, 95% dependents), unlimited PTO with 2 weeks mandatory, monthly mental health days, and 14 weeks paid parental leave
   

  

**Remote work support:** 
 $1,000 hiring bonus plus $250/month taxable Work\-From\-Home stipend
   

  

**Financial security:** 
 Life and disability insurance fully covered, 401(k) plan, and Professional Development Fund after one year
   

  

 We pride ourselves on celebrating everyone; Hologram is an equal opportunity employer actively working on creating a diverse and inclusive work environment where underrepresented groups can thrive.
   

  

**What To Expect In The Interview Process**
* Intro call (15 min)
* Take\-Home Technical Assessment (45\-60 min)
* Peer Technical Interview (50 min)
* Cross\-Team Interview (30 min)
* Hiring Manager Interview (50 min)
* Leadership Interview (30 min)


**Ready to apply?**
 If you share our values and our passion for connecting the world, we’d love to review your application! For any needed accommodations during the hiring process, please email people@hologram.io.
   

  

 Even if you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, please still consider applying. Studies show that you can still be considered for a role if you meet just 50% of the role’s requirements.

**Eaton’s EITC division is currently seeking a Program and Delivery Manager \- AI and Data Delivery.**

**What you’ll do:**
-------------------

This position leads the delivery of data and artificial intelligence products for the HR, Legal and Corporate Development functions. The role owns the portfolio from demand intake through design, build, deployment and adoption, and is accountable for the scope, schedule, cost and quality of every initiative within it. It is a new role, created to give these functions a dedicated delivery leader as the demand for data and AI capability continues to grow.  



  

The leader manages the HR, Legal and Corporate Development delivery team and acts as the primary point of contact for functional leadership. Working closely with the System Architect, Enterprise Architecture and Cyber Security, the role ensures that solutions handling sensitive employee and legal information meet Eaton architecture, privacy and security standards. The position also serves as secondary owner of the AI Navigator idea\-to\-disposition process for ideas raised by these functions.  



  

* Lead end\-to\-end data and artificial intelligence delivery for the HR, Legal and Corporate Development functions, covering demand intake, prioritization, execution, deployment and value realization.
* Own the delivery roadmap and release plan for every product in the portfolio, and hold delivery teams accountable to committed scope, schedule, cost and quality.

* Act as secondary owner for AI Navigator idea\-to\-disposition for ideas originating in HR, Legal and Corporate Development, ensuring each idea is assessed, dispositioned and tracked to closure.
* Build and manage the financial plan for the portfolio, including annual budget, project and run forecasting, platform consumption, contractor cost control and variance reporting.
* Partner with the System Architect, Enterprise Architecture and Cyber Security so that solutions comply with architecture guardrails, data privacy obligations and information security standards applicable to employee and legal data.
* Establish and operate delivery governance, covering status reporting, risk and issue management, dependency management, change control and steering reviews.
* Drive adoption of Agile delivery practices and improve predictability, cycle time and quality through objective delivery metrics.
* Manage supplier and partner relationships, including statements of work, resource onboarding and performance against agreed service levels.
* Champion organizational change management and user adoption for AI products, and ensure realised benefits are measured and communicated to stakeholders.

-------------------

* Bachelor degree in a technical discipline such as B.E. / B.Tech / MCA, or B.S. in Computer Science, Mathematics or Engineering. A master degree or MBA is preferred.
* 14 or more years of relevant industry experience in information technology delivery.
* 8 or more years leading program or project delivery for data, analytics or application products in a global organization.
* 4 or more years of direct people leadership of engineering teams that include employees and contract resources.
**Skills:**
-----------

* Project or program management certification such as PMP, PgMP, Scrum Master or SAFe is preferred.
* Experience delivering technology for HR, Legal or Corporate Development functions, including work with confidential employee or legal data, is preferred.
* Working knowledge of data engineering and analytics platforms, including data pipelines, data warehousing and reporting on Microsoft Azure.
* Practical understanding of artificial intelligence and generative AI solution patterns, including large language models, retrieval augmented generation, prompt design and accuracy evaluation.
* Strong command of program and portfolio management disciplines covering scope, schedule, cost, risk, quality and benefits management.
* Experience running Agile delivery at scale using Scrum, Kanban or SAFe, with hands\-on use of Azure DevOps or equivalent tooling.

* Financial management capability covering budgeting, forecasting, vendor contracting and cost control.
* Executive communication and stakeholder management, with the ability to translate technical work into business outcomes.
* Ability to lead through influence across a matrixed, global organization and across time zones.
* Proven capability in coaching, developing talent and building inclusive, high\-performing teams.
* Structured problem solving and sound decision making in conditions of ambiguity.
* Customer focus, solution orientation and a strong drive for results.
