9972d37c.title: EOP Global Solution Architect
9972d37c.description:
**Job Description**
**Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?**
**Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Matter.**
 You will be a key technical leader within the Mondelēz International Digital \& Technology organization, responsible for designing, securing, and integrating the o9 Enterprise Operations Planning (EOP) platform across our global supply chain. You will drive architectural excellence and ensure seamless integration between o9, SAP, and non\-SAP applications to enable world\-class planning capabilities across NALA, MEU, and AMEA regions.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute**
 You will serve as the Solution Architect for the o9 EOP platform, owning the end\-to\-end technical architecture, security framework, and integration landscape. You will work closely with business stakeholders, platform vendors, and internal technology teams to ensure that the o9 platform delivers scalable, secure, and high\-performing planning solutions. Specifically, you will:
   

  

* Design and govern the overall o9 EOP solution architecture, ensuring alignment with Mondelēz enterprise architecture standards and global technology strategy.
* Lead the architecture and implementation of integrations between o9 and SAP (S/4HANA, ECC), as well as non\-SAP applications including Trade Promotion Management (TPM) and SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC).
* Define and enforce security architecture standards for the o9 platform, including data governance, access controls, role\-based security, and compliance with MDLZ information security policies.
* Evaluate and recommend o9 hosting environment options (self\-hosted vs. o9\-managed cloud) for NALA, MEU, and AMEA regions, assessing trade\-offs in performance, cost, security, and scalability.
* Collaborate with the o9 product team and internal DevOps teams to optimize platform performance, minimize application downtime, and improve batch/FTB job scheduling strategies.
* Provide technical leadership during solution design reviews, architecture governance, and key project milestones including Go\-Live readiness.
* Develop and maintain architecture blueprints, integration specifications, and technical documentation to support ongoing operations and future wave rollouts.
* Partner with cross\-functional teams — including Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Finance, and IT — to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions.
* Identify and mitigate technical risks across the integration landscape and drive resolution of complex platform issues.
* Stay current with o9 platform innovations, including Agentic AI capabilities, and assess applicability to MDLZ planning processes.


**What You Will Bring**
 A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career. You will bring experience and knowledge in:
   

  

* Solution architecture design for enterprise planning platforms, preferably o9 Solutions, SAP IBP, or equivalent supply chain planning tools.
* Deep expertise in SAP integration architecture — including SAP S/4HANA, ECC, BW/4HANA — and non\-SAP application integration such as TPM and SAC.
* Designing and implementing API\-based, event\-driven, and middleware integrations (e.g., MuleSoft, Dell Boomi, Azure Integration Services, or similar).
* Security architecture principles including identity and access management (IAM), data encryption, network security, and cloud security frameworks.
* Cloud infrastructure platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and experience evaluating hosting models for enterprise SaaS platforms.
* Supply chain planning domains including Demand Planning, Supply Planning, S\&OP, and financial integration.
* Communicating complex technical concepts effectively to both technical teams and senior business stakeholders.
* Working in large\-scale, global, matrixed organizations with multiple regional teams and vendors.
* Agile and DevSecOps ways of working within enterprise program delivery.


**More About This Role**
 What you need to know about this position:
   

  

* This role supports the o9 Wave 1 – Demand program and subsequent wave rollouts across NALA, MEU, and AMEA regions.
* The Solution Architect will be accountable for the technical integrity of the o9 EOP platform, including all integration touchpoints with SAP and non\-SAP systems.
* Close collaboration with the o9 vendor team, SAP CoE, and MDLZ enterprise architecture teams is essential.
* The role sits within the Digital \& Technology function and reports into the o9 Program Leadership.


 What extra ingredients you will bring:
   

  

* Hands\-on experience with o9 Solutions platform configuration, data models, and APIs is a strong advantage.
* Knowledge of Agentic AI, machine learning, or advanced analytics capabilities within enterprise planning platforms.
* Experience with Trade Promotion Management (TPM) systems and their integration into planning workflows.
* Familiarity with MDLZ or FMCG/CPG supply chain processes is highly desirable.


**Education / Certifications:**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical engineering discipline. Engineering background strongly preferred.
* Professional certifications in Solution Architecture (e.g., TOGAF, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert) are highly desirable.
* SAP certifications (e.g., SAP Certified Technology Associate – SAP Integration Suite) are a plus.
* o9 platform certifications or formal training, where available, are an advantage.


**Job specific requirements:**
* Minimum 8–10 years of experience in IT/technology roles, with at least 5 years in a solution architecture capacity.
* Proven track record delivering enterprise platform implementations with complex integration landscapes.
* Experience working in global CPG, FMCG, or manufacturing organizations preferred.


**Travel requirements:**
* Occasional travel may be required to support regional deployments across NALA, MEU, and AMEA.


**Work schedule:**
* Full\-time. Flexible working arrangements available in line with MDLZ policy. Must be able to accommodate cross\-regional time zones as needed


 No Relocation support available
   

  

**Business Unit Summary**
 Headquartered in Singapore, Mondelēz International’s Asia, Middle East and Africa (AMEA) region is comprised of six business units, has more than 21,000 employees and operates in more than 27 countries including Australia, China, Indonesia, Ghana, India, Japan, Malaysia, New Zealand, Nigeria, Philippines, Saudi Arabia, South Africa, Thailand, United Arab Emirates and Vietnam. Seventy\-six nationalities work across a network of more than 35 manufacturing plants, three global research and development technical centers and in offices stretching from Auckland, New Zealand to Casablanca, Morocco. Mondelēz International in the AMEA region is the proud maker of global and local iconic brands such as
 *Oreo* 
 and

 biscuits,

 and

 chocolate,

 candy,

 gum,

 powdered beverage and
 *Philadelphia* 
 cheese. We are also proud to be named a Top Employer in many of our markets.
   

  

 Mondelēz International is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

1cffd65b.title: Solutions Architect - Business Systems Engineering
1cffd65b.description:
Searce's process\-first transformation practitioner \& AI solutions builder — futurifying enterprise operations from the ground up.
 



  





**We identify better ways of doing things.** 




**Solver? Absolutely. But not the usual kind.** 




 We're searching for the architects of the audacious \& the pioneers of the possible. If you're the type to dismantle assumptions, re\-engineer ‘best practices,’ and build solutions that make the future possible NOW, then you're speaking our language.
 


* Improver. Solver. Futurist.
* Great sense of humor.
* ‘Possible. It is.’ Mindset.
* Compassionate collaborator. Bold experimenter. Tireless iterator.
* Natural creativity that doesn’t just challenge the norm, but solves to design what’s better.
* Thinks in systems. Solves at scale.



**This Isn’t for Everyone.** 
 But if you’re the kind who questions
 *why* 
 things are done a certain way—and then identifies 3 better ways to do it — we’d love to chat with you.
 



  





**Your Mission: The Role** 




 solving for better.
 



 As a Senior Architect in Business Systems Engineering, you aren’t here to ‘implement AI.’ You are here to
 **futurify** 
 how businesses actually work — from the inside out. You will
 **hands\-on diagnose, redesign, and deploy AI\-powered process solutions** 
 , working alongside clients to deliver transformation that actually sticks.
 



 This is a chance to
 **stop “experimenting”** 
 and
 **start “solving.”** 
 You sit at the convergence of
 **AI Solution Building** 
 and
 **Business Process Re\-engineering.** 
 Your mission: deconstruct chaotic domain processes (in Supply Chain, Logistics, Freight Forwarding, 3PLs, Warehousing, Transportation and Manufacturing) and reconstruct them as intelligent, autonomous, production\-hardened workflows.
 



**This Seat is for You If...** 



* You are a
 **"Process\-First" Builder:** 
 You believe an AI model is worthless if it doesn’t fundamentally improve the underlying business metric. You diagnose the process, then you build the fix.
* You are
 **Hands\-On by Nature:** 
 You don’t just design solutions — you build them. You can go from process map to working prototype in the same week.
* You
 **bridge Workshops and Working Code:** 
 You can run a process discovery session with a client’s ops team in the morning and review an API integration with engineers in the afternoon.
* You
 **Value Impact Over Hype:** 
 Solving a logistics bottleneck, a customs dispute, or a billing reconciliation failure matters more to you than any experimental POC.
* You are a
 **Real Improver:** 
 You don’t settle for done. Iteration is your personality. Under\-promise, over\-deliver — always.



  





**Your Responsibilities** 




 what you will wake up to solve.
 



**1\. Business Transformation Consulting** 



* Turn client operational chaos into clear, prioritized modernization roadmaps — as a trusted AI advisor to business and IT stakeholders.
* Run workshops and process mapping sessions that move decisions. Drive adoption, not just deployment.



**2\. AI\-Powered Process Architecture \& Build** 



* Diagnose and re\-engineer complex processes using first\-principles — then design AND build the AI solution around it.
* Integrate AI into enterprise systems (ERP, CRM, TMS, BPM) in production\-hardened architectures, not decks.



**3\. The 'Agentic' Shift** 



* Build Agentic AI systems where agents plan, reason, and execute inside real enterprise processes — procurement, reconciliation, triage, scheduling.



**4\. Delivery \& Client Advocacy** 



* Own your workstreams end\-to\-end — scope, timelines, quality, client communication. Accountable, not just contributing.
* Bridge business and tech fluently, close the feedback loop, and enable client adoption post\-deployment.



**5\. Collaborative Building \& Growth** 



* Be the dot\-connector in modernization squads — alongside architects, analysts, and engineers.
* Grow fast, own early, mentor when you can. Ship things. Build a reputation for it.



  





**Functional Skills** 




**1\. Delivery Excellence \& Client Impact** 



* **Process \& AI Solutioning:** 
 Operates at the intersection of business process re\-engineering and AI solution design — diagnosing problems first, then building the intelligence around them.
* **Client Engagement:** 
 Builds trusted working relationships with client stakeholders. Translates their operational pain into actionable technology solutions.
* **Delivery Ownership:** 
 Owns workstream delivery — scope, quality, timelines, and client communication. Not just contributing, but accountable.
* **Structured Problem\-Solving:** 
 Breaks chaotic, cross\-domain challenges into solvable chunks using first\-principles thinking — then builds the AI solution around it.
* **Feedback Loop Mastery:** 
 Gathers, synthesizes, and acts on end\-user feedback to iteratively improve deployed solutions.



**2\. Technical Execution Charter** 



* **Hands\-On AI Building:** 
 Designs and builds production\-grade AI solutions: LLM integrations, agentic workflows, RAG pipelines, and intelligent automation — with working code, not just diagrams.
* **Cloud\-Native Fluency:** 
 Functional knowledge of modern AI system design (RAG Frameworks, Agentic Workflows, Inference Optimization) across GCP and AWS.
* **BPM \& Enterprise Systems:** 
 Working knowledge of BPM methodologies (BPMN, value stream analysis, workflow automation) and enterprise platforms (ERP, CRM, TMS, Pega, Appian, ServiceNow).
* **Integration \& Configuration:** 
 Integrates, configures, and tests multiple enterprise systems — ensuring seamless interoperability and real\-world performance.
* **Quality \& Governance:** 
 Adheres to technical quality standards: model validation, testing coverage, and ethical AI governance — non\-negotiable in production.



  





**Tech Superpowers** 



* **Hands\-On AI Solution Building:** 
 Strong practical expertise in building AI solutions: LLM integrations, Agentic AI frameworks, RAG pipelines, and workflow automation. You ship things, not just design them.
* **Process\-to\-Architecture Translation:** 
 Translates messy business process requirements into clean, deployable AI system designs — always grounded in what will actually work in production.
* **Cloud\-Native AI Fluency:** 
 Proficient in GCP (Vertex AI, BigQuery ML) and/or AWS AI/ML ecosystems. You build and deploy AI solutions in the cloud, not just consume cloud services.
* **Software \& Engineering Foundation:** 
 Solid software engineering background — you've built real systems. Can review code, debug integrations, and validate technical decisions at the solution level.
* **BPM Tooling \& Low\-Code Fluency:** 
 Hands\-on experience with BPM platforms and Low\-Code/No\-Code tools (Power Platform or similar) for rapid process automation alongside AI integrations.



  





**Experience \& Relevance** 



* **A hands\-on AI solution builder \& process transformation practitioner with 5–12 years of experience** 
 — spanning technology delivery, AI solution design, and business process re\-engineering.
* **Leadership Track Record:** 
 Proven track record of delivering end\-to\-end AI and process modernization solutions — from discovery workshops to production deployment. Not just advisory; you’ve built things that run in production.
* **Applied AI Experience:** 
 Hands\-on experience building and deploying AI\-powered workflows, agentic systems, intelligent automation, or LLM integrations in real client environments.
* **BPM \& Domain Knowledge:** 
 Working knowledge of process re\-engineering methodologies and at least one process\-heavy industry: Supply Chain, Logistics, Freight Forwarding, 3PLs, Warehousing, Transportation, or Manufacturing.
* **Client\-Facing Experience:** 
 Experience working directly with business stakeholders — running workshops, presenting solutions, and owning delivery outcomes in client\-facing roles.



  





**Bonus Points (you will thrive if you have)** 



* **Founder’s Energy:** 
 Bias for action, thrive in ambiguity, relentless focus on outcomes. You’ve built something from zero.
* **Low\-Code/No\-Code Fluency:** 
 Experience with AI integrations via Power Platform or similar for rapid process automation.
* **AI Copilots \& Agentic Builders:** 
 Built plugins, copilots, or agentic automation frameworks — in production, not just POCs.
* **Thought Leadership DNA:** 
 Industry content creation, technical blogs, conference talks, or public contributions to AI/BPM discourse.
* **Ethical Compass:** 
 Strong commitment to responsible AI — governance, fairness, and transparency built into design from day one.
* **Engineer at Heart:** 
 Background in product development or engineering before moving into consulting. That builder credibility shows.
* **Domain Depth:** 
 Vertical expertise in Supply Chain, Logistics, BFSI, Healthcare, or Manufacturing — process\-heavy industries where transformation actually matters.



  





**Join the ‘real solvers’** 




 ready to futurify?
 



 If you are excited by the possibilities of what an AI\-native engineering\-led, modern tech consultancy can do to futurify businesses,
 **apply here** 
 and experience the ‘Art of the possible’.
 **Don’t Just Send a Resume. Send a Statement.**

+ Bridge platform engineering with business strategy by translating complex infrastructure capabilities into scalable business outcomes and delivery roadmaps.

+ Lead automation of AI infrastructure provisioning using Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates and CloudFormation.

+ Lead the setup and scaling of MLOps and LLMOps capabilities including experiment tracking, model versioning, model registry, artifact management, pipeline orchestration and deployment governance.

* Asset and Accelerator Development

+ Package technical accelerators as EY market offerings for rapid client deployment across industries and cloud ecosystems.

7f8e1ee9.title: Technical Delivery Lead
7f8e1ee9.description:
**Entity**
 Technology
   

  

**Job Family Group**
 IT\&S Group
   

  

**Job Description**
**Technical Delivery Lead – Corporate Affairs Digital Platforms**
**Role Profile / Job Description**
 Role Purpose
   

  

 The Technical Delivery Lead is responsible for leading the technical delivery of digital platform changes, product enhancements and operational improvements across Corporate Affairs digital platforms and services. The role acts as the bridge between delivery, product, architecture, engineering, operations and business stakeholders, ensuring technical solutions are clearly defined, prioritised, delivered, tested and transitioned into support effectively.
   

  

 The role combines hands\-on technical delivery leadership with selected Product Owner responsibilities, including backlog refinement, requirements definition, sprint planning support, acceptance criteria, prioritisation and value realisation. This ensures delivery teams focus on the right outcomes and that solutions are secure, resilient, scalable, supportable and aligned to business needs.
   

  

 Scope \& Scale
   

  

**Area**
**Scope**
**Platform focus**
 Supports one or more Corporate Affairs digital platforms, products or services, such as Brand Portal, global web, campaign, content, analytics or operational support capabilities.
   

  

**Technical delivery**
 Leads technical delivery across releases, enhancements, integrations, operational improvements and service transition activities.
   

  

**Product ownership**
 Owns or supports backlog management, story refinement, prioritisation, acceptance criteria and value\-based delivery decisions.
   

  

**Team coordination**
 Coordinates engineering, architecture, QA, security, privacy, operations, supplier and business teams to deliver agreed outcomes.
   

  

**Operational readiness**
 Ensures solutions are production\-ready, supportable and aligned to non\-functional requirements, governance and operating model expectations.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Technical Delivery Leadership
   

  

* Lead technical delivery of platform changes, product enhancements, integrations and operational improvements.
* Coordinate developers, architects, QA, infrastructure, security, privacy, analytics, support teams and suppliers.
* Ensure technical work are clearly defined, sequenced, estimated, delivered, tested and released.
* Identify and manage technical dependencies, risks, blockers, assumptions and decisions.
* Support release planning, deployment readiness, service transition and post\-launch stabilisation.
* Ensure solutions align to architecture, security, privacy, accessibility and operational standards.


 Product Ownership \& Backlog Management
   

  

* Define, refine and maintain the technical backlog in partnership with Product Managers, Delivery Managers and business partners.
* Translate business outcomes into clear epics, features, user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Prioritise backlog items based on business value, technical risk, compliance needs, dependencies and delivery capacity.
* Support sprint planning, backlog refinement, retrospectives, demos and delivery reviews.
* Review and accept completed technical work against agreed acceptance criteria.
* Ensure delivered features provide measurable value and align to platform standards and user needs.


 Requirements, Analysis \& Solution Definition
   

  

* Work with business, product and technical stakeholders to clarify requirements and desired outcomes.
* Break down complex technical and business needs into structured, testable delivery items.
* Surface assumptions, constraints, risks and dependencies before development begins.
* Support discovery, solution options, impact assessments and technical feasibility reviews.
* Maintain clear user documentation, decision logs and delivery artefacts.


 Platform Readiness \& Operational Support
   

  

* Ensure platforms and services are technically ready for production use and BAU support.
* Coordinate non\-functional requirements across performance, resilience, security, monitoring, observability, accessibility and supportability.
* Support operating models, support processes, knowledge articles, runbooks and handover documentation.
* Work with support teams to ensure incidents, problems, service requests and enhancements are handled optimally.
* Drive technical improvements that reduce operational risk, improve service quality and increase automation.


 Customer \& Supplier Coordination
   

  

* Act as the technical delivery point of contact for assigned platforms, products or workstreams.
* Coordinate internal teams, supplier resources and third\-party vendors to maintain delivery momentum.
* Communicate progress, risks, issues and decisions clearly to Delivery Managers, Product Managers and customers.
* Facilitate technical discussions, unblock delivery issues and advance material risks where required.
* Help ensure supplier delivery meets agreed quality, governance and operational expectations.


 Leadership Expectations
   

  

* Provide hands\-on technical delivery leadership across multidisciplinary teams.
* Bring structure, clarity and accountability to technical delivery activities.
* Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Delivery Managers, Architects, Engineers and Support teams.
* Balance business value, technical quality, delivery pace and operational resilience.
* Promote strong engineering rigor, agile ways of working and continuous improvement.


**Skills \& Experience**
* Experience leading technical delivery across digital platforms, CMS, web, content, brand, campaign or enterprise technology services.
* Solid understanding of Agile delivery, backlog management, sprint planning, release management and service transition.
* Ability to translate business needs into clear technical requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Experience coordinating developers, architects, QA, infrastructure, security, privacy, operations and supplier teams.
* Good understanding of non\-functional requirements, including performance, resilience, availability, accessibility, monitoring and supportability.
* Experience with third\-party suppliers, handled service teams and enterprise governance standards.
* Desirable experience with Contentful, MACH architecture, headless CMS, Azure DevOps, automation, analytics or AI\-enabled platform capabilities.


 Success Measures
   

  

* Delivery of agreed technical roadmap items, releases and enhancements to expected scope, quality and timeline.
* Clear, prioritised and well\-maintained backlog with strong user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Effective sprint planning, refinement, dependency management and technical delivery coordination.
* Secure, resilient, supportable and production\-ready technical solutions.
* Reduced technical risk, improved operational performance and stronger support readiness.
* Strong customer confidence in technical delivery quality, transparency and decision\-making.
* Successful transition of new capabilities into BAU support with clear documentation, ownership and operating model readiness.


**About Bp**
 Our purpose is to deliver energy to the world, today and tomorrow. For over 100 years, bp has focused on discovering, developing, and producing oil and gas in the nations where we operate. We are one of the few companies globally that can provide governments and customers with an integrated energy offering. Delivering our strategy sustainably is fundamental to achieving our ambition to be a net zero company by 2050 or sooner!

 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
   

  

 Even though the job is advertised as full time, please contact the hiring manager or the recruiter as flexible working arrangements may be considered.
   

  

 What you can expect from us!

 At bp, you could be part of Business Resource Groups (BRGs) which belief in the power of inclusion, deeper connections, and shared experiences. They provide a place for employees to learn and share knowledge, to connect, and to improve. DROIDAL.AI 
 



 Agentic AI for Healthcare Revenue Cycle Management 
 



  





 Delivery Manager \- RCM AI 
 



 Where Deep RCM Expertise Meets Agentic Transformation 
 



 Location: Chennai or Coimbatore    
 



 Experience: 12\+ years    
 



 Function: Delivery \& Client Transformation 
 



  





 About the Role 
 



 You understand revenue cycle the way few people do. You have lived the daily reality of eligibility checks 
 



 that stall, prior authorizations that pile up, claims that deny for reasons that should not exist, and accounts 
 



 receivable that ages while teams scramble. You have led the people who fight those battles — and you 
 



 have likely wondered why so much of this work still depends on humans performing the same repetitive 
 



 tasks again and again. 
 



 At Droidal.ai, we asked the same question, and we built the answer: AI agents that take on revenue cycle 
 



 workflows end to end and actually perform the work. We are now looking for someone who has been in 
 



 the trenches of healthcare RCM to lead how we deliver that transformation to our provider clients. 
 



 This is a Delivery Manager role \- but it is best understood as the bridge between hard\-won RCM domain 
 



 expertise and the future of how revenue cycle work gets done. You will be the person providers trust to 
 



 understand their operations deeply and to deliver agentic transformation that measurably improves their 
 



 financial outcomes. 
 



 Why This Role Is Different 
 



 Most delivery roles manage tickets and timelines. This one calls for something rarer: a leader who can sit 
 



 across from a provider’s Vice President of Revenue Cycle, speak their language fluently, diagnose where 
 



 workflows break, and then orchestrate AI agents and delivery teams to fix them. 
 



 If you are a subject\-matter expert or operations leader at a large RCM billing company \- or you run revenue 
 



 cycle operations for a health system \- the proposition is straightforward. You have mastered a domain that 
 



 is about to be transformed, and you can either watch that transformation unfold or lead it. Here, your deep 
 



 knowledge of denials, coding, AR, and payer behavior becomes the engine that makes AI deliver real 
 



 results. 
 



 Key Responsibilities 
 



 • Client Facing \- Serve as the trusted delivery partner for provider clients, understanding their revenue 
 



 cycle operations deeply and keeping client satisfaction consistently high while ensuring measurable 
 



 financial impact. 
 



 • Delivery Management and Lead agentic transformation. Take ownership of how Droidal’s AI agents 
 



 are deployed across client RCM workflows \- translating operational challenges into automation that 
 



 delivers results. 
 



 • Provide RCM expertise. Bring subject\-matter authority across the end\-to\-end revenue cycle: front
 



 end (eligibility, prior authorization, registration), mid\-cycle (coding, charge capture, clinical 
 



 documentation integrity), and back\-end (claims, denials, AR follow\-up, payment posting). 
 



 • Manage and grow people. Build, mentor, and motivate delivery teams, leading with clarity and care 
 



 to make transformation real for clients. 
 



 • Partner across the business. Work with product and engineering to channel client needs into how 
 



 our agents evolve, and with client partners to ensure delivery consistently exceeds expectations. 
 



 • Apply a consulting mindset. Diagnose before prescribing, and frame every engagement in the metrics 
 



 providers care about \- clean claim rate, denial rate, days in AR, and cost to collect. 
 



 What You Bring 
 



 • 10\+ years in healthcare revenue cycle management, with deep, hands\-on expertise across the end\-to
 



 end cycle. 
 



 • Proven experience as a Delivery Manager, RCM operations lead, or subject\-matter expert at an RCM 
 



 billing company, BPO, or healthcare provider. 
 



 • Strong command of front\-end, mid\-cycle, and back\-end RCM workflows, payer dynamics, and the 
 



 metrics that define success \- clean claim rate, denial rate, days in AR, and cost to collect. 
 



 • Demonstrated people\-management experience building, leading, and mentoring operational delivery 
 



 teams. 
 



 • A consulting mindset: you diagnose root causes, design solutions, and communicate in outcomes. 
 



 • The ability to engage credibly with provider executives, including VP of Revenue Cycle, CFO, and 
 



 operations leadership. 
 



 • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and client\-relationship skills. 
 



 • Familiarity with, or strong curiosity about, AI, automation, and their impact on healthcare operations. 
 



 • A bachelor’s degree is required; relevant RCM certifications such as CRCR, RHIA, or CPC are a strong 
 



 advantage. 
 



 • Willingness to be based in Chennai or Coimbatore, with client interaction as required. 
 



 What Makes You Stand Out 
 



 You have owned the metrics that keep a revenue cycle leader up at night, and you have moved them in the 
 



 right direction. You have sat with a frustrated provider client and left them confident. You think in root 
 



 causes rather than symptoms. And somewhere in you there is a builder who would rather shape the future 
 



 of revenue cycle than continue managing its present. 
 



 Why Droidal.ai 
 



 We sit at the frontier of agentic AI for healthcare \- deploying agents that providers are using to transform 
 



 revenue cycle operations and see real, measurable results today. You will join early enough to influence 
 



 how we deliver, with the autonomy to run your clients and teams as if they were your own business. This is 
 



 not a delivery seat to fill; it is an opportunity to help redefine how revenue cycle work gets done. 
 



 Ready to turn your RCM expertise into the future of healthcare operations? 
 



 Apply now or reach out directly. We would be glad to meet the person who has been waiting for exactly 
 



 this role. 
 



 Droidal.ai is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds.

89966717.title: Risk Consulting-Digital Risk-Manager-Cloud
89966717.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Job description \-** 
**Manager – Cloud (Risk Consulting – Digital Risk)**
**Requisition ID \- TBC**
 EY focuses on high\-ethical standards and integrity among its employees and expects all candidates to demonstrate these qualities. At EY GDS, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with global scale, support, inclusive culture, and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY GDS become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 The objective of our Risk Consulting services is to provide clients with a candid and reliable overview of their risk landscape. Our solutions enable clients to build confidence and trust with customers, regulators, and the broader market.
   

  

 Within Cloud Risk and Security, this role focuses on leading engagements that assess, test, and validate cloud security and risk controls across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform environments. The role involves working closely with IT, cloud engineering, security teams, and business stakeholders to ensure that cloud environments are secure, resilient, and aligned with business objectives and regulatory requirements.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Operate as a fieldwork leader, assisting clients in identifying, assessing, and monitoring cloud\-related security and technology risks.
* Lead and execute cloud security and risk assessments, including control design and operating effectiveness testing across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
* Collaborate with engagement teams to plan engagements, develop work programs, timelines, risk assessments, and testing procedures.
* Serve as a fieldwork leader by directing daily testing activities, tracking engagement progress, and managing staff performance.
* Perform cloud architecture and configuration reviews covering landing zones, identity models, network segmentation, encryption and key management, logging and monitoring, and backup and disaster recovery.
* Assess cloud governance and security controls aligned to shared responsibility models and industry frameworks.
* Prepare high\-quality deliverables, reports, and recommendations aligned with US work product quality standards.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong fundamentals across cloud risk and cloud security, with hands\-on experience across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform.
* Strong audit mindset with the ability to design, execute, and evidence control testing across cloud environments.
* Proven experience leading cloud security audits, risk assessments, architecture reviews, and maturity assessments.
* Practical experience assessing controls related to identity and access management, network security, encryption and KMS, logging and monitoring/SIEM, backup and disaster recovery, and data protection.
* Experience with containerized and cloud\-native environments, including Kubernetes, serverless, and workload security.
* Proven ability to lead multi\-location teams, manage delivery risks, and deliver high\-quality outcomes within agreed timelines and budgets.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English (non\-negotiable).
* Ability to manage time effectively and work in US time zones, as per project needs.
* Exposure to cyber\-related risk or security activities is an added advantage.


**Behavioral Skills**
* Demonstrates adaptability and agility, with a strong commitment to continuous learning across cloud platforms and emerging technologies.
* Exhibits end\-to\-end engagement leadership, delivering cloud security audits and risk assessments across complex environments.
* Brings an innovation\-oriented mindset, leveraging automation and analytics to enhance control testing efficiency and continuous monitoring.
* Actively contributes to practice\-building initiatives, including development of accelerators, tools, and reusable assets.
* Proven ability to lead, mentor, and guide teams to deliver high\-quality outcomes.
* Communicates effectively and manages stakeholder expectations across technical and business audiences.


**To qualify for the role, you must have.**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with 7–12 years of total experience, including 3–5 years in cloud security or cloud risk roles.
* Cloud security certifications such as CCSP or CCSK, AWS Security Specialty, Azure Security Engineer, or equivalent.
* Demonstrated experience in cloud security audits, risk assessments, architecture reviews, and control testing.
* Experience designing and assessing controls across identity and access management, network security, encryption and KMS, logging and monitoring, backup and disaster recovery, and data protection.
* Familiarity with regulatory frameworks and compliance standards such as ISO 27001, NIST CSF, SOC 2, PCI DSS, and privacy expectations.
* Client\-facing experience working with engineering, security, and risk stakeholders.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Exposure to container security, Kubernetes, Zero Trust concepts, SASE/SSE, CASB, or cloud\-native security tooling is preferred.
* Experience supporting regulated industries or large\-scale cloud transformations or migrations is an added advantage.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

a0232e4e.title: Presales Specialist
a0232e4e.description:
**Company Description** 




  





 SRCHN is building the discovery and engagement layer for Bengaluru’s offline economy.
 



 Bengaluru is filled with cafés, restaurants, breweries, hotels, workspaces, retail destinations, and lifestyle experiences, yet discovering what is actually worth experiencing remains fragmented across maps, social media, search, and word of mouth.
 



 SRCHN brings these experiences together through an interactive Hyper\-Local Map.
 



 Built using Google Maps data, map types, and layers, our map combines location intelligence with video\-first discovery. Instead of simply showing where a business is, SRCHN helps people understand what the place feels like, what it offers, and why they should experience it.
 



 We curate brands and experiences onto the SRCHN Hyper\-Local Map and create a complete content layer around every participating location.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 The Presales Specialist role at SRCHN is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Bengaluru. This role involves partnering with the sales team to understand client needs, preparing tailored product demonstrations, and supporting the development of proposals and presentations. The Presales Specialist will analyze customer requirements, translate them into solution recommendations, and participate in discovery calls, meetings, and workshops. Daily responsibilities include responding to presales queries, coordinating with product and delivery teams, and ensuring that prospects clearly understand the value and capabilities of SRCHN’s offerings. The role also includes gathering feedback from potential clients to refine messaging, support product enhancements, and contribute to improved sales processes.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills to assess client requirements, interpret data, and develop relevant solution recommendations.
* Candidates should possess excellent Communication and Customer Service skills to engage with prospects, explain complex concepts clearly, and build trust throughout the sales cycle.
* Candidates should possess Consulting and Presales skills to conduct discovery sessions, design solution approaches, and support the preparation of proposals and demos.
* Candidates should have proficiency in presentation tools (such as PowerPoint or similar), and the ability to create clear documentation and sales collateral.
* Candidates should demonstrate the ability to collaborate with sales, product, and technical teams, managing multiple opportunities in a structured and organized manner.
* A bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, IT, or a related field is preferred; prior experience in presales, solution consulting, or a customer\-facing technical role is an advantage.
* Familiarity with Retail or E\-Commerce solutions, and comfort working in a fast\-paced, target\-driven environment will be beneficial.

**About The Role**
 We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled Mainframe Infrastructure Architect to join our dynamic team. This pivotal role will be responsible for providing technical leadership and strategic guidance throughout the presales cycle, focusing on mainframe solutions and modernization initiatives. The ideal candidate will possess deep technical knowledge of mainframe environments, coupled with exceptional communication and presentation skills to articulate complex solutions to both technical and non\-technical audiences, including C\-level executives.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Solution Design \& Architecture:
+ Lead the design and definition of overall mainframe infrastructure solutionframeworks for mainframe components within client proposals and bids.
+ Analyze client requirements, existing IT landscapes, and business objectives to architect tailor\-made mainframe solutions, including on\-premise, cloud, and hybrid models.
+ Develop detailed architectural designs, high\-level designs, and associated documentation (e.g., application views, multiple sections \& views, artefacts).
+ Evaluate and recommend solutions to integrate mainframe systems with the broader technology ecosystem.
+ Identify improvements, options, and tradeoffs to define target state solutions.

* Presales \& Client Engagement:
+ Act as the primary technical subject matter expert during the presales phase, supporting the sales team in all technical aspects.
+ Engage directly with clients, including C\-level executives, technical decision\-makers, and business stakeholders, to understand their challenges and demonstrate how our mainframe solutions can address their needs.
+ Develop and deliver compelling technical presentations, demonstrations, and proofs\-of\-concept (POCs).
+ Collaborate with sales, program/project, and consulting teams to ensure proposed solutions align with client expectations and internal capabilities.
+ Participate in the development of RFP/RFS responses, providing technical analysis, cost estimations, and architectural validation.
+ Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective clients.

* Mainframe Modernization \& Innovation:
+ Provide technical and strategic input for mainframe modernization strategies, including re\-hosting, refactoring, re\-platforming, and rewriting initiatives.
+ Guide customers in planning, evaluating, architecting, and re\-engineering legacy applications to leverage modern cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, GCP, etc.).
+ Stay abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies (e.g., AI/ML for modernization), and best practices in mainframe and cloud landscapes.
+ Contribute to the development of white papers, case studies, and thought leadership content related to mainframe solutions and modernization.

* Technical Leadership \& Mentorship:
+ Provide technical leadership to design, development, and implementation teams for custom solutions.
+ Mentor developers, designers, and junior architects, fostering their growth and enhancing their capabilities.
+ Contribute to internal architecture practices by conducting interviews and sharing knowledge.

* Costing \& Risk Management:
+ Develop fully costed solution architectures and provide accurate cost estimates for mainframe solution implementation (such as MFaaS) and ongoing support.
+ Identify implementation risks and potential impacts, proposing mitigation strategies.
+ Validate solutions from a technology, cost structure, and customer differentiation perspective.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Typically 12\+ years of experience in a technology environment, with a strong focus on mainframe infrastructure solutions
* Minimum of 5\+ years of hands\-on technical experience with mainframe systems and technologies such as:

+ Databases: DB2 for z/OS, IMS DB, VSAM, Adabas.
+ Transaction Managers: CICS, IMS TM.

+ Middleware: MQ, WebSphere.
+ Tools: IBM Debug Tool for z/OS, Syncsort, SPUFI, ChangeMan, Endevor, CA\-7/ESP/Control\-M (Job Schedulers).

* Strong expertise in Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentic AI workflows, Prompt Engineering, and AI solution design.
* Experience designing enterprise\-scale AI, data, cloud, and integration architectures.
* Hands\-on experience with Azure AI Services, Azure OpenAI, AWS AI/ML, GCP AI, or equivalent cloud AI ecosystems.
* Strong understanding of MLOps, data pipelines, API integrations, and modern AI application architectures.
* Proven experience supporting RFPs, proposals, technical evaluations, solution estimations, and client presentations.
* Demonstrated ability to build and present executive\-level demos, prototypes, and proof\-of\-concept solutions.
* Excellent communication, presentation, stakeholder management, and technical storytelling skills.
* Experience interacting with senior leadership, executive stakeholders, and business decision\-makers.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to evaluate technical and commercial trade\-offs.
* Ability to create technical content, thought leadership materials, and industry\-focused solution narratives.
* Experience working in cross\-functional and matrixed environments involving sales, consulting, architecture, and delivery teams.
* Exposure to Public Sector, Government, Education, Higher Education, or Non\-Profit domains is preferred.
* Familiarity with Microsoft, ServiceNow, and related enterprise technology ecosystems is highly desirable.
* Demonstrated thought leadership through publications, conference speaking engagements, webinars, or industry contributions is a plus.

 Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.

7d303f89.title: PLA Principal, Enterprise Solutions
7d303f89.description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

 ERP: Finance Focus (FICO)
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Lead ERP – Finance Specialist, you will lead finance transformation programs leveraging ERP solutions such as SAP S/4HANA FICO, Treasury, and Financial Planning \& Budgeting. You will collaborate with client CFOs, finance leaders, and BCG partners to deliver end\-to\-end ERP\-enabled finance modernization initiatives.
   

  

 What You’ll Do
   

  

* Lead finance\-focused ERP transformations across General Ledger, AP/AR, Asset Accounting, and Treasury Management.
* Drive integration between Controlling (CO), Project Systems (PS), and Planning \& Budgeting.
* Provide strategic guidance on finance data models, cost allocations, and statutory reporting.
* Design future\-state processes for financial close, consolidation, and performance management.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory frameworks (IFRS, GAAP) and internal controls.
* Work closely with clients to optimize Capex/Opex through ERP and digital finance initiatives.


**What You’ll Bring (Experience \& Qualifications)**
* 16\+ years in ERP finance roles with deep SAP FICO, Treasury, or BPC/Group Reporting experience.
* Experience designing and deploying end\-to\-end finance solutions in S/4HANA or equivalent ERP.
* Exposure to projects integrating finance with supply chain, procurement, and HR.
* Strong understanding of budgeting, forecasting, and project accounting.
* Experience engaging with CFOs, Controllers, and Finance Transformation leaders.


 ERP – Sales and Distribution Focus (SD)
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Lead ERP – Sales Specialist, you will lead end\-to\-end design and delivery of ERP sales, order management, and pricing processes using SAP SD, AATP, and CRM/BRIM capabilities.
   

  

 What You’ll Do
   

  

* Lead ERP transformations across Order\-to\-Cash (O2C), Billing, and Pricing processes.
* Implement and optimize SAP SD, AATP, and integrated CRM/BRIM platforms.
* Enable digital customer experience and omnichannel sales models within ERP.
* Develop revenue recognition and subscription\-based pricing capabilities.
* Collaborate with marketing and supply chain functions for integrated sales operations.


**What You’ll Bring (Experience \& Qualifications)**
* 16\+ years’ experience in ERP\-led sales and customer operations transformation.
* Deep SAP SD and CRM/BRIM expertise; AATP experience preferred.
* Strong grasp of order fulfillment, returns, rebate, and pricing management processes.
* Exposure to industries like CPG, manufacturing, or telecom.
* Experience engaging with Sales, Commercial, and Digital Transformation leaders.


 ERP – Procurement and Supply Chain Focus
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Lead ERP – Procurement \& Supply Chain Specialist, you will design and implement ERP\-driven procurement and sourcing processes that deliver efficiency, transparency, and savings. You will lead initiatives using SAP MM, WM, and complementary tools like Ariba, Coupa, and iValua.
   

  

 What You’ll Do
   

  

* Lead ERP transformations in Procurement, Vendor Management, and Warehouse Operations.
* Architect and integrate eProcurement and Source\-to\-Pay platforms (Ariba, Coupa, iValua) with ERP.
* Optimize inventory and warehouse operations through SAP MM and WM modules.
* Enhance supplier collaboration through catalogs, SRM, and spend analytics.
* Develop KPIs for procurement effectiveness, compliance, and sustainability goals.


**What You’ll Bring (Experience \& Qualifications)**
* 16\+ years’ experience in ERP procurement and logistics, with deep SAP MM and WM expertise.
* Working knowledge of QM, SRM, Ariba, Coupa, or iValua integration with ERP.
* Strong understanding of supply base rationalization, contract lifecycle, and cost optimization.
* Experience advising CPOs and Procurement Transformation teams.
* Exposure to AI/analytics\-driven procurement insights preferred.

 BCG Platinion is part of the Boston Consulting Group (BCG) family, specializing in technology consulting that bridges strategic business challenges with modern technology solutions. BCG Platinion is a rapidly growing global team of leading tech experts. We are shaping the future of technology consulting by combining business expertise with cutting\-edge technology capabilities. We help our clients solve their most pressing challenges by designing and delivering enterprise architecture solutions. We partner with clients across industries to design and implement enterprise architecture and digital transformation programs that drive innovation, agility, and scalable value.

**At BCG Platinion, You Will Enjoy:**
* A challenging and rewarding career in enterprise architecture consulting
* A diverse and inclusive culture that values your unique perspective and contribution
* Enterprise Architecture consulting with implementation and value realization in a client setting
* A supportive and collaborative environment that fosters your personal growth and development
* A competitive compensation and benefits package that reflects your skills and experience
* Opportunity to deepen knowledge in specific industries and gain implementation experience.


 If you want a challenging and rewarding career in enterprise architecture consulting, apply now!

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

d608ff30.title: Senior Business Solutions Engineer, BizTech(LegalTech)
d608ff30.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
   

  

 L9 \- Senior Business Solutions Engineer, Legal Tech
   

  

 Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
   

  

**The Community You Will Join**
 The Legal Technology team, within the BizTech organization, leads the mission to deliver innovative technology, empowering our legal function to utilize technology productively, driving connection, and scale support. This role sits within BizTech and partners directly with Airbnb's global Legal organization to accelerate the deployment of AI\-powered tools, implementation of legal systems \& integrations, and workflow automation across the CLO org.
   

  

**The Difference You Will Make**
 We're looking for a world\-class Senior Business Systems Engineer to help redefine how Legal operates. You'll deliver fast, practical solutions using internal tools and agentic AI — owning system and tool changes end\-to\-end, from design through support.
   

  

 You'll spot what's slowing teams down, champion best practices, and safeguard data integrity across our platforms — all while staying ahead of how AI is reshaping the way we work.
   

  

 This isn't conventional IT or Legal Ops. You'll be embedded directly within our Legal teams, solving real challenges in real time. As a key driver of our Legal Tech strategy, you'll lead the deployment of AI agents, legal application implementations, and automation that scales our global legal infrastructure.
   

  

 If you're energized by fast\-paced problem\-solving and want to shape the future of legal technology with AI — this is the role for you.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 Embedded Deployment \& Enablement
   

  

* Partner directly with practice group leads, paralegals, and in\-house counsel to identify high\-value workflow automation and AI integration opportunities.
* Act as the technical DRI for Legal AI tools — from intake through deployment — owning the full lifecycle development within your assigned legal function.
* Build, test, and deploy Legal AI workflows, multi\-agent workflows, RAG pipelines, and AI copilots powered by Claude Enterprise. Building MCPs would be add on
* Run discovery workshops and translate business requirements into engineering\-ready specifications for internal engineering teams.


 Governance \& Stakeholder Management
   

  

* Navigate internal governance processes (PLADIS, Security, Privacy) on behalf of Legal stakeholders — managing intake, review, and approvals.
* Maintain the Legal Tech project portfolio, ensuring initiatives are tracked, prioritized, and communicated effectively to leadership.
* Build trusted relationships with Deputy General Counsels, Legal Ops leads, and cross\-functional partners in BizTech, Security, and Engineering.


 AI Enablement
   

  

* Design and deliver Claude Enterprise training sessions for Legal teams — covering prompting, workflow integration, and responsible AI use.
* Create adoption playbooks, user guides, and enablement materials tailored to Legal personas (lawyers, paralegals, legal ops).
* Track usage metrics and adoption KPIs; report to Legal Technology and CLO leadership on impact.


 What We're Looking For
   

  

* 8\+ years of professional experience in Legal Technology, or Enterprise SaaS implementation — preferably in a tech company or law firm technology function.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience demonstrably using AI in workflows and to support customers.
* Proven track record of architecting and building AI\-powered applications including multi\-agent workflows, retrieval systems, and LLM integrations
* Proven track record in forward\-deployed, embedded, or client\-centric technical positions.
* Experience researching and implementing custom applications from the Marketplace from research, to design and implementation
* Advanced degree (e.g., MS/MBA) in Business, Computer Science, or related fields preferred.
* Demonstrated experience designing and implementing custom business solutions and integrations using enterprise platforms.
* Skilled at stakeholder engagement and cross\-functional collaboration in large global organizations.
* Adept at leading complex projects, simplifying technical concepts, and promoting operational excellence.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, especially in critiquing technical designs and leading workshops, and engaging with senior leadership.
* Identifies opportunities for product and process improvements and can lead and implement said improvements, obtaining necessary buy\-in from stakeholders and leadership..

b34de843.title: Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, Developer AI, Google Cloud
b34de843.description:
For Singapore applicants:  

Google will be prioritizing applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require Google's sponsorship of a visa.  

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Singapore; Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Gurugram, Haryana, India; Mumbai, Maharashtra, India**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in cloud computing or a technical customer\-facing role.
* Experience deploying, scaling, and debugging Large Language Model (LLM) or agent\-based systems in production environments (including tools, memory, orchestration, evaluation, tracing, and cost/latency profiling).
* Experience with end\-to\-end technical ownership of engineering projects with executive stakeholders.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master’s degree or PhD in AI, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
* Experience implementing multi\-agent systems using frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, Agent Development Kit (ADK)) and complex patterns (e.g., ReAct, self\-reflection, hierarchical delegation).
* Experience with agentic frameworks and harness layers, such as Google's Agent Development Kit (ADK) or equivalent, protocol\-level interoperability (MCP, Agent\-to\-Agent (A2A)) across third\-party Independent Software Vendor (ISV) platforms (e.g., ServiceNow), and security ecosystem in DevSecOps.
* Knowledge of LLM\-native metrics (e.g., tokens/sec, cost\-per\-request) and techniques for optimizing state management and granular tracing.

**About the job**
-----------------


As a GenAI Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) at Google Cloud, you are an embedded builder who bridges the gap between frontier Artificial Intelligence (AI) products and production\-grade reality within customers. Unlike traditional advisory roles, you function as an "innovator\-builder," moving beyond high\-level architecture to code, debug, and jointly ship bespoke agentic solutions directly within the customer’s environment. You will address blockers to production including solving the integration complexities, data readiness issues, and state\-management challenges that prevent AI from reaching enterprise\-grade maturity. You will serve a dual purpose, providing white glove deployment of complex AI systems and acting as a critical feedback loop, transforming real\-world field insights into Google Cloud’s future product road map. You will embed with the engineering organizations of our largest customers and take Google's developer AI Gemini Code Assist, anti\-gravity Integrated Development Environment (IDE), Software Development Kit (SDK), Command Line Interface (CLI) and the agentic surfaces beneath them from the first conversation to a production\-grade workflow. You will find what actually slows an engineering organization down, design the system that fixes it, and own it end\-to\-end like discovery, build, roll\-out, hardening, and the long tail of making it reliable.It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go\-To\-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Serve as a developer for complex AI applications, transitioning from rapid prototypes to production\-grade agentic workflows (e.g., multi\-agent systems, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers) that drive measurable Return on Investment (ROI).
* Architect and code the connective tissue between Google’s AI products and customer's live infrastructure, including APIs, legacy data silos, and security perimeters as part of an expert team.
* Design and deploy production\-grade agentic developer workflows on Google Cloud's AI stack, executing large\-scale refactors, language migrations, Specification\-to\-Pull Request pipelines, and automated review/incident\-to\-fix loops.
* Embed with customer's staff engineers and leaders to identify core SDLC bottlenecks, such as legacy migrations, test coverage, review latency, or onboarding friction, and define success metrics.
* Integrate Google’s agentic systems into the customer's existing ISV and tools (e.g., Teamwork Graph, GitLab, ServiceNow, Slack) leveraging MCP and A2A protocols.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

a14892cb.title: Senior Cloud AI Engineer
a14892cb.description:
**Location:** Bangalore, Hyderabad, or Pune, India


**Our Company**


At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.


**What You’ll Do**


As a **Senior Cloud AI Engineer**, you will play a key role in designing and delivering highly scalable, next generation infrastructure within our AI stack. You will work in a technically rich environment with talented peers, contributing to product planning, design and execution while influencing the evolution of Teradata’s AI capabilities.


In this role, you will:


* Design, develop, and maintain high quality cloud native or on\-prem infrastructure with an emphasis on scalability, availability, resiliency, and performance.
* Design and review large\-scale distributed systems supporting multi cloud deployments.
* Use IaC and automation tools such as Terraform to ensure infrastructure changes are reliable, repeatable, and version controlled.
* Develop self\-service platforms and tools that improve developer productivity and streamline deployment lifecycles.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional engineers and product partners to shape the product and enable consistent delivery of end to end features.
* Build and integrate robust RESTful APIs, ensuring security, data consistency, and maintainability.
* Work with SQL and/or NoSQL databases to implement efficient data models and service access patterns.
* Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and alerting systems.
* Apply and experiment with AI/ML technologies, including agentic AI and large language models (LLMs).
* Use AI powered engineering tools to improve development quality, speed, and productivity.
* Use engineering standards and best practices.
* Mentor engineers, supporting them in technical planning and execution.
* Identify and resolve system performance bottlenecks, optimizing code, design, and infrastructure.
* Write unit and integration tests and participate in code reviews to uphold engineering excellence.
* Investigate production issues, ensuring timely and effective solutions.
* Stay current with emerging trends in infrastructure engineering, AI/ML, and cloud\-native technologies.
  


**Who You’ll Work With**


You will be part of a high\-performing engineering team building core components of Teradata’s AI platform. You will collaborate closely with other engineers, AI/ML specialists, product managers, cloud architects, and partner teams across the company. The role offers opportunities to contribute directly to Teradata’s AI product roadmap and technological direction.

  




**What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**


* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent from a recognized institution.
* 4\+ years of experience in infrastructure, networking, devops or cloud technologies.
* Hands\-on expertise with public cloud providers such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, cloud APIs and SDKs, or infrastructure components such as VPC/VNet, API gateways, storage or compute.
* Experience with virtualization/container orchestration technologies like Kubernetes, Istio or Docker.
* Advanced proficiency in automation tools like Terraform and Helm.
* Experience with configuration management tools like Chef or Puppet.
* Strong proficiency in languages like Python, Go, or Bash for services development and scripting.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions or ArgoCD.
* Good understanding of design principles, distributed system patterns.
* Familiarity with security, compliance, IAM and observability.
* Hands\-on experience designing and developing RESTful APIs.
* Experience with SQL or NoSQL databases and data modelling.
* Strong debugging, problem solving, and troubleshooting skills.
* Experience with AI productivity tools such as Claude Code or GitHub Copilot.
* Ability to work independently, drive workstreams, and deliver high quality outcomes.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  


**What You’ll Bring**


(Preferred qualifications)


* Familiarity with infrastructure KPIs and cost optimization.
* Experience with messaging systems such as Kafka.

913cabeb.description:
**About Workato**
 Workato is the leading Control and Execution Platform for Enterprise AI — the neutral platform enterprises trust to put AI to work across their business. Workato unifies data, applications, and processes into a single platform so AI can reliably orchestrate business processes in production at enterprise scale. Built on more than a decade of running mission\-critical processes for over half the Fortune 500 — including Nasdaq, Amazon, Cisco, Vodafone, Atlassian, and Lucid Motors — Workato turns over 14,000 enterprise systems AI needs to act on into one governed execution layer. For more information, visit workato.com.
   

  

**Why join us?**
 Ultimately, Workato believes in fostering a
 **flexible, trust\-oriented culture that empowers everyone to take full ownership of their roles** 
 . We are driven by
 **innovation** 
 and looking for
 **team players** 
 who want to actively build our company.
   

  

 But, we also believe in
 **balancing productivity with self\-care** 
 . That’s why we offer all of our employees a vibrant and dynamic work environment along with a multitude of benefits they can enjoy inside and outside of their work lives.
   

  

 If this sounds right up your alley, please submit an application. We look forward to getting to know you!
   

  

**Also, Feel Free To Check Out Why**
* Business Insider named us an “enterprise startup to bet your career on”
* Forbes’ Cloud 100 recognized us as one of the top 100 private cloud companies in the world
* Deloitte Tech Fast 500 ranked us as the 17th fastest growing tech company in the Bay Area, and 96th in North America
* Quartz ranked us the \#1 best company for remote workers


**About The Role**
 Workato is looking for a Principal Technical Architect, AI to join as a Field Specialist operating at the intersection of applied AI engineering and customer\-facing technical strategy. This is a dual\-mandate role with an approximately equal split:
   

  

**Mandate 1 – AI Field Specialist (Customer\-facing):** 
 You will work directly with enterprise customers and prospects in pre\-sales and post\-sales engagements to define and architect their AI strategies on Workato. This includes designing agentic automation solutions, advising on the latest approaches and best practices, scoping AI agent implementations, and helping customers move from proof\-of\-concept to production\-grade autonomous systems.
   

  

**Mandate 2 – Agentic CS Platform (Internal initiative):** 
 You will be a core architect and developer on Workato's autonomous Customer Success agent initiative, a production\-grade system that captures complete customer context to support reasoning, and compounds intelligence over time. You will own the agent and memory architecture, evals and learning loop, and autonomy framework that power this system.
   

  

 This is a role for someone who builds agentic systems to orchestrate LLMs into reliable, auditable, enterprise\-grade agent architectures, and who can articulate that vision to a customer CIO and technical leaders as fluently as they can implement it in code.
   

  

 Workato has a positive, diverse, and collaborative culture; we look for people who are curious, inventive, smart, hardworking, and who work to be a little better every day.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 AI Field Specialist
   

  

* Support as an expert AI architect in strategic enterprise engagements: roadmapping customer AI agent use cases and delivering technical deep\-dives that demonstrate Workato's agentic capabilities.
* Lead architecture workshops with enterprise customers to define their AI automation strategy, including agent design, integration patterns, and governance frameworks.
* Advise customers on applied AI best practices: prompt engineering and agent orchestration patterns, evaluation and testing strategies for agent systems, confidence calibration, human\-in\-the\-loop design, and continuous learning loops.
* Build reusable technical assets, such as reference architectures, solution blueprints, demonstration environments, and best\-practice documentation, that enable the broader field team to position AI solutions.
* Develop and deliver technical collateral: architecture white papers, webinars, blog posts, conference talks, etc. that establish Workato's thought leadership in agentic automation.
* Partner with Product and Engineering to feed field insights back into the platform roadmap, ensuring customer\-facing AI capabilities evolve based on real deployment patterns.
* Support global strategic accounts across the US, EMEA, and APAC geographies as needed for critical engagements.
* May require up to 20% global travel.


 Agentic CS Platform
   

  

* Architect and implement core subsystems of the autonomous CS agent platform, including memory layers, the agent orchestration layer, and the decision trace architecture.
* Design and build a Customer Knowledge Graph as a structured, semantic network that models customers, users, policies, decisions, and operational artifacts as interconnected entities and relationships, enabling queryable representation of contextual states, and policy evaluations for governance, traceability, and decision optimization.
* Implement the confidence\-based autonomy framework, including precedent matching, confidence scoring (precedent match, pattern recognition, data completeness, policy clarity), and policy\-governed escalation routing.
* Define and design infrastructure architecture to ensure optimal performance and latency.
* Take scalable technology selection decisions.
* Establish evaluation frameworks: define metrics for decision quality, context accuracy, and learning velocity (autonomous threshold increases month over month).


**Requirements**
 Qualifications \& Experience
   

  

* B.Tech/BE or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* 15\+ years of total relevant experience in enterprise software architecture, design, and implementation.
* 8\+ years of hands\-on experience with Integration Platforms (MuleSoft, TIBCO, Oracle SOA, webMethods, or similar). Deep familiarity with iPaaS architecture patterns is essential.
* 2\+ years of applied AI/Agents engineering experience, specifically in building systems that leverage LLMs and agent frameworks, orchestrating them into production applications.


 Applied AI \& Agent Architecture (Must\-Have)
   

  

* Hands\-on experience designing and building AI agent systems: multi\-step reasoning pipelines, tool\-use orchestration, and autonomous execution frameworks.
* Working knowledge of Python agent frameworks such as LangGraph, Claude Agent SDK, or equivalent. LangGraph experience with persisted state and human\-in\-the\-loop patterns is strongly preferred.
* Experience with graph database design and implementation: entity modeling, relationship extraction, graph querying, and using graph structures for contextual retrieval. Neo4j/NetworkX equivalent experience is a plus.
* Practical experience with RAG architectures, vector databases, embedding strategies, and hybrid retrieval (vector \+ structured \+ graph).
* Understanding of evaluation and testing for AI systems: building evals, measuring agent quality, confidence calibration, A/B testing of prompts/pipelines, and regression testing for non\-deterministic outputs.
* Familiarity with prompt engineering at production scale: structured prompting, chain\-of\-thought patterns, output parsing, retry/fallback strategies, and prompt versioning.
* Experience with observability for LLM systems: tracing, token/cost monitoring, and latency profiling. Familiarity with Langfuse, LangSmith, Phoenix, or similar tools.
* Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) standards for LLM\-to\-system integration.


 Integration \& Enterprise Architecture (Must\-Have)
   

  

* Strong expertise in enterprise integration patterns: event\-driven architectures, microservices orchestration, pub/sub messaging, and data synchronization.
* Deep working knowledge of APIs: RESTful, SOAP, webhooks, and data formats (JSON, XML).
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and cloud\-native services (Lambda/Functions, DynamoDB, Kafka/Kinesis, S3\).
* Familiarity with enterprise applications: Salesforce, ServiceNow, SAP, Workday, NetSuite, or similar. Understanding how these systems participate in agentic workflows.
* Understanding of enterprise security and governance requirements: OAuth, SSO, data residency, SOX compliance, audit trails, and role\-based access control.


 Nice\-to\-Have
   

  

* Background in Customer Success platforms (Gainsight, ChurnZero) or CRM architecture.
* Prior experience in a customer\-facing technical role (Solutions Architect, Field CTO, Technical Account Manager, or Pre\-Sales Engineer) at a SaaS or platform company.
* Contributions to open\-source AI/agent projects or published technical content in the applied AI space.


 Soft Skills
   

  

* Exceptional ability to communicate complex AI and architecture concepts to diverse audiences: from engineering teams to C\-level executives: adapting depth and vocabulary to the room.
* Strong consultative instinct: able to listen to a customer's business problem, decompose it into architectural components, and propose a credible path forward in real\-time.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with comfort operating in ambiguity: this role spans an internal build and an external advisory function, and requires someone who can context\-switch and self\-prioritize.
* Collaborative by default: able to work across Product, Engineering, Customer Success, Sales, and Marketing without needing formal authority.
* Excellent written communication: able to produce architecture documents, white papers, and technical briefs that are clear, precise, and persuasive.
* Fast learner who stays current with the rapidly evolving AI agent ecosystem and can distill emerging patterns into practical guidance.

* Creating sound project plans with the business by engaging with multidisciplinary teams, and by identifying, managing and mitigating risk

* Understanding how the end\-to\-end management vision is aligned to the broader organization strategy and objectives
