8fc89c7e.description:
LevelBlue reduces risk and builds lasting resilience so organizations can innovate and advance their mission with confidence. As the world’s most analyst\-recognized and largest pure\-play managed security services provider, LevelBlue elevates client outcomes that matter: stronger defense, faster response, and sustained business continuity. LevelBlue combines AI\-powered security operations, advanced threat intelligence, and elite human expertise to provide the most comprehensive portfolio of strategic advisory, managed security, offensive security, and incident response services.
   

  

 Working Model: Hybrid / On\-call flexibility required (including occasional out\-of\-hours support)
   

  

 Working Time: 9\.00 am – 5\.30 pm US EST
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are seeking a highly motivated Solution Implementation Manager (SIM) to lead the onboarding, delivery, and implementation of Managed Security Services (MSS) for enterprise customers. This role combines technical project delivery, customer engagement, and security solution enablement, ensuring successful deployment of complex network and security services. The SIM acts as the primary point of coordination across customers, engineering teams, and vendors, with a strong focus on on\-time delivery, service quality, and customer satisfaction.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead end\-to\-end implementation and onboarding of MSS solutions across customer environments
* Gather, analyze, and validate customer technical and business requirements
* Translate requirements into solution designs and implementation plans in collaboration with engineering teams
* Coordinate and manage deployment activities including ordering, provisioning, configuration, and testing
* Act as the primary customer\-facing interface during implementation lifecycle
* Ensure successful integration of firewall, SASE, and SD\-WAN solutions into customer environments
* Track and manage project milestones, risks, and dependencies to ensure timely delivery
* Drive issue resolution and escalation management across internal teams and vendors
* Maintain clear documentation, reporting, and status communication with stakeholders
* Contribute to continuous improvement of delivery processes and automation


**Core Technical Expertise**
 Network \& Security Fundamentals
   

  

**Strong Understanding Of**
* TCP/IP, ports, and protocols
* Routing (BGP, OSPF) and WAN technologies
* LAN/WAN architectures and network design fundamentals


 Security \& Network Technologies
   

  

**Experience With Enterprise Security Solutions**
* Firewalls (Palo Alto, Fortinet, Cisco, Check Point)
* VPN technologies (IPsec / SSL VPN)
* NAT, segmentation, and policy\-based security Secure Access \& Cloud\-Delivered Security


**Delivery \& Project Management Skills**
* Strong experience in technical project delivery / service implementation
* Ability to manage multiple parallel customer deployments
* Solid understanding of:
* Project lifecycle management
* Risk and dependency management
* Vendor and stakeholder coordination


**Professional Skills**
* Excellent customer\-facing communication and stakeholder management
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making skills
* Ability to translate technical concepts into customer\-friendly language
* High attention to detail with strong ownership and accountability mindset
* Self\-driven and proactive with the ability to work in a global environment


**Qualifications**
* 3–5\+ years of experience in:
* Network/security implementation, service delivery, or project management roles
* Experience delivering firewalls or managed security services is highly preferred


**Certifications (Preferred)**
* Cisco (CCNA / CCNP)
* ITIL Foundation or equivalent service management certification
* Project Management certifications (PMP, Prince2\) – advantage
* Vendor certifications (Palo Alto, Fortinet) – advantage


**Education**
* BCA / B.Tech graduates or candidates with relevant qualifications in cybersecurity, information technology or related fields.


 This role is open to candidates legally authorized to work in India. At LevelBlue, including teams that previously operated as Trustwave, we support flexible work and bring people together in person for key moments based on role, team, and business needs.
   

  

 LevelBlue is committed to a culture of respect, inclusion, and equal opportunity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age, or any other status protected under applicable law.

LevelBlue’s policy is to only accept resumes from agencies through its approved agency process and with a valid agreement in place. Any resume submitted outside this process will be considered the property of LevelBlue, and no fee will be paid if a candidate is hired from such a submission.

023a3b9f.description:
**Build your future with Sovos.**
 If you're seeking a career where innovation meets impact, you've come to the right place. As a global leader, Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth while revolutionizing how businesses navigate the ever\-changing regulatory landscape.
   

  

 At Sovos, we're dedicated to more than just solving compliance challenges \-\- we're committed to making a positive and lasting difference in everything we do. Our teams operate on the modern edge of digital technology, working not only to solve complex business challenges but also to enrich our personal, professional, and local communities.
   

  

 Our purpose\-built systems provide the tools you need to thrive in a world where governments demand increased visibility, faster reporting and greater control over business processes. Excited about the possibilities? So are we!
   

  

 Don't worry if you don't check all the boxes \-\- apply anyway! We're focused on hiring the right people, not just the "right" resume. It's not about what you've done elsewhere; it's all about what you're capable of doing here.
   

  

**The Work You'll Do**
 At Sovos, we deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that power global tax compliance for some of the world’s largest organizations. As a Solution Consultant, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting system\-to\-system integrations between Sovos platform, client ERP \& third\-party applications.
   

  

 This role is a client\-facing and integration\-focused. You will act as the technical owner of implementation projects, leading requirement gathering, solution design, testing, deployment, go live and hypercare. Collaboration with clients, external integration partners and internal technical teams is key to ensuring seamless integration \& successful project completion.
   

  

**More Specifically, You Will**
* Be the primary technical point of contact throughout the project lifecycle, providing technical support and guidance throughout the project lifecycle
* Collaborate with Client technical, functional \& Sovos project teams, outlining and designing Sovos products to the project scope.
* Gather \& analyse business and technical requirements from clients, translating them into effective solution and integration designs.
* Complete solution design and architecture documents which includes all configuration details and any other necessary information to support Client and Sovos implementations.
* Design and implement API\-based integrations (REST/SOAP) between Sovos platforms and client ERP systems.
* Analyse the structure and definition of our customers integration data files and map their fields/data to Sovos internal data structure according to project scope.
* Validate data flows, mappings, and transformations between source and target systems to ensure accuracy and reliability.
* Coordinate with client, internal teams and integration partners to ensure timely project delivery and resolve any issues that may arise by following internal escalation and procedures
* Ensure integrations adhere to security, compliance and performance standards as required by Sovos and its clients.
* Must be capable of leading fast\-paced work sessions with internal and/or client’s teams to come up with solutions to solve project problems within Sovos products capabilities and project scope.
* Understanding the impact of individual task completion on the overall project schedule.
* Excellent understanding of Sovos product and capabilities.
* Provide training as necessary to clients in relation to Sovos Products.
* Identify and implement improvements to processes, documents, tools, reports, etc. to benefit and improve Sovos project team and new Client’s implementation processes.
* Perform SIT (System Integration Testing) \& UAT (Users Acceptance Testing) according to Sovos products configurations and project implementation plan.


**What We Need From You**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or similar.
* 5\+ years of experience in system integration, or, enterprise application integration in customer facing role
* Knowledge of development languages, ability to read and understand code, to analyse rules/conditions and data mappings (C\# or similar)
* Good understanding of ERP systems such as NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar platforms.
* Solid hands\-on experience with REST and SOAP APIs, covering authentication, error handling, and retries.
* Experience in systems \& data integration, data structure and data mappings with strong knowledge of system architecture, data flows and integration patterns.
* Experience with JSON, XML, and data mapping/transformation techniques.
* Experience in Electronic Invoicing, Billing, Systems Integration, Invoicing Systems (ERP) projects an added advantage.
* Excellent English communications skills (verbal and written)
* Strong critical thinking skills and a solution\-oriented mindset.
* Strong time management, organizational and decision\-making skills.
* Interact effectively with teammates, colleagues and Client’s.
* Comprehend and communicate complex concepts.
* Concentrate, analyse and resolve complex problems.


 The tools to enhance your life \- because we want you to enjoy your life outside of work and inside!
   

  

* 3 days per week in our Navi Mumbai (Airoli) office, with flexibility to work remotely for the remaining days
* Opportunity to work with a global organization and gain international exposure
* Bi\-Weekly Meeting Free Days!
* Mentoring Programs and career development opportunities
* Globally recognized Training and Development programs
* Comprehensive health benefits and insurance coverage
* Collaborative work environment with modern tools and technologies
* Opportunity to be part of a newly acquired entity and shape its growth journey


**Our Recruitment Process**
 We believe in a transparent and comprehensive hiring process. Here's what a typical process will look like:
   

  

 Stage 1: CCAT (Criteria Cognitive Aptitude Test) and EPP (Employee Personality Profile) Assessment
   

  

 Stage 2: Automated Video Interview
   

  

 Stage 3: Department Interview with Hiring Manager and/or key stakeholders
   

  

 Stage 4: Final Interview
   

  

 Sovos is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an environment that celebrates diversity and where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate against race, color, religions, national origin, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic provided by law. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work.
   

  

**Company Background**
 Sovos is a global provider of tax, compliance and trust solutions and services that enable businesses to navigate an increasingly regulated world with true confidence. Purpose\-built for always\-on compliance capabilities, our scalable IT\-driven solutions meet the demands of an evolving and complex global regulatory landscape. Sovos' cloud\-based software platform provides an unparalleled level of integration with business applications and government compliance processes.
   

  

 More than 100,000 customers in 100\+ countries \-\- including half the Fortune 500 \-\- trust Sovos for their compliance needs. Sovos annually processes more than three billion transactions across 19,000 global tax jurisdictions. Bolstered by a robust partner program more than 400 strong, Sovos brings to bear an unrivaled global network for companies across industries and geographies. Founded in 1979, Sovos has operations across the Americas and Europe, and is owned by Hg and TA Associates. For more information visit http://www.sovos.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Twitter

c7021167.title: Laboratory Solutions Specialist
c7021167.description:
GA International, manufacturer of LabTAG® laboratory labels, provides specialized identification solutions for life sciences, healthcare, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and research laboratories. Our portfolio includes cryogenic, freezer, chemical\-resistant, autoclave, histology, PCR, and general laboratory labels, along with label printers, ribbons, barcode scanners, and custom identification solutions.
 



  





**Role Description** 




  





 The Laboratory Solutions Specialist is a full\-time, customer\-facing sales role focused on developing new business and growing GA International’s presence within the laboratory, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, and life sciences markets in India.
 



  





 The successful candidate will actively identify and develop prospective customers, understand their laboratory workflows and labeling requirements, and recommend suitable LabTAG® labeling, printing, barcode, and identification solutions.
 



  





 Day\-to\-day responsibilities will include prospecting and lead generation, visiting laboratories and customer sites, conducting product presentations and demonstrations, preparing quotations and proposals, following up on sales opportunities, and supporting customers throughout the sales process.
 



  





 The role will involve building relationships with laboratory managers, scientists, procurement teams, quality teams, distributors, and other decision\-makers. The Laboratory Solutions Specialist will also work closely with GA International’s internal technical, customer service, marketing, and product teams to develop solutions for customer applications and support successful account development.
 



  





 The position requires regular travel for customer meetings, distributor visits, product demonstrations, conferences, and industry exhibitions.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Identify and develop new sales opportunities within laboratories, pharmaceutical companies, biotechnology companies, CROs, CDMOs, hospitals, biobanks, IVF facilities, research institutions, and other life science organizations.
* Prospect for new customers through direct outreach, referrals, exhibitions, distributor networks, and inbound leads.
* Visit customer laboratories to understand existing labeling, sample identification, printing, barcode, and tracking workflows.
* Recommend appropriate LabTAG® labels, printers, ribbons, barcode scanners, and custom identification solutions based on customer requirements.
* Conduct product demonstrations, sample evaluations, technical discussions, and customer presentations.
* Prepare quotations, proposals, product recommendations, and follow\-up communications.
* Manage sales opportunities from initial inquiry and qualification through evaluation, quotation, negotiation, and order.
* Develop and maintain relationships with key customer accounts and identify opportunities for repeat business and account growth.
* Work with distributors and channel partners to develop opportunities and support local sales activities.
* Maintain accurate records of leads, opportunities, customer interactions, and sales activities using CRM tools.
* Gather market intelligence, competitor information, and customer feedback to support product and business development.
* Represent GA International at trade shows, conferences, customer meetings, and industry events.
* Provide basic product training and post\-sale support to ensure successful adoption of GA International solutions.
* Work toward agreed sales targets, develop a qualified opportunity pipeline, and contribute to revenue growth within the assigned market or territory.



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* Master’s degree in Biotechnology, Life Sciences, Biomedical Sciences, or a related scientific field is preferred.
* Minimum 2 years of relevant experience is preferred, ideally in sales, business development, laboratory products, life sciences, biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, diagnostics, scientific equipment, or a related industry.
* Strong sales and business development skills, with the ability to prospect, qualify opportunities, build relationships, and move customers through the sales process.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain technical products clearly to scientists, laboratory personnel, procurement teams, and business decision\-makers.
* Strong consultative selling skills with the ability to understand customer workflows, identify requirements, and recommend appropriate solutions.
* Comfortable conducting customer visits, product demonstrations, follow\-up discussions, and commercial negotiations.
* Ability to develop and maintain long\-term customer and distributor relationships.
* Knowledge of common laboratory techniques, laboratory workflows, and scientific applications is a strong advantage.
* Familiarity with sample identification, barcode systems, LIMS, laboratory consumables, labeling technologies, or scientific equipment is an advantage.
* Self\-motivated and comfortable working independently while managing multiple customer opportunities and priorities.
* Willingness to travel regularly for customer meetings, distributor meetings, product demonstrations, conferences, and exhibitions.
* Comfortable using CRM systems, Microsoft Office, online meeting platforms, and other digital sales tools.

0f4e87bf.title: Solution Design Engineer
0f4e87bf.description:
**Company Description** 
 Armstrong Dematic is a leading provider of intralogistics automation solutions, focused on helping businesses in emerging markets overcome complex supply chain challenges. The company designs future\-ready systems that support multi\-channel order fulfillment, OTIF delivery, and strong ROI, enabling clients to scale profitably and maintain market leadership. With over 25 years of industry leadership and a strategic partnership with global automation leader Dematic, Armstrong Dematic delivers end\-to\-end automation solutions backed by robust project management and adaptive innovation. Its multi\-agent orchestration software integrates seamlessly with reliable global technologies, and a unique lifecycle support model ensures long\-term sustainability through modernization, upgrades, and world\-class service. Armstrong Dematic offers world\-class solutions at competitive pricing, tailored to local market needs, positioning itself as a true growth partner for businesses looking to scale with confidence.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Solution Design Engineer is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Pune City, responsible for designing and engineering intralogistics automation solutions that meet client requirements and operational goals. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include analyzing customer processes and data, developing concept layouts, and creating detailed designs using CAD tools in collaboration with mechanical and electrical engineering teams. The role involves preparing technical proposals, specifications, and cost estimates, while ensuring solutions align with performance, safety, and quality standards. The Solution Design Engineer will work closely with sales, project management, and implementation teams to refine designs, support presentations, and provide technical input throughout the project lifecycle. This position also includes continuous improvement of design methodologies, staying current with industry technologies, and contributing to innovation in Armstrong Dematic’s solution portfolio.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




**The Solution Design Engineer is responsible for designing optimised application solutions to meet customer objectives. The role involves studying new business opportunities, capturing customer requirements, developing 2D/3D concept layouts for Material Handling (conveyor) systems, and supporting the Manager in providing end\-to\-end solutions from concept through to site validation.** 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**• Validate and capture customer requirements along with URS (User Requirement Specification) raised by the Sales team via Request for Quote.** 




**• Collect data from customers by preparing query sheets; visit customer sites when required.** 




**• Prepare Material Flow Diagrams and Throughput Diagrams based on customer inputs.** 




**• Prepare 2D concept layouts of Material Handling (conveyor) systems.** 




**• Discuss proposed solutions with the internal sales team and subsequently present to the customer.** 




**• Prepare 3D static layouts of Material Handling (conveyor) systems.** 




**• Freeze the layout technically with the customer (URS sign\-off) for large/big\-ticket orders.** 




**• Validate the solution at site during installation in coordination with the Installation and Commissioning team.** 




**• Capture project learnings and document them as FAQ sheets/Laws for continuous improvement.** 




  





**Key Skills \& Competencies** 




**Technical Skills:** 




**• Proficiency in AutoCAD for 2D layout design** 




**• Working knowledge of Demo3D or similar simulation/3D layout tools** 




**• Understanding of Material Handling systems and conveyor technologies** 




**• Ability to prepare Material Flow and Throughput Diagrams** 




**• Familiarity with URS (User Requirement Specification) documentation processes** 




**• Core engineering knowledge in Mechanical / Production / Automobile / Mechatronics** 




**Behavioural Skills:** 




**• Strong analytical and problem\-solving ability** 




**• Effective communication and customer\-facing skills** 




**• Collaborative mindset — ability to work with sales, installation, and commissioning teams** 




**• Attention to detail and accuracy in design and documentation** 




**• Self\-driven with ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously** 




**• Willingness to travel for customer visits and site validations** 




  





**Educational Qualification** 



* **BE / Diploma in Mechanical, Production, Automobile, or Mechatronics Engineering with minimum 50% marks, OR minimum 2 years of relevant industry experience in a similar role.**

0fb896c7.title: Cloud Administrator
0fb896c7.description:
:
**ZS** is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by **bringing together data, science, technology** and **human ingenuity** to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side\-by\-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life\-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a **client\-first mentality** to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life\-changing impact to ZS.

  


 :
**What you'll do: Information Protection Analyst in the Enterprise will…**


ZS's CCoE (Cloud Center of Excellence) Team builds, maintains and helps architect the systems enabling ZS client\-facing software solutions. We define and implement best practices to ensure performant, resilient and secure cloud solutions. The CCoE team at ZS is comprised of analytical problem solvers coming from diverse backgrounds while sharing a passion for quality delivery — whether our customer is a client or another ZS employee. The team has presence in ZS’s Evanston, Illinois and Pune, India offices”.


The CLOUD ADMINISTRATOR (LINUX) will be part of CCoE Compute Team Pune. As a Senior Cloud Administrator, you will manage AWS infrastructure in multiple regions and accounts. You will be actively engaged in planning, configuration, management, maintenance and upgrade of various components related to the Public cloud.

**What You'll Do:**

* Work on various activities related to planning, configuration and management of different distributions of Linux servers.
* Responsible for migration and upgrade of Linux instances, serverless resources and container infrastructure.
* Configure and Participate in Linux patching rollout, rollback and threat mitigation.
* Work on regular operations activities related to AWS and Linux.
* High level log analysis, monitoring alerts, performance reports, trend analysis, experience with process monitoring tools, Wireshark etc
* Audit IT infrastructure and publish report and manage access control
* Perform root cause analysis for escalated issues and provide resolution.
* Mentor and train newly joined team members.

**What You'll Bring:**

* BE/B.Tech or higher in CS, IT or EE.
* Linux server administration experience of 1\-3 Years ( AWS Linux and RHEL), specifically in AWS cloud.
* Hands on experience with AWS services like CloudFormation, Systems Manager, CloudWatch
* Deep knowledge of OS Installation, upgrades, troubleshooting, patching etc.
* Good knowledge in IP Addressing, troubleshooting network issues.
* Experienced in day to day operational issues and runtime operations in a multi\-domain, multi region environment
* Hands on experience in Bash, Python and Ansible
* Understanding concepts of enterprise data center technologies including Networking, Security, TCP/IP and Firewalls and how they work together.
* Knowledge of AWS VDI solutions like Workspace and Appstreams will be an added advantage.
* Should have good communication skills and a can\-do attitude.
* Fluency in English
* Client\-first mentality
* Intense work ethic
* Collaborative spirit and problem\-solving approach


 :
**How you’ll grow:**

* Cross\-functional skills development \& custom learning pathways
* Milestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunities
* Internal mobility paths that empower growth via s\-curves, individual contribution and role expansions

 **Perks \& Benefits:**


At ZS, your growth matters. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that supports your health and well‑being, financial future, time away, and professional development. With robust skills‑building programs, multiple career progression paths, internal mobility, and a deeply collaborative culture, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, expand your capabilities, and thrive as part of a global community. For details on total rewards in India, visit ZS India office locations \| Where we work \| ZS.  



**Hybrid working model:**


We are committed to giving our employees a flexible and connected way of working. A flexible and connected ZS allows us to combine work from home and on\-site presence at clients/ZS offices for the majority of our week. The magic of ZS culture and innovation thrives in both planned and spontaneous face\-to\-face connections.

 **Travel:**


Travel is a requirement at ZS for client facing ZSers; business needs of your project and client are the priority. While some projects may be local, all client\-facing ZSers should be prepared to travel as needed. Travel provides opportunities to strengthen client relationships, gain diverse experiences, and enhance professional growth by working in different environments and cultures.

 **Considering applying?**

**Job Description**
**The Opportunity**
* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130\- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.

* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision\-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.


 Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
   

  

 A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well\-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The Public Cloud Automation Software Engineer role will be instrumental in implementing the architecture and the engineering processes and best practices to enable the foundational infrastructure (compute, network, storage, observability) required for application hosting in public cloud. This role will focus on designing, building, and operating automated, secure, and compliant cloud infrastructure at scale. The ideal candidate combines strong infrastructure\-as\-code expertise (Terraform), deep cloud networking knowledge, and practical experience delivering repeatable, auditable automation in highly regulated environments.
   

  

**What Will You Do In This Role**
* Design, implement, and maintain cloud infrastructure using infrastructure\-as\-code (IaC), with Terraform as the primary IaC tool
* Build and operate automated pipelines for provisioning, configuration, testing, and deployment of cloud resources (CI/CD for infrastructure)
* Deliver the tooling and capabilities needed to enable our cloud first strategy
* Drive client satisfaction by identifying and developing process improvement and automation initiatives while ensuring compliance of slutions to operation roadmap
* Develop, document, and maintain reusable Terraform modules, templates, and standards to accelerate secure and compliant cloud deployments across multiple teams and regions
* Develop, document, and maintain reusable Ansible playbooks, templates, and standards to accelerate secure and compliant cloud deployments across multiple teams and regions
* Collaborate with network engineering to design and implement cloud network architectures (VPC/VNet design, subnets, routing, transit/gateway, peering, security zones)
* Implement and manage connectivity solutions including VPN, Direct Connect / ExpressRoute, Transit Gateways, NAT, service endpoints, and hybrid connectivity patterns
* Implement robust security and compliance controls in infrastructure code (IAM roles and policies, network segmentation, NSGs/firewalls, encryption, logging)
* Build automated testing, policy\-as\-code and validation frameworks (e.g., Terraform plan checks, Sentinel/Open Policy Agent, GitOps workflows)
* Integrate infrastructure automation with observability, logging and incident management (CloudWatch/Azure Monitor/GCP Monitoring, SIEM integration)
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex infrastructure and network issues across cloud environments; work with cloud vendor support as needed
* Drive automation best practices, runbooks, and operational playbooks; mentor other engineers on IaC and network design
* Maintain lifecycle management for cloud infrastructure drift detection, upgrades, module versioning, and secure secrets handling
* Participate in architecture reviews, risk assessments, and change control processes required for a regulated industry
* Provide technical input for cost optimization and capacity planning for network and infrastructure services
* Groom Jira features and stories to improve reliability and reduce support incidents for global cloud infrastructure
* Provide on\-call support in case of escalations and major incidents

 IaC (Infrastructure as Code) / DevOps, Terraform, Ansiblie, infrastructure automation
   

  

**Secondary\-** 
 Azure, AWS, GCP
   

  

* Bachelors’ degree in Information Technology, Computer Science or any Technology stream.
* 7\+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure engineering with infrastructure\-as\-code
* Advanced hands\-on experience with Terraform (module development, state management, workspaces, remote backends)
* Strong understanding of cloud networking concepts and hands\-on experience designing and implementing network architectures in at least one major public cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Familiarity with cloud provider networking services and best practices (e.g., AWS Transit Gateway, Azure Virtual WAN, Google Cloud VPC \+ Shared VPC)
* Proficiency in CI/CD tooling for infrastructure (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps), and Git\-based workflows (GitOps)

69bd489c.title: Manufacturing Program Manager – PMO
69bd489c.description:
**About This Job**
**Designco India**
**Location:** 
 Moradabad, Uttar Pradesh, India
   

  

**Work Mode:** 
 On\-site
   

  

**Industry:** 
 Wholesale Import and Export
   

  

**Job Description**
 Location: Moradabad, Uttar Pradesh (factory\-based, full\-time on site)
   

  

 Reports to: Managing Director
   

  

 Level: Mid\-senior \| 8–12 years of experience
   

  

**About DesignCo**
 DesignCo is a leading Indian export house in handicrafts and home décor, supplying some of the world's largest retail chains. We run a 100% made\-to\-order business with exceptional product velocity with over 1,500 new products developed and 7,000\+ sales orders executed every year across in\-house production shops and an external contractor network. We are now investing in the systems, governance, and leadership needed to scale this business 3–5x.
   

  

 The Mandate
   

  

 We are establishing a Project Management Office (PMO) as a formal governance function, reporting directly to the Managing Director, and we are hiring a Program Manager to build and run it from the factory floor.
   

  

 This is not a reporting or coordination desk. The PMO's job is to make execution visible, accountable, and non\-negotiable across every department — production, sampling, quality, stores, order management, and external contractors. The Program Manager carries the authority of the MD's office to enforce process compliance, and the responsibility to earn that compliance through credibility on the ground.
   

  

**The PMO's Scope Will Build In Two Phases**
 Phase 1: New Product Development. Every new product developed is tracked as a project from concept to production\-ready: sampling, validation, documentation, costing, and process freeze with clear stage gates, owners, and dates.
   

  

 Phase 2: Purchase Order Execution. Every buyer purchase order is then managed as a project in its own right ... planned, tracked, and delivered against committed milestones through to dispatch.
   

  

 What You'll Own
   

  

 Run the PMO on the ground
   

  

 Own day\-to\-day PMO operations at the Moradabad factory: stage gates, review cadences, escalations, and closure of open actions across all departmentsBe the single source of truth on real execution status — from the floor, not from reports
   

  

 Enforce governance and compliance
   

  

 Hold department heads and external partners accountable to defined processes, milestones, and documentation standardsRun a disciplined escalation mechanism: issues surface early, reach the right level fast, and get resolved — with the MD's office as final backstopBuild compliance through respect and consistency, not just authority
   

  

 Lead and build the on\-ground PMO team
   

  

 Lead an on\-ground team of PMO coordinators — partly in place, partly to be hired by youSet their operating rhythm, develop their capability, and hold their output to a high standard
   

  

 Operate the PMO on Asana
   

  

 Run the entire PMO — projects, milestones, tasks, dependencies, dashboards — on Asana as the system of recordPartner with a central enablement team that supports you remotely on strategy, process design, templates, analytics, and Asana configuration, automation, and AI\-enabled workflowsDrive adoption of Asana across departments so that work is managed in the system, not around it
   

  

 Report to leadership
   

  

 Give the Managing Director a sharp, honest view of execution health: what's on track, what's slipping, why, and what's being done about itConvert leadership decisions into tracked commitments on the ground
   

  

 What Makes You a Fit8–12 years of experience in program management, PMO leadership, or plant/operations management in a manufacturing environmentA track record of driving cross\-functional compliance in complex setups — you have made many stakeholders, senior and junior, follow a process that wasn't theirsExperience in high\-mix, made\-to\-order, or export\-oriented manufacturing strongly preferred (home décor, handicrafts, furniture, apparel/fashion export, giftware, or similar)Hands\-on fluency with modern work management tools — Asana strongly preferred (or Monday.com, Wrike, Jira with fast conversion) — you run your work in the tool, not in your inboxStrong first\-principles grasp of NPD/sampling cycles and order execution in manufacturingTeam leadership experience: you have built, run, and raised the bar for a coordination or PMO teamFluent in Hindi and English; equally effective in a shop\-floor conversation and an MD\-level reviewBased in or willing to relocate to Moradabad; this is a full\-time, on\-site leadership role
   

  

 Good to have
   

  

 Exposure to SAP or another ERP environmentExperience working with job\-work contractors or distributed vendor networksFamiliarity with workflow automation or AI\-assisted reporting
   

  

 Why This Role
   

  

 Direct reporting to the Managing Director. A mandate with real authority, not a staff function. A dedicated on\-ground team plus a remote enablement team handling strategy, analytics, and tooling so you can focus on execution. And the opportunity to build a governance function from the ground up in one of India's leading export businesses as it scales to its next phase.
   

  

 To apply, share your CV along with a short note on the toughest cross\-functional program you've driven to compliance — what resisted, and how you got it done.

17b121a3.description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

### **About Us:**

Zendesk is a leader in customer experience solutions, dedicated to delivering innovative technology and exceptional service. Our Contact Center Center of Excellence (CoE) focuses on optimizing customer support platforms, including Zendesk, Amazon Connect, and AWS\-based solutions, to enhance customer interactions and operational efficiency.  



  

### **Position Overview**

We are seeking a seasoned Contact Center Partner Solutions Consultant with deep expertise in contact center technologies and CX Suites—preferably Zendesk, Amazon Connect, and AWS—with a strong focus on partner onboarding, technical enablement, and co\-selling support. This role will lead partner technical enablement efforts, ensuring partners are fully equipped and supported to resell and implement Zendesk Contact Center solutions effectively. The ideal candidate will provide strategic direction, technical leadership, and hands\-on expertise to drive partner success and seamless integration of contact center solutions.  



  

### **Core Daily Activities**

* Partner Onboarding and Enablement: Drive the technical onboarding process for partners, ensuring they acquire the skills and knowledge necessary to successfully implement and resell Zendesk Contact Center solutions.
* Co\-Sell Technical Support: Collaborate closely with partners during co\-sell engagements, providing expert technical guidance and solving complex implementation challenges.
* Architect and Optimize Contact Center Solutions: Design scalable and efficient architectures leveraging Amazon Connect, AWS, and Zendesk to support partner deployments.
* Lead Technical Strategy and Partner Roadmap: Define technical enablement strategies aligned with partner needs and evolving business goals.
* Provide Technical Leadership and Mentorship: Coach partners, internal teams, and presales specialists on best practices in solution design and deployment.
* Drive Innovation and Emerging Technology Adoption: Stay updated on AI, ML, and automation trends in contact centers to continuously improve partner technical capabilities.
* Support Pre\-Sales and Post\-Sales Activities with Partners: Support technical discovery, solution design, demonstrations, PoCs, and ongoing partner support.
Develop Enablement Materials: Create technical documentation, playbooks, and training content tailored for partner consumption.  
* 

  

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Partner Success Focus: Own the technical onboarding and enablement process for partners, reducing onboarding friction and accelerating time to market.
* Strategic Leadership: Define and execute the architectural vision for partner\-facing contact center solutions within the CoE framework.
* Technical Oversight: Support and guide partners and internal teams to adhere to architectural best practices, security standards, and delivery excellence.
* Collaboration: Work with partner sales leads, sales, and engineering teams to align on technical requirements, scope, and co\-sell strategies.
* Innovation Advocacy: Promote adoption of the latest contact center technologies and best practices with partners.
Governance and Compliance: Ensure partner solutions meet compliance, security, and governance requirements.  
* 

  

### **Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or Business Administration.
* Experience: Minimum of 10 years in solution architecture, with at least 5 years focused on contact center technologies including Amazon Connect and Zendesk, with partner\-facing or customer enablement experience preferred.
* Technical Expertise: Proficient designing solutions using Zendesk, Amazon Connect, AWS services (Lambda, Lex, IAM, DynamoDB, S3, API Gateway). Experience with Python and/or NodeJS is a plus.
* Enablement Skills: Demonstrated ability to deliver technical training and enablement to partners or customers.
* Leadership: Experience leading technical engagements involving multiple stakeholders including partners, internal teams, and vendors.
* Communication: Exceptional verbal and written skills with the ability to translate complex technical information for diverse audiences.
Problem Solving: Strong analytical skills and ability to devise creative technical solutions in partner\-centric contexts.  
* 

  

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Certifications: Zendesk certifications, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, or equivalent.
* Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with omnichannel contact center solutions, AI\-driven automation, workforce engagement management, and reporting tools.
* Agile Experience: Working knowledge of Agile and DevOps methodologies.

Please note that Zendesk can only hire candidates who are physically located and plan to work from Karnataka or Maharashtra. Please refer to the location posted on the requisition for where this role is based.


Hybrid: In this role, our hybrid experience is designed at the team level to give you a rich onsite experience packed with connection, collaboration, learning, and celebration \- while also giving you flexibility to work remotely for part of the week. This role must attend our local office for part of the week. The specific in\-office schedule is to be determined by the hiring manager.

Zendesk software was built to bring a sense of calm to the chaotic world of customer service. Today we power billions of conversations with brands you know and love.

d8c1ff57.title: Salesforce Technical Architect
d8c1ff57.description:
**Description**
 Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include—but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
   

  

 You are both a big picture thinker and in\-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution, including knowing how to leverage AI development tools like Claude and GitHub Copilot to optimize code quality and accelerate design cycles. The solutions you design are built for the long\-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API's as well as a strong development background.
   

  

**What You'll Actually Be Doing**
* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Translate business requirements into well\-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform, including identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI capabilities using Agentforce
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects, championing an AI\-First Delivery \& Engineering methodology by utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed, utilizing AI coding assistants to help enforce standards and optimize code performance
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation, championing the team's use of tools like GitHub Copilot to accelerate the generation of Apex classes, mock data, and REST integrations
* Focus on Performance Evaluation \& ROI by collaborating with customers to develop evaluation frameworks to measure AI performance and business value for their specific use cases
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues, leveraging AI diagnostics to interpret system logs and isolate performance bottlenecks quickly
* From time\-to\-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre\-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep\-dive sessions, Proof\-Of\-Concept (POC) development with prospects using AI tools to build prototypes rapidly
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50\-75%


**You're Our Person If...**
* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9\-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Community, Marketing, and Community Clouds, as well as an understanding of Agentforce architecture
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance\-driven solutions, including using AI platforms to evaluate architectural scaling and load limits
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices, with experience using AI tools to model data distribution and analyze potential data skew risks
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth) and how to configure them securely
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.), utilizing AI platforms to parse third\-party REST API documentation and map complex data schemas
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Practical fluency using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to accelerate delivery, document technical architecture, and maintain a high standard of code quality
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end\-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web\-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire.

 Volante Technologies is the leading global provider of low\-code cloud Payments as a Service solution for financial businesses. We are disruptors and innovators and we are growing fast. For the last three years, we have been the \#1 seller of wholesale payment systems worldwide. At Volante, we are all about revolutionizing the world of Payments.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are seeking an experienced Director – Cloud Infrastructure to lead the strategy, architecture, operations, and continuous evolution of our cloud platform supporting mission\-critical SaaS solutions in the fintech and payments domain. This role will be responsible for ensuring high availability, scalability, security, operational excellence, and cost optimization across Azure and AWS while leading a global 24x7 infrastructure organization.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Define and execute the cloud infrastructure strategy aligned with business and technology objectives.
* Lead and develop high\-performing teams across:



 o Cloud Operations \& Production Support
 



 o Network Operations Center (NOC)
 



 o DevOps \& Platform Engineering
 



 o Middleware Services (Kafka, RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ, IBM MQ, IBM Connect: Direct)
 



 o Database Administration (MongoDB, SQL Server, Oracle)
 



 o Cloud Networking
 



 o Cloud Architecture
 


* Ensure platform reliability, scalability, security, disaster recovery, and operational resilience while meeting customer SLAs.
* Drive automation, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD, observability, and operational excellence initiatives.
* Partner with Engineering, Product, Security, Customer Success, and Compliance teams to deliver secure and resilient cloud platforms.
* Lead major incident management, executive escalations, capacity planning, and continuous service improvements.
* Own cloud governance, infrastructure standards, technology roadmaps, vendor management, and cloud cost optimization.



  





**Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline (Master's preferred).
* 15\+ years of IT Infrastructure experience with at least 8 years leading enterprise infrastructure or cloud organizations.
* Proven experience managing global 24x7 operations supporting enterprise SaaS platforms.
* Strong experience in fintech, payments, banking, or other highly regulated environments is preferred.



  





**Required Skills** 



* Mandatory hands\-on experience with both Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS).
* Strong understanding of cloud architecture, Kubernetes, networking, DevOps, Infrastructure as Code, observability, disaster recovery, and security best practices.
* Experience managing enterprise middleware, databases, and cloud infrastructure at scale.
* Mandatory Certifications: Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert OR AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional.



  





**Preferred Skills** 



* Strategic leadership, operational excellence, customer focus, people development, executive communication, financial acumen, incident leadership, stakeholder management, and continuous improvement.



  





**Equal Opportunity Statement** 




 At Volante Technologies, we believe diversity drives innovation and inclusion fuels success. We are committed to creating a performance driven workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic self to work. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and ensure equitable opportunities for growth. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, age, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. Together as ONE TEAM, we celebrate differences and foster collaboration, creativity, and belonging.

ddc0c023.title: Digital Solutions Consultant I
ddc0c023.description:
**About us**Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI\-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.
  

  

**The Role**

***As a*** **Digital Solutions Consultant I** ***with Worley,*** you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.


* Possess strong architectural and implementation knowledge of enterprise AI solutions leveraging Databricks AI Gateway as a centralized control plane for: LLM access, Agent orchestration, Model governance, Policy enforcement, Telemetry collection, Rate limiting, Prompt protection, Observability.
* Work in close collaboration with Cloud, DevOps, Security, Infrastructure, and Platform Engineering teams to design and operationalize unified agentic AI workflow platforms across cloud and on\-prem ecosystems.
* Demonstrate expertise in integrating enterprise AI services and platforms including AWS Bedrock, Azure AI Foundry, ServiceNow AI Agents, Oracle AI Services, NVIDIA on\-prem AI infrastructure using Run.AI, MCP servers and direct agent integrations.
* Partner with observability and platform teams to design enterprise\-grade telemetry and observability pipelines using Open Telemetry (OTEL).
* Collaborate with Security and Governance teams to ensure telemetry, traces, logs, prompts, model outputs, alerts, and usage metrics from external systems are consolidated into: Databricks MLflow, Databricks system tables, Unity Catalog governed environments.
* Work alongside Security Operations and SIEM teams to enable downstream integrations with Azure SIEM / Microsoft Sentinel for enterprise monitoring, governance, and security operations.
* Possess strong understanding of secure AI access patterns and collaborate with Security and IAM teams to implement: Managed identities, Federated identities, IAM, RBAC, Least privilege access models.
* Partner with business, operations, and platform teams to build operational and executive dashboards using: Power BI, Databricks Dashboards.
* Collaborate with Cloud and FinOps teams to monitor and optimize: LLM usage costs, Agent execution costs, Infrastructure utilization, API consumption.
* Work with enterprise API management and DevOps teams to design and operationalize integrations using: Azure API Management (APIM), AWS API Gateway.
* Support automation, CI/CD integration, platform reliability, governance enforcement, and operational excellence initiatives in coordination with DevOps and SRE teams.
* Contribute to enterprise AI platform standards, reusable architecture patterns, security controls, governance frameworks, and operational best practices.

**About You**

To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:


* We are seeking a highly motivated and hands\-on Technical Solution Architect (with 15\+ years of experience) to help design and implement a unified enterprise AI and agentic workflow platform centered around Databricks AI Gateway.
* The role requires strong architectural knowledge across enterprise AI ecosystems, observability, governance, cloud platforms, security frameworks, and operationalization of large\-scale AI/LLM environments.
* The ideal candidate should possess a deep understanding of Databricks, AI/LLM platforms, multi\-cloud architectures, observability frameworks, identity and access management, API gateways, and enterprise governance models.
* The architect will collaborate extensively with Cloud Engineering, DevOps, Platform Engineering, Security, Infrastructure, and Operations teams to deliver a centralized, secure, observable, scalable, and governed enterprise AI platform across cloud and on\-prem environments.

1b335075.title: Sr. Salesforce Developer - Sales Cloud
1b335075.description:
**Req ID:** 386505
  
  

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  

We are currently seeking a Sr. Salesforce Developer \- Sales Cloud to join our team in Delhi, Delhi (IN\-DL), India (IN).
  
  

Role Overview
  
  

We are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Sales Cloud Developer to design, develop, and deliver scalable CRM solutions on the Salesforce platform. The role involves deep technical expertise in Sales Cloud, strong hands\-on development capabilities, and the ability to work across cross\-functional teams to drive business outcomes.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

1\. Salesforce Development Customization
  
* Design and develop custom solutions on Salesforce Sales Cloud using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and Aura.
* Implement complex business logic using Triggers, Batch Apex, Queueable, and Future methods.
* Build and customize objects, workflows, validation rules, flows, and approval processes.
* Develop reusable and scalable components aligned with best practices and governor limits.


2\. Sales Cloud Expertise
  
* Implement and enhance core Sales Cloud functionalities including:
* Leads, Accounts, Contacts, Opportunities
* Pipeline and Forecasting
* Territory Management
* Sales Process Automation
* Optimize sales workflows and user experience for business efficiency.


3\. Integration API Development
  
* Design and implement integrations using:
* REST/SOAP APIs
* Middleware tools (e.g., MuleSoft preferred)
* Work with external systems like ERP, Marketing, or Data platforms.
* Handle event\-driven integrations using Platform Events and Change Data Capture.


4\. Data Management Security
  
* Manage data models, data migration, and data quality.
* Implement role hierarchy, sharing rules, profiles, and permission sets.
* Ensure compliance with security and governance standards.


5\. Release Deployment Management
  
* Work with CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Copado, Gearset, Jenkins).
* Manage deployments across environments using SFDX and DevOps best practices.
* Support release planning, version control, and rollback strategies.


6\. Performance Optimization
  
* Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks.
* Optimize queries, code, and configurations to stay within Salesforce governor limits.


7\. Stakeholder Collaboration
  
* Work closely with business analysts, architects, admins, and stakeholders.
* Translate business requirements into technical design and solutions.
* Provide technical guidance and mentor junior developers.


Required Skills Qualifications
  
  

Technical Skills
  
* Strong hands\-on experience in:
* Apex, SOQL, SOSL
* Lightning Web Components (LWC)
* Salesforce configuration (Flows, Process Builder, Validation Rules)
* Experience with Sales Cloud implementations.
* Proficiency in Salesforce APIs and integrations.
* Knowledge of DevOps tools and CI/CD pipelines.


Experience
  
* 5–8\+ years of Salesforce development experience.
* At least 3\+ years specifically in Sales Cloud.
* Experience working in enterprise\-scale environments.


Certifications (Preferred/Expected)
  
* Salesforce Platform Developer I (mandatory)
* Salesforce Platform Developer II (preferred)
* Salesforce Sales Cloud Consultant (highly preferred)
* Additional certifications are a plus:
* Integration Architecture Designer
* Application Architect


Soft Skills
  
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical thinking.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management.
* Ability to work in agile and fast\-paced environments.
* Leadership and mentoring capabilities.


Nice to Have
  
* Experience with MuleSoft or other integration platforms.
* Exposure to Data Cloud or Einstein/AI capabilities.
* Knowledge of Salesforce CPQ or Revenue Cloud.
* Experience in global delivery / managed services model.


Key Deliverables / Success Metrics
  
* High\-quality, scalable Salesforce solutions.
* Reduced defects and faster delivery cycles.
* Improved sales process efficiency and user adoption.
* Stable production environment with minimal downtime.


About NTT DATA
  
  

NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100\. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise\-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start\-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in RD.
  
  

Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in\-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. At NTT DATA, we are committed to staying flexible and meeting the evolving needs of both our clients and employees. NTT DATA recruiters will never ask for payment or banking information and will only use @nttdata.com, @nttdatafed.com and @talent.nttdataservices.com email addresses. If you are requested to provide payment or disclose banking information, please submit a contact us form, https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact\-us.

If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please contact us at https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact\-us. This contact information is for accommodation requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications. NTT DATA is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. 57c65310.title: MIST - Delivery Manager
57c65310.description:
**About M\&G India**

  

We are M\&G India, the strategic innovation and digital hub for M\&G. Established in 2003, we have offices in Mumbai and Pune.

  

Our teams work closely with colleagues across the Group worldwide to drive transformation, build digital capability, and support sustainable growth. By leveraging technology, AI, automation, and process excellence, we bring new ways of thinking to improve outcomes for both customers and colleagues.

  

Grounded in a vibrant culture with strong foundations, we are central to how M\&G is transforming as a business.

 **About M\&G**

  

Our purpose is to give everyone real confidence to put their money to work. With a heritage dating back more than 175 years, we have a long history of innovation in savings and investments, combining asset management and insurance expertise to offer a wide range of solutions.

  

Our two distinct operating segments, Asset Management and Life, work together to provide access to balanced, long\-term investment and savings solutions.

  

Through telling it like it is, owning it now, and moving it forward together with care and integrity; we are creating an exceptional place to work for exceptional talent.

 **Delivery Manager – Model Development**


Working within the **Model Implementation \& Support** team, part of the **Actuarial Modelling \& Valuations** function in **M\&G Finance**, this role is responsible for coordinating the delivery of model development activity across a complex portfolio of change. The role requires **strong delivery management experience**, with the ability to turn agreed scope into clear plans, coordinate stakeholders across teams, and maintain momentum through effective tracking, issue management and communication.

**What you’ll do**


Scope \& prioritisation

* Collate and shape model development scope, ensuring alignment with business priorities and strategic objectives, and that changes to agreed scope are assessed and agreed through a change control process
* Coordinate input to assess effort, dependencies and delivery options
* Support agreement of funding and resource allocation with relevant budget holders


Delivery planning \& execution

* Develop and maintain clear delivery plans with named owners, milestones, dependencies and progress tracking
* Drive disciplined execution through effective resource planning, RAID management and regular check\-ins with delivery owners
* Ensure delivery activity remains aligned across workstreams and that emerging issues are surfaced early


Progress \& risk management

* Provide regular progress updates, including clear issue flagging, escalation routes and recommended actions
* Track costs against agreed funding and highlight any emerging risks or pressures
* Maintain RAID logs, supporting timely resolution


Governance \& stakeholder communication

* Prepare materials for key meetings and governance forums, track actions and ensure appropriate follow\-up
* Support engagement with internal review teams and external audit where required
* Provide clear communication to stakeholders on progress, risks, dependencies and actions needed to keep delivery on track


Cross\-initiative coordination

* Coordinate delivery across related model development initiatives to support joined\-up implementation and effective handover into valuation and reporting processes

  

We have a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture at M\&G Global Services, regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, nationality, disability or long term condition, we are looking to attract, promote and retain exceptional people. We also welcome those who take part in military service and those returning from career breaks.

6e8fdc24.title: Technical Delivery Manager
6e8fdc24.description:
We are looking for a highly skilled Technical Delivery Manager to join us on an exciting journey as we modernize our core platforms to make them Simpler, Leaner and more Efficient. You will utilize your strong industry and domain expertise to shape up our Technology product offerings to meet the Business requirements for the future. You'll harness cutting\-edge technology to revolutionize our digital offerings, ensuring unparalleled customer experiences.
   

  

 To be successful as a Technical Delivery Manager you should have experience with:
   

  

  

* Experience in managing large multi\-year complex projects involving global teams, through the full project lifecycle from inception to implementation.
* Collaborating with an experienced team of SMEs, Operations, Dev managers, and other Global Business stakeholders to understand the requirements and project deliverables.
* Managing Risks, Assumptions, Issues and Dependencies closely, across all aspects of the project.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, together with well\-developed collaborative mindset.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* Formal credentials in PMP/SAFE.
* Estimation skills for tasks, including design, development, technical debt, and testing.
* Exposure to Cloud Technologies (public or private).
* Understanding of any Liquidity Management or Core Banking Product suite.


 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 The role is based out of Pune.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To manage the efficient delivery of large\-scale technical projects and capabilities across the bank and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to understand their needs and expectations throughout the software product lifecycle, adhering to agreed time, budget and quality requirements.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Management of the delivery, resource allocation and improvement of complex technical project capabilities across the bank using Agile/Scrum methodologies for planning, stand\-ups, demos, retrospectives and the execution of sprints.
* Collaboration with customers and business teams to manage and implement customer trails to support the proposal of technically feasible solutions, and effort and timeline expectations.
* Collaboration with software engineers, quality teams, product managers and other engineering teams to deliver high\-quality products and features through the software project lifecycle aligned to the banks objectives, regulation and security policies.
* Identification, assessment, and mitigation of risks associated with technical projects to prepare the bank for potential challenges.
* Management of change requests and communication with stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
* Management of vendor relations involved in technical projects to ensure they deliver according to agreed terms.
* Stay abreast of the latest industry technology trends and technologies, to evaluate and adopt new approaches to improving deliver outcomes and to foster a culture of continuous learning, technical excellence and growth.


**Vice President Expectations**
* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi\-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In\-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.
