3dd6ccab.title: Lead Technical Program Manager
3dd6ccab.description:
**About Us**
 Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
   

  

 At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
   

  

 Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
   

  

**Overview**
**Job Description**
 Commercial and Money Movement Solutions (CMS) within Visa has a strategic growth initiative to expand beyond core consumer card payments (C2B) and into broader money movement flows between individuals, businesses, and governments. The investments that Visa has made over decades in C2B provide Visa with the infrastructure, technical capability, brand, expertise, and relationships to tap into money movement between a much broader coupling of counterparties (B2B, B2b, B2C, P2P, G2C, G2B, etc.). The target market opportunity of more than 185T in potential volume is a Board\-level aspiration for the company, with an aggressive net revenue CAGR forecast of 25%\+ over the next five years.
   

  

 Visa is evolving from legacy Agile to outcome\-led, telemetry\-driven, human\-accountable delivery to unlock faster innovation, greater customer impact, and higher productivity through a single agentic pipeline with Human in the loop.
   

  

 Visa Commercial Solutions (VCS) is a key business within (CMS responsible for growing all flows between businesses and governments from SMBs to the largest global corporates. We enable business and government entities of all sizes to thrive in dynamic global and local markets, by providing innovative end\-to\-end payment capabilities and frictionless experiences that simplify the critical processes that businesses perform daily. These critical processes include managing expenses, compliance, vendors and reporting and of course, making payments. Our suite of products and solutions deliver better cash flow, productivity, administrative efficiency, reconciliation, control and acceptance for clients. Visa is the number one payment network for small businesses, and we are rapidly growing our depth and breadth of solutions for large corporates and governments. We work closely with Issuers, Merchants, FinTechs and other ecosystem players to deliver these services.
   

  

 The VCS PMO team has responsibility for driving transformation, enabling and orchestrating the end\-to\-end delivery on Fiscal year OKRs and organizational strategy. The team works collaboratively with Product Development, Product Management, Operations \& Infrastructure, Cyber\-Security, Client Services, and other key enterprise teams, across both global and region stakeholders, ensuring collaboration, alignment, governance, execution, and delivery.
   

  

 The VCS PMO team has responsibility for driving transformation, enabling and orchestrating the end\-to\-end delivery on Fiscal year OKRs and organizational strategy. The team works collaboratively with Product Development, Product Management, Operations \& Infrastructure, Cyber\-Security, Client Services, and other key enterprise teams, across both global and region stakeholders, ensuring collaboration, alignment, governance, execution, and delivery.
   

  

 Lead Technical Program Manager for Visa Commercial Solutions will provide oversight and governance on cross\-functional delivery of the VCS programs \& initiatives as well as ensure seamless and timely planning, prioritization and execution, leveraging the Visa Agentic Tool Chain (VATC). This role is critical for a successful delivery of the 2030 Strategic objectives and milestones on the product \& technology roadmap.
   

  

 The person must possess a can\-do attitude, a growth\-oriented mindset, process\-focused and an ability to deal with change and ambiguity. Candidates must have a high technical background, extremely data centric and analytical, and be willing to learn new technologies, leverage Claude Code, Gen AI and other Agentic AI technologies to optimize and govern the programs. (S)he must understand the products and solutions being developed and possess a keen business acumen. Experience in Enterprise Operational methodologies (Agentic, Agile, Stage gate) is highly preferred.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Deep expertise in steering and implementing large scale product development transformations from ground up and act as a point of contact with geographically disbursed teams where risk and ambiguity is high, and outcome driven.
* Manage the team’s growth, learnings, and overall development while aligning with the organization’s and PMO’s goals.
* Partner with Product \& Technology leads to drive and ensure effective Annual Operational Planning, Quarterly Product Reviews and program reviews leveraging Visa Enterprise tools (GitHub, ServiceNow, Clarity, Power BI, Jira/Jira Align).
* Help and facilitate prioritization of Initiatives \& Epics (Product requirements) that align to the Objectives \& Business Results (OKRs) and available workforce capacity.
* Manage resource rosters for their Portfolios or Team of Agentic Squads in Jira, Jira Align and Polaris
* Manage program forecasts, budgets, labor capitalization and asset depreciation/amortization.
* Ensure effective participation of the teams in the Quarterly Planning activities across programs, collaborating with partners in Operations \& Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, and other Visa Technology verticals.
* Ensure that the program and projects follow Visa's Agentic Lifecycle Methodology and Key Controls, and that accurate and timely information is reported regularly on program progress and financial status in various forums and reporting modes.
* Act as a coach and mentor to the PMO team and the scrum teams on adopting agile best practices. Be the leader in advancing the ongoing transformation to Visa’s Agentic Lifecycle Management Operating Model.
* Learn and adopt Visa’s Secure Software Development Lifecycle Management (SSDLC), Golden Rules, release management and Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) processes.
* Provide telemetry in quality, flow, and value metrics\-based reporting to all stakeholders, hold regular program\-level reviews
* Cultivate a mindset of rigorous planning \& prioritizing while proactively identifying risks and dependencies to accelerate value realization.
* Manage cross\-functional communications to maximize understanding, impact, and speed of change adoption.
* Act as a coach and mentor to the Engineering, PMO and Product teams on adopting agile best practices and a cadence of portfolio, program \& team level ceremonies.
* Capture metrics \& measurables that clearly indicate progress toward accomplishment of Reimagining Work at Visa Initiative.
* Develop a rigor for understanding and leveraging the productivity, quality, flow, usage, adoption , and value\-based metrics to accelerate benefit realization.
* Generate and improve the agility metrics (performance, predictability, and persistency) by optimizing and governing the Visa processes for planning, budgeting, prioritization, delivery, release management, workforce planning and stakeholder (ELT, SLT) reporting.
* Assist and support with External (FFIEC) \& Internal audits on the program. Ensure that all programs supported by the PMO adhere to always audit compliant processes.
* Ensure that identified security vulnerabilities are addressed and remediated in a timely manner to prevent non\-compliance. Ensure that exceptions are obtained in a timely manner and kept to a minimum.
* Volunteer for additional responsibilities related to Visa processes, cross\-functional project governance and hiring of team members and participate in required fire drills.


 Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Essential Qualifications:
   

  

* 16\+ years of work experience in technical program management or software development with a Bachelor s Degree or at least 10 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g., Masters/MBA/JD/MD) or at least 5 years of work experience with a PhD.
* Experience developing plugins \& agents using Claude Code, cline or other AI Agentic tools
* Enterprise Program Management Tools (Jira, Jira Align, (Clarity, Primavera, HP PPM etc.).
* Scaled Agile Certification (SAFe for Teams, Leading SAFe, Implementing SAFe, SAFe for Release Train Engineers).
* Experience with analytical reporting tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI.)
* Experience with productivity and collaboration tools, including GitHub, Share point, Microsoft Teams, Wiki pages, Microsoft 360 copilot etc
* Experience in managing large\-scale engineering and operational projects.
* Experience in driving alignment with business objectives across multiple teams.
* Experience in implementing advanced project management techniques.
* Experience in promoting innovation within technical program management.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Scaled Agile Framework Certified – SAFe Agilist or SAFe Program Consultant
* Program Management Professional (PgMP) and/or Project Management Professional (PMP).
* Experience with JIRA Align, Tableau, Power BI.
* Experience with project management techniques software development lifecycle in a Fin\-Tech background scrum or agile experience.
* Experience with productivity and collaboration tools, including Share point, Microsoft Teams, Wiki pages, Microsoft 360 copilot etc.
* Experience leveraging Artificial Intelligence/Machine learning to improve. effectiveness of the Product delivery.


**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

34346ee6.title: Technical Program Manager
34346ee6.description:
Job Description: Technical Program Manager (Hackathons \& Innovation Challenges)
 



 Position: Program Manager
 



 Location: Noida, UP, India (On\-site)
 



 Type: Full\-Time
 



  





**The role** 




 You are the single point of ownership for every program you run — end to end, from pre\-launch kickoff to the final debrief. Not the coordinator of it: the owner. Scope, the client relationship, and the final call all sit with you.
 



 What makes this role different from a conventional program management role is where the ownership comes from.
 



 You will be the trusted partner for our clients and the central hub for all internal teams, ensuring that every hackathon is delivered flawlessly, on time, and within budget. This role is for a natural leader who thrives on structure, excels at communication, and has a passion for turning ambitious ideas into reality.
 



  





**What you'll own** 



* Technical program design. Problem statements, evaluation criteria, judging rubrics, and tech\-stack fit. You decide what a good submission looks like and defend that standard to clients and juries.
* End\-to\-end program ownership. Multiple concurrent programs from post\-sales handover through delivery and debrief. Scope, objectives, timelines, and resourcing are yours to define.
* The client relationship, post\-sales. Primary point of contact once sales hands over. You set expectations, manage change, and are the voice on technical scope and feasibility — including on what isn’t deliverable.
* Strategic program architecture. You build the blueprint. Defining objectives, resource allocation, and timelines is your domain. You ensure every component is technically sound and logistically viable before a single line of code is written.
* Internal cross\-functional bridge. You lead the charge across Marketing, Operations, and SME teams. You are the glue that keeps diverse internal stakeholders aligned and focused on delivering a cohesive product.
* Risk and quality gatekeeping. Spotting friction before it happens. You own the mitigation strategies and maintain a relentless standard for the participant experience and final deliverables.
* Scope and fiscal discipline. You hold the line on the budget and the agreed\-upon roadmap. Using rigorous verification, you ensure we deliver exactly what was promised without slippage.
* External partner synchronization. Managing the ecosystem. You direct third\-party vendors and partners to ensure their contributions integrate seamlessly into the live event execution.
* Documentation and executive reporting. Maintaining the narrative of progress. You provide clear, direct visibility on milestones and technical hurdles to both clients and our leadership team.
* Jury and participant experience. Recruiting and briefing evaluators, running the judging process with rigour, and making sure the experience holds up for developers and students who chose to spend a weekend on it.



  





**What you'll need** 



* Deep technical fluency. You can hold an architecture\-level conversation with a client, a jury, or a partner without escalating it. You can read a submission and judge whether it actually works. Hands\-on coding is not required — credible technical judgement is non\-negotiable.

**About Globals:**
 Globals has drastically grown from a small home office to a globally recognized enterprise offering world\-class quality solutions on Cybersecurity, Cyberwarfare, ERP Systems, AI, and Enterprise Application Development for various industries including Defence, Education, Government, Financial Services and Transport Industries. Globals has enabled its customers to be game\-changers in their industry through its disruptive and innovative solutions. Globals is certified as a "Great Place to Work" organization for its laudable work culture that helps its team members manage work\-life, have dedicated hours to upskill and reskill themselves, and most important to ensure that the projects that they are working on are always unique, challenging their status quo every time. Our unique work culture has made us one of the world’s fastest\-growing technology companies as recognized and featured by The Economist. Our excellence in technical stewardship and service\-offering expertise has facilitated our clients ranging from individual entrepreneurs to Fortune Global 500 – to explore new business opportunities, reduce their operational costs significantly and boost their revenues. Today, Globals enjoys a strong position in the industry as a high\-performing leader through its technology innovation and remarkable domain expertise. Globals is a CMMI Level 5 certified company.
   

  

**Role Summary:**
 We're hiring a Pre\-Sales Consultant to be the technical bridge between our engineering teams and defence and government buyers — DRDO labs, MoD units, PSUs, and system integrators. You'll own technical positioning, proof\-of\-concept delivery, and RFP/tender responses across our satellite \& space cybersecurity, drone security, SDR/RF security, and PKI/quantum\-safe cryptography lines, translating deep technical capability into solutions that mission stakeholders can evaluate and buy.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Partner with the business development team on defence and government accounts to understand mission requirements, threat models, and procurement processes.
* Translate technical capabilities — PKI and quantum\-resistant cryptography, CCSDS/satellite protocols, MAVLink and C2 link security, SDR/RF hardening, cryptographic module compliance under India's IT Act/CCA framework — into clear solution narratives for both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Lead technical discovery calls, site visits, and stakeholder briefings with defence and government customers.
* Design and deliver proofs\-of\-concept and live technical demonstrations across satellite/space cyber, drone/UAV security, and SDR/RF capability areas.
* Own the technical sections of RFP, RFI, and tender responses, working with engineering and the technical writing team to produce compliant, credible submissions aligned to DRDO/MoD procurement formats.
* Build and maintain technical collateral — solution briefs, architecture diagrams, and capability decks — with correct handling of sensitive and controlled information.
* Track the competitive landscape and relevant compliance frameworks (MoD Cyber Security Policy, CERT\-In guidelines, ISRO/DRDO standards) that shape active bids.
* Support pricing and BOM discussions with technical trade\-off input, and coordinate with legal on NDA, export\-control, and classification requirements.


**Requirements**
* 3\-5 years of experience in pre\-sales, solutions engineering, or technical account management, ideally within defence electronics, aerospace, satcom, or cybersecurity.
* Demonstrated prior experience working within the Indian defence industry — DRDO, MoD, Defence PSUs, or a defence\-focused System Integrator/OEM — is required.
* Working knowledge of at least two of: satellite/space systems (CCSDS, ground segment operations), drone/UAV platforms and C2 links (MAVLink, PX4/ArduPilot), SDR/RF security (GNU Radio, SDR hardware), or PKI/cryptography (X.509, IT Act/CCA crypto compliance, post\-quantum crypto).

* Engineering degree (CS, ECE, Aerospace, or related field); willing to travel to defence and government establishments.

**Nice to have:**

* Bilingual in Hindi and English for government stakeholder communication.
* Relevant certifications in RF engineering, cryptography, or embedded security.

1024a844.title: Solutions Strategist - APAC
1024a844.description:
**The Team** 




**Team:** 
 Solutions Strategists, part of Wingify's global PreSales organization
 



**Coverage:** 
 APAC \- East Asia, South East Asia, ANZ and India
 



**You'll work with:** 
 the VP Sales APAC, regional Account Executives and Solutions Engineers, and the Solutions Strategist covering Europe and MEA
 



**Role overview:** 
 You will be Wingify's first dedicated Solutions Strategist in APAC, building the strategic PreSales practice for the region from the ground up alongside existing regional Sales and Solutions Engineering teams.
 



**Who We Are** 




 Wingify is a global leader in experimentation, personalization and conversion rate optimization, born from the merger of AB Tasty and VWO. Together, we help some of the world's most ambitious brands turn insight into revenue across every digital touchpoint.
 



 With teams spanning Europe, the Americas, MEA and Asia\-Pacific, we partner with enterprise customers across retail, travel, media and financial services to build and scale high\-performing CRO and CXO programs. As we grow our Enterprise footprint globally, we're expanding the PreSales organization that makes our biggest deals win.
 



**Your Mission** 




 As a Solutions Strategist, you own the strategic and business narrative on Wingify's most complex Enterprise and strategic deals. You partner with the Account Executive and the Solutions Engineer as one team. Your work is structured around four levers:
 



 •
 **Differentiate:** 
 build one coherent strategic narrative across the entire pre\-sales journey, frame competitive differentiation at every step, and strategize ahead of an upcoming opportunity on strategic and key deals.
 



 •
 **De\-Risk:** 
 address the perceived risks that stall Enterprise evaluations (switching cost, resourcing, governance readiness, and CRO/CXO maturity) through direct CXO\-level conversations
 



 •
 **Visualize:** 
 make Wingify's impact tangible for each specific deal (tailored market and vertical insight, tool/suite fit, use cases built from real analysis of the prospect's business, and competitive positioning.)
 



 •
 **Prove:** 
 turn a ROI model into a business case narrative the Champion can defend in front of Finance, translating gains, savings and break\-even into language a CFO expects.
 



 Beyond the four levers, you will:
 


* Contribute to the strategic response and differentiation on complex, competitive RFPs.
* Steer multi\-stakeholder POCs and complex evaluations, facilitating decisions across technical and business stakeholders.
* Act as an evangelist for Wingify at conferences, webinars and workshops.



**What You'll Bring** 




**Core Competencies** 



* **Organizational Diagnosis:** 
 Assess an organization's CRO/CXO maturity and political dynamics within a single conversation, asking the right questions to enrich the Sales team's account intelligence.
* **Business \& Technical Diagnosis:** 
 Spot optimization opportunities at a glance and reframe a functional brief into the 2\-3 underlying problems Wingify can solve.
* **Product \& Solution Mastery:** 
 Understand how our solutions work well enough to quickly assess use case feasibility, propose new ones, and recommend the most relevant products for a prospect's context.
* **Consultative Posture:** 
 Hold consultative conversations on the execution of a CRO/CXO strategy, including on challenges peripheral to the tools themselves such as governance, resourcing or process.
* **Narrative \& Competitive Positioning:** 
 Build a narrative that puts our tools' value into sharp relief and position effectively in an intensely competitive context.



**Mindset \& Behaviors** 



* Active listening and organizational acumen : reads stakeholder dynamics and unspoken politics, not just stated requirements.
* Analytical thinking and structured problem\-solving : synthesizes and prioritizes quickly under ambiguity.
* Intellectual curiosity and learning agility : genuine appetite to dig into how things work without waiting for all the answers.
* Consultative presence and executive credibility : comfortable challenging a prospect's thinking without arrogance.
* Communication and storytelling : clear and compelling at executive level, composed under competitive pressure.
* Multi\-threading and autonomy : manages multiple stakeholders, issues and deals in parallel, structuring the approach on each account independently.



  





 If you don't meet 100% of these qualifications, tell us why you'd still be a great fit for this role in your application!
 



**Why You'll Love It Here** 



* Make a Real Impact: sit at the center of Wingify's biggest deals and directly influence win rate and deal size.
* Ownership \& Autonomy: no micromanagement, just the freedom to own your region's strategic deals.
* International Culture: collaborate with a diverse, global PreSales, Sales and Product organization spanning Europe, the Americas, MEA and APAC.
* Career Development: vast opportunities for professional growth as Wingify scales its Enterprise footprint globally.



**Details** 




**Contract:** 
 Permanent, full\-time
 



**Location:** 
 India
 



**Remote:** 
 100% remote
 



**Reporting line:** 
 Solutions Strategist Director

5b23f31f.title: Senior Systems Engineer (Pre Sales)
5b23f31f.description:
**Company Description**
 Arista Networks is an industry leader in data\-driven, client\-to\-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. Arista is a well\-established and profitable company with over $9 billion in revenue. Arista’s award\-winning platforms, ranging in Ethernet speeds up to 800G bits per second, redefine scalability, agility, and resilience. Arista is a founding member of the Ultra Ethernet consortium. We have shipped over 20 million cloud networking ports worldwide with CloudVision and EOS, an advanced network operating system. Arista is committed to open standards, and its products are available worldwide directly and through partners.
   

  

 At Arista, we value the diversity of thought and perspectives each employee brings. We believe fostering an inclusive environment where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome is essential for driving creativity and innovation.
   

  

 Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as the Great Place to Work Survey for Best Engineering Team and Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work\-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest quality and performance standards in everything we do.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Who You'll Work With**
 When you join Arista as part of the Sales Engineering team, you're not just stepping into a role, you're becoming part of a team of industry experts and technical leaders. Typically reporting to the System Engineering Manager, you'll be working alongside some of the most skilled field engineers in the industry. Our team prides itself on not just understanding the technology but also the business impact and aligning our solutions with the larger goals of our clients. In collaboration with our Product Management and Software Development teams, you will play a pivotal role in steering product developments, offerings, and strategic direction to best serve our customers and prospects. Supported by the expertise of our world class Arista TAC, cutting\-edge proof\-of\-concept resources, and support of the executive team, you are well\-positioned to lead and innovate within the industry.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 We are experiencing tremendous growth and have an immediate need for a collaborative, self\-motivated Senior Systems Engineer to partner with our Account teams to provide pre\-sales technical systems engineering support for our enterprise/commercial customers in the Western India area.
   

  

* The Systems Engineer is a critical component of the Arista Sales team with the key responsibility of acting as a trusted advisor for our customers to gather requirements and identify opportunities with existing and new customers.
* You will partner with the Arista Account Managers to understand customer pain points and conduct white board network architectural reviews in addition to conducting Arista product presentations of Arista’s Open Networking Data Centre and Cognitive Campus (including Wi\-fi) networking solutions, CloudVision (Network Automation), Security (Network Detection \& Response), Endpoint Security and Real\-time Fabric Monitoring solutions.
* You will architect, design and propose Arista Data Centre \& Campus network solutions using leaf\-spine architectures (VxLAN, EVPN) and network overlays to capture additional sales.
* Perform hands\-on tests to validate customer proof\-of\-concept setups, Data Centre and/or Campus network designs, and network deployments using new products and features
* Put together design guidelines and recommend improvements to customers for the networks they support
* Partner with Sales Team to respond to RFP/RFQs
* Provide feedback to Product Management and Engineering
* Represent Arista at SDN and Open Networking industry events and conferences
* Keep up\-to\-date on competitive solutions, products, and services
* Author white papers on technology and product.


**Qualifications**
* BE/BS/CS/CE technical degree required
* Network Industry Certification preferred (e.g. CCIE (R\&S), JNCIE)
* You possess a minimum of 10\+ years of L2/L3 networking design and implementation experience with a focus on Data Centre and Campus networks.
* You possess expert level expertise in routing and switching including L2/L3 protocols (Cisco, Juniper, Extreme, Aruba)
* Demonstrated work experience as either a Sales Engineer, Solutions Architect, Pre\-Sales SE or Network Consulting Engineer preferred
* Previous experience with network overlays preferred.
* Expert knowledge in three or more of the following areas: Ethernet, RSTP/ MSTP, VLANs, IP Routing, TCP/IP, BGP, eBGP, VxLAN, EVPN, Multicast, Spanning Tree, QoS
* Expert\-level knowledge of industry\-standard CLI
* Experience with SDN and Network Function Virtualization (NFV) highly desired.
* Previous experience building network automation using Python and Ansible desired.
* Knowledge of competitive products, solutions, and services
* Ability to write white papers a plus.


**Additional Information**
 Arista stands out as an engineering\-centric company. Our leadership, including founders and engineering managers, are all engineers who understand sound software engineering principles and the importance of doing things right.
   

  

 We hire globally into our diverse team. At Arista, engineers have complete ownership of their projects. Our management structure is flat and streamlined, and software engineering is led by those who understand it best. We prioritize the development and utilization of test automation tools.
   

  

 Our engineers have access to every part of the company, providing opportunities to work across various domains. Arista is headquartered in Santa Clara, California, with development offices in Australia, Canada, India, Ireland, and the US. We consider all our R\&D centers equal in stature.
   

  

 Join us to shape the future of networking and be part of a culture that values invention, quality, respect, and fun.

b7bf1a90.description:
**Company Description:** 
 NEXUS AIDC is a San Francisco\-based AI infrastructure company building the intelligent operating layer for next\-generation AI data centers. We are part of the NVIDIA Inception Program, Intel Partner Alliance, and AWS for Startups, positioning NEXUS within a global ecosystem advancing AI compute and data center infrastructure. Our platform brings together infrastructure observability, AI workload performance, DCIM, FinOps and intelligent operations to help enterprises and data center operators manage increasingly complex AI infrastructure at scale.
 



 We are looking for an ambitious, technically sharp Pre\-Sales Engineer (Solutions Engineer / Sales Engineer) with 2 to 3 years of experience to support our growing enterprise sales efforts across the Middle East and Asia\-Pacific (APAC).In this role, you will work alongside our commercial and technical teams to deliver compelling product demos, support technical evaluations (PoCs), and answer technical questionnaires for enterprise prospects. If you have a solid foundation in cloud infrastructure or Kubernetes, enjoy working with customers, and want to learn how modern AI clusters and cloud economics work at scale, this is an exceptional opportunity to accelerate your career.
 



  





**What you will do** 



* Prepare and deliver clear, hands\-on product walkthroughs showing prospective customers how our platform tracks multi\-cloud costs, monitors container spend, and identifies idle infrastructure waste.
* Assist customers during Proof\-of\-Concept stages by helping configure integrations, connecting telemetry feeds (Prometheus, OpenTelemetry), and validating that data is flowing correctly.
* Complete technical RFP/RFI responses, security questionnaires, and architecture checklists, coordinating with senior engineering colleagues when deep architectural escalations are needed.
* Shadow discovery conversations with client platform engineers and DevOps leads across the Middle East and APAC to understand their current cloud setup, pain points, and monitoring tools.
* Use APIs and basic scripting to customize demo environments, simulate cost scenarios, and showcase specific customer use cases.
* Proactively use AI assistants and modern productivity tools to draft proposal sections, format data, and speed up turnaround times on customer queries.



**Required Qualifications:** 



* 2–3 years of hands\-on experience in technical pre\-sales, technical support, cloud engineering, or customer\-facing solutions engineering.
* Solid practical knowledge of at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, GCP, or OCI) and core concepts around compute, storage, and networking.
* Practical understanding of Docker and Kubernetes concepts (pods, namespaces, resource requests/limits).
* Familiarity with modern monitoring and metrics tools (such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or OpenTelemetry).
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with the confidence to run technical presentations and demos for prospective buyers.
* Based in or comfortable supporting accounts across the Middle East (GCC) and APAC time zones.
* A clear drive to master emerging areas like GPU workload economics, modern AI infrastructure, and FinOps.



**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Basic familiarity with cloud billing concepts (AWS Cost Explorer, Azure Cost Management, or basic FinOps principles).
* Exposure to basic scripting in
 
 Python, Bash, or SQL to query data or test REST APIs.
* Familiarity with on\-premises data centers, private cloud setups, or power metrics (PUE).
* Exposure to enterprise customers in the GCC or Asia\-Pacific region.



**Why Now** 




 NEXUS is expanding globally. We are actively scaling our footprint across our core international theatres, with APAC and the Middle East representing our most dynamic, rapidly accelerating frontier for AI infrastructure adoption. We are hiring exceptional engineering, operational, and customer\-facing technical talent to drive our organization forward. If you are an autonomous, high\-conviction professional who wants your next decade of work to sit at the intersection of AI, infrastructure, and enterprise software at the precise moment the market is being decided — we want to talk to you.

3919123c.title: Principal Solution Architect

****About SKF****

 SKF is the world leading supplier of products and solutions in the bearing business including technical support, maintenance services, condition monitoring and training.
   

  





 The inherent skills and competence of our around 40,000 employees help us to fulfill our objective of creating more intelligent, sustainable and innovative customer solutions. SKF is a truly global company with presence in more than 130 countries, serving an extensive range of industries and customers worldwide. SKF started its operations in India in 1923\.
   

  





 SKF has hands\-on experience in over 40 industries with knowledge and a vast product portfolio across the SKF technology platforms: bearings and units, seals, lubrication systems, condition monitoring equipment, and services.
   

  





 We operate in regions – China \& North East Asia (CNEA), Europe \& Africa, India, South East Asia \& Middle East (ISEAM) , The Americas – to serve customers with speed and responsiveness.
   

  





 SKF has been in India since more than 100 years and has a pan India footprint consisting of 6 manufacturing facilities, 12 offices, a supplier network of over 300 distributors and an employee base of more than 2600 dedicated professionals.
   

  





 To know more, please visit: www.skf.com/in
   

  





**Innovation is the key:**




 We make some of the world’s most innovative products and solutions to reduce friction. But we sell something bigger. Less friction means more energy saved. And it means that society can move forward to a more energy\-efficient future where we can all do more with less.
   

  





**Sustainability:**




 At SKF, we have a long history of working with industrial sustainability. It is an integral part of what we do every day. And we strive to create engagement throughout the business, not only by implementing sustainability on a strategic level, but also by encouraging the ideas and grass root projects initiated by our people around the world.
   

  





****About Technology Development****




 As a team, we're responsible for global research, technology development, product development and technology strategy. Our group strategy is that 25 percent of our growth should come from new products. Filling that funnel with new and bold innovation is one of the things that we do. We bring customer value by combining our unique knowledge and technology in products and solutions with sustainability to develop ‘Intelligent \& Clean’ solutions." \- Annika Ölme, CTO and Senior Vice President, Technology Development
   

  





**Digital Engineering \& Innovation**




 Digital Engineering \& Innovation team is an international team based in multiple countries across the globe. We serve customers and distributors directly through services like Bearing Assist mobile application and AI enabled search on skf.com and provide immediate support for product selection and troubleshooting. Additionally, we support customers indirectly by offering solutions such as Engineering Tools, Product Lifecycle Management, Configurators, and Design Solutions. Many of these are AI\-enabled, secure, and compliant with industry standards. We collaborate with various SKF teams to create a digital ecosystem, develop innovative solutions, and enhance our entire value chain to add value to our customers
   

  





**SKF Purpose Statement**




 Together, we re\-imagine rotation for a better tomorrow.
   

  





 By creating intelligent and clean solutions for people and the planet

**Job Title:**

**Reports To** 
 : Director \& Global Head, Digital Engineering \& Innovation (DE\&I)
   

  





**Location** 
 : Bangalore
   

  





**Role Purpose :**




 The Lead Solution Architect drives the development and maintenance of Digital Engineering \& Innovation (DE\&I) Architecture to create visualizations comparing current and future states of Digital Engineering \& Innovation products and services. The role entails aligning SKF IT infrastructure with DE\&I and Technology Development Business requirements, ensuring IT systems and technologies are optimized to effectively support business objectives.
   

  





**Key Responsibilities:** 
  

  





* 
+ Lead the architecture and design for a future platform of sales, products and services by assessing existing systems and emerging business models and needs.
+ Continuously research, evaluate, and implement new technologies within DE\&I and TD.
+ Analyze existing systems and processes to identify opportunities for cost reduction and efficiency gains.
+ Maintain clear communication with DE\&I Management and Global IT to confirm alignment between systems and business needs.
+ Evaluate market technology options for suitability, including software and hardware solutions.


**Candidate Profile :** 
  

  





* 
+ Qualification \- Master’s or bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Electronics or related fields
+ Overall Experience – 15\+ Years (5\-10\+ years of software development experience and 5\+ years of leading architectural decisions or teams)
+ Knowledge of cloud computing, enterprise data management \& IT infrastructure
+ Proficiency in programming languages \& database management
+ Familiarity with EA frameworks like TOGAF, ZACHMAN or GARTNER
+ Understanding of RESTful APIs, GraphQL, and event\-driven systems
+ Working knowledge of development operations and automation like Kubernetes etc.
+ Knowledge of identity and access management (IAM), encryption, and compliance frameworks (GDPR, HIPAA, ISO).
+ Soft skills: Strategic Thinking, communication, leadership, ability to explain technical concepts to non\-technical audience






****About SKF****




 SKF has been around for more than a century and today we are one of the world’s largest global suppliers of bearings and supporting solutions for rotating equipment. With more than 40,000 employees in around 130 countries, we are truly global. Our products are found everywhere in society. In fact, wherever there is movement, SKF’s solutions might be at work. This means that we are an important part of the everyday lives of people and companies around the world. See more, at www.skf.com.

OPENTEXT \- THE INFORMATION COMPANY
  
OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We're hiring talent that AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.

This role has administration emphasis, combined with the consultative skills required to promote the impression of quality and excellence actively fostered within the Customer Success Services.
  
Engagements may vary from managing multiple short and relatively fast paced engagements, to larger projects depending upon levels of experience. The nature of work may include supporting full application lifecycle activities right from development, deployment/provisioning, testing, migration, decommissioning and ongoing run\& maintain (upgrades, patching etc.) support of the cloud deployments.
  
  

The role is customer facing and requires excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate to a wide range of stake holders (internally and externally), both verbally and in writing.

Work within an OpenText technical delivery/consulting team in order to:
  
  

* Participate and contribute to Project execution phases
* Participate in the day to day administration of the systems, including Incident\& Problem Management
* Participate in execution of new implementations, upgrades and patching activities.
* Participate in the advanced configuration of CS software components, in line with project and customer time scales.
* To co\-ordinate project delivery through multiple teams that may include 3rd party suppliers, partners and client resources.
* Actively contribute in identifying opportunities for automating day to day activities where possible to achieve operational efficiencies.
* Actively seek new opportunities by working with the customer and the change control provisions provided by the contract, to extend the scope of profitable business.
* Actively use and contribute to the project management standards and quality checks used within OpenText Cloud Services.
* Understand requirements, conduct detailed design, determine level of effort, plan work breakdown structures and implementation approach
* Prepare, maintain and submit activity/progress reports and time recording/management reports in accordance with published procedures. Keep project managers informed of activities and alert of any issues promptly. Provide inputs as part of engagement closure on project learnings and suggest improvements
* Manage expectations and responsibilities for all client and internal stakeholders.
* Utilize exceptional written and verbal communication skills while supporting customers via web, telephone, or email, while demonstrating a high level of customer focus and empathy.
* Respond to and solve customer technical requests, show an understanding of the customer's managed hosted environment and applications within the Open Text cloud enabling resolution of complex technical issues. Document or Implement proposed solutions.
* Respond to and troubleshoot alerts from monitoring of applications, servers and devices sufficient to meet service level agreements
* Collaborating on cross\-team and cross\-product technical issues with a variety of resources including Product support, IT, and Professional Services.


What you will need to succeed
  
Well versed with deployment, administration and troubleshooting of the OpenText Content Suit Platform and surrounding components (Content Server, Archive Server, xECM, Brava, OTDS, Search\& Indexing). Experience with Cloud deployment of the Content Suit Platform will be advantage.

Hier wirst du für das, was du bist, wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert. Dies schafft ein Umfeld, in dem du sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich wachsen kannst. Werde Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.
  
  

Die Position
  
  

Job description
  
The ERP Solution Consultant leads independently complex ERP solution delivery, proactively solves product issues, and contributes to architecture. In this role, you will guide product teams, champion accountability, and effectively communicate with all stakeholders. You will solve complex problems, make independent product\-level decisions, provide technical oversight, and report at the product or product line level. By bringing advanced ERP knowledge, in\-depthexpertise in key areas, and strong analytical skills, you will actively contribute to continuous improvement and team development.
  
Description of the area
  
Job Responsibilities
  
  

* Scope / (ContentLeadership): Works and leads independently to deliver solution design and products with increased complexity (e.g., technical, scope, stakeholders) in the ERP area that meet product requirements and business priorities. Proactivelyidentifies issues at the product level, proposes ideas on how to tackle them, and keeps applying a continuous improvement mindset. Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the product lifecycle, andleads the development of approaches to be used across product teams/squads.Researches, evaluates, pilots, and drives the adoption ofnew technologies while providing technical oversight and consultation.
* Accountability/Problem Solving: Determines methods and procedures on assignments and coordinates or guides the activities of others in the team. Champions accountability by example (such as taking tech lead and/or product owner roles) and helps drive the successful completion of major programs or product milestones.Solves complex problems which require the regular use of ingenuity and creativity, taking a new perspective on existingsolutions and exercising judgment based on the analysis of multiple sources of information. Independently makes decisions with impact at the squad/product level under limited direction.
* Stakeholder Management: Interacts within and across multiple product squads within a domain, working directly with all stakeholders in the Chapter and Domains. Communicates information, issues, and potential solutions to the product team or squad and to external stakeholders. Proactively communicates across project work\-streams, taking responsibility for fostering teamwork, resolving confusion or miscommunication, andfacilitating discussions.
* Impact/Strategy: Makes an impact that is typically limited to a product orinitiatives in a section or cluster.Identifies opportunities and improves existing solutions to enhance value and business processes, providing technical oversight and guidance for the product teams.
* Complexity / (Product Size): Demonstrates the ability to plan, prioritize, and report status at the product (or even product line) level. Contributes to talent acquisition and capability development, for instance by screening CVs, interviewing candidates, and organizingtrainings.
* Business / Technical ability: Applies advanced knowledge of ERP IT concepts and practices,possessing general and in\-depth knowledge in one or two ERP and technology areas.


Qualifications
  
Education / Experience
  
  

* Demonstrated experience working and leading independently to deliver complex solution designs and products within the ERP area.
* Proventrack record of driving the successful completion of major programs or product milestones,frequently functioning in a leadership, tech lead, or product owner role.
* Experience contributing to talent acquisition and capability development, including mentoring, interviewing, and organizing training.


Technical Skills
  
  

* Advanced knowledge of ERP IT concepts and practices, with general and in\-depth knowledge in one or two specific ERP\& technology areas.
* Extensive understanding of tools, principles, concepts, and techniques related to requirements, data, usability, and process analysis.
* Good knowledge of architecture practices, and the ability to document and evolve architecture throughout the product life cycle.
* Intermediate level of business process domain knowledge.


1\. Solution Design\& Architecture
  
  

* Lead end\-to\-end implementation and configuration ofSAP Batch Release Hub for Life Sciences onSAP BTP.
* Architect cross\-system data flows between SAP S/4HANA (QM, MM, PP\-PI), third\-party Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS), Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), and Document Management Systems (DMS) into the BRH.
* Design data models andleverageSAP HANA DB capabilities to ensure high\-performance querying and aggregation of batch genealogy, inspection lots, and regulatory release data.


2\. Configuration\& Integration
  
  

* Configure SAP BRH business rules, release check suites, release decision triggers, and Quality Department authorization structures.
* Setup integration adapters viaSAP Integration Suite / CPIutilizing public APIs and REST services.
* Establish integrations withSAP Global Batch Traceability (GBT) or S/4HANA Batch Genealogy to perform multi\-tier genealogy checks.
* Manage extension development onSAP BTP (CAP/RAP models, Node.js/Java, or SAP Fiori/UI5\) for customized release check logic or localized compliance rules.


3\. Compliance, Validation\&GxP
  
  

* Ensure all technical implementationsstrictly comply withGxP, FDA 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, and EMA guidelines.
* Configure secure electronic signature workflows, audit logging, and data freezing mechanisms uponrelease decision confirmation.
* Prepare and execute Computer Software Validation (CSV) deliverables, including Functional Specifications (FS), Configuration Specs, IQ/OQ/PQ protocols, and Traceability Matrices.


4\. Collaboration\& Support
  
  

* Partner directly with Quality Assurance (QA), Regulatory Affairs, and Qualified Persons (QPs) to translate life sciences business requirements into functional BRH features.
* Troubleshoot deployment issues on SAP BTP subaccounts, Identity Authentication Services (IAS/IdP), and destination services.


Required Qualifications\&ExperienceTechnical Skills
  
  

* SAP Batch Release Hub (BRH): Hands\-on configuration experience with SAP Batch Release Hub for Life Sciences.
* SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform): Proven experience navigating BTP Cockpit, Cloud Foundry, SAP Integration Suite (CPI), Extension Suite, Destination Service, and Identity Authentication Service (IAS).
* SAP HANA / S/4HANA: Strong background in SAP S/4HANA Quality Management (QM), Materials Management (MM), Production Planning (PP\-PI), and Core Data Services (CDS) views / HANA DB querying.
* Integration Expertise: Solid knowledge of OData, REST APIs, JSON/XML handling, and middleware integration patterns connecting SAP and non\-SAP platforms (LIMS, MES, Veeva,Syncade).


Domain\& Compliance Knowledge
  
  

* Industry Experience: Minimum 3–5 years of experience in the Life Sciences, Pharmaceuticals, or Biotechnology sector.
* GxP\& Regulatory Standard: In\-depth understanding of GMP, Electronic Signatures (21 CFR Part 11\), Audit Trails, and CSV frameworks.


Education\& Soft Skills
  
  

* Education: Bachelor’s orMaster’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Pharmacy, Industrial Engineering, or related fields.
* Certifications (Preferred): SAP Certified Development Associate (SAP BTP) or SAP Certified Integration Associate.
* Strong problem\-solving, analytical, and communication skills to bridge technical delivery teams with quality business users.


Additional Qualifications
  
  

* Strong collaboration and inclusion mindset, capable of resolving conflicts at the team level and fostering effective teamwork across project work\-streams.
* High level of self\-direction and initiative, with the ability and willingness to learn in a self\-directedfashion to stay informed onnew technologies and concepts.

Wer wir sind
  
  

Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation an. Mehr als 100\.000 Mitarbeiter weltweit arbeiten gemeinsam daran, wissenschaftliche Fortschritte zu erzielen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und für zukünftige Generationen. Durch unser Engagement werden über 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt und mehr als 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostik\-Produkten durchgeführt. Wir ermutigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und hohe Ziele zu setzen, um lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen zu liefern.

c39c616d.title: SAP EWM Architect, AWS FinTech
c39c616d.description:
We are seeking a highly experienced SAP Warehouse Management Architect to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for leading the architecture, design, implementation, and support of SAP warehouse management solutions, ensuring efficient warehouse operations, scalable system design, and seamless integration with enterprise platforms. The candidate is expected to provide expert guidance on SAP warehouse management best practices and serve as a key design authority across implementation, transformation, and rollout initiatives.



Key job responsibilities


* Lead and manage warehouse management processes and solution design in SAP systems.
* Architect, configure, and support SAP warehouse management solutions, including inbound, outbound, internal warehouse movements, putaway, picking, packing, staging, replenishment, physical inventory, and handling unit management.
* Conduct solution assessments and implement process improvements and mitigation strategies for warehouse and logistics challenges.
* Ensure compliance with internal operational standards, warehouse controls, and process requirements.
* Lead SAP Warehouse Management projects, including implementations, rollouts, template design, upgrades, and enhancements.
* Develop and maintain solution design documents, architecture standards, process documentation, procedures, and support materials.
* Monitor warehouse management processes and integrations for failures or process issues and drive corrective actions as necessary.
* Conduct regular system and process reviews and provide detailed reports on findings and recommendations.
* Work closely with other IT, business, operations, supply chain, and integration teams to ensure seamless integration of SAP Warehouse Management with other SAP and non\-SAP systems.
* Provide guidance, training, and support to end users, project teams, and junior consultants on warehouse management\-related processes and issues.
* Act as the architecture lead for warehouse solution design across multiple warehouses, business units, or geographies.
* Drive standardization of warehouse processes, solution templates, and integration patterns across the organization.

### **Basic Qualifications**


* 6\+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics) experience
* 6\+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 7\+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

### **Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience working within software development or Internet\-related industries
* Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
* Experience working with AWS technologies from a dev/ops perspective

6a5d18d2.title: Sr. Engagement Manager, AWS Professional Services India
6a5d18d2.description:
AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud. We are looking for a Senior Engagement Manager to lead and deliver complex, multi\-workstream cloud transformation programs for AWS Professional Services (ProServe) India. In this role, you will own the end\-to\-end delivery lifecycle of large and complex customer engagements, shaping cloud strategies, driving business outcomes, and acting as a trusted advisor to senior customer stakeholders. The ideal candidate is an experienced program leader with deep IT consulting expertise, a proven track record in delivering complex technical programs across enterprise customers, and the ability to navigate ambiguity with limited guidance. You thrive in a fast\-paced, growth environment, insist on incredibly high standards, and are passionate about mentoring others and scaling delivery best practices across teams. You will lead matrixed teams of AWS consultants, partners, and customer resources across multiple workstreams simultaneously. You are expected to drive delivery excellence, maximize engagement value, manage risks proactively, and serve as a force multiplier for your peers and the broader organization. You will actively contribute to pre\-sales, build deep customer trust, and leverage AI/GenAI to drive delivery innovation. In this capacity you will be based in India and are expected to travel occasionally (30\-40%). You will report into the India ProServe Engagement Management Delivery Practice Manager.



Key job responsibilities


* Own and lead end\-to\-end delivery of complex, multi\-workstream cloud transformation programs, ensuring business outcomes are achieved within schedule, scope, and financial constraints.
* Shape and validate cloud delivery strategies for complex engagements, applying frameworks such as the Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF), Well\-Architected Framework (WAF), and Engagement Delivery Framework (EDF).
* Serve as a strategic advisor to senior customer stakeholders, leading steering committees, driving alignment, and building deep trusted relationships.
* Proactively identify, manage, and escalate risks and issues; develop and execute mitigation plans; redirect distressed programs to delight customers.
* Maximize engagement value by negotiating conditions of acceptance, managing scope changes, and amending contractual terms within project constraints.
* Drive delivery excellence across engagements by defining and sharing EM best practices, creating reusable mechanisms, and establishing operational excellence.
* Actively mentor and develop team members; perform Technical Promotion Assessments (TPAs) and coach Engagement Managers to raise the bar.
* Participate in pre\-sales activities, contributing to proposals, scoping, and business development for complex services engagements.
* Leverage Agentic AI and GenAI to optimize delivery processes, improve team productivity, and drive innovative customer outcomes.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional AWS teams including Delivery Consultants, Account Executives, Cloud Architects, and Partner teams to solution and deliver cloud programs.


About the team Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.



Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.



Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.



Mentorship \& Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.



Work/Life Balance We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.


### **Basic Qualifications**


* 7\+ years of leading multiple Agile teams (like Scrum Masters, Product Owners) concurrently or at scale experience
* 7\+ years of leading and delivering enterprise\-level IT engagements experience
* Knowledge of the value proposition of the public cloud and cloud engagement delivery (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS)
* Experience with Agile and project management toolsets like Jira, Rally, VersionOne or Taiga
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 7\+ years of project/program management experience

### **Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience working with and presenting to C\-level executives, IT, and lines of businesses across organizations or equivalent
* PMP, Prince2, PgMP, SAFe or SCRUM/Agile certification
* 9\+ years of working with Data \& AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage experience

Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

d8b3d62d.title: FinOps & Cloud Architecture Engineer
d8b3d62d.description:
*Cloud \& Infrastructure Team \| Full\-Time \| Mid\-Level (7 –12 years)*
****About The Role****
 We're looking for a FinOps \& Cloud Architecture Engineer who can bridge the gap between engineering and finance. You'll design and maintain scalable, secure cloud infrastructure while owning the cost side of the equation — tracking spend, identifying waste, and building the tagging, budgeting, and forecasting practices that keep cloud costs predictable as we scale. This is a hybrid role for someone who's as comfortable in a cost\-allocation spreadsheet as they are in a Cloud knowledge.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
**Cloud Architecture**
* Maintain cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, and/or GCP) that is secure, scalable, and cost\-efficient.
* Build and manage Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar).
* Evaluate architecture decisions (compute, storage, networking) for both technical fit and cost impact.
* Support migrations, right\-sizing initiatives, and adoption of managed/serverless services where they reduce cost or operational overhead.
* Knowledge of Github


**FinOps**
* Own cloud cost visibility: build dashboards and reports for spend, forecasts, and budget variance across teams.
* Implement and enforce tagging, showback/chargeback, and cost\-allocation standards across cloud accounts.
* Identify and drive cost\-optimization opportunities — reserved instances/savings plans, spot usage, rightsizing, storage tiering, idle resource cleanup.
* Partner with business and Finance leadership on budgeting, forecasting, and unit economics for cloud spend.
* Track and report on FinOps KPIs (e.g., cost per unit, waste %, savings realized) and present findings to stakeholders.
* Evaluate and manage cloud cost\-management tooling (e.g., native cost tools, Flexera etc)


****Required Qualifications****
* 6–10 years of experience in cloud engineering, infrastructure, DevOps, or a related role, with meaningful exposure to cost management.
* Hands\-on experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP); working knowledge of a second is a plus.
* Solid understanding of cloud billing models, cost drivers, and optimization levers (reserved capacity, autoscaling, storage classes, etc.).
* Comfortable working with data — building reports/dashboards in tools like Excel, Looker, Tableau, or native cloud cost tools.
* Strong communication skills; able to translate technical cost drivers into terms Finance and business stakeholders understand.


****Preferred Qualifications****
* FinOps Certified Practitioner (FOCP) certification or equivalent.
* Cloud architecture certification (AWS Solutions Architect etc)
* Experience with Kubernetes cost management (e.g., Kubecost) and containerized workloads.
* Familiarity with FinOps tooling.
* Scripting ability (Python, Bash, or similar) for automating cost reports or cleanup tasks.


****What Success Looks Like****
* Cloud spend is fully tagged, allocated, and visible by team/product within the first few months.
* Architecture reviews consistently catch cost and reliability issues before deployment.
* Measurable, sustained reduction in cloud waste through concrete optimization initiatives.

018d3a51.title: Cloud Engineer (Windows,IIS)
018d3a51.description:
**Why Join IDX?** 




**Not Just Any Brands:** 
 See your work come to life for iconic brands like Vodafone, Rolls Royce and Diageo.
 



**Collaborative Spirit:** 
 Work alongside passionate innovators who share your thirst for progress.
 



**Continuous Learning:** 
 Grow your skills with ongoing training, mentorship, and the freedom to experiment.
 



**Fast Paced \& Fun:** 
 Thrive in a dynamic environment where big ideas and bold action collide.
 



**Cutting\-Edge Technology:** 
 Play with the latest analytics tools, use AR to build immersive digital events, and explore the future of brand storytelling!
 



**Global Presence:** 
 We Get It Done morning, day and night with offices across multiple time\-zones!
 



**Our Perks:** 



* 29 paid annual leave days.
* 10 Festival holidays (including 1 optional Holiday for your special day through the year).
* Family Insurance Plan.
* Accident Insurance Plan.
* Regular Wellness Sessions.
* Regular Rewards \& Recognition.
* Opportunity to participate in charity initiatives and volunteering.
* Opportunity to participate in Cultural and Sporting Events.



**The Gig:** 




 We are looking for a skilled Cloud Engineer to join our cloud infrastructure and DevOps team. The role involves managing cloud environments, application servers, and automation workflows. The ideal candidate will have prior experience in cloud technologies and system administration with the ability to troubleshoot, optimize, and deliver solutions in a 24x7 production environment.
 



**What you'll be doing:** 



* Install, configure, and maintain IIS/Apache/Nginx web servers.
* Deploy and configure .NET applications on IIS/Apache/Nginx with SSL integration.
* Analyze logs and troubleshoot application/server issues.
* Manage and secure Windows and Linux OS environments, including upgrades and patches.
* Develop automation scripts using PowerShell and Shell scripting.
* Ensure SLA\-based resolution of incidents and execution of changes.
* Configure and manage AWS services such as EC2, Route53, ALB, S3, CloudFront, ECS, VPC, RDS, AWS backup certificate manager, and Docker.
* Work with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, Docker).
* Handle networking concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, SSL/TLS).
* Provide production support in a 24x7 environment, including rotational shifts.



**About you:** 



* 3\-6 years of experience in Cloud/System Administration.
* Strong knowledge of AWS tools and services.
* Proficiency in PowerShell and Shell scripting.

Keep project managers informed of activities and alert of any issues promptly. Provide inputs as part of engagement closure on project learnings and suggest improvements

We're also committed to providing transformational opportunities for our own employees by investing in their growth. We aspire to create a culture that's built on trust, care, inclusion, and fun – where everyone can succeed.
   

  





 Join us to transform the way the world works.

The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.

We help businesses achieve their marketing ROI objectives with a suite of superior products that includes native advertising and programmatic. * Continued investment in educating and empowering the clients about the LinkedIn platform

* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including but not limited to, product, marketing, finance etc. to ensure best in class client experience
* Build strong, lasting client relationships by owning and delivering customer success through various market dynamics; cultivate deep partnership with key decision makers and influencers
* Build solution using data insights.
* Demonstrate the impact to the client and influence marketing spends.
* Demonstrate a deep understanding of marketing channels (offline/online etc) and marketing automation stacks.
* Provide integration / setup support for advertisers using LinkedIn ad technology partners

* Bachelor's degree in related field

**Preferred qualification:**

* Previous experience in a consulting role
* Experience of having worked on any of the marketing technology platforms such as Marketo, Adobe and Salesforce
* Experience of having worked on advertising technology platforms such as Doubleclick or Sizmek
