For us lasting trusted relationships are everything, both with our teams and our clients.
   

  

 We are looking for a developing Solution Architect who enjoys design work, stakeholder engagement, and turning delivery activity into supportable services. This role is suited to someone who has already contributed to solution designs and wants to further build their architecture career across cloud, service transition, vendor delivery, and operational readiness. It is not a hands\-on engineering role; the focus is on design quality by ensuring effective documentation, governance, vendor engagement, and ensuring new services can be successfully supported after go\-live by effective design.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
**In this role you will:**
* Support the design of new IT services across the full delivery lifecycle, from requirements and design through to build review, release readiness, handover, and early\-life support.
* Embed non\-functional requirements into solution designs, including availability, capacity, performance, security, monitoring, disaster recovery, recoverability, etc.
* Produce, review, and maintain design documentation, ensuring solutions are clearly described, traceable to requirements, and suitable for transition into IT support.
* Produce and review architecture artefacts including solution designs, architecture diagrams, and design decisions to support delivery and operational readiness.
* Assess vendor and internal delivery artefacts to confirm alignment with approved designs, cloud standards, security expectations, and operational requirements.
* Review handover materials, including operational documentation, monitoring and alerting requirements, service mapping, support models, and service readiness artefacts.
* Support the preparation, as the design SME, the release readiness packs, support hypercare planning, manage hypercare exit criteria, and ensure a clean handover to IT Support.
* Participate in CCoE, CAB, design reviews, release readiness reviews, post\-incident reviews, and other governance forums.
* Act as the interlock between functional teams, product owners, vendors, internal subject matter experts, and IT support teams.
* Support incident and problem management where design input is required, helping identify whether issues relate to design gaps, documentation gaps, integration issues, or weak handover.
* Contribute to policies, procedures, and delivery standards with the Enterprise Architect and Data Architect, with a focus on making them practical and usable across delivery and support.
* Improve delivery and handover practices by supporting the standardising of templates,
* improving documentation quality, and raising the operability of new IT services.
* Ensure knowledge capture, clear service mapping, and up\-to\-date documentation in agreed repositories.


**We would love to hear from you if you:**
* Have 5 to 8 years’ experience primarily in solution architecture, technical design, or a developing Solution Architect type roles.
* Can show evidence of producing, contributing to, or reviewing solution designs, architecture diagrams, and design documentation, rather than solely delivering hands\-on engineering activity, plus can show understanding of the importance of traceable designs, support models, runbooks, monitoring requirements, service mapping, and clean handover into operational teams.
* Have good Azure cloud knowledge, including integration patterns, security, and operational support considerations.
* Have experience working across the delivery lifecycle, including requirements, design documentation, vendor engagement, build review, release readiness, handover, and early\-life support.
* Can engage well with vendors, product owners, functional teams, architects, support teams, and technical subject matter experts.
* Can challenge constructively when requirements are unclear, documentation is incomplete, or a solution is not ready to transition into support.
* Are detail\-oriented, quality\-focused, and comfortable assessing whether documentation is complete, understandable, and fit for delivery \& support use.
* Communicate clearly with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders and can explain design decisions in plain language


**Nice to have:**
* Have or are working towards relevant cloud certifications, ideally Azure certifications such as AZ\-305 or equivalent cloud certifications
* Have knowledge of other Cloud Hosting platforms such as Google Cloud or Amazon Web Services
* Have experience using Jira and Confluence, and/or Azure DevOps, to track delivery activity, document decisions, manage actions, and maintain knowledge.
* Ideally have familiarity with security and compliance practices such as ISO 27001\.
* Have working knowledge of Azure FinOps \& Policy Management
* Exposure to Oracle, Salesforce, SAP, or other enterprise SaaS platforms and enterprise integration patterns, or middleware platforms.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code, or modern cloud delivery practices.


 All interviews are conducted either in person or virtually with video required.

 Linesight is a highly successful global project and cost management consultancy that keeps clients coming back. And for that we have our people to thank. You see we’re not like the others. We’re different. Unique. It’s our fresh thinking and focus on what matters that has led to our evolving. We are on a journey working in some of the most exciting innovative sectors with some of the world’s most prestigious companies delivering major projects that deliver a more sustainable built environment. We have an open culture and a flat structure where you can expect to be treated with genuine care, respect, and empathy.  Linesight is committed to transparent, equal opportunity employment practices. 78ac9ed0.title: Delivery Manager
78ac9ed0.description:
**Technical Delivery Manager**
 Who We Are
   

  

 Bidgely (which means "electricity" in Hindi) is an AI\-powered SaaS company accelerating a clean energy future by enabling energy companies and consumers to make data\-driven energy\-related decisions. Ranked \#7 in Applied AI on Fast Company’s list of Most Innovative Companies in the World, Bidgely is putting customers at the center of the clean energy future.
   

  

 What We Do
   

  

 Powered by our unique patented technology, Bidgely's UtilityAI™ Platform transforms multiple dimensions of customer data—such as energy consumption, demographics, and interactions—into deeply accurate and actionable consumer energy insights. We leverage these insights to empower each customer with personalized recommendations tailored to their individual personality and lifestyle, usage attributes, behavioral patterns, purchase propensity, and beyond.
   

  

 How We Do It
   

  

 From a distributed energy resources (DER) and grid edge perspective, Bidgely advances smart meter innovation with data\-driven solutions for solar PVs, electric vehicle (EV) detection, EV behavioral load shifting and managed charging, energy theft, short\-term load forecasting, grid analytics, and time\-of\-use (TOU) rate designs. Bidgely’s UtilityAI™ platform provides deep visibility into generation and consumption for better peak load shaping and grid planning and delivers targeted recommendations for new value\-added products and services.
   

  

 For more information, please visit:
   

  

* Website: www.bidgely.com
* Blog: bidgely.com/blog


**About The Role**
 We are looking for a Delivery Manager to head a cross\-functional team in implementing and configuring our product solutions for enterprise\-level clients. This role demands extensive technical leadership, people management, and project ownership skills, ensuring thorough quality checks and leading innovative approaches (e.g., GenAI, automation) to streamline delivery. You’ll collaborate closely with internal engineering, R\&D, QA, and support teams, receiving high\-level, outcome\-based requirements from our Technical Program Managers.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Strategic Leadership \& Team Management
   

  

* Manage, mentor, and inspire a team of engineers and project leads, ensuring a high standard of performance, engagement, and professional growth.
* Develop and optimize team structures, resource planning, and talent development strategies to scale delivery capabilities.
* Foster a culture that values ownership, accountability, innovation, and continuous learning.


 Senior\-Level Project Delivery
   

  

* Translate complex, outcome\-driven requirements from Technical Program Managers into comprehensive project roadmaps and execution plans.
* Oversee multiple, concurrent implementation projects—coordinating internal teams to ensure timely, budget\-conscious, and high\-quality releases.
* Communicate progress, risks, and mitigation strategies effectively with senior stakeholders and leadership.


 Quality Assurance \& Release Management
   

  

* Establish and uphold rigorous quality controls, encompassing functionality, data integrity, performance, and user acceptance criteria.
* Work with QA resources (matrixed or dedicated) to align on testing strategies, automation frameworks, and release protocols.
* Drive continuous improvement in release readiness processes and performance metrics.


 Technical Innovation \& Problem\-Solving
   

  

* Provide deep\-dive technical guidance, from code\-level debugging to data\-level analysis, empowering the team to solve complex challenges.
* Collaborate with R\&D to integrate new product features seamlessly, ensuring reliable configurations for enterprise\-scale use cases.
* Champion the introduction and application of cutting\-edge tools—including GenAI—to automate, optimize, and simplify implementation workflows.


 Process Optimization \& Automation
   

  

* Identify and implement strategic improvements to reduce manual effort, boost delivery speed, and maintain consistent quality across projects.
* Promote documentation, best practices, and standardized procedures to drive efficiency and scalability.
* Leverage metrics, analytics, and user feedback to iterate on processes and evolve best\-in\-class delivery methodologies.


**Requirements**
 Experience \& Education
   

  

* 7\+ years of experience in software delivery, implementation, or technical program/project management, with progressive leadership responsibilities.
* Proven track record of managing large\-scale, cross\-functional projects in fast\-paced or enterprise environments.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; an advanced degree (MBA, MS) is a plus.


 Technical Expertise
   

  

* Demonstrated proficiency in software configuration, integration APIs, data pipelines, debugging, and system performance optimization.
* Hands\-on experience tackling complex technical issues at both application and data levels.
* Familiarity with automation frameworks, DevOps practices, and emerging technologies (e.g., GenAI).


 Leadership \& Communication
   

  

* Strong background in leading and mentoring high\-performing technical teams, including architects, senior developers, and QA leads.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, capable of interfacing with executive\-level audiences.
* Adept at guiding cross\-functional groups toward common goals and managing change in a dynamic environment.


 Domain Knowledge
   

  

* Experience in the energy or utilities sector is beneficial, but not required.
* Ability to adapt rapidly to evolving industry trends and new technologies.


 Equal Opportunity Statement
   

  

 Bidgely is an equal\-opportunity employer. We are serious about and embrace diversity and equal opportunity. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills to build a better future and a better workforce.

f9f80030.title: Staff Program Manager – Expert Readiness & Engagement (India)
f9f80030.description:
**Overview**
------------


At Intuit, our global network of thousands of tax, bookkeeping, and financial experts is the human intelligence (HI) that powers our AI\-driven financial technology platform. This position is a critical regional leadership role within Intuit's Expert Network, focused on the expert brand, operational readiness, change management, and engagement of our India\-based expert community.

  

As the Staff Program Manager of Expert Readiness \& Engagement (India), you will serve as the essential connective tissue between our global product/experience strategies and our local Indian expert footprint. Your mission is to ensure that when new technology, workflows, or product updates are introduced, the India network is 100% prepared to execute flawlessly. You will focus inward — architecting site branding, driving localized engagement strategies, managing internal communication, and leading regional change management frameworks. By leveraging continuous listening loops, you will ensure our India expert community is trained, equipped, and culturally aligned to deliver delight to our global customers.

 **Responsibilities**

*Lead Regional Change Management \& Expert Readiness*

* Deployment Orchestration: Act as the strategic partner to central expert readiness and change management and corresponding COEs for global tool deployments and product releases. Own the regional readiness roadmap for India, mapping out dependencies, training timelines, and process variations
* Impact \& Friction Assessment: Conduct change impact assessments to understand how global platform updates uniquely affect the Indian workforce. Identify and mitigate potential operational risks before deployment
* Adoption Tracking \& Hypercare: Define and monitor tool adoption metrics. Lead post\-launch "hypercare" support structures locally to quickly address technical glitches or operational confusion during critical peak seasons

*Establish Local Listening Infrastructure \& Process Rigor*

* Gemba \& Observational Studies: Establish a disciplined cadence of "Gemba" walks and workflow shadowing to observe real\-time tool usage, capturing friction points that quantitative metrics might miss
* Continuous Feedback Loops: Set up regional listening posts and pulse\-survey frameworks tailored to capture the daily sentiment, technical health, and overall tools readiness of the India network
* Insights\-to\-Action Root Cause Analysis: Partner with the global Expert Voice \& Insights team to translate local workflow friction into structured, data\-backed business requirements for the core product engineering backlog

*Drive Internal Engagement, Site Experience, and Communications*

  

* Strategic Communication Alignment: Manage regional internal communication channels, translating complex technical rollouts and global updates into clear, actionable, and culturally contextualized narratives for our experts
* Site Identity \& Brand Advocacy: Partner with local facilities and global creative stakeholders to guide physical and virtual site branding, creating a workplace environment that fosters deep brand pride and a unified mission
* Culture of Excellence: Design and scale localized engagement initiatives that boost community belonging, maintain high engagement scores, and celebrate "magic moments" where experts leverage AI to delight customers

 **Qualifications**

*Experience \& Change Management Domain Expertise*

* 8–10\+ years of experience leading Program Management, Change Management, or Operational Excellence initiatives within a global technology company or a highly scaled Global Capability Center (GCC) in India
* Change Management Frameworks: Direct expertise applying structured change methodologies; Certified Change Management Professional (CCMP) or equivalent credentials preferred
* Rollout Architecture: Proven history of successfully landing complex, multi\-stakeholder software migrations or tool deployments across a large workforce of distributed users
* Operational Listening: Deep familiarity with setting up workforce feedback loops, executing Gemba\-style observational studies, and parsing qualitative feedback into structured data

*Leadership \& Influence*

  

* Cross\-Border Autonomy: Exceptional ability to operate as a self\-driven regional anchor, managing local delivery while maintaining matrixed alignment with a global cross\-functional team in the US
* Stakeholder Management: Strong capability to navigate tension between global tech timelines and local operational realities, advocating fiercely for the expert experience while respecting product launch goals
* Strategic Communications: Elite verbal, written, and presentation skills with a demonstrated ability to synthesize highly technical changes into intuitive, empathetic workforce communications

  

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers \| Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

* Comfortable with ambiguity and able to navigate through uncertainty while maintaining focus on program objectives.


Why Cisco?
  
  

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  

Disclaimer

* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx


Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. * Experience managing cross\-functional technical programs with multiple teams, team members, dependencies, delivery constraints, and production launch requirements.

* Stakeholder management and identify blockers, evaluate tradeoffs, and lead practical decisions.
* Experience running meetings and maintaining delivery artifacts using tools such as Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, Google Workspace, or equivalent tools.
* Perform initial MR reviews for delivery completeness, documentation quality, test evidence, dependency impact, and scope alignment while partnering with engineers for detailed technical validation.
* Practical experience using AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT Enterprise, or approved internal AI assistants to improve productivity, communication quality, meeting summaries, documentation, risk identification, and decision support.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting programs involving Snowflake, dbt, AWS, Power BI, Airflow, Python, or similar data engineering technologies.
* Experience working with Finance, Sales, Marketing, Customer, or Product data domains.
* Experience managing release readiness, production launch planning, dependency management, or enterprise\-scale delivery coordination.
* Experience creating executive\-level program updates, dashboards, delivery scorecards, or operational reporting.
* Experience with Agile, Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, or hybrid delivery models.
* PMP, CSM, SAFe, AWS, Snowflake, dbt, or other relevant certifications.
* Experience working with globally distributed teams across multiple time zones.


 Avalara is an AI\-first Company
   

  

 AI is embedded in our workflows, decision\-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.
   

  

* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI\-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges \- improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

Our growth is real \- we're a billion dollar business \- and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission \- to be part of every transaction in the world.
   

  

 We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.

30431c58.title: Presales & Solutioning Lead – CRE, Connected Factory, Data Centre
30431c58.description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE** 




**Overview** 




 We are seeking a highly motivated Presales \& Solutioning Lead to act as the techno\-commercial bridge between Ecolibrium's business development team and enterprise customers across commercial real estate (CRE), connected factories and data centres. The role will lead discovery, design solution architectures and drive proof\- of\-concepts and pilots that demonstrate quantifiable value, including energy savings, uptime improvement and maintenance cost reduction, across discrete and process industries.
 



  





 The Presales \& Solutioning Lead will work closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Delivery and Procurement to translate customer requirements into robust technical solutions, proposals and implementation plans, and will lead technical selling through to deal close alongside the sales team. This is a hands\-on presales role requiring strong technical solutioning, stakeholder management, commercial acumen and the ability to simplify complex Industry 4\.0 concepts for business audiences, and requires 8–10 years of relevant experience.
 



  





**THE WORK** 




**Key Responsibilities** 




 • Lead site walkthroughs, stakeholder workshops and requirement deep\-dives across production, maintenance, energy and IT/OT teams in CRE, connected factory and data centre environments.
 



 • Build ROI/TCO models with clear KPIs, including power reduction, demand optimisation, asset uptime and MTBF/MTTR improvement across electrical, mechanical and workplace solutions.
 



 • Apply working knowledge of HVAC and mechanical controls concepts across CRE, manufacturing and retail environments.
 



 • Design end\-to\-end solutions spanning sensors/gateways, connectivity, AI/ML analytics and dashboards.
 



 • Configure and deliver tailored demos, and plan and run PoCs/pilots with defined success criteria, test plans and acceptance gates.
 



 • Produce SoWs, solution architecture documents, BoMs/sizing, integration architecture diagrams and pricing inputs to support the sales team.
 



 • Lead technical selling and solution walkthroughs with the client from the second round of discussion through to deal close, alongside the sales team.
 



 • Lead RFI/RFP responses, compliance matrices and technical due diligence.• Assess existing monitoring tools and define integrations with EMS/BMS/SCADA/MES/ERP/CMMS and
 



 historians (e.g. PI, Ignition), using protocols including OPC UA, Modbus/TCP, BACnet, MQTT and API integration.
 



 • Collaborate with the product and data science teams to align use cases such as anomaly detection, predictive maintenance and energy baseline modelling/M\&V.
 



 • Work with clients on site to identify exact requirements and integration gaps for new products.
 



 • Apply hands\-on experience solutioning control solutions for HVAC high\-side and low\-side systems.
 



 • Act as a trusted advisor to plant managers, facility heads, data centre managers, operational heads, energy managers, reliability/maintenance, IT/OT security and procurement stakeholders.
 



 • Ensure clean handover to delivery teams with documented architecture, KPIs and implementation plans.
 



 • Coordinate between the Sales, PMO and Procurement teams for smooth project execution.
 



 • Collaborate with the sales team on custom site requirements and solution customisation.
 



  





**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR** 




**Qualifications \& Experience** 




**Essential** 




 • Engineering degree or Master's degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Instrumentation, Industrial Engineering or a related field, or equivalent.
 



 • 8–10 years of relevant experience in presales, solution consulting or technical sales within Industrial IoT, Energy Management Systems or condition\-based monitoring for manufacturing/facilities.
 



 • Solid understanding of the Industry 4\.0 stack, including sensors, gateways, edge, cloud, time\-series data, streaming analytics and eventing.
 



 • Hands\-on experience with one or more industrial protocols (OPC UA, Modbus, BACnet, MQTT, SNMP) and gateway configuration.
 



 • Working knowledge of HVAC control systems (high\-side and low\-side), gained through hands\-on solutioning experience.
 



 • Demonstrated experience running PoCs/pilots in plant environments and working comfortably within site conditions and OT constraints.
 



 • Experience building business cases for energy savings, demand optimisation and maintenance outcomes.
 



 • Familiarity with AI/ML industrial use cases and SaaS delivery models, including multi\-tenant architecture, APIs, dashboards and alerting/workflows.
 



 • Knowledge of energy standards and measurement \& verification frameworks (ISO 50001, IPMVP, ASHRAE).
 



 • Excellent communication, whiteboarding and proposal\-writing skills, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for business stakeholders.
 



  





**Desirable** 




 • Exposure to BMS, EMS, historians, digital twins or power quality/HVAC optimisation.
 



 • Experience across the APAC manufacturing market and within partner ecosystems (SIs/OEMs).

d48c5f07.title: Solution Area Specialists Windows & Devices
d48c5f07.description:
**Overview**
 With a vision to
 **build and sell Microsoft AI‑powered platforms, cloud services, and devices through a rich partner ecosystem** 
 , the
 **Windows and Device Sales (WDS)** 
 organization brings together sales, technical expertise, and partners to help customers achieve real business outcomes with Microsoft technology.
   

  

 WDS plays a critical role in shaping and delivering the endpoint platform that powers modern, secure, and AI‑enabled work. WDS works across Microsoft’s commercial ecosystem, including OEMs, silicon partners, distributors, resellers, and services partners \- to drive Windows platform adoption, protect and grow share, and ensure customers realize long‑term value from their device and endpoint investments.
   

  

 This role contributes to a
 **multi‑billion‑dollar business** 
 and plays a direct role in
 **defending and expanding Windows as the enterprise endpoint platform** 
 , enabling customers to modernize their environments, adopt AI‑driven workflows, and build confidence in Windows as the foundation for future innovation.
   

  

 As a Windows Specialist, you will defend and grow Windows within Microsoft’s largest and most strategic customers. You will help them define and modernize their endpoint strategy in an era shaped by AI, security threats, and rapid platform competition. You will operate as a trusted advisor to senior IT and business leaders \- anchoring engagement with the CIO while expanding influence across CTO, CISO, and AI transformation leaders \- to ensure Windows remains the foundational platform for secure, AI‑driven work.
   

  

 In this role, you will lead high‑impact, time‑bound customer engagements where Windows platform decisions are at risk or strategically critical. You will articulate differentiated Windows value across security, resiliency, management, and AI workloads; orchestrate partners and internal teams to deliver proof and outcomes; and convert lighthouse wins into repeatable evidence that scales across industries and partners.
   

  

 This opportunity will allow you to deepen executive‑level consultative skills, build technical and platform credibility across the Windows ecosystem, and play a visible role in protecting and expanding Microsoft’s commercial footprint in priority accounts.
   

  

 \[
 *This role is flexible in that you can work partially from home* 
 ]
   

  

 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead Windows endpoint strategy with senior executives: Leverage you technical expertise to lead strategic Windows discussions with CIOs, CTOs, CISOs and AI leaders, translating technology capabilities into business value.
* Defend and extend Windows in competitive environments, deepen insights on why customers adopt alternative platforms, articulate fact based \& differentiated platform value to protect the Windows socket.
* Modernize endpoint management and identity architectures, helping customers decouple from legacy environments, improve total cost of ownership, and unlock AI‑driven workflows at scale.
* Lead high‑impact customer engagements across discovery, envisioning, proof, and value realization, with clear entry criteria, success measures, and exit plans.
* Deliver lighthouse wins that demonstrate real Windows AI value, converting customer outcomes into evidence such as case studies, reference architectures, and repeatable industry scenarios.
* Orchestrate across internal teams and partners, working closely with account teams, engineering, and OEM/channel partners to ensure clarity of roles, clear hand\-offs, escalation process, and accelerated outcomes.
* Provide structured feedback and insights from customer engagements to inform product, go‑to‑market, and partner strategy, identifying patterns that can scale across similar customers.


**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications (RQs)**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or a related field AND 8\+ years of customer‑facing experience in enterprise technology, consultative selling, Specialist, solution architecture, or transformation‑focused roles OR
* Equivalent professional experience.
* Demonstrated capability and experience in leading technical and executive‑level customer conversations, translating complex platform concepts into clear, outcome‑oriented guidance for CIO, CTO, CISO, and AI transformation leaders.
* Prior background in technical sales, solutions architecture, GBB or platform Specialist roles, where credibility across both business outcomes and technical depth was required.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Security and compliance technologies, including Microsoft Defender, Entra, Purview, identity and access management, and Zero Trust principles, with the ability to translate technical capabilities into business value and risk reduction outcomes.


**Preferred Qualifications (PQs)**

**Overview**

 **Windows and Device Sales (WDS)** 
 organization brings together sales, technical expertise, and partners to help customers achieve real business outcomes with Microsoft technology.

WDS works across Microsoft’s commercial ecosystem, including OEMs, silicon partners, distributors, resellers, and services partners \- to drive Windows platform adoption, protect and grow share, and ensure customers realize long‑term value from their device and endpoint investments.
   

  

 This role contributes to a
 **multi‑billion‑dollar business** 
 and plays a direct role in
 **defending and expanding Windows as the enterprise endpoint platform** 
 , enabling customers to modernize their environments, adopt AI‑driven workflows, and build confidence in Windows as the foundation for future innovation.
   

  

 As a Windows Specialist, you will defend and grow Windows within Microsoft’s largest and most strategic customers. You will help them define and modernize their endpoint strategy in an era shaped by AI, security threats, and rapid platform competition. You will operate as a trusted advisor to senior IT and business leaders \- anchoring engagement with the CIO while expanding influence across CTO, CISO, and AI transformation leaders \- to ensure Windows remains the foundational platform for secure, AI‑driven work.
   

  

 In this role, you will lead high‑impact, time‑bound customer engagements where Windows platform decisions are at risk or strategically critical. You will articulate differentiated Windows value across security, resiliency, management, and AI workloads; orchestrate partners and internal teams to deliver proof and outcomes; and convert lighthouse wins into repeatable evidence that scales across industries and partners.
   

  

 This opportunity will allow you to deepen executive‑level consultative skills, build technical and platform credibility across the Windows ecosystem, and play a visible role in protecting and expanding Microsoft’s commercial footprint in priority accounts.
   

  

 \[
 *This role is flexible in that you can work partially from home* 
 ]

As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
   

  

**Responsibilities**

* Equivalent professional experience.
* Demonstrated capability and experience in leading technical and executive‑level customer conversations, translating complex platform concepts into clear, outcome‑oriented guidance for CIO, CTO, CISO, and AI transformation leaders.
* Prior background in technical sales, solutions architecture, GBB or platform Specialist roles, where credibility across both business outcomes and technical depth was required.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Security and compliance technologies, including Microsoft Defender, Entra, Purview, identity and access management, and Zero Trust principles, with the ability to translate technical capabilities into business value and risk reduction outcomes.


**Preferred Qualifications (PQs)**
* Strong Windows platform expertise, including Windows Pro and Windows 11 Enterprise, with the ability to articulate differentiated value across security, manageability, performance, and AI for enterprise and commercial customers.

fd2c97eb.title: Senior Solutions Architect - AWS
fd2c97eb.description:
**SAINTS \& MASTERS PVT LTD.** 




**Senior AWS Solutions Architect** 




*Pre\-Sales Solutioning \& Delivery Enablement* 




**Location:** 
 Kochi, Kerala, India (Work from Home)
 



**Function:** 
 Cloud Solutioning / Pre\-Sales Engineering
 



**Experience:** 
 8 to 12 years
 



**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a Senior AWS Solutions Architect to join our cloud practice in Kochi. This is a customer\-facing, solutioning\-focused role that sits at the intersection of pre\-sales and delivery. You will work alongside the AWS field team to identify where AWS can add value for our customers, shape technical solutions, and translate business needs into practical, well\-architected proposals.
 



 The ideal candidate is a hands\-on technologist with a strong development background who has moved deeper into the AWS stack, with particular strength in AWS AI services and agent\-based solutions. You will not only design solutions but also help validate effort estimates and ensure a smooth handover to the delivery teams who build them.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Pre\-Sales \& Customer Solutioning** 



* Partner with the AWS account and field teams to identify opportunities and areas where AWS services can solve customer problems.
* Lead technical discovery conversations with customers, understand their business and technical challenges, and map them to AWS solutions.
* Design and present solution architectures, proofs of concept, and technical proposals that are secure, scalable, and cost\-aware.
* Communicate the value of proposed solutions clearly to both technical and business stakeholders, including senior decision makers.
* Respond to RFPs, RFIs, and technical questionnaires, and support commercial discussions with well\-reasoned technical inputs.



**AI Services \& Agent Development** 



* Design and build agent\-based solutions on AWS, using services such as Amazon Bedrock, Bedrock Agents, and Amazon Q, with hands\-on experience across the agent lifecycle.
* Apply AWS AI and machine learning services (for example Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker AI, Amazon Textract, Comprehend, Transcribe, and Rekognition) to real customer use cases.
* Develop working prototypes and demos that showcase generative AI and agentic capabilities to customers.
* Stay current with the rapidly evolving AWS AI and generative AI landscape and advise customers on suitable, practical approaches.



**Data Solutions** 



* Bring a working understanding of the AWS data landscape, including storage, databases, analytics, and data pipelines (for example Amazon S3, RDS, DynamoDB, Redshift, Glue, and Athena).
* Advise on how data solutions underpin AI workloads and factor data readiness into overall solution design.



**Application Development \& Engineering** 



* Draw on solid software development and application\-building experience to design solutions that are realistic to build and maintain.
* Guide the design of applications on AWS using serverless and container services (for example Lambda, API Gateway, ECS, EKS) and modern integration patterns.
* Contribute to reusable assets, reference architectures, and accelerators that speed up future engagements.



**Delivery Collaboration \& Handover** 



* Work closely with the delivery teams to review and validate effort estimates against the proposed scope.
* Ensure a clean, well\-documented handover from pre\-sales to delivery so that what was sold matches what gets built.
* Stay engaged through early delivery phases to clarify solution intent and resolve architectural questions.



**Required Skills \& Experience** 



* **Experience:** 
 8 to 12 years of overall experience, with a strong software development or engineering foundation and clear depth in the AWS stack.
* **AI \& agents:** 
 Demonstrable, hands\-on experience building AI agents and generative AI solutions on AWS (Amazon Bedrock, Bedrock Agents, Amazon Q, or equivalent).
* **AWS AI services:** 
 Strong knowledge of AWS AI and ML services and how to apply them to business problems.
* **Data solutions:** 
 Working understanding of AWS data services and how data supports AI and analytics workloads.
* **Development:** 
 Proven experience building and maintaining applications, ideally with cloud\-native and serverless patterns on AWS.
* **Pre\-sales:** 
 Experience in a customer\-facing or pre\-sales capacity, comfortable leading technical discussions and presenting to customers.
* **Delivery:** 
 Ability to review estimates, define scope, and collaborate effectively with delivery teams.
* **Communication:** 
 Excellent communication skills, able to explain complex technical ideas simply to varied audiences.



**Preferred / Nice to Have** 



* AWS certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Associate or Professional), or an AWS AI/ML specialty certification.
* Experience working directly with an AWS partner team or within the AWS Partner Network (APN).
* Exposure to well\-architected reviews, cost optimization, and security best practices on AWS.
* Experience mentoring engineers or guiding delivery teams on AWS solution design.



**What We Value** 



* A consultative mindset, genuinely curious about customer problems before proposing solutions.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity and shaping clarity out of early\-stage opportunities.
* A collaborative, team\-first attitude across sales, solutioning, and delivery.
* A bias for practical, buildable solutions over theoretical designs.



**Location** 




 This role is based in Kochi, Kerala. Some travel may be required for customer meetings, workshops, and AWS engagements.
 



*Saints \& Masters Pvt Ltd. is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates.*

df35e9a3.title: Product Solution Engineer
df35e9a3.description:
**The Impact You’ll Drive**
 At Vegapay, we’re building the infrastructure powering next\-gen credit programs for banks and fintechs. As a
 *Product Solutions Engineer,* 
 you’ll sit at the intersection of product, engineering, and clients \- owning production reliability while solving complex, real\-world fintech problems at scale.
   

  

 This is not a traditional support role. You will be the first line of defense for mission\-critical systems, the go\-to person for debugging deep issues, and a key partner in ensuring our platform runs flawlessly for our banking partners.
   

  

*The Hats You Will Wear*
* Own end\-to\-end production reliability across credit, UPI, ledgering, and reconciliation systems
* Debug complex production issues across services, APIs, and data layers with strong problem\-solving depth
* Partner with engineering teams to identify root causes and drive permanent fixes
* Drive incident management rigor including triaging, prioritization, and resolution within SLAs
* Lead post\-incident RCA discussions with clear, actionable insights
* Proactively monitor systems using logs, metrics, and alerts to prevent failures
* Work directly with B2B clients (banks/partners) to communicate issues and build trust
* Create and maintain playbooks/runbooks for faster issue resolution
* Support product launches and releases, ensuring production readiness and smooth rollouts


**The Perfect Fit**
* 4 \- 6 years of experience in B2B SaaS / Fintech / Payments companies
* B.E / B.Tech in Computer Science or related field (or equivalent experience)
* Strong hands\-on experience in SQL (joins, aggregations, debugging data mismatches)
* Solid understanding of APIs and request/response flows; experience with tools like Postman
* Experience with logs and observability tools (Kibana / ELK stack)
* Proven ability to debug issues in distributed systems
* Familiarity with incident management and ticketing tools (JIRA or similar)
* Exposure to monitoring tools (Grafana / Prometheus)
* Understanding of system design basics (microservices, queues, retries, failure handling)
* Working knowledge of databases


*Your Edge Over the Rest*
* Experience in payments / banking / fintech systems
* Exposure to UPI, card networks (Visa, Mastercard, RuPay), ledger systems, or reconciliation flows
* You don’t just fix issues you prevent them
* You combine deep debugging with sharp stakeholder communication


**The Problem We’re Solving**
 Financial institutions today are held back by legacy systems that are slow, rigid, and expensive to scale. Launching or evolving credit, lending, and UPI products often takes months, requires heavy engineering effort, and limits the ability to create personalized customer experiences.
   

  

 At the same time, customer expectations have changed \- speed, flexibility, and tailored financial products are no longer optional. Banks and fintechs need infrastructure that allows them to innovate quickly, adapt continuously, and scale without friction.
   

  

 This is where we come in.
   

  

 At Vegapay, we are building modern, configurable fintech infrastructure that enables banks, NBFCs, and enterprises to design, launch, and manage credit and payment programs with ease. Our platform brings together flexibility, speed, and control \- helping our partners unlock new growth opportunities and deliver personalized banking experiences at scale.
   

  

**The Opportunity Ahead**
* Solve real\-world fintech problems at scale with high ownership and impact
* Work directly with top banks and cutting\-edge credit infrastructure
* Fast\-paced, high\-learning environment with strong growth opportunities

We believe in connecting the world and supporting our colleagues to do the same in their careers by undertaking assignments and opportunities globally that broaden their skills and ultimately benefit our clients.
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are hiring a hands\-on Solutions Architect to design, build, and operate complex, regulated, global solutions across payroll, tax, and immigration domains. This role is technical\-first: you will own the end\-to\-end architecture for a product or suite of products and contribute directly to implementation (spikes, reference services, critical\-path features), while partnering with a global, cross\-functional team to drive delivery, deployments, and production support across time zones. You will also lead the adoption of AI\-powered development practices—including spec\-driven development and agentic coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex)—and design AI\-enabled solutions using Azure OpenAI APIs and intelligent agents to automate business process flows.
   

  

**What You’ll Do (Hands\-On)**
* Architecture \+ Build: Produce architecture designs and implement key components (reference implementations, platform libraries, integration adapters, critical workflows).
* Distributed Systems: Design and build event\-driven services (messaging, async workflows, idempotency, retries, backpressure, eventual consistency), including well\-defined event contracts and versioning strategies.
* Azure Solution Design: Build using Azure PaaS services and patterns (identity, networking, storage, messaging, API management, monitoring), with practical tradeoffs across cost, scalability, resilience, and latency. Design and integrate AI capabilities using Azure OpenAI APIs (GPT, embeddings, assistants) to enable intelligent features and agent\-driven automation within business process flows.
* Front\-End Architecture: Architect and ship large Next.js/React applications (routing, state strategy, data\-fetching patterns, performance, accessibility, modularization, micro\-frontend considerations where relevant).
* Integration Architecture: Define secure integration patterns (REST and event\-based), build connectors/adapters, and establish operational runbooks for partner/client integrations.
* Security by Design: Implement secure SDLC practices—threat modeling, secrets management, encryption, least\-privilege access, audit logging, and secure defaults aligned to regulated environments.
* Authentication \& Authorization: Implement end\-to\-end authn/authz using OAuth2/OIDC, SSO, and token\-based access. Design RBAC/ABAC/ReBAC, tenant\-aware authorization, API scopes/claims, and service\-to\-service identity (e.g., managed identities).
* Operational Readiness: Own observability and reliability patterns (structured logging, metrics, tracing, SLOs, alerting, incident response) and participate in troubleshooting production issues.
* Documentation that Ships: Create actionable architecture artifacts (ADRs, sequence diagrams, domain flows, deployment diagrams, runbooks) that teams can execute against.
* AI Agent Design; Process Automation: Design, build, and deploy AI agents that automate business process flows—using Azure OpenAI APIs, function calling, orchestration frameworks, and RAG pipelines—with appropriate guardrails, evaluation, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls for regulated environments.
* Technical Leadership: Drive peer architecture/code reviews, coach engineers, and raise engineering standards across onshore/offshore teams. Lead and mentor teams in agentic development practices—spec\-driven workflows, AI\-assisted coding (Claude Code, Codex), and automated test/review generation—to accelerate delivery velocity while maintaining quality and governance.


**Patterns We Expect You to Use**
* Event\-based systems (pub/sub, workflow orchestration, event sourcing where appropriate)
* Distributed systems (partitioning, resiliency, failure\-mode design, consistency tradeoffs)
* Domain\-driven integration approaches (bounded contexts, contracts, anti\-corruption layers)
* Agentic AI patterns including plan/execute/verify loops, tool/function calling, RAG, verifier/critic steps, guardrails, evaluation, and agent observability/auditability. Experience applying these patterns to automate business process flows using Azure OpenAI APIs and orchestration frameworks.


**AI\-Enabled Delivery Expectations**
* Experience working in environments using AI for development, build, and operations (coding assistants such as Claude Code and Codex, automated PR reviews, test generation, incident support).
* Comfortable using a spec\-driven AI development workflow: translating requirements into structured specs, acceptance criteria, diagrams, and prompts that accelerate delivery while maintaining governance. Ability to lead teams in adopting agentic development practices—spec\-driven development, AI\-assisted coding, and agent\-based automation—as standard ways of working.


**Required Qualifications**
* 10\+ years in software engineering, including 3\+ years in architecture/solution design (or equivalent scope).
* Proven experience designing and operating solutions in a regulated global environment (privacy, auditability, security controls, cross\-border considerations).
* Strong Azure experience designing and building cloud\-native solutions using Microsoft PaaS and frameworks, including Azure OpenAI APIs for AI\-enabled features and agent\-based automation.
* Strong experience architecting Next.js and/or React applications at scale.
* Demonstrated experience with event\-driven and distributed system design and production operations.
* Hands\-on experience with agentic development tools and practices (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, spec\-driven development) and a track record of leading engineering teams in AI\-assisted delivery workflows.
* Strong communication skills: can explain tradeoffs clearly to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with enterprise integrations (HRIS, payroll providers, finance systems) and/or iPaaS patterns.
* Strong testing and automation mindset (TDD/BDD, CI/CD quality gates).
* Experience with data modeling, SQL, and reporting/analytics.
* Microsoft certifications (Azure Solutions Architect or similar) a plus.
* Experience designing AI agents to automate business process flows (e.g., using Azure OpenAI Assistants API, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or similar orchestration frameworks).
* Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree preferred.


**Additional Information**
* This job is based in our Bangalore office, with the possibility of a hybrid work mode
* We are an equal opportunity employer that does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected status
* Please note that AI is used as part of the application process

**ERM** 
 is a leading global sustainability consulting firm, committed for nearly 50 years to helping organizations navigate complex environmental, social, and governance (ESG) challenges. We bring together a diverse and inclusive community of experts across regions and disciplines, providing a truly multicultural environment that fosters collaboration, professional growth, and meaningful global exposure. **Job Objective**

* Cross\-Functional Problem\-Solving: Partners with development, infrastructure, and operations teams to troubleshoot technical challenges and drive the successful deployment of solutions.

- 

**Influence And Decision\-Making Authority**
* Provides technical recommendations and articulates the rationale behind architectural decisions.
* Identifies and resolves technical disputes, balancing business and technical complexity to design effective systems.
* Drives the adoption of architectural principles and best practices within development teams and broader organizational technology initiatives.


**Job Requirements \& Capabilities**
**Qualifications:**
 B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field.
   

  

**Job specific capabilities/skills:**
* Architectural Expertise: 12\+ years of experience in technology delivery, with 2\+ years dedicated to architecting scalable, secure, and cloud‑native solutions across AWS, Azure, or multi‑cloud environments.
* Technology Leadership: Strong understanding of software development architecture, cloud computing, and modern technology stacks.
* Enterprise Experience: Demonstrated ability to work in large organizational environments, navigating cross\-functional teams and enterprise\-wide technology strategies.
* Cloud \& DevOps Proficiency: Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms (Preferably on AWS and Azure) and modern architectural patterns, including microservices and serverless computing.
* Gen AI Expertise: Expertise in designing and deploying enterprise\-grade GenAI and RAG architectures, with working knowledge of Amazon Bedrock and/or Azure AI Foundry. An understanding of Agentic AI systems is desirable.
* Development Methodologies: Strong knowledge in one or more of Agile, Kanban, Scrum, DevOps methodologies, etc.
* Technical Tooling: Familiarity with version control systems (Git), infrastructure\-as\-code tools (Terraform/CDK/CloudFormation), and automation scripting (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript).
* Security \& Compliance: Understanding of security best practices, compliance frameworks, and risk management in enterprise IT environments.
* Problem\-Solving \& Analytical Thinking: Ability to analyse complex technical challenges and propose effective solutions.
* Excellent Communication \& Stakeholder Management: Strong ability to translate technical concepts for diverse audiences and collaborate across business and technology teams.
* Project \& Task Management Tools: Experience with tools such as JIRA, Trello, or similar platforms for managing development activities.

c53d9c14.title: Associate Customer Program Manager (EG)
c53d9c14.description:
**About MISUMI Americas**


MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world\-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.


**\*\*Work Hours:** **9:30 PM – 5:30 AM IST, Monday through Friday (aligned with US Pacific business hours)\*\***


**F****ictiv exists to help product innovators create**


Fictiv is a global manufacturing company that simplifies sourcing for custom manufacturing, from prototype to low\-volume production. Through its highly\-vetted manufacturing network, AI\-powered technology platform, and global operations centers across the USA, Mexico, India, and China, Fictiv delivers fast, high\-quality custom manufacturing services from quote to delivery. Fictiv’s capabilities span the full mechanical bill of materials, including Injection Molding, Compression Molding, 3D Printing, CNC Machining, Die Casting, and Sheet Metal. To date, Fictiv has delivered more than 30 million commercial and prototype parts for early\-stage companies and large enterprises alike, helping them innovate faster, free up precious resources, and drive profitable growth.


**Impact in this Role**


Are you ready to shake up the world of customer service? Do you thrive on making connections and finding creative solutions? If you’re passionate about putting customers first in a dynamic, non\-traditional environment, we want YOU on our team!


In your role as **Associate Customer Program Manager**, you will be working directly with our US\-based customers, and you’ll be using your agility, problem\-solving skills, and customer service advocacy to help our customers increase the velocity and quality of products delivered. You will collaborate with the cross\-functional teams to resolve customer pain points, address customer needs, and help manage customer projects end to end. You will support multiple customers across a variety of manufacturing orders to be fulfilled in different regions around the world.


**Work Hours:** 9**:30 PM – 5:30 AM IST, Monday through Friday (aligned with US Pacific business hours)**  

  

This role follow a hybrid work schedule \- 3 nights in office, 2 nights remote


**What you will be doing**


* **Customer Management:** You will be our customers’ best ally at Fictiv. Work closely with our customers to ensure a seamless and high\-quality experience. Nurture relationships and resolve issues to help drive customer loyalty.
* **Case management:** Concurrently manage a variety of manufacturing orders with multiple customers and the internal operations teams. Prioritize and resolve top user requests to address their product development needs and meet customer expectations for timing and quality.
* **Communication:** Gather, interpret, and communicate engineering, design, manufacturing, and logistics requirements to ensure the orders will be delivered on time and in full
* **Collaboration**: Collaborate with sales and the manufacturing operations teams to ensure successful delivery to the customer and advocate on their behalf \- through the project lifecycle, including post\-delivery exceptions.
* **Program Managemen**t: Manage projects with top\-down oversight throughout the entire execution to ensure success as defined by adherence to standards of scope, budget, and timeline.
* **Continuous Improvement**: Identify improvement areas and collaborate with the cross\-functional team to prioritize and define solutions to increase our efficiency.

**Desired Traits**


* **Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or MBA required.**
* **4\+ years of experience in program management, project management, supply chain or customer\-facing operations roles.**
* **Experience supporting NPI, low\-volume production, or rapid prototyping programs.**
* **PMP/project management certification and understanding of project management/operations knowledge preferred.**
* **The work is fast\-paced** \- you will be working in an operations environment with tight deadlines and high standards. You will need to be organized with good time management, prioritization skills and great attention to detail.
* **We obsess over our customers** \- you will need to be personable and have outstanding communications skills (both written and verbal) and be able to adapt your communication style effectively. Must be fluent in written and spoken English. Proven experience working directly with US\-based customers and/or during US business hours is preferred
* **This role requires a self\-starter mentality**. We want you to be excited by a hands\-on, high\-performing, results\-oriented role and driven to exceed expectations for our clients. Accountability is everything; you say what you do and do what you say.
* **Aligned with our culture centered around continuous learning** \- bring passion to learn about the manufacturing ecosystem and the New Product Development process.

**Interested in learning more? We look forward to hearing from you soon.**


We’re actively seeking teammates who:


* Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company.
* Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team.
* Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth.
* Have an ‘always learning’ mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins.
* Help us continue to build a world\-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates

We encourage applications from members of underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, members of the LGBTQ community, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans.

404e275e.title: Program and Delivery Manager - AI and Data Delivery
404e275e.description:
**Eaton’s EITC division is currently seeking a Program and Delivery Manager \- AI and Data Delivery.**
**What You’ll Do**
 This position leads the delivery of data and artificial intelligence products for the HR, Legal and Corporate Development functions. The role owns the portfolio from demand intake through design, build, deployment and adoption, and is accountable for the scope, schedule, cost and quality of every initiative within it. It is a new role, created to give these functions a dedicated delivery leader as the demand for data and AI capability continues to grow.
   

  

 The leader manages the HR, Legal and Corporate Development delivery team and acts as the primary point of contact for functional leadership. Working closely with the System Architect, Enterprise Architecture and Cyber Security, the role ensures that solutions handling sensitive employee and legal information meet Eaton architecture, privacy and security standards. The position also serves as secondary owner of the AI Navigator idea\-to\-disposition process for ideas raised by these functions.
   

  

* Lead end\-to\-end data and artificial intelligence delivery for the HR, Legal and Corporate Development functions, covering demand intake, prioritization, execution, deployment and value realization.
* Own the delivery roadmap and release plan for every product in the portfolio, and hold delivery teams accountable to committed scope, schedule, cost and quality.
* Lead engagement with senior functional stakeholders to identify business priorities, shape demand into fundable initiatives, and secure agreement on outcomes and success measures.
* Manage the HR, Legal and Corporate Development delivery team, including hiring, onboarding, coaching, performance management, capability building and retention of employees and contractors.
* Act as secondary owner for AI Navigator idea\-to\-disposition for ideas originating in HR, Legal and Corporate Development, ensuring each idea is assessed, dispositioned and tracked to closure.
* Build and manage the financial plan for the portfolio, including annual budget, project and run forecasting, platform consumption, contractor cost control and variance reporting.
* Partner with the System Architect, Enterprise Architecture and Cyber Security so that solutions comply with architecture guardrails, data privacy obligations and information security standards applicable to employee and legal data.
* Establish and operate delivery governance, covering status reporting, risk and issue management, dependency management, change control and steering reviews.
* Drive adoption of Agile delivery practices and improve predictability, cycle time and quality through objective delivery metrics.
* Manage supplier and partner relationships, including statements of work, resource onboarding and performance against agreed service levels.
* Champion organizational change management and user adoption for AI products, and ensure realised benefits are measured and communicated to stakeholders.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor degree in a technical discipline such as B.E. / B.Tech / MCA, or B.S. in Computer Science, Mathematics or Engineering. A master degree or MBA is preferred.
* 14 or more years of relevant industry experience in information technology delivery.
* 8 or more years leading program or project delivery for data, analytics or application products in a global organization.
* 4 or more years of direct people leadership of engineering teams that include employees and contract resources.


**Skills**
* Project or program management certification such as PMP, PgMP, Scrum Master or SAFe is preferred.
* Experience delivering technology for HR, Legal or Corporate Development functions, including work with confidential employee or legal data, is preferred.
* Working knowledge of data engineering and analytics platforms, including data pipelines, data warehousing and reporting on Microsoft Azure.
* Practical understanding of artificial intelligence and generative AI solution patterns, including large language models, retrieval augmented generation, prompt design and accuracy evaluation.
* Strong command of program and portfolio management disciplines covering scope, schedule, cost, risk, quality and benefits management.
* Experience running Agile delivery at scale using Scrum, Kanban or SAFe, with hands\-on use of Azure DevOps or equivalent tooling.
* Understanding of enterprise application integration, application programming interfaces and workflow automation.
* Familiarity with data privacy, records retention and information security requirements that apply to employee, legal and corporate development data.
* Financial management capability covering budgeting, forecasting, vendor contracting and cost control.
* Executive communication and stakeholder management, with the ability to translate technical work into business outcomes.
* Ability to lead through influence across a matrixed, global organization and across time zones.
* Proven capability in coaching, developing talent and building inclusive, high\-performing teams.
* Structured problem solving and sound decision making in conditions of ambiguity.
* Customer focus, solution orientation and a strong drive for results.


 All positions may require participation in video and in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process. All candidates will be evaluated based on job\-related competencies, and all candidates’ privacy rights and data security will be protected in accordance with applicable laws.
   

  

 We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for job applicants and employees. Our recruitment processes use balanced selection criteria and avoid unlawful discrimination against applicants on the basis of their age, colour, disability, marital status, national origin, gender, gender identity, genetic information, race or racial origin, religion, sexual orientation or any other status protected or required by law.

78904d41.description:

 Experience: 10\+ yrs

 We are looking for an experienced
 **Technical Delivery Manager** 
 with strong expertise in
 **Identity and Access Management (IAM), Okta, and Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM)** 
 to lead complex technology initiatives from planning through successful delivery.

**Requirements**

* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of IAM and CIAM programs, from requirements and planning through implementation and production rollout

* Work with architects and engineering teams to define scalable identity and access management solutions
* Oversee implementation of SSO, MFA, federation, authentication, authorization, and identity lifecycle management capabilities
* Drive Okta integrations with enterprise applications, APIs, directories, and customer\-facing platforms
* Coordinate CIAM initiatives focused on secure and seamless customer identity experiences
* Translate business and security requirements into actionable technical delivery plans
* Manage project scope, schedules, milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, and resource allocation
* Lead cross\-functional engineering and technology teams across multiple workstreams
* Facilitate architecture discussions, technical reviews, design decisions, and implementation planning
* Monitor delivery progress and proactively address technical, operational, and resource\-related blockers
* Partner with security and compliance teams to ensure identity solutions meet organizational security and governance standards
* Establish delivery processes, engineering standards, documentation, and operational best practices
* Coordinate testing, deployment, production readiness, and post\-implementation activities
* Communicate project status, risks, dependencies, and outcomes to senior stakeholders and leadership
* Identify opportunities to improve IAM platforms, automation, operational efficiency, and overall identity security posture
* Mentor technical teams and promote strong engineering, security, and delivery practices


**What Makes You a Great Fit**
* 10\+ years of experience in technology delivery, engineering management, solution delivery, or a related technical leadership role
* Strong hands\-on understanding of Identity and Access Management (IAM) and enterprise identity architectures
* Proven experience with Okta and Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM) implementations
* Strong knowledge of SSO, SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect, MFA, federation, authentication, authorization, and identity lifecycle management
* Experience integrating identity platforms with enterprise applications, APIs, directories, and cloud environments
* Strong understanding of cybersecurity, access governance, identity security, and compliance principles
* Proven experience managing complex technical programs involving multiple teams and stakeholders
* Strong project planning, risk management, dependency management, and delivery governance skills
* Ability to communicate effectively with engineering teams, architects, security teams, business stakeholders, and senior leadership
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to navigate complex technical challenges
* Experience working in Agile or other modern software delivery environments
* Strong ownership, decision\-making, stakeholder\-management, and leadership capabilities
* Ability to balance technical depth, delivery execution, business priorities, security, and user experience
* Relevant IAM, Okta, cybersecurity, or cloud certifications would be an advantage

* Collaborate with I\&O Product leads on executing strategic initiatives aimed at cost reduction and increased efficiencies aligned with strategic business goals.

a27ed2fe.title: Engagement Manager, Professional Services, AWSI, Healthcare and Life Sciences
a27ed2fe.description:
**Description**
 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing global accounts to enterprise\-level customers.
   

  

 The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Sr. Engagement Manager to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you will lead delivery quality and velocity for programs spanning several concurrent workstreams, orchestrating 50\+ person teams of AWS builders, partners, and customers to deliver transformational AI, data, and enterprise modernization outcomes for the world's leading HCLS organizations.
   

  

 Your objective will be to deliver distinctive customer business outcomes and experience. In doing so, you will lead the implementation of AWS delivery innovations with customers, including re\-designing software development processes to become AI\-native end\-to\-end (“AI\-DLC”). You will bring exceptional stakeholder orchestration and relationship\-building skills, intrinsic problem\-solving ability to proactively shape program direction, anticipate and mitigate risks, and actively manage interdependencies, and the backbone to influence customers and partners when program success demands it. This is an opportunity to shape the future of the industry directly through hands\-on transformation leadership.
   

  

 The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Build and nurture trusted executive relationships (VP\+), delivering strategic counsel on program direction, health, risks, and trade\-offs to inform executive decisions
* Proactively manage interdependencies, mitigate risks, and drive accountability for program outcomes in ambiguous, fast\-changing environments
* Orchestrate across customer lines of business, IT, and partner teams simultaneously, aligning these stakeholders on priorities, timelines, and definitions of success, and escalating blockers where necessary for resolution
* Define and track measurable customer business outcomes (e.g., time\-to\-market acceleration) as the north star for program success, translating technical delivery progress into executive\-ready value narratives that demonstrate ROI and inform strategic decisions
* Own the program financial health, including forecasting, revenue recognition, commercial management, change request negotiation, and scope management for fixed\-price, milestone\-based delivery constructs
* Influence human builder and agent builder teams effectively, establishing clear operating models and responsible AI guardrails as delivery increasingly incorporates AI\-augmented development workflows and agentic automation
* Drive adoption of AI\-DLC (AI\-Driven Development Life Cycle) methodologies across delivery programs, adapting delivery models and team structures for accelerated scale and pace, establishing outcomes\-based governance frameworks for AI\-native builds, and steering multi\-agent systems at scale to drive delivery productivity across the program
* Establish and enforce governance frameworks for agentic AI in delivery — including observability, cost controls, human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, and compliance guardrails — ensuring AI\-augmented workflows remain auditable, secure, and aligned with customer regulatory requirements
* Proactively surface ideas on how ProServe and other AWS teams can innovate to help our customers achieve their goals at a faster pace and larger scale


**About The Team**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of leading multiple Agile teams (like Scrum Masters, Product Owners) concurrently or at scale experience
* 7\+ years of leading and delivering enterprise\-level IT engagements experience
* Bachelor's degree in STEM field
* Knowledge of the value proposition of the public cloud and cloud engagement delivery (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS)
* Experience in leading multiple Agile teams (like Scrum Masters, Product Owners) concurrently or at scale
* Experience in leading and delivering enterprise\-level IT engagements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of delivering customer engagements in a professional services role experience
* active project management certification (e.g., APM, CSM, PMI\-ACP, PRINCE2\)
* AWS certification
* Experience in delivering customer engagements in a professional services role
* Experience with Agile and project management toolsets like Jira, Rally, VersionOne or Taiga
* Experience working with and presenting to C\-level executives, IT, and lines of businesses across organizations or equivalent


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

 Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions.  As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff.
