2a121f9d.title: Lead Technical Program Manager
2a121f9d.description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Lead Technical Program Manager
Overview  

The Mastercard Core Payments \- Network \& Digital Payment Services (part of Product and Engineering) team is looking for a Lead Technical Program Manager to drive delivery to move our eCommerce product and platform strategy forward by consistently innovating and problem\-solving. You will manage the implementation of multiple projects/programs ensuring product/engineering strategy goals and requirements are delivered with quality.  

As Lead TPM, you will interact with product managers, software development managers, developers, and senior leaders across partner teams in the Product and Engineering organization to deliver complex projects and programs. You will define roadmap deliverables, develop program execution plans, align dependencies, track progress, anticipate risks, provide escalation management, make sound trade\-off decisions, and balance business needs versus technical constraints.  

The ideal candidate is passionate about the customer experience journey, highly motivated, intellectually curious, analytical, and possesses an entrepreneurial mindset. You are expected to be detail\-oriented, with a solid technical background and excellent problem\-solving skills.  

* Responsible for planning, execution, and delivery, from inception to completion, for an existing technology product or program.
* Proactively manages the end\-to\-end delivery of engineering work though the engineering team and all dependent organizations.
* Reports on progress, ensuring dependencies are covered.
* Operates between teams and architectures overseeing the gaps between teams, processes, and systems, while removing all blocking issues leading to a successful delivery


Responsibilities  

* Plan and manage a group of related technology projects or activities in a coordinated way from inception through successful delivery
* Deep understanding of the design approaches and technologies utilized in your area
* Focus on the customer experience, the build and delivery processes and the problems to be solved
* Work across multiple scrum teams (may be cross\-cutting across products, scrum teams, and/or technologies or work may be vertically focused on a single product or feature set)
* Align dependent organizations and remove/mitigate all blocking issues
* Work directly with external to the organization or external to Mastercard technology providers and customers
* Work with limited guidance, seeking guidance as needed because the product and delivery strategy is defined. The design is not.
* Deep understanding of the business and technical requirements for the solutions being built
* Understand the needs of the engineers and technical operations teams who must build, maintain, and operate the system for the life of the system
* Recognize complex designs and propose simplified solutions by working with software design engineers, principals and TPMs
* Help customers and the engineering teams make trade\-off decisions by considering all of the data including business goals, technical platform strategy, customer experience and maintainability. You identify blocking issues and manage their resolution.

**Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution** 




  





 At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission\-critical work.
 



  





**Why Skan AI** 




  





 We're in hyper\-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.
 



  





 Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.
 



  





 Our diverse, collaborative team of 250\+ innovators is solving category\-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross\-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.
 



  





 AI Solutions is our global post\-sales and professional\-services organization — the team that takes process intelligence and agentic AI out of pilots and into production, and owns customer outcomes end\-to\-end. We are AI\-first by default: we spot repeating patterns and build agents to automate them, scaling the value we deliver with the book of business, not with headcount.
 



  





**The role.** 
 Set the technical bar for AI\-native delivery and be the first line of defense on every solution we build. You own architecture and solutioning end\-to\-end — from pre\-sales through delivery — and you see the whole picture: not just what the customer asked for, but why they bought us and what they actually need. You translate wants into needs, frame the real problem, and drive it from idea to implementation to impact. This is an AI\-native operational\-intelligence architect, not a traditional workflow or BPM architect.
 



  





**What you own** 



* End\-to\-end, AI\-native architecture and integration design for customer engagements — the build patterns the whole delivery team works to.
* The big picture — understanding why the customer is buying Skan, shaping the real problem behind the stated request, and designing to the outcome.

* Agentic systems design — perception, reasoning and planning; bounded autonomy, contextual memory, multi\-agent orchestration and runtime observability.



**What we look for** 



* Thinks in systems, not workflows — reasons about enterprise operational behavior, not requirements → approvals → implementation.

**Overview**
 With more than 45,000 employees and partners worldwide, the Customer Experience and Success (CE\&S) organization is on a mission to empower customers to accelerate business value through differentiated customer experiences that leverage Microsoft’s products and services, ignited by our people and culture. We drive cross\-company alignment and execution, ensuring that we consistently exceed customers’ expectations in every interaction, whether in\-product, digital, or human\-centered. Our Threat Protection strategy at Microsoft spans multiple products and services, providing state\-of\-the\-art protection across the entire digital estate. Our culture is centred on embracing a growth mindset, a theme of inspiring excellence, and encouraging teams and leaders to bring their best each day. This is a customer\-facing role, owning the technical relationship between the customer and Microsoft, helping customers to leverage their Microsoft investments through architecture, implementation, and operational health engagements. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

You will own the customer engagements deliveries, including architecture design sessions, specific implementation project/pilots and helping to remove technical blockers. You will be driving successful customer security outcomes enabled by your design and engagement with key customer teams. The ideal candidate will have experience in customer\-facing roles, a background of deep technical expertise, and success building trusted advisor relationships with senior customer executives, Enterprise Architects, IT Management and Developers.

d8f9e56d.title: Security Architect (Bangalore, India)
d8f9e56d.description:
**About AiPrise**
-----------------


AiPrise is a global compliance orchestration platform helping fintechs, marketplaces, and payment companies verify and onboard customers worldwide. We integrate with 80\+ identity and compliance vendors to deliver a holistic view of risk. We're now building AI\-powered compliance agents to revolutionize KYB, AML, sanctions screening, and risk scoring — enabling our customers to onboard faster, reduce manual reviews, and prevent financial crime.

**About the Role**
------------------


We are looking for a Security Architect to own the security architecture of our platform end to end, across infrastructure, applications, and APIs, and to be hands\-on in making it better. This is a builder’s role, not a paper one. You will work shoulder to shoulder with engineers to find and fix real security issues, set the standards that keep them fixed, and translate a demanding regulatory landscape into practical controls the team can actually ship.


You will also be the technical face of security in the rooms that matter: with auditors, with enterprise customers’ security teams, and with regulators. You will join as an individual contributor with the depth to lead by doing, and as the security team grows you will have the opportunity to build and manage a team of your own.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Own the security architecture across cloud infrastructure, applications, and APIs, and evolve it as the platform grows into new products and regions.
* Work directly with engineers to identify, prioritize, and remediate security issues in infrastructure, application code, and APIs, reviewing designs, pairing on fixes, and validating that they hold.
* Perform threat modeling and security design reviews for new services and significant changes, and embed security into the development lifecycle (secure coding standards, code review, CI/CD controls, dependency and container security).
* Define and maintain security standards, reference architectures, and hardening baselines, and drive their adoption across engineering.
* Lead and coordinate security testing, including penetration tests, vulnerability management, and remediation tracking, and hold findings to closure within defined timelines.
* Translate industry and regulatory security and privacy requirements into concrete technical and organizational controls, and keep them current as obligations change.
* Own the technical side of audits and assessments, including industry and certification audits (for example SOC 2 and ISO 27001\), enterprise\-customer security reviews, and regulatory reviews, covering evidence, control mapping, and remediation of findings.
* Represent security in customer\-facing conversations, including security questionnaires, due\-diligence calls, and trust discussions with prospects, customers, and their auditors.
* Partner with the privacy and data\-protection function to ensure controls meet GDPR and other applicable data protection requirements, with particular care for personal and biometric data.
* Contribute to incident readiness and response, including detection, investigation, and post\-incident improvement.
* As the team grows, mentor and eventually manage junior security engineers, setting technical direction, reviewing work, and developing the team.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 7 to 9 years of experience in security engineering, security architecture, or a closely related field, with a track record of securing production systems at scale.
* Genuine hands\-on technical depth. You can read and reason about application code, cloud infrastructure, and API design, and work with engineers to fix issues rather than only flagging them.
* Strong command of cloud security, including network segmentation, IAM, secrets and key management, and workload and container security, along with infrastructure\-as\-code.
* Deep application and API security knowledge, including the common vulnerability classes (for example access\-control flaws, injection, and SSRF), secure design patterns, authentication and authorization, and secure SDLC practices.
* Solid, current understanding of industry and regulatory security and privacy requirements, such as SOC 2, ISO/IEC 27001, GDPR, and related frameworks, and the judgment to apply them proportionately.
* Demonstrated experience handling audits and assessments of multiple kinds (certification, enterprise\-client, and regulatory), including preparing evidence and driving findings to closure.
* Excellent stakeholder and customer\-facing communication. You can explain security clearly and credibly to engineers, executives, auditors, and customers alike.
* Sound risk judgment. You can balance security, business needs, and delivery, and make defensible decisions with incomplete information.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Experience in fintech, regtech, identity verification, or another regulated, data\-sensitive domain.
* Experience handling personal or biometric and identity data and the associated privacy obligations.
* Background in penetration testing, red teaming, or vulnerability research.
* Familiarity with privacy frameworks and regulations beyond GDPR (for example regional data protection laws), and with DevSecOps practices and tooling.
* Relevant certifications (for example CISSP, CCSP, OSCP, or privacy certifications such as CIPP or CIPT) are valued, but hands\-on capability matters more.
* Experience mentoring or leading engineers, with an interest in building and managing a team.

**Growth and Leadership Track**
-------------------------------


This role is designed to grow. You will start as a hands\-on individual contributor with real ownership of our security architecture. As the security function expands, you will have a clear path into leadership: building, mentoring, and managing a team while continuing to set technical direction.

**About the interview**
-----------------------

* Introductory Discussion (Engineering Manager) – 45 mins
* Security Deep Dive \& Practical Assessment – 90 mins
* Security Deep Dive – 60 mins
* Founder \& Culture Alignment – 45 mins


Compensation Range: ₹30L \- ₹50L

355bb42e.title: Portfolio PMO Program Manager (Automotive - Connectivity)
355bb42e.description:
**About The Role**
 We are seeking a strategic and execution\-focused Senior Portfolio PMO Program Manager to strengthen portfolio governance, operating discipline, and business transparency across HARMAN SBU Connectivity Portfolio Team. Based in India, this role will partner with global product, engineering, finance, sales, and business leaders to translate portfolio priorities into measurable plans, clear decisions, and predictable outcomes.
   

  

 The successful candidate will operate beyond traditional status reporting. The role will establish governance routines, integrate portfolio data, identify risks and dependencies early, and enable leadership decisions through fact\-based insights. This position may support one or multiple product lines (per business need) and strategic initiatives while promoting common processes, accountability, and continuous improvement across the portfolio.
   

  

 What You Will Do
   

  

* Lead portfolio governance and execution\-enablement activities across assigned Connectivity product lines and strategic initiatives.
* Plan and facilitate portfolio operating cadences, including monthly status reviews, QBRs, portfolio reviews, decision forums, and leadership workshops.
* Prepare decision\-oriented materials that clearly summarize portfolio health, key milestones, risks, dependencies, financial status, and actions requiring leadership attention.
* Establish and maintain integrated portfolio plans, milestones, roadmaps, and cross\-functional dependencies; ensure alignment with approved business priorities.
* Drive consistent application of HARMAN business management, product lifecycle, and governance processes, including compliance with applicable BMS and PLM requirements.
* Coordinate the definition and tracking of portfolio OKRs, KPIs, and execution metrics; identify trends, gaps, and corrective actions.
* Partner with Finance and product leaders to support business\-case governance, budget planning, forecast\-versus\-actual reviews, investment tracking, and financial risk visibility.
* Support demand, capacity, and resource planning by consolidating needs, highlighting constraints, and facilitating trade\-off decisions across functions and programs.
* Own portfolio\-level risk, issue, action, and decision tracking; ensure timely escalation with clear impact analysis and recommended options.
* Drive cross\-functional alignment among Product Management, Engineering, Finance, Quality, Sales, Business Development, and regional teams.
* Improve portfolio transparency through standardized dashboards, reporting templates, data quality controls, and traceability across planning and execution tools.
* Facilitate resolution of execution barriers by clarifying ownership, due dates, dependencies, and decision paths.
* Conduct governance and process reviews, identify recurring gaps, and implement practical continuous\-improvement actions.
* Support portfolio communication and change\-management activities, ensuring stakeholders understand priorities, governance expectations, and operating\-model changes.
* Mentor project and program management colleagues and promote a collaborative, accountable, and data\-driven PMO culture.


 What You Need
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Operations, Finance, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience will be considered.
* Typically 12\+ years of overall professional experience, including at least 8 years in program management, portfolio management, PMO, product operations, or a related role.
* Demonstrated experience leading governance and execution across complex, global, cross\-functional product or technology portfolios.
* Strong working knowledge of portfolio planning, milestone management, dependency management, risk and issue management, and executive reporting.
* Experience with financial governance, including budgets, forecasts, business cases, investment tracking, and variance analysis.
* Ability to synthesize complex information into concise, decision\-ready insights for senior leaders.
* Excellent facilitation, stakeholder management, communication, negotiation, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to influence without direct authority and work effectively across cultures, functions, and time zones.
* Proficiency with common portfolio and reporting tools such as Microsoft 365, Jira, Confluence, Aha!, Salesforce, Power BI, Qlik, or equivalent platforms.
* Automotive, connected\-product, embedded software, electronics, or mobility industry experience is preferred.


 What Is Nice to Have
   

  

* Master’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Finance, or a related discipline.
* PMP, PgMP, SAFe, Agile, Lean, or portfolio\-management certification.
* Experience with automotive telematics, connectivity, software platforms, or product lifecycle management.
* Experience implementing or transforming a PMO operating model, governance framework, or portfolio reporting capability.
* Experience working with geographically distributed teams across India, Europe, Asia, and North America.


 What Makes You Eligible
   

  

* Be willing to work from a HARMAN office in India in accordance with the applicable hybrid or on\-site work policy.
* Be willing to travel up to 20% domestically and internationally, including travel to HARMAN and customer locations when required.
* Successfully complete any required employment, background, and compliance checks.


 What We Offer
   

  

 HARMAN FlexConnect Program, offering a flexible hybrid work environment that fosters stronger collaboration, meaningful connections, and innovation through a minimum of three in\-office days per week.
   

  

* Access to employee discounts on world\-class HARMAN/Samsung products (JBL, Harman Kardon, AKG, etc.)
* An inclusive and diverse work environment that fosters and encourages career development opportunities
* Flexible work schedule with a culture encouraging work\-life integration and collaboration in a global environment
* On\-site opportunities to focus on personal well\-being and development such as onsite café, fitness center, weekly massage, fitness classes, and other onsite events promoted by our Employee resource groups
* Professional development opportunities through HARMAN University’s business and leadership academies
* Internal talent management leadership acceleration programs
* “Be Brilliant” employee recognition and rewards program
* Scholarship programs for employee family members


**You Belong Here**
 HARMAN is committed to making every employee feel welcomed, valued, and empowered. No matter what role you play, we encourage you to share your ideas, voice your distinct perspective, and bring your whole self with you – all within a support\-minded culture that celebrates what makes each of us unique. We also recognize that learning is a lifelong pursuit and want you to flourish. We proudly offer added opportunities for training, development, and continuing education, further empowering you to live the career you want.
   

  

**About HARMAN: Where Innovation Unleashes Next\-Level Technology**
 Ever since the 1920s, we’ve been amplifying the sense of sound. Today, that legacy endures, with integrated technology platforms that make the world smarter, safer, and more connected.
   

  

 Across automotive, lifestyle, and digital transformation solutions, we create innovative technologies that turn ordinary moments into extraordinary experiences. Our renowned automotive and lifestyle solutions can be found everywhere, from the music we play in our cars and homes to venues that feature today’s most sought\-after performers, while our digital transformation solutions serve humanity by addressing the world’s ever\-evolving needs and demands. Marketing our award\-winning portfolio under 16 iconic brands, such as JBL, Mark Levinson, and Revel, we set ourselves apart by exceeding the highest engineering and design standards for our customers, our partners and each other.
   

  

 If you’re ready to innovate and do work that makes a lasting impact, join our talent community today!

 Please be aware that HARMAN recruiters will always communicate with you from an '@harman.com', ‘@careers.harman.com’ or ‘harmanglobal.avature.net’ email address. We will never ask for payments, banking, credit card, personal financial information or access to your LinkedIn/email account during the screening, interview, or recruitment process. If you are asked for such information or receive communication from an email address not ending in one of the above email domains about a job with HARMAN, please cease communication immediately and report the incident to us through: harmancareers@harman.com.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. 34aaedb4.title: Solutions Engineer
34aaedb4.description:
**The role sits between sales and engineering, and is accountable to both** 



  


 A high\-growth, VC\-backed SaaS company is hiring its founding India team through Flexiple. Deals are increasingly won or lost on whether a prospect's technical evaluator believes the product will work in their environment, and right now the founders are personally doing that call. It does not scale past about here. Flexiple is a managed marketplace that helps global companies build high\-performing teams and GCCs in India.
 


  


**What the week contains** 



  


 Technical discovery with prospects, which mostly means finding out what they actually have rather than what the RFP says. Building demonstrations against a customer's real constraints. Running proofs of concept and being straight about what did not work. Writing up integration requirements clearly enough that engineering can act on them without a second meeting.
 


  


**The uncomfortable part** 



  


 Telling a sales lead the deal will not work as scoped. That happens, and the people who last in this role are the ones who do it early rather than letting a proof of concept quietly fail three weeks later.
 


  


**Looking for** 



  

* 4 to 8 years in solutions engineering, pre\-sales engineering or a customer\-facing technical role
* Enough hands\-on ability to build a working integration, not only describe one
* APIs, authentication models and the usual enterprise objections around data residency
* Composure in front of a sceptical technical audience


  


 Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune, Delhi NCR, Mumbai or Chennai, or remote within India, with some travel to customer sites. A screening call, a technical conversation, a live scenario, then time with the founding team.
 


  


*Applying once also puts you forward for later customer\-facing engineering roles here.*

8b5bbce0.title: Lead AI Solutions Consultant
8b5bbce0.description:
**Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution** 




  





 At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission\-critical work.
 



  





**Why Skan AI** 




  





 We're in hyper\-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.
 



  





 Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.
 



  





 Our diverse, collaborative team of 250\+ innovators is solving category\-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross\-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.
 



  





 AI Solutions is our global post\-sales and professional\-services organization — the team that takes process intelligence and agentic AI out of pilots and into production, and owns customer outcomes end\-to\-end. We are AI\-first by default: we spot repeating patterns and build agents to automate them, scaling the value we deliver with the book of business, not with headcount.
 



  





**The role.** 
 The design authority and quality bar for the team — a functional\-governance role for the most technical, most trusted consultant in the room. You set the solution\-quality bar across the whole team, frame and gate\-review the hardest solutions before they ship, build the industry\-specific playbooks and reusable AI assets that scale everyone, and lead from the front, hands\-on, on the toughest work. Additionally, you own your own book of accounts end\-to\-end — these are the highest\-impact, most strategic accounts the company has. You begin to own top\-line and margin alongside delivery leadership. For a seasoned leader from a top consulting firm or SI who wants to build, ship and set the standard, this is the seat.
 



  





**What you own** 



* Full end\-to\-end ownership of your own book — the highest\-impact, most strategic accounts the company has (across industries such as BFSI and healthcare), owned from discovery to realized value.
* Design authority and the solution\-quality bar across the team — you frame the hardest problems and gate\-review solutions before they ship.
* Industry\-specific playbooks and reusable AI assets that make the whole team faster and more consistent.
* Leading from the front — hands\-on where the solution stretches beyond out\-of\-the\-box — and coaching the Seniors.
* Top\-line and margin awareness — beginning to own the delivery\-leadership economics alongside delivery leadership.



**What we look for** 



* 8\+ years with deep, demonstrable end\-to\-end delivery leadership on strategic accounts; top consulting\-firm / SI leaders who now build and ship, not just advise.
* Principal\-level technical depth and architecture judgment — sets standards, builds playbooks, raises the bar for others.
* Industry depth (BFSI, healthcare or similar) and the ability to build reusable, industry\-specific assets.
* Commercial awareness — comfortable reasoning about utilization, top\-line and margin.
* Solutions\-led leader who leads by example; heavily hands\-on at the highest bar.



**The persona \& bar** 



* **Thrives in uncertainty:** 
 Can run a substantive, back\-and\-forth customer conversation, build on a fuzzy idea, and convert uncertainty into certainty — Idea → Implementation → Impact. Customers are under pressure and want someone who guides and coaches them.
* **Pragmatic solutioning:** 
 Navigates roadblocks and imperfect systems without waiting to be told what to do — independent judgment over guidance\-dependence.
* **Data\-first, value\-driven (not task execution):** 
 The real work isn't just executing the task in front of you. You own the step before — figuring out what data matters to create foresight on what to optimize — and the step after — the 'what next' that turns insight into value — keeping everything aligned to the customer's bigger goals.
* **AI\-first by default:** 
 Collects data first, then builds agents to optimize workflows — moving past large, manual analyst\-and\-developer teams.
* **Ownership, agility, client\-facing:** 
 Continuous contact with the customer and heavy ownership across every one of these dimensions.



**How the role works** 



* **Our priorities, in order:** 
 product expert (trained and certified on Skan), AI\-first (agents do the repeat work — every consultant a 10x consultant), solutions\-led (solve the true business problem), and end\-to\-end ownership from discovery through adoption.
* **The bar:** 
 you solve real customer problems, and you independently lead a customer discovery session — turning discovery and ideas into a clear plan to ship and adopt an AI solution.
* **Hands\-on and technical:** 
 you set the solution bar, gate\-review the toughest work, and still build from the front where it counts.

We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion or belief, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital or family status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws in the locations where we operate.*

* Lead architecture reviews, design authorities and technical governance across global delivery teams.
* Mentor technical architects, developers and Agentforce specialists.

* Salesforce Agentforce and associated agentic architecture concepts.
* Salesforce CPQ and Revenue Cloud Advanced / Revenue Lifecycle Management.
* Salesforce Sales Cloud and core platform architecture.
* Agent orchestration and tool/function calling.
* Multi\-agent architectures, delegation and coordination patterns.
* Agent state, short/long\-term memory and session/context management.
* MCP and agent\-to\-agent interoperability concepts/patterns.
* RAG, semantic/vector search, embeddings, chunking and retrieval optimization.
* Context engineering beyond basic prompt engineering.
* Evaluation frameworks and AI observability.
* AI safety, grounding, guardrails and least\-privilege action design.
* LLM model selection and architectural trade\-offs.
* Classic NLP concepts including intent classification, entity extraction, semantic similarity and ranking.
* Apex, Lightning Platform, Flow, APIs and enterprise integration patterns.
* Strong understanding of asynchronous processing, transaction boundaries, resiliency, retries and idempotency.
* Security architecture including sharing, CRUD/FLS, permission models and data protection.

* Agentforce and Revenue Cloud\-related certifications or demonstrable implementation experience.
* Experience with MuleSoft and large enterprise integration landscapes preferred.

ce6bdd4c.title: Managed Services Consultant Mumbai, India
ce6bdd4c.description:
### **About ITRS**


At ITRS, we make society’s critical technology work. Our mission is to deliver automated and holistic IT observability solutions that safeguard critical applications and enable innovation. We are the only monitoring and observability platform designed for the most demanding and regulated industries — trusted by 90% of Tier 1 capital markets firms.


We believe when our team thrives, so do our customers. With us, you’ll find:


* **A culture that backs you** – We’re proud to be a Great Place to Work for multiple years in a row due to our inclusive, supportive environment.
* **Work that matters** – Make a real difference with 1,000s of global customers in industries that keep the world running, including 9 out of 10 top investment banks.
* **Room to grow** – Whether you're starting your career or bringing years of experience, we’re committed to your development. Just ask our team members who’ve been excelling here for 10\+ years.

  

With headquarters in London and teams across the US, Europe, and Asia, ITRS combines the agility of a high\-impact tech business with the stability of a private equity–backed global partner.


### **Scope of Role**


Our clients choose Managed Services to ensure Geneos is kept up to date, operational and correctly configured. We also work with our clients to ensure their monitoring is taken to a higher advancement level, to allow them to get the most value out of the product.

  



Reporting to our Service Delivery Manager, our Managed Service team monitors all ITRS components in our client environment to ensure they are up and operational. We respond to client queries on how to use the product, requests to make changes and configuration requests where the client requires. Also, we perform project work which includes upgrading and enhancing the client’s Geneos environment. We also work with our on\-site team members who are based in Singapore and Mumbai working onsite our client premises.


### **As a Managed Services Consultant, you will:**


* **Monitor** ITRS components in our client environment and resolve issues to ensure uptime and Client SLAs are met.
* **Answer Client Queries** providing clients with the information they need to use ITRS products and implementing changes to deliver the latest monitoring for the client.
* **Restore Client Incidents** by investigating and resolving issues with ITRS components in our client environment with assistance.
* **Perform root cause analysis** using problem analysis methodology to assess and diagnose underlying causes of recurring Incidents
* **Hands\-on implementation of technical solutions** to permanently fix reccuring incidents.
* **Monitor progress on the resolution of Known Errors** and ensure best available workaround for Incidents are documented and communicated.
* **Fulfil Client Configuration Requests** by gathering requirements and helping our client configure Geneos implementing within client SLA.
* **Document and share information** by updating the knowledge base to provide accurate troubleshooting for the Managed Services team.
* **Provide ideas and suggestions** improve products, services, or processes.

  

**Performance is measured through regular quarterly appraisals with your line manager to include a review of the following:**


* Quality of client communication by providing concise information to the client.
* Quality of work to the client by meeting our defined standards including quality checks.
* Client satisfaction and feedback of your work.
* Positive contribution to the Managed Service workload by meeting the targets set by your line manager.
* Meet your ticket response and resolution time SLA.
* Meet Geneos uptime SLA by monitoring and resolving incidents.
* Expectation to perform according to our behaviour and values

  

**Requirements**


### **You will have:**


* Minimum 3 years’ experience working in a client\-facing environment preferably in a financial institution or vendor and preferably in an IT Operations role.
* Excellent written and oral English communication skills.
* Passionate about our client experience.
* Experience in Unix and Windows Operating Systems.
* Experience in one or more scripting languages such as Shell, Bash, Perl, XML.
* An understanding of Databases e.g. Oracle and an understanding of SQL.
* Willingness to work onsite to our Mumbai office

### **A person in this role would benefit from the following:**


* Experience using or administering a real\-time monitoring tool, e.g. Geneos, BMC Patrol, AppDynamics, Nagios.
* Exposure to an ITIL Operations environment.
* Experience of Application Support in Financial Services.
* Deliver continuous improvement

**Benefits**


* Health insurance with Care
* Provident Fund
* Group personal accident policy
* Generous leave entitlements

ITRS is an Equal Opportunity employer and Inclusion is part of our everyday life. We celebrate diversity and pride ourselves on providing an environment where all employees can be their authentic selves and have a voice, allowing everyone to contribute equally. We remain committed to advocating inclusion, diversity, and equality into our ITRS family as we grow and enrich our business.

  



We welcome applications from everyone in the community as we recognise that a diverse workforce is a stronger workforce.

 You will shape initiatives spanning education, inclusion, community development, and water, translating social\-impact objectives into effective programs.
   

  

 The role combines program strategy, governance, stakeholder engagement, monitoring, and communications.
   

  

 You will work with multidisciplinary internal teams and a broad ecosystem of external partners, including NGOs, governments, academia, and social enterprises.
   

  

 A key part of the role is ensuring strong governance, regulatory compliance, transparency, and accountability across the portfolio.
   

  

 You will also help communicate program outcomes through compelling stories, impact highlights, and employee\-volunteering initiatives.

* Demonstrated track record of developing and delivering strategic initiatives with measurable social impact.
* Strong understanding of at least several of the relevant sectors, including education, inclusion, community development, and water.
* Excellent stakeholder\-management skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships across government, nonprofit, corporate, academic, and community environments.
* Strong written, verbal, interpersonal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex initiatives clearly to diverse audiences.

* Exposure to strategic programs involving diverse internal and external stakeholders.
* Collaboration with multidisciplinary teams and organizations across government, nonprofit, corporate, academic, and community sectors.
* Opportunity to develop expertise in program governance, monitoring and evaluation, stakeholder management, and social\-impact communications.

b5d343fd.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, Ordering
b5d343fd.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


It’s no secret that Amazon relies on its technology to deliver millions of packages every day to its customers – on time, with low cost. We build the complex software solutions that work across our vendors, warehouses and carriers to optimize both the time and cost of getting packages delivered. Our products and services already handle thousands of requests per second, make business decisions impacting billions of dollars a year, integrate with a network of small and large carriers worldwide, manage business rules for millions of unique products, and improve the ordering and delivery experience for millions of online shoppers.  

  

We are looking for a Sr. Technical Program Manager (TPM) to join our growing team! This position requires influencing across multiple teams, businesses, and senior leaders. ca001660.title: SAP BTP / CPI Technical Architect
ca001660.company: Blue Ocean Systems Infotech Pvt. Ltd.
ca001660.description:
HI,  
Urgent hiring for SAP Technical Architect \- offshore/Remote work  
Time: 6:00 AM to 3:30 PM IST

**Role Overview**  
We are looking for an experienced **SAP Technical Architect** to provide end\-to\-end technical architecture and governance across SAP cloud implementations, with a strong focus on **SAP SuccessFactors, SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), SAP Integration Suite / Cloud Integration (CPI), SAP Cloud Identity Services – IAS and IPS**, APIs, extensions, and enterprise integrations. The architect will work across multiple SAP projects and act as the **technical authority overseeing the overall solution architecture**, ensuring that SuccessFactors and other SAP solutions are integrated securely, efficiently, and in accordance with SAP recommended architecture and development standards. This is not purely an integration\-development role. The individual is expected to understand the complete SAP cloud technical landscape and provide architectural direction to functional consultants, integration developers, BTP developers, infrastructure/security teams, and customer IT teams.

**Key Responsibilities**  
**1\. Overall SAP Technical Architecture**

* Define and govern the end\-to\-end technical architecture for SAP implementation programs.
* Provide technical oversight across **SAP SuccessFactors, S/4HANA, BTP, Integration Suite, IAS, IPS and other SAP/non\-SAP applications**.
* Review solution designs and ensure consistency with SAP recommended architecture, security principles and integration standards.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies and architectural gaps during design and implementation.
* Act as the technical escalation point for complex cross\-system issues.

**2\. SAP SuccessFactors Technical Architecture**

* Provide technical architecture oversight for SAP SuccessFactors implementations.
* Understand SuccessFactors APIs, OData services, Compound Employee API, Integration Center, Intelligent Services, MDF, scheduled integrations and file\-based interfaces.
* Guide teams on the appropriate use of standard SuccessFactors capabilities versus BTP extensions or custom integrations.
* Support technical design across modules including Employee Central, Payroll, Time, Recruitment, Onboarding, Performance, Compensation and Learning.
* Review technical specifications and integration designs prepared by functional and technical teams.

**3\. SAP BTP Architecture**

* Design and govern solutions implemented on **SAP Business Technology Platform**.
* Define appropriate use of BTP services including:
* SAP Integration Suite
* Cloud Integration / CPI
* API Management
* SAP Build
* BTP Extension applications
* Destination Service
* Connectivity Service
* Cloud Connector
* Event\-based integration services
* Define BTP account, subaccount, environment and connectivity architecture where required.
* Ensure appropriate separation between development, test and production environments.

**4\. Integration Architecture – CPI / Integration Suite**

* Design enterprise integration architecture using **SAP Integration Suite / CPI**.
* Define integration patterns including synchronous, asynchronous, API\-based, event\-driven and batch/file integrations.
* Review and guide CPI interface development.
* Define reusable integration standards, naming conventions, error handling, logging and monitoring frameworks.
* Review interfaces between SuccessFactors and systems such as:
* SAP S/4HANA / ERP
* SAP Employee Central Payroll
* Active Directory / Entra ID
* Payroll providers
* Time and attendance systems
* Benefits providers
* Banks
* Government systems
* Learning systems
* Recruitment platforms
* Other third\-party enterprise applications
* Promote API\-led integration and standard SAP APIs wherever appropriate.

**5\. Identity \& Access Architecture – IAS / IPS**

* Own or oversee the technical setup and administration of **SAP Cloud Identity Services**.
* Configure and govern **Identity Authentication Service (IAS)** and **Identity Provisioning Service (IPS)**.
* Design authentication and SSO architecture across SAP cloud solutions.
* Configure SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect and certificate\-based authentication where applicable.
* Design user provisioning and de\-provisioning processes.
* Support SuccessFactors\-to\-IAS migration and Identity Authentication integration.
* Troubleshoot authentication, provisioning and authorization issues.
* Coordinate with corporate identity platforms such as Microsoft Entra ID / Active Directory.

**6\. Security \& Technical Governance**

* Establish technical standards and architecture principles across SAP projects.
* Ensure integrations and extensions comply with enterprise security requirements.
* Review authentication, authorization, encryption, certificate management and credential\-management approaches.
* Ensure credentials and sensitive information are appropriately secured using SAP\-recommended services.
* Participate in technical security reviews and architecture review boards.
* Support audit and compliance requirements where applicable.

**7\. Technical Design \& Quality Assurance**

* Review:
* Solution Architecture Documents
* Technical Design Documents
* Functional Specifications
* Interface Specifications
* API specifications
* Security designs
* Data\-flow diagrams
* Infrastructure/connectivity designs
* Ensure technical documentation contains sufficient implementation\-level detail.
* Conduct technical design reviews before development begins.
* Perform architecture and code\-quality reviews for critical developments.
* Ensure solutions are scalable, maintainable and supportable after go\-live.

**8\. Troubleshooting \& Production Support**

* Lead resolution of complex technical issues involving multiple SAP and third\-party systems.
* Support project teams during SIT, UAT, cutover and production stabilization.
* Analyze interface failures, authentication issues, API problems, certificate issues and performance bottlenecks.
* Establish monitoring and operational support practices for integrations and BTP applications.
* Provide technical guidance to AMS/support teams for critical incidents.

**9\. Technical Leadership**

* Provide architectural guidance and mentoring to:
* BTP developers
* CPI developers
* SuccessFactors technical consultants
* Integration consultants
* Functional consultants
* Project managers
* Work closely with Solution Architects and Functional Leads to translate business requirements into technically viable solutions.
* Challenge unnecessary customization and recommend SAP\-standard approaches wherever possible.
* Support presales teams with solution architecture, estimation, technical presentations and customer discussions.

**Required Experience**

* Approximately **8–12\+ years of SAP technical/integration experience**, with significant experience in SAP cloud implementations.
* Strong hands\-on or architecture\-level experience with **SAP BTP**.
* Strong experience with **SAP Integration Suite / Cloud Integration (CPI)**.
* Strong understanding of **SAP SuccessFactors technical architecture and integrations**.
* Experience with **SAP IAS and IPS administration and implementation**.
* Experience designing enterprise\-level integrations between SAP and non\-SAP systems.
* Good knowledge of:
* REST APIs
* OData
* SOAP
* SFTP
* XML / JSON
* OAuth 2\.0
* SAML 2\.0
* OpenID Connect
* Certificates and encryption
* Understanding of cloud security, identity management and enterprise integration architecture.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex issues across application, integration, identity and network layers.

**Preferred Experience**  
Experience in several of the following areas would be advantageous:

* SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central
* SAP Employee Central Payroll
* SAP S/4HANA
* SAP Cloud Connector
* API Management
* SAP Build / BTP application development
* CAP / Java / Node.js
* SAP HANA Cloud
* Event\-driven architecture
* Microsoft Azure / Entra ID
* SmartRecruiters
* SAP Concur
* SAP Ariba
* SAP Analytics Cloud
* SAP Cloud ALM

SAP BTP, Integration Suite, SuccessFactors or related SAP certifications would be advantageous.

**Key Competencies**  
The successful candidate should demonstrate:

* Strong solution architecture capability
* Ability to see the **complete end\-to\-end technical landscape**, rather than an individual interface or application
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting capability
* Ability to challenge technical designs constructively
* Strong documentation and architecture\-diagramming skills
* Ability to communicate complex technical subjects clearly to customers and non\-technical stakeholders
* Strong ownership and accountability
* Ability to work across multiple projects simultaneously
* Ability to guide and mentor technical teams
* Customer\-facing consulting capability

**Role Expectation**  
This individual will function as the **Technical Architecture Authority for SAP cloud implementations**, particularly SuccessFactors\-led transformation programs.  
The architect is expected to ensure that:  
**SuccessFactors \+ BTP \+ Integration \+ Identity \+ Security \+ Extensions \+ External Systems**  
operate as one coherent enterprise architecture rather than as independently designed technical components.

 Josys, a dynamic B2B SaaS platform startup, has embarked on a mission to revolutionize IT operations globally, following an exceptional launch in Japan and securing $195 million in Series A and B funding. Our platform enables businesses to conquer the complexities of work\-from\-anywhere setups, rapid digital transformation, and the proliferation of SaaS applications by simplifying, optimizing, and securing their IT operations.
 



 With a presence in 9 countries, including Japan, India, and the USA, our cutting\-edge product technology center is located in Bengaluru, India. As we continue our rapid expansion, we aim to double our full\-time employee headcount in 2024, enhancing our capacity to innovate and deliver.
 



 Josys was spun off from RAKSUL, a celebrated Japanese unicorn and Forbes Startup of the Year 2018, which is renowned for driving transformation through three pioneering B2B e\-commerce platforms.

 We are seeking a skilled Full Stack Enterprise Software Architect to join our team and help us build innovative and scalable applications for Josys. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining full\-stack software that meet our company's business requirements and user needs.
 



 To be successful in this role, the candidate must have a strong understanding of software architecture and design principles, as well as experience working on SaaS applications. Additionally, the candidate MUST have experience with scaling applications and systems preferably working on building cloud native SaaS applications in 1→10 or 10→100 growth scenarios.

* Architect and design scalable, resilient, secure, and high\-performance cloud\-native SaaS platforms and distributed systems leveraging Node.js and modern microservices architectures.

* Partner with engineering and infrastructure teams to optimize cloud architecture, operational efficiency, system reliability, and platform cost management.

**Requirements / Qualifications:** 



* 10\+ years of experience in software engineering with at least 6 years in a hands\-on Architecture role designing and delivering scalable enterprise SaaS platforms.
* Proven experience architecting and building cloud\-native, SaaS applications capable of supporting high growth and large\-scale distributed workloads.
* Strong understanding of modern AI/ML concepts, including Generative AI, LLMs, NLP, embeddings, vector search, RAG, and AI orchestration patterns.
* Strong expertise in designing and implementing distributed systems, microservices architectures, RESTful APIs, GraphQL services, and event\-driven integration patterns.
* Extensive hands\-on experience with Node.js and related technologies for building scalable, reliable, and high\-performance systems.
* Deep understanding of cloud\-native architecture and experience working with AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, and modern container orchestration platforms.
* Experience driving platform engineering, Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC), and CI/CD automation initiatives using tools such as Terraform, Helm, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or equivalent technologies.
* Strong knowledge of relational and NoSQL database technologies, data modeling, indexing strategies, caching, and scalable data processing architectures.
* Experience designing secure enterprise systems with knowledge of authentication, authorization, encryption, secrets management, audit logging, and secure software development practices.
* Familiarity with enterprise security and compliance frameworks.
* Experience implementing observability, resiliency, fault tolerance, disaster recovery, and high\-availability architecture patterns for mission\-critical systems.
* Hands\-on experience building and managing integrations with third\-party SaaS platforms using SDKs, REST APIs, and secure data exchange mechanisms.
* Experience with Elasticsearch, search architecture, and scalable querying solutions is highly preferred.
* Exposure to Ruby on Rails, Golang, or additional backend technologies is a plus.

434f8906.description:
**About Suffolk:** 




 Suffolk is a national enterprise that builds, innovates, and invests. We provide value across the entire project lifecycle through our core construction management services and complementary business lines in real estate investment, design, self\-perform construction, and technology start\-up investment through Suffolk Technologies.
 



 With more than $10 billion in annual revenue and projects across healthcare, life sciences, higher education, mission critical, aviation, transportation, commercial, and other complex sectors, Suffolk is redefining how America builds through innovation, technology, and operational excellence.
 



  





**About Suffolk Global:** 




 Suffolk Global is a strategic extension of Suffolk Construction, established to unlock the full potential of a globally integrated delivery model. Based in Bangalore, India, Suffolk Global brings together world\-class talent, advanced technology, and innovative processes to enhance how Suffolk designs, plans, and builds.
 



 By partnering closely with teams across the United States, Suffolk Global will help drive quality, scalability, and innovation while creating new opportunities for technical professionals to contribute to some of the most complex construction projects in North America.
 



  





**About Digital Delivery:** 




 Suffolk is building the next generation of Digital Delivery capabilities to transform how buildings are designed, coordinated, and constructed. By combining Building Information Modeling (BIM), data\-driven workflows, automation, and emerging technologies, our goal is to create a more connected, efficient, and predictable project delivery process.
 



 As part of this vision, Suffolk Global is establishing a high\-performing Digital Delivery team in Bangalore that will partner directly with project teams across the United States. Together, we will develop scalable modeling standards, improve coordination workflows, enhance quality through digital reviews, and create innovative solutions that support some of the most complex construction projects in North America.
 



 This is an opportunity to help build a new capability from the ground up and play a leadership role in defining how Digital Delivery services are delivered globally.
 



  





**Title:** 
 Digital Delivery Lead
 



**Key Responsibilities:** 




**Delivery Leadership:** 



* Lead execution of Digital Delivery services across multiple concurrent projects.
* Coordinate project assignments, priorities, and workloads across Digital Delivery Engineers and Senior Digital Delivery Engineers.
* Monitor project schedules, deliverables, and resource requirements to ensure successful execution.
* Identify delivery risks and proactively develop mitigation strategies.
* Serve as an escalation point for technical and project delivery challenges.



  





**Team Leadership \& Development:** 



* Provide day\-to\-day leadership, coaching, and mentoring for Digital Delivery team members.
* Support onboarding and development of new staff.
* Conduct regular reviews of work quality and performance.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Support career development planning and technical skill growth across the team.



  





**Quality \& Standards Management:** 



* Ensure compliance with Suffolk Digital Delivery standards, workflows, and governance processes.
* Oversee QA/QC reviews across assigned projects.
* Monitor model quality, coordination performance, and deliverable consistency.
* Drive adoption of standards, templates, content libraries, and best practices.
* Review lessons learned and implement corrective actions where needed.



  





**Technical Oversight:** 



* Provide technical guidance related to BIM modeling, coordination, constructability analysis, and content development.
* Support resolution of complex technical issues and project challenges.
* Collaborate with Senior Digital Delivery Engineers to maintain standards and technical consistency.
* Ensure proper application of modeling workflows and coordination processes.



  





**Stakeholder Management:** 



* Collaborate with U.S.\-based project teams, Digital Delivery leadership, and project stakeholders.
* Support project planning and workload forecasting activities.
* Communicate project status, risks, resource needs, and delivery performance.
* Build strong working relationships across project and operational teams.



  





**Operational Excellence:** 



* Monitor team utilization and workload balancing.
* Support staffing and resource planning activities.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, quality, and delivery performance.
* Drive implementation of process improvements and operational best practices.
* Contribute to the growth and scalability of Suffolk Global's Digital Delivery organization.



  





**Required Qualifications:** 




**Education:** 



* Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, or related discipline.



  





**Experience:** 



* 8–12 years of experience in BIM, Digital Delivery, VDC, architecture, engineering, or construction technology.
* Demonstrated experience leading BIM delivery teams or coordination teams on complex building projects.
* Experience managing multiple concurrent projects and competing priorities.



  





**Technical Skills:** 



* Expert\-level proficiency in Autodesk Revit.
* Strong experience with BIM coordination and clash detection workflows.
* Deep understanding of BIM standards, model governance, QA/QC processes, and digital delivery best practices.
* Experience with BIM content development, template management, and standards implementation.
* Strong understanding of architectural, structural, and MEP systems.



  





**Leadership Skills:** 



* Proven ability to lead and develop technical teams.
* Strong organizational and planning skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
* Strong decision\-making and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Ability to balance technical quality with delivery commitments.



  





**Preferred Qualifications:** 



* Experience with Navisworks Manage.
* Experience with Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) or BIM 360\.
* Experience with point cloud and Scan\-to\-BIM workflows.
* Experience developing BIM standards and enterprise delivery processes.
* Experience supporting global or distributed project teams.



  





**Success Measures:** 




**A successful Digital Delivery Lead will:** 



* Deliver projects on schedule and in accordance with quality expectations.
* Maintain high levels of team productivity and utilization.
* Improve model quality, QA/QC performance, and coordination outcomes across projects.
* Successfully develop and mentor Digital Delivery team members.
* Ensure consistent adoption of Digital Delivery standards and workflows.
* Build strong partnerships with project teams and stakeholders.
* Contribute to the growth, scalability, and operational maturity of the Digital Delivery organization.

294b7048.title: V&V Program Manager
294b7048.description:
**Aerospace V\&V Program Manager / Project Manager**

**Experience**

**10\+ Years overall experience**  
**8–12 years in Aerospace V\&V, with 3–5 years in Project/Program Management**

**Location**

**Bangalore**

**Qualification**

* Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in **ECE, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering**, or a related field.
* **PMP certification** preferred/required as applicable.

**Job Overview**

We are looking for an experienced **Aerospace V\&V Program Manager** to lead end\-to\-end **Verification \& Validation (V\&V) programs** for safety\-critical aerospace systems.

The role will be responsible for managing project scope, schedules, deliverables, cost, risks, and multidisciplinary teams while ensuring compliance with aerospace safety and certification standards such as **DO\-178C, DO\-254, and ARP4754A**.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Program / Project Leadership**

* Define and manage **V\&V project scope, schedules, milestones, and deliverables**.
* Lead multidisciplinary engineering, quality, certification, and supplier teams.
* Ensure projects are delivered within agreed **time, cost, quality, and scope**.
* Track project progress, risks, dependencies, and mitigation plans.
* Manage customer requirements and ensure alignment with project objectives.

**Technical \& V\&V Oversight**

* Oversee **platform\-level Verification \& Validation activities**.
* Define and drive test strategies, automation, and certification readiness.
* Ensure complete **requirements\-to\-test traceability and test evidence**.
* Provide technical direction on V\&V processes for safety\-critical aerospace systems.
* Drive adoption of advanced approaches such as **AI\-driven test automation and Zero Touch V\&V**.

**Compliance \& Certification**

* Ensure adherence to aerospace standards including:
* **DO\-178B/C**
* **DO\-254**
* **ARP4754A**
* Support preparation of certification documentation/dossiers.
* Interface with certification authorities and support **SOI audits**.
* Lead risk assessment and mitigation activities for safety\-critical systems.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Act as the primary interface with **customers, senior leadership, suppliers, partners, and regulatory stakeholders**.
* Present project status, risks, issues, and mitigation plans to senior management.
* Coordinate with suppliers and partners to ensure successful integrated V\&V delivery.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Drive digital transformation initiatives within V\&V.
* Explore **digital twins and model\-based evidence** approaches.
* Identify opportunities for cost optimization and process improvements.
* Mentor engineering teams on aerospace V\&V best practices.

**Mandatory Skills**

* Strong experience in **Aerospace V\&V / Verification \& Validation**.
* Strong knowledge of **DO\-178B/C**.
* Experience with **DO\-254**.
* Knowledge of **ARP4754A**.
* Strong understanding of **V\&V and software/hardware development processes**.
* Experience in **platform\-level V\&V**, not just application\-level testing.
* Project/Program Management experience in complex engineering environments.
* Proficiency in **Microsoft Project** for project planning and scheduling.
* Experience creating management dashboards using **Tableau or Power BI**.
* Awareness of **Earned Value Management (EVM)**.
* Strong risk management and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Experience**

* **PMP certification**.
* Experience managing **safety\-critical aerospace programs**.
* Experience working with certification authorities and **SOI audits**.
* Exposure to **AI\-driven testing, test automation, digital twins, and model\-based engineering**.
* Experience managing large, multidisciplinary and multi\-stakeholder programs.

**Key Candidate Profile**

**Aerospace V\&V \| DO\-178C \| DO\-254 \| ARP4754A \| Project/Program Management \| Platform\-Level V\&V \| PMP \| Microsoft Project \| Tableau/Power BI \| Earned Value Management \| Safety\-Critical Systems \| Certification \| Risk Management**

**Important:** The strongest candidates should have **both Aerospace V\&V technical experience and hands\-on Project/Program Management experience**, rather than being purely functional/project managers.

Pay: ₹1,000,000\.00 \- ₹1,200,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

991818f6.title: Senior Manager- AI Strategy & Solutions
991818f6.description:
**About Our Company**


Ameriprise India LLP has been providing client based financial solutions to help clients plan and achieve their financial objectives for 20 years. We are part of Ameriprise Financial Inc., a US financial planning company headquartered in Minneapolis with a global presence and diversified financial services leader with more than $1\.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year\-end 2024\. The firm’s focus areas include Asset Management and Advice, Retirement Planning and Insurance Protection.


Be part of an inclusive, collaborative culture that rewards you for your contributions, and work with other talented individuals who share your passion for doing great work. You’ll also have plenty of opportunities to make your mark at the office and a difference in your community. So, if you're talented, driven and want to work for a strong, ethical company that cares, take the next step and create a career at Ameriprise India LLP.

**Job Description**


Integral role in supporting AIM’s data analysis, system control, and database needs. Provide strategic ideas and thought leadership. Has/can apply solid financial industry data systems knowledge to support decision and strategy problems in key business areas. Demonstrates strong technical/problem solving skills. Manages multiple projects collaboratively. Works with HR in recruitment and performance appraisal process. Mentor the team members and layout their growth path.**Role Summary**


Leads the execution and operationalization of enterprise AI initiatives, ensuring AI strategy is translated into scalable, business\-impacting solutions. Partners across business and technology teams to drive delivery, adoption, and measurable outcomes, while maintaining strong alignment to enterprise priorities and governance. Acts as a senior program leader with end\-to\-end accountability for execution, value realization, and executive alignment across priority AI initiatives

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\) Enterprise AI Execution \& Operationalization:** Translate enterprise AI strategy into actionable roadmaps, delivery plans, and implementation milestones**.** Drive end\-to\-end execution of priority AI initiatives across multiple business areas. Ensure AI solutions move from concept to pilot to scaled deployment, and ultimately to sustained adoption. Own delivery outcomes across initiatives, including scope, timelines, and measurable business impact.

**2\) Program \& Portfolio Delivery:** Lead a portfolio of AI use cases and programs across the enterprise. Establish and manage delivery discipline (prioritization, dependencies, timelines, risk mitigation). Ensure outcomes are tied to clear business value (e.g., productivity, growth, cost, risk). Drive integrated program plans, track KPIs and milestones, and proactively manage risks, dependencies, and execution challenges, escalating as needed.

**3\) Cross\-Enterprise Partnership** Partner with Business leaders across functions, Technology, Data \& Analytics team, and Risk, Legal, and Governance teams.Align stakeholders around what gets delivered and how, while shaping execution priorities and ensuring alignment to enterprise AI strategy. Engage senior leaders, including ELT stakeholders, to drive alignment, inform decision\-making, and ensure transparency on progress, risks, and outcomes. Act as a clear point of accountability for progress and results.

**4\) Technical \& Solution Leadership:** Provide informed direction on AI/ML and GenAI solutions to ensure fit\-for\-purpose design.Bridge strategy and execution by helping teams define use cases, select appropriate approaches/models, and ensure scalability and integration. Stay current on emerging AI capabilities and translate into practical application.

**5\) Adoption, Change \& Value Realization:** Drive business adoption of AI solutions, not just delivery. Define metrics and success measures and track realization of expected outcomes. Partner with HR / change / comms teams to support workflow integration and behavior change. Ensure value realization is clearly defined, tracked, and communicated, with a focus on measurable outcomes.

**6\) Governance \& Responsible AI:** Ensure adherence to enterprise AI governance, risk, and compliance frameworks. Operationalize responsible AI practices (e.g., transparency, fairness, controls). Support approval processes and risk assessments for AI deployments. Ensure alignment to the enterprise AI operating model, embedding best practices across data, technology, risk, talent, and change management.

**7\) Matrix Team Leadership:** Lead through influence and build strong execution capability and accountability across a broad cross\-functional team. Create consistency in delivery methodologies and standards. Foster a high\-performance, results\-oriented environment; drive clarity, accountability, and continuous improvement across teams.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent
* 8–10\+ years in AI, data/analytics, digital, or large\-scale transformation (preferably experience in strategy consulting)
* Demonstrated success in operating with an enterprise mindset and delivering complex, cross\-functional initiatives
* Strong understanding of: AI/ML and GenAI applications, data platforms and enterprise technology environments

* Proven ability to exercise sound judgment, make timely decisions, and navigate ambiguity confidently
* Experience leading large\-scale programs or transformation initiatives with clear accountability for outcomes
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to use data to inform decisions and optimize execution

**Preferred**

* Background balancing technical depth with program leadership
